2025-04.daily_overview: Work was paused for the Qingming Festival. Ye Mingxuan and his father completed the solemn family tomb-sweeping ceremony, and through his father's recollections of family history, he felt the weight of heritage. In the afternoon, father and son strolled through the antique market and unexpectedly picked up a Xuantong Tongbao coin for 80 yuan, adding a collector's memento to this Qingming Festival.

events.name: On the morning of Qingming Festival, prepared for tomb sweeping with my father.
events.description: Early in the morning as dawn broke, Ye Mingxuan and his father Ye Jianguo gathered the items needed for tomb sweeping in the living room: the fruit, pastries, incense, and candles his mother had prepared in advance, as well as a shovel and a new bag of soil taken from the balcony storage cabinet. As his father packed the items into a canvas bag, he reminded his son to check the lighter and the wine flask. The cool spring rain had stopped, and the air was full of the smell of earth.

events.name: Tomb sweeping at the ancestral grave and passing on family stories.
events.description: Father and son drove to the family ancestral graves in Xiqing District. Ye Mingxuan first cleared the weeds on the grave mound, then, under his father's guidance, arranged the offerings and lit incense and candles. His father Ye Jianguo stood under an old pine tree and, in a terse tone, told the story of how several generations had migrated here from Hebei and put down roots through turbulent times. When he grew emotional, he silently handed over a handful of fresh soil. Ye Mingxuan understood, knelt before the grave, and carefully sprinkled the soil over it. After the rain, sunlight broke through the clouds, and the atmosphere was solemn yet warm.

events.name: Came across a Xuantong Tongbao coin at an antique stall in Yangliuqing.
events.description: After tomb sweeping, it was still early, so Ye Mingxuan suggested going to the antique stall market in Yangliuqing Town nearby. Drawing on knowledge from online exchanges with collector friend Zhao Jianguo and from lectures, he spotted at an inconspicuous stall a Xuantong Tongbao coin with clear inscriptions and an old patina. After squatting down to examine it closely and rubbing it with his fingertips to confirm the texture, he bargained unhurriedly and finally closed the deal at 80 yuan. The stall owner smiled and said the coin had been sitting at the bottom of a box for a long time, and that it was fate during Qingming.

events.name: Go home, organize ancient coins, and record reflections
events.description: In the evening, when he got home, Ye Mingxuan carefully wiped the loose dirt off the coin with a soft cotton cloth dipped in a little clean water, then dried it with a dry cloth, and carefully placed it into the modern machine-struck coin section of his collection album. He also wrote in his phone notes the story of finding it during Qingming and the key identification points. Looking at this small bronze coin that had traveled through time, he was moved by the invisible combination of family heritage and his collecting hobby.

start_state.location: Home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Solemn, with reverence for ancestors

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Calm and content, with family affection and the joy of collecting intertwined.

2025-04.daily_overview: The new week began with detailed design work. Ye Mingxuan optimized details such as chamfers and wall thicknesses of the connectors and verified them with manual calculations, then moved on to formal AutoCAD engineering drawing. In the evening, he went to Master Qian's place to study woodworking, finding tranquility in traditional craftsmanship, but the late-night snack his mother prepared caused a slight fluctuation in his weight.

events.name: Optimize connector design and hand-check critical cross-sections.
events.description: In the morning, as soon as he sat down, Ye Mingxuan opened the 3D model saved last Friday. He first adjusted the transition fillet radius at the root of the connector to reduce stress concentration, then fine-tuned the wall thickness of two reinforcing ribs. After modifying the model, he took out last week's handwritten calculation draft and recalculated the bending stress, shear stress, and bearing stress one by one. Only after confirming that the safety factor was above 1.5 did he save the final draft shape.

events.name: Use AutoCAD to draw three-view drawings and add dimension annotations.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan started drawing formal part engineering drawings in AutoCAD based on the optimized 3D model. He first drew the main view outline, then projected the top view and left view, and finally added the necessary section views to show the internal structure. All linear dimensions, diameters, and angles were labeled one by one on the drawing. After staring at the screen for three hours, he stood up and stretched his waist.

events.name: In the evening, learn mortise-and-tenon joinery from carpenter master Qian Jianguo
events.description: After getting off work and returning home, he quickly finished the dinner his mother had left for him. Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike to the workshop in the backyard of Master Qian's house. Tonight's task was to repair a loose tenon on an old elm dining table. Master Qian first demonstrated how to carefully disassemble the old tenon with a flat chisel and a wooden mallet, then taught Ye Mingxuan how to reinforce it with the same kind of wood. In over two hours, wood shavings scattered all over the floor, and he felt that his understanding of "interference fit" had extended from metal to wood.

events.name: The late-night snack prepared by my mother caused me to exceed my calorie limit for the evening.
events.description: Returning home at nearly ten o'clock, his mother brought out a bowl of her specialty tomato and egg noodles. Ye Mingxuan wasn't hungry, but he was too embarrassed to refuse, so he ate while briefly chatting about his woodworking progress. Although this bowl of noodles caused a deficit in his daily calorie record, looking at his mother's gentle smile, he felt warm.

Based on yesterday's three-view drawings, Ye Mingxuan spent the whole day adding geometric tolerances, surface roughness, and technical notes, aiming to ensure that the downstream stages of the design documents would not have any errors. The evening personal training session went on as usual, but there was a slight soreness in his lower back, and the trainer suggested pausing some movements.

events.name: Refinement of engineering drawing annotations and technical requirements
events.description: Ye Mingxuan's main focus today was almost entirely on the details of the engineering drawings. Referring to the mechanical design manual and internal company standards, he added coaxiality tolerances to the bearing mounting holes, marked flatness on the sealing surfaces, and specified surface roughness values for the different machined surfaces one by one. The technical requirements section in the lower right corner was also densely filled with heat treatment requirements, unspecified chamfers, and deburring instructions. After annotating each view, he checked it repeatedly, showing his ISTJ personality's pursuit of precision to the full.

events.name: Had a brief discussion with simulation colleague Li Xiang about boundary conditions.
events.description: In the afternoon, Li Xiang came to Ye Mingxuan's workstation to ask his opinion on the load spectrum and constraint method that needed to be set for the connector in subsequent simulations. The two exchanged views for ten minutes over the drawings and 3D model, and finally decided to first perform linear static analysis under the most severe working condition, and then add fatigue verification later.

events.name: Evening personal training strength session; slight discomfort in the lower back
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan went to the gym as usual for Wang Jian's personal training session. Today's training focused on glutes, legs, and core, including deadlifts, weighted lunges, and hanging leg raises. During light-weight deadlifts, he felt a brief soreness in his lower back, but it did not affect his form. Wang Jian noticed it and immediately had him reduce the weight, used a fascia ball to relax his erector spinae muscles, and suggested he add more core stability training.

events.name: Before bed, apply a hot towel to the lower back and log the discomfort

After showering, he applied a hot towel for ten minutes and briefly noted in his phone's memo app how today's training felt and where the discomfort was, deciding to consult a family doctor if it continued to worsen.

In the evening, he launched the long-planned Python ancient coin crawler project, from analyzing the website structure to completing the environment setup, taking the first key step toward data-driven collecting. The excitement of coding late at night delayed his sleep.

events.name: Import the 3D model into ANSYS and set up simulation preprocessing
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan exported the completed model to a common format on the engineering computer and then imported it into ANSYS Workbench. Following his study notes, he set the material (alloy steel), generated a tetrahedral mesh, applied fixed constraints at the bolt holes, and applied loads on the bearing surface. Since it was his first time completing the entire preprocessing independently, he communicated with Li Xiang several times about mesh density, and finally succeeded in saving a solvable model.

events.name: In the evening, analyzed ancient coin trading websites and set up a web scraping environment.
events.description: After showering in the evening, Ye Mingxuan sat down in his study, logged into the ancient coin trading website he often visited, carefully analyzed the URL patterns and HTML structure of the list and detail pages, and sketched out the crawler workflow on paper. Then, in the command line, he installed libraries such as requests, BeautifulSoup, and csv, and successfully wrote a small test code that fetched the title information from the homepage. The smooth setup of the environment made him look forward to the full-scale crawl.

events.name: Excited about the crawler test, went to bed half an hour late.
events.description: He had planned to go to bed at 23:00, but after the test code ran, new ideas kept popping up. He debugged for another 45 minutes until he managed to scrape all the information from a list page, then closed his laptop with reluctance. Lying in bed, his mind was still replaying the webpage structure, and he tossed and turned for more than twenty minutes before falling asleep.

2025-04.daily_overview: A day of technical breakthroughs alongside body warning signs. The lower back soreness became noticeable after several hours of work, and Ye Mingxuan could only tough it out by adjusting his sitting posture. In the evening, however, he successfully cracked the ancient-coin crawler script and received remote guidance from Xu Ming, taking his coding ability to the next level. But the back discomfort intensified his anxiety.

events.name: Lower back soreness worsened; self-monitored and adjusted sitting posture.
events.description: Starting a little after 10 a.m., the lower back soreness that had been building up over several days became distinct and persistent, especially after long periods of sitting while drawing. Ye Mingxuan realized this was more than ordinary fatigue. He got up, did a few stretches in the break room, adjusted the lumbar support on his chair to its most protruding position, and asked a colleague to find an unused soft cushion. He decided to monitor it on his own first, and to contact his family doctor if it hadn't improved by the weekend.

events.name: Submitted the simulation calculation and resolved the convergence issue.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan opened the model saved yesterday and clicked Solve. The initial calculation diverged due to mesh distortion, so following Li Xiang's suggestion, he refined the mesh in the area around the hole and slightly adjusted the minimum element size. After resubmitting, the solver gradually converged. After more than ten minutes of iteration, the stress contour appeared, and he saved the preliminary result with a screenshot.

events.name: In the evening, wrote and successfully ran the ancient coin trading crawler script.
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan officially wrote the crawler according to the previous day's strategy. He set request headers to disguise it as a browser and wrote logic to parse the list and detail pages. On the first test, the website returned a 403 error. Not discouraged, he added Referer and Cookie to the request headers and successfully retrieved the data. He then ran it over the full dataset, scraping the names, prices, eras, and other information of nearly a hundred ancient coins, and saved them as a CSV file.

events.name: Send the code to programming peer Xu Ming for optimization suggestions
events.description: After the script ran successfully, Ye Mingxuan could not contain his excitement and immediately sent the core code and output files to Xu Ming in Shenzhen via WeChat, along with the problems he encountered. Half an hour later, Xu Ming replied with detailed comments, pointing out that the request header disguise could be further improved, and reminding him to add try-except to prevent a single page exception from interrupting the full crawl. He also gave several specific changes to streamline the code structure.

events.name: Optimized scripts based on feedback and organized the practical logs.
events.description: Ye Mingxuan implemented Xu Ming's suggestions one by one: he added more thorough exception handling, optimized the request header parameters, and refactored a lengthy parsing function. After the tests passed, he organized the final script, scraped data, and the problems and solutions into his personal technical log, with the folder named Ancient Coin Feature Database_phase1.

He immediately increased the transition fillet there in CAD and added an auxiliary support boss on the back. After the modification, he re-imported it into ANSYS for verification; the second calculation showed that the stress concentration was significantly alleviated and the safety factor met the requirement.

After the call, Ye Mingxuan immediately organized the key ideas and made an initial modular split of the crawler script.

Ye Mingxuan looked at his father's slightly graying temples, drank it silently, and resolved to go see a doctor the next day.

2025-04.daily_overview: Back pain prompted Ye Mingxuan to book a family doctor appointment in the morning, but an invitation from his childhood friend Zhang Wei, who had just started a new job, gave him a novel test-drive experience. From the hospital appointment to testing a Tesla, the two completely different rhythms made him temporarily forget his discomfort. After the test drive, he discussed the integration of software and hardware with Zhang Wei, and began to consider buying a car in the future—but that collided with the reality of saving money and paying off the mortgage.

events.name: Contacted the family doctor via WeChat to book a Sunday morning outpatient appointment.
events.description: When he woke up on Saturday morning, the discomfort in his lower back still had not noticeably eased. Ye Mingxuan hesitated no longer and left a message to Dr. Liu Wentao via WeChat describing his symptoms. He quickly received a reply recommending that he come to the Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center on Sunday morning, with an appointment set for 9:30. After the appointment was successfully made, he let out a slight sigh of relief.

events.name: At the invitation of his childhood friend Zhang Wei, went to the Tesla Experience Center for a test drive
events.description: Almost at the same time as booking a doctor's appointment, his old friend Zhang Wei, who had just joined the Tesla experience store in Tianjin, sent a WeChat message warmly inviting Ye Mingxuan to test-drive a Model 3 at the store as one of the first friends he would host. Ye Mingxuan checked the route and replied that he would arrive at 2 p.m. In the afternoon, he took the subway to the experience center in Xiqing District, where Zhang Wei was already waiting at the door in his work uniform. Zhang Wei first walked him around the car, explaining the minimalist exterior, hidden door handles, and smart cockpit. Then he put on a temporary license plate and accompanied him for a drive along the city roads. Ye Mingxuan paid particular attention to the instant torque of the electric car and the smoothness of the assisted driving system.

events.name: After the test drive, had an in-depth discussion with Zhang Wei on "mechanics and software"
events.description: After the test drive, they returned to the lounge area of the showroom. Each holding an Americano, they talked from the mechanical precision of traditional cars to Tesla's software-defined approach. From an engineer's perspective, Ye Mingxuan emphasized that physical reliability is fundamental, while Zhang Wei presented the ecosystem vision of OTA upgrades and remote diagnostics. They went back and forth with a few arguments and then laughed heartily, ultimately agreeing that deep integration of software and hardware is the trend. Ye Mingxuan joked that once his mortgage becomes stable, he might consider letting his pure mechanical faith embrace a bit of Silicon Valley genes.

events.name: Returning home in the evening, recording test drive impressions and worrying about the car purchase budget
events.description: Back home, Ye Mingxuan took out his notebook and wrote down in detail the test drive highlights, from powertrain response and interior quietness to assisted driving performance. He also wrote in red ink a marginal note about how "software-defined vehicles" might impact his mechanical design work. But when he opened his mobile banking app and saw his balance, he remembered the mortgage he was about to sign. He silently crossed out "short-term car purchase" in the corner of the notebook and wrote "long-term goal" next to it.

start_state.location: Home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Lower back discomfort caused mild irritability, but I remained curious about new things

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: The excitement of the new experience temporarily overshadowed his physical discomfort, but he still felt a hint of nervousness about tomorrow's doctor's appointment; financial reality kept him grounded.
