2025-04.daily_overview: In the morning, he went to the hospital and was diagnosed with mild lumbar muscle strain, and began systematic physical therapy; in the afternoon, he slowed down and strolled through the flower and bird market, adding a few adorable succulents to the balcony. The diagnosis actually put Ye Mingxuan at ease, because he knew what to do. In the evening, he communicated with his coach and decided to adjust the training plan.

events.name: Visited the community health service center, was diagnosed with lumbar muscle strain, and received the first physical therapy treatment
events.description: Ye Mingxuan arrived at Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center at the scheduled time and registered for a general practice appointment with Dr. Liu Wentao. Dr. Liu carefully conducted a physical examination, asked about his recent sitting and exercise habits, and diagnosed mild lumbar muscle strain. He explained that it was caused by long-term poor sitting posture combined with insufficient core and lower back strength during training, and prescribed three sessions of low-frequency pulsed electrical stimulation therapy, once a week. Ye Mingxuan received the first treatment on the spot in the therapy room. The electrode pads were placed against his lumbar muscles and released a comfortable current; after 20 minutes, the tension noticeably eased. He immediately scheduled the remaining two sessions.

events.name: Following the doctor's advice, added a stretching and core exercise plan during work breaks.
events.description: After the consultation, Ye Mingxuan sat on a bench in the corridor and wrote down Dr. Liu's core rehabilitation advice in his phone's memo app: every 45 minutes of sitting, he must stand up and do extension and lateral flexion stretches, and do core muscle training such as planks during lunch break and in the evening. He also thought about contacting his fitness coach Wang Jian as soon as possible to adjust the training content and pause heavy deadlifts and squats.

events.name: Visit the flower and bird market in the afternoon to buy succulents.
events.description: After his nap, Ye Mingxuan felt fairly refreshed and walked to the flower and bird market in Zhongbei Town. He browsed several stores he frequented, carefully examining the condition of each succulent. In the end, he chose a Bear's Paw, a jade-like Haworthia with translucent leaves, and a variegated Echeveria. He also bought a small clay pot with good breathability. When paying with his phone, he deliberately glanced at the bill; compared with the pressure of the monthly mortgage payment, this little joy was still within budget.

events.name: Go home to repot the succulents and record key care points
events.description: Back at home, Ye Mingxuan spread newspapers on the balcony plant stand and put on gardening gloves. He carefully removed three succulents from their original plastic pots, shook off the old soil, trimmed the dead roots, then placed clay pebbles at the bottom of new ceramic pots, filled them with granular soil, and planted the succulents firmly. Finally, he used tweezers to spread kanuma soil on the surface. He numbered each pot in order in his notebook and wrote down the names, watering and sunlight habits, planning to observe the growth changes in the future.

events.name: Communicated with coach Wang Jian via WeChat to pause high-intensity training.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan sent the diagnosis results to his coach Wang Jian via WeChat. After a brief discussion, they decided to change both private training sessions next Monday and Wednesday to rehabilitation training, focusing mainly on core stability exercises, upper limb stretching, and low-intensity aerobics, while avoiding any weighted lower-back movements. Wang Jian also recommended a few bird-dog and dead bug exercises that he could do at home.

start_state.location: Home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Anxious about the medical consultation results, but ready to face them.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Peace of mind after the cause was identified, the small horticultural joy brought by succulents calmed his mood, and the training adjustments gave him a sense of professional support.

state.daily_exercise: Rehabilitation stretching after physiotherapy; tried a 30-second plank for 2 sets and bird-dog exercises.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy

2025-04.daily_overview: Colleague Zhou Tao officially revealed that he was leaving his job to start a business, which gave Ye Mingxuan quite a psychological shock. He proactively communicated with Wang Peng to take on more tasks, and meanwhile began a systematic handover. When alone in the evening, he re-examined his career planning and incorporated lumbar rehabilitation stretching into his work breaks. Under considerable stress, he had a video chat with Wang Lei in Shenzhen for about 40 minutes in the evening, which slightly eased his gloom.

events.name: Proactively communicated with project manager Wang Peng about the follow-up division of work.
events.description: Early in the morning after arriving at the company, Ye Mingxuan vaguely sensed rumors that Zhou Tao was leaving from casual chat in the break room. He immediately organized the current project progress and proactively went to Wang Peng's office. Wang Peng confirmed the news and frankly said he hoped Ye Mingxuan would take over part of the design work for the intelligent warehousing subsystem. Faced with the sudden expansion of responsibilities, Ye Mingxuan felt pressure, but also saw it as an opportunity to accumulate capital for promotion.

events.name: Zhou Tao candidly told him about his resignation and startup plans on the rooftop
events.description: During the lunch break, Zhou Tao called Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang to the company rooftop. In the warm spring breeze, Zhou Tao solemnly announced that he had planned to resign and would devote himself fully to starting a venture in intelligent warehousing. He explained the timeline in detail and went through the handover of technical documents, key design parameters, and remaining issues one by one. Although Ye Mingxuan had sensed it coming, he still felt a sense of loss because the team was losing a close working partner.

events.name: Discuss the handover and follow-up collaboration with Li Xiang
events.description: Coming down from the rooftop, Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang each got a cup of coffee in the break room. In lowered voices, they discussed how the project responsibilities might change after Zhou Tao's departure. They decided that Ye Mingxuan would first thoroughly review the subsystem design documents that Zhou Tao had been responsible for, while Li Xiang would familiarize himself with the related simulation models in advance. They agreed to complete an internal pre-handover within the week to reduce the impact when Zhou Tao officially leaves.

events.name: Reflect on career path and adjust promotion plan in the evening.
events.description: After returning home and eating dinner, Ye Mingxuan shut himself in his study. Zhou Tao's decision to start a business was like a stone thrown into a calm lake. He opened the "Career Development" Excel spreadsheet on his computer, fine-tuned his recent skill gaps and time allocation, and listed system-level simulation capability and project management awareness as the priorities for the next stage.

events.name: Persisted with lower back stretching and core activation during lunch breaks and after work.
events.description: The diagnosis of lumbar muscle strain made Ye Mingxuan no longer dare to ignore his body's signals. He set a countdown timer every 45 minutes on his computer; whenever it went off, he went to an empty workstation to do back extension and lateral flexion. During the lunch break, he did planks and bird-dog exercises on a yoga mat in the break room. Before bed, he also applied a hot towel to his lower back for ten minutes. These small habits were gradually becoming part of his daily routine.

events.name: Video call with middle school classmate Wang Lei to relieve stress.
events.description: In the evening, after finishing his rehabilitation exercises, Ye Mingxuan made a WeChat video call to Wang Lei in Shenzhen. The two talked about their work pressures, and Wang Lei also revealed that his team had just undergone a reorganization. Ye Mingxuan poured out his feelings about the impact of his colleague's resignation, and Wang Lei, speaking from experience, comforted him: 'Change is also an opportunity.' After hanging up, Ye Mingxuan felt that the weight on his chest had been greatly relieved.

start_state.location: Home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Strong work rhythm, but a faint unease brought by team changes.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: Determined after deep thought; although disappointed by the change, he decided to turn pressure into motivation, and an old friend's comfort put him at ease.

state.daily_exercise: Lower back rehabilitation stretches, 30-second plank × 3 sets, bird-dog pose, and try the dead bug in the evening.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny

2025-04.daily_overview: A major turning point in life. In the morning, I completed the preliminary work handover arrangements. In the afternoon, accompanied by my father, I formally signed the home purchase contract and arranged a combined loan, shouldering a large mortgage for the first time. In the evening, I shopped for a 3D printer and canceled the May Day trip to cover the monthly mortgage payment. Life suddenly entered a tightening phase. Because I was running around handling procedures, I only briefly completed the waist rehabilitation exercises.

events.name: Met with Wang Peng and confirmed taking over the intelligent warehousing subtask.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Ye Mingxuan met with project manager Wang Peng on time. Wang Peng formally assigned to Ye Mingxuan the design tasks for the conveyor drive module and some structural parts of the intelligent warehousing subsystem, allowed him to consult Gao Zhiyuan directly during the transition period, and promised to coordinate resources. Ye Mingxuan signed the meeting minutes, fully aware that this extra workload would be an important advantage in the promotion assessment.

events.name: Conduct technical documentation and module handover with Zhou Tao.
events.description: At 10:30, Ye Mingxuan and Zhou Tao found a small meeting room and went through the handover item by item according to the checklist. Zhou Tao opened the hard drive and copied all the related 3D models, simulation analysis reports, technical emails exchanged with suppliers, and unfinished pending items to Ye Mingxuan one by one, explaining the original design intent of some non-standard parts item by item. Ye Mingxuan simultaneously drew a key handover roadmap in his notebook.

events.name: Go with his father to the real estate transaction center to sign the home purchase contract.
events.description: At 1:30 in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan took half a day off and, together with his father Ye Jianguo, brought a full set of documents including ID cards, income certificates, provident fund deposit certificates, and down payment receipts, and went to the Xiqing District Real Estate Transaction Center. Accompanied by the bank account manager and the agent, he formally signed the "Tianjin Existing Housing Sales Contract" with the seller, with a transaction price of 2.1 million yuan and a down payment of 900,000 yuan. At the moment he signed his name, Ye Mingxuan felt the weight of the pen tip.

events.name: Submit a combined provident fund and commercial loan application.
events.description: After signing the contract, the father and son submitted a combined loan application at the transaction center's loan window: 600,000 yuan of provident fund loan plus 600,000 yuan of commercial loan, with a 30-year term and equal principal and interest payments. The bank staff verified the materials on the spot and entered them into the system, indicating a monthly payment of about 4,200 yuan. Ye Mingxuan quickly deducted the amount from his monthly salary in his mind, a thin sweat forming on his forehead.

events.name: Decided to cancel the planned May Day trip due to mortgage pressure.
events.description: After completing all the formalities, while sitting on a rest chair in the transaction center waiting for his father to come back from the restroom, Ye Mingxuan opened the calculator on his phone and repeatedly calculated his future monthly income and expenses. He realized that the travel budget would be largely swallowed up by the monthly mortgage payment. He thought it over and decided to cancel the planned May Day self-driving trip, keeping only a simple meal gathering in Tianjin. But considering that the mortgage payment had not yet been deducted and the financial tightening had not officially begun, he decided to formally tell Sun Jing only after the first mortgage deduction; for now, it was just a decision he had made in his own mind.

events.name: Ordered an entry-level 3D printer in the evening.
events.description: After returning home and having a simple dinner, Ye Mingxuan sat in his study, opened JD.com, and browsed the Creality Ender-3 V2 entry-level 3D printer he had saved for a long time. Despite the monthly payment pressure, he repeatedly checked his deposit balance and felt that this 3,500 yuan investment could provide long-term support for woodworking part prototyping and design verification. In the end, he placed the order, along with several rolls of PLA filament and common tools. At that moment, he bought himself a future possibility of production.

events.name: Do simple waist rehabilitation exercises before bed
events.description: After standing and rushing around for a long time in the afternoon, his lower back felt sore and swollen again. Before bed, Ye Mingxuan spread a thin blanket on the bedroom floor, did two sets of planks and several sets of cat-cow poses, and rolled his back with a foam roller, ensuring that his recovery was not interrupted by a busy schedule.

start_state.location: Home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.
start_state.mood: Determined to take on the dual challenges of work and life

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin
end_state.mood: The excitement of successfully buying a house was intertwined with the oppressive weight of the monthly mortgage, making it hard to fall asleep, but completing the rehabilitation exercises brought some relief.

state.daily_exercise: Lower back rehabilitation stretching: plank 30 seconds × 2 sets, cat-cow pose, foam roller relaxation

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, temperature 12-22°C, gentle spring breeze.

2025-04.daily_overview: A key day for advancing the home-buying process, with efficient switching between work and family. In the morning, he submitted the design drawings and underwent the technical review. In the afternoon, he sorted out Zhou Tao's departure handover documents. After work, he completed the 900,000 yuan down payment transfer and tax payment with his father. The day shuttled between two major matters. Although he did not do dedicated exercise, the cycling commute and trips to and from the bank consumed considerable energy. He was tired before bed but felt at peace because the milestones had moved forward.

events.name: Submit the robotic arm connector design drawings and undergo the technical review.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ye Mingxuan submitted the repeatedly revised design drawings and simulation report for the key connecting parts of the robotic arm to Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan and Manager Wang Peng. During the technical discussion, Senior Engineer Gao pointed out a deviation in the tolerance marking and suggested recalculating according to the ISO 2768 standard; Wang Peng affirmed the overall approach and urged Ye Mingxuan to quickly benchmark against Li Xiang's simulation results so that prototype trial production could begin. Ye Mingxuan noted down the revisions in detail and promised to complete the corrections the same day.

events.name: Modify tolerances according to review comments and update the drawing version
events.description: After the meeting, Ye Mingxuan immediately recalculated the tolerance chain in SolidWorks. After referring to the ISO 2768-mK standard, he adjusted the tolerance callout from ±0.05mm to ±0.03mm and made linked corrections to the associated mating surfaces. At noon, he quickly ate the homemade chicken breast and brown rice bento at his workstation, used the lunch break to finish updating the drawings, uploaded version V3.2 to the PLM system, and notified it for review.

events.name: Finalize Zhou Tao's departure handover document and produce the official version
events.description: At 2 p.m., focused on organizing the handover documents, arranging the smart warehousing subsystem tasks by priority, and detailing completed modules, key technical points in progress, unresolved interface issues, and debugging notes. To make it easier for the successor, I specifically added comments on key parameters and a troubleshooting flowchart. Before leaving work, I saved the final PDF and source files to the department shared folder and copied Gao Zhiyuan and Wang Peng.

events.name: Schedule lower back physiotherapy and discuss a fitness rehabilitation plan
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., he contacted family doctor Liu Wentao via WeChat to confirm the two low-frequency pulse physiotherapy sessions on April 20 and 27. He then sent a message to coach Wang Jian explaining the diagnosis of lumbar muscle strain and the doctor's advice. Wang Jian replied that he would adjust the upcoming training: adding core stability exercises such as planks and bird dogs, reducing weighted squats and deadlifts, and agreed to provide movement guidance at the next session.

events.name: Paid the down payment for the home purchase together with Father and paid the taxes and fees.
events.description: After getting off work at 6 p.m., I cycled home and handled the funds together with my father, Ye Jianguo. I transferred 300,000 yuan from my personal savings account, and my father transferred 600,000 yuan from the family account, for a total of 900,000 yuan into the fund supervision account. Then father and son went to a bank branch near the property transaction center and paid about 23,000 yuan in transfer fees such as deed tax and stamp duty at the self-service terminal. After Ye Jianguo checked each receipt, he sat quietly for a moment on the stone steps at the bank entrance and said calmly, "The formalities are done; the house is secure."

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but with a clear goal — today he needs to complete the down payment transfer for the house purchase and the design drawing review. The two major matters overlapping make him tense yet filled with a sense of efficiency.

end_state.mood: Fatigue mixed with a sense of solidity — the 900,000 yuan down payment was successfully transferred, taxes were paid, the design drawings were revised, and the handover documents were formally finalized. Multiple key matters were advanced in one day. Lying in bed, although his lower back was sore, he felt at peace.

state.daily_exercise: Due to a packed schedule, he did not exercise specifically, but he rode an electric bike back and forth between the bank and the trading center, covering about 8 kilometers in total, and walked intermittently for about 5,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature 14-24°C, bright sunshine

2025-04.daily_overview: The legal closing day for the home purchase was also the day of the formal work handover with Zhou Tao. In the morning, he went through the task list item by item in the meeting room with his soon-to-depart colleague; in the afternoon, he completed the entire process with the seller at the Real Estate Registration Center and received the property certificate bearing his own name. From his workstation to the certificate counter, he completed a dual confirmation of his identity. In the evening, after returning home, he briefly reviewed the entire home-buying process with his father and made clear notes for the future.

events.name: Conduct a formal face-to-face work handover with Zhou Tao.
events.description: At 9:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan and Zhou Tao held a formal handover in the small meeting room. Facing the whiteboard, Ye Mingxuan spread out the printed handover documents and checked the task list item by item: the code repository paths for completed modules, the progress of designs in progress, pending issues, and supplier contact information. Zhou Tao added debugging insights, especially explaining in detail the troubleshooting approach for the motor selection and matching problem that had troubled him for two weeks. Li Xiang knocked on the door, brought in two cups of coffee, and quietly left. The handover lasted more than two hours. At the end, Zhou Tao patted Ye Mingxuan on the shoulder and said, “I'm reassured handing this work over to you. If there are any issues, WeChat me anytime.” The two signed the paper documents to confirm, and shook hands with extra firmness.

events.name: Completed the full real estate registration process with the seller and obtained the new property ownership certificate.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ye Mingxuan took half a day off and went with his father Ye Jianguo and the seller to the Xiqing District Real Estate Registration Center. After submitting the full set of documents, they waited for review. Ye Mingxuan stared at the electronic screen, unconsciously rubbing the old coin keychain in his hand. About 40 minutes later, they moved to the tax payment and review step, and both parties signed the Application and Approval Form for Real Estate Registration. After another half hour, the staff member handed over the dark-red Real Estate Ownership Certificate, with 'Ye Mingxuan' clearly printed in the 'Right Holder' column. Ye Jianguo gave his son's back two firm pats, with a glint of relief in his eyes.

events.name: Reviewed the entire home-buying process with my father and checked the subsequent mortgage repayment plan.
events.description: After leaving the registration center, father and son rested at the nearby Yonghe Soy Milk shop. Ye Jianguo took out his ledger, which neatly recorded every expense: down payment 900,000 yuan, taxes and fees 23,000 yuan, agency fee 12,000 yuan, appraisal fees and the like about 5,000 yuan. He turned to the last page and wrote down the subsequent monthly repayment plan of 4200 yuan, adding a marginal note: "The monthly housing provident fund contribution of 2600 yuan will be automatically offset, so the actual payment is 1600 yuan." Ye Mingxuan, looking at his father's aged handwriting, felt for the first time a clear sense of the assets in his name and the debt on his shoulders, and said, "Dad, I will repay this debt myself." Ye Jianguo shook his head: "Why rush? We're one family, so let's not stand on ceremony."

start_state.mood: The goal was clear and solemn — today was the day of legally formalizing the home purchase, and also the day of the formal handover with a longtime work partner. His mood was steady with a sense of ceremony.

end_state.mood: Relieved yet solemn — the real estate certificate was on the bedside table, and before going to sleep I couldn't help opening it for another look. I now own a house, but the burden on my shoulders has truly settled in. The handover with Zhou Tao went smoothly, and I feel confident about the follow-up work.

state.daily_exercise: Due to a tight schedule, he did not do a dedicated workout, but while waiting in the registration center lobby he consciously did 20 minutes of standing stretches and marching in place, and in the evening he did a set of lower back relaxation exercises.

date_attribute.weather: Clear to partly cloudy, 15-23°C, light breeze in the evening.

2025-04.daily_overview: It was the day to get the keys to the new apartment and formally accept the house, and also the day when family emotions and financial pressure collided head-on for the first time. In the evening, he went with his father to the second-hand two-bedroom apartment to get the keys and inspect the house, and then posted a photo symbolizing a new beginning on Moments. That evening, his mother made braised pork to celebrate, but at the dinner table she sighed that they would have to 'tighten their belts' from now on, injecting the weight of reality into the celebratory atmosphere. At the same time, he had the last joint practice with his teammates for tomorrow's corporate basketball league, seeking an outlet in a stressful life.

events.name: Went with my father to the new house to pick up the keys and inspect the condition of the property
events.description: After getting off work at 6 p.m., Ye Mingxuan and his father cycled to the two-bedroom apartment in Xiqing District that had already been transferred to his name. At the entrance of the unit, the seller handed a set of three keys to Ye Mingxuan. The three of them went upstairs and entered the apartment. Following an online home-inspection checklist, Ye Mingxuan checked the door locks, windows, and walls, while his father focused on the water and electricity: testing water pressure, checking the breaker box, and examining the toilet and floor drain. After confirming that everything was basically satisfactory, the seller signed the handover confirmation. Ye Jianguo stood in the empty living room for a moment and said, 'This apartment has a regular layout; with good renovation it won't look bad.'

events.name: Posted on WeChat Moments to record the home-purchasing milestone and received many blessings
events.description: It was already 7:30 in the evening when he left the new house and returned home. Ye Mingxuan sat at his desk, chose a photo taken from the living room window showing the greenery of the residential complex, and edited a Moments post: “Xiqing coordinates, the starting point. The wish I made when I joined the company in 2018 finally came true in 2025.” He set it to public. A few minutes later, his phone buzzed nonstop: Sun Jing liked it instantly and commented, “Congratulations! We must celebrate properly at the May Day gathering”; Zhou Tao wrote, “Awesome, man, double happiness”; Liu Yang sent a string of firecracker emojis; Zhao Xiaofeng replied, “I’ll come visit another day”; collector friend Zhao Jianguo also liked it and sent a private message saying, “Congratulations on settling in. Now I have a fixed address to send you rubbings.” His mother poked her head out from the kitchen and said, “Posting is posting, hurry up and wash your hands for dinner.”

events.name: Family dinner to celebrate the home purchase, but mother expressed concerns about financial strain.
events.description: At 8 p.m., the three members of the Ye family sat around the dining table. On the table were four dishes Wang Xiulan had specially prepared: braised pork, steamed bass, garlic broccoli, and cucumber salad, with a plate of Goubuli buns in the middle. Father opened a bottle of Fenjiu that had been stored for two years and poured a small half glass for his son. The atmosphere at dinner was relaxed at first, as they talked about the location of the house and future renovation plans. But when the topic turned to the monthly mortgage payment, Wang Xiulan stopped her chopsticks and sighed, “We'll have to tighten our belts from now on—more than four thousand yuan a month for thirty years.” She glanced at the braised pork in Ye Mingxuan's bowl and added, “We can't eat meat like this every day anymore.” Ye Mingxuan silently calculated that the actual payment was 1,600 yuan, but adding daily expenses and maintenance costs, they really had to watch every penny. His father noticed his silence and raised his glass: “Come on, finish this glass first. Life is lived one day at a time.”

events.name: Final joint practice with teammates before the basketball game.
events.description: After dinner ended at 9 p.m., Ye Mingxuan changed into his sports gear and headed to the basketball court near the company for the final joint practice before the company league game the next day, together with Zhou Tao, Li Xiang, and two other colleagues. Since his lower back was still recovering, he reduced intense physical contact and mainly did three-point warm-up shooting and pass-and-cut drills. Zhou Tao and Li Xiang ran several pick-and-roll plays, while Ye Mingxuan, as the point forward, handled ball distribution and cuts. The training lasted about an hour, focusing on coordinating positioning and confirming the starting lineup. At the end, the four gathered at the center circle for a brief tactical summary. After training, Ye Mingxuan paid special attention to stretching and relaxing his lower back to prevent a recurrence of the old injury.

start_state.mood: Eager yet solemn — tonight I'm going to pick up the keys and view the house, about to stand in my own home for the first time as the owner.

end_state.mood: Mixed emotions — the joy of owning a first home was tangible, but his mother's sigh at the dinner table and the monthly mortgage figures echoed repeatedly in his mind. The well-wishes on Moments made him feel warm, but in the quiet of the night, the excitement faded, leaving a heavy sense of responsibility.

state.daily_exercise: Practiced together for about an hour before the basketball game, focusing on tactical coordination and shooting warm-ups; stretched the lower back thoroughly after exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, 13-20°C, with brief showers in the afternoon

2025-04.daily_overview: A Saturday filled with the basketball league, buying a 3D printer, and preparations for tomorrow morning's healthy run. In the morning, I gave my all on the court with my teammates but unfortunately exited in the first round. In the afternoon, after repeated financial calculations, I placed the order for the 3D printer I had been eyeing for a long time. In the evening, Zhou Tao, Li Xiang, and I reviewed the game and talked freely about life at a street food stall. The loss brought brief disappointment, but the candid late-night conversation made our friendship stronger in the face of setback. When Zhou Tao once again brought up his idea of starting a business, Ye Mingxuan, while helping him analyze the risks, also genuinely felt the loss of his tacit partner about to leave.

events.name: Meet up with teammates and conduct pre-match warm-up and tactical deployment
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Ye Mingxuan arrived at the corporate basketball league court in the park. After changing into his blue jersey, he jogged around the court three times with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang as a dynamic warm-up, then did stretching, shooting, and passing drills. The captain drew a simple diagram on the whiteboard and reiterated the starting lineup and man-to-man defensive rotation strategy. Ye Mingxuan was assigned to the small forward position, responsible for help defense and fast breaks. During the warm-up, he paid attention to protecting his lower back and avoided movements with too much jumping amplitude.

events.name: Gave it his all but regrettably lost in the first round
events.description: The game officially started at 10 a.m. The first half was closely contested. Midway through the second quarter, Ye Mingxuan caught a pass from Zhou Tao and hit a three-pointer to tie the game. But in the second half, the opposing guard suddenly picked up the pace, launching consecutive fast-break counters, and our defense had gaps in rotation. During one chase-back, Ye Mingxuan felt slight discomfort in his lower back and deliberately reduced his sprint frequency. In the final three minutes of the fourth quarter, the gap widened to 8 points. Although Li Xiang kept grabbing offensive rebounds and scoring, they ultimately lost by 4 points in regret. As the final whistle blew, Zhou Tao put his arm around Ye Mingxuan's shoulder and said, 'We'll come back next year, but I might not be here next year.' In the noisy court, only Ye Mingxuan heard this clearly.

events.name: After repeated financial calculations, decided to purchase a 3D printer.
events.description: At 2 p.m., after returning home and taking a shower, Ye Mingxuan opened the Python financial spreadsheet he had written himself and entered the 4,200 yuan monthly repayment due to be deducted on April 28, the necessary monthly expenses that followed, and the current account balance of about 60,000 yuan. He repeatedly simulated the cash flow for the next three months. The spreadsheet showed that, while maintaining basic living expenses, the one-time expenditure of 3,500 yuan was still within the safety margin. After nearly an hour of calculation, he finally placed an order on the Tmall flagship store and paid 3,500 yuan for an entry-level FDM 3D printer, expected to arrive on April 21. After ordering, he recorded the expense in his notebook, labeling it 'investment in digital auxiliary equipment for woodworking.'

events.name: Prepare gear and adjust sleep schedule for tomorrow morning's fitness run.
events.description: At 6 p.m., despite having consumed a lot of energy during the day's race, Ye Mingxuan decided to join tomorrow morning's community 5K health run as usual. After dinner, he started to prepare his gear: he folded his running shorts and quick-dry T-shirt at the foot of the bed, checked the battery of his sports watch and charged it, and filled the kettle in the kitchen with warm water and put it in the refrigerator. Considering his lower back condition, he planned to run at a conservative pace of 6:30 to 7 minutes per kilometer, without chasing a fast time. He set the alarm for 6 a.m., 20 minutes earlier than on a normal workday.

events.name: Late-night match review at a food stall and a candid heart-to-heart with Zhou Tao.
events.description: At 9 PM, Ye Mingxuan, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang met at a roadside food stall near the company for a late-night snack. They ordered skewers, edamame, peanuts, and a few bottles of Snow Beer, sitting around outdoor plastic tables and chairs. For the first half hour, they seriously reviewed the details of the game: which defensive set had a missed assignment, which counterattack opportunity was not seized. As the alcohol took effect, the conversation turned to work. Zhou Tao tilted his head back, finished a glass of beer, and put it down: "To be honest, I probably really don't want to do mechanical design anymore. This startup opportunity isn't perfect, but I want to try it. Even if I fail, I'll accept it." Ye Mingxuan analyzed it for him point by point: how to continue social insurance after resigning, how long the startup capital would last, and where to find customers. It was all practical advice to alert him to the risks, but his tone showed no intention of discouraging him. Li Xiang sat quietly to the side shelling edamame, occasionally interjecting a technical question. When they wrapped up at 11 PM, the three stood by the roadside waiting for a designated driver. Zhou Tao hugged Ye Mingxuan tightly: "Thanks, brother." Ye Mingxuan watched the taxi drive away, knowing full well that this team would soon be one person short.

start_state.mood: Determination mixed with nervousness — the first round of the corporate league is imminent. I hope my teammates and I can perform at our best, but I'm also secretly worried that my back won't hold up under intense physical play.

end_state.mood: Physically and mentally exhausted, yet relieved by the late-night conversation—there was regret about losing the match, and anticipation because the 3D printer had been ordered, but what truly occupied his mind was Zhou Tao's words, "Even if I fail, I'll accept it." He worried about his friend's decision and felt a vague sense of loss at the impending loss of a well-matched partner, but the candid late-night conversation made their friendship more solid.

state.daily_exercise: Basketball game about 40 minutes (moderate-to-high intensity play). After the game, walked nearly 10,000 steps; after the evening street-food stall, walked about 2 kilometers home.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature 11-19°C, cool in the morning, suitable for running.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Ye Mingxuan started a full-of-energy day with a community fun run. During the 5 km route, he naturally got to know Chen Xiao, a programmer neighbor from the same community. As they ran, they chatted about technical topics and discovered they were both fellow travelers burdened with mortgages. After the race, they exchanged contact information and gained an unexpected friendship. In the afternoon, he went to the community health service center for his second lumbar physiotherapy session, continuing his recovery. When he got home, he reflected on the new friendship. Chen Xiao's half-marathon suggestion sparked a new fitness goal in his mind. Although he couldn't act on it yet due to monthly mortgage pressure, the idea had quietly taken root.

events.name: Got up early, got ready, and headed to the starting point of the fitness run.
events.description: Woken by the alarm at 6 a.m., I washed up briefly, then ate a slice of whole wheat bread and half a banana as pre-run fuel. I put on the gear prepared last night and did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching and targeted lower back relaxation exercises in the living room—Dr. Liu and Coach Wang had repeatedly stressed that the core muscles must be fully activated before running. At 6:30 I walked to the starting point at Zhongbei Town Community Square. The spring morning air was cool and fresh, and the crabapple blossoms along the road were in full bloom. After arriving, I picked up my race number bib and timing chip and stood at the back of the starting area.

events.name: Participated in the 5 km health run in Zhongbei Town and got to know fellow runner Chen Xiao.
events.description: At exactly 7 a.m., the starting gun sounded, and Ye Mingxuan moved forward steadily at a pace of about 6:40 per kilometer. By the second kilometer, he noticed a young runner beside him with a similar pace; their cadences were almost identical. At the third kilometer, as they passed the water station, the other runner took the initiative to speak: 'You have a very steady rhythm. Do you usually run often?' Ye Mingxuan smiled and said two or three times a week, and the two started chatting. The other runner was named Chen Xiao, a software engineer who had just moved to Zhongbei Town last month, working on data visualization development. When Ye Mingxuan mentioned that he used Python to write an ancient coin trading scraper and financial analysis tables, Chen Xiao became visibly excited, saying he also used Python for real-time visualization of sensor data. The two immediately found common ground. The remaining two kilometers passed unnoticed amid their lively discussion. Ye Mingxuan finished in 33 minutes 42 seconds, and Chen Xiao was 20 seconds faster.

events.name: After the race, had an in-depth exchange with Chen Xiao and exchanged contact information
events.description: After crossing the finish line, Ye Mingxuan and Chen Xiao picked up their finisher bags in the rest area and leaned against a roadside bench to continue the conversation they had not finished. Chen Xiao shared his experience of running a half marathon in Wuqing, Tianjin last year, and encouraged Ye Mingxuan to try an official race: "Your pace for five kilometers is very steady; with some endurance training, you can definitely take on a half marathon." Ye Mingxuan was tempted for a moment, but when he thought of the mortgage payments that had just begun and his account balance, expenses such as the registration fee and new running shoes made him put aside the idea of signing up for now. The two added each other on WeChat, and Chen Xiao said he would invite him for a morning run on a weekend another day; Ye Mingxuan gladly agreed. After saying goodbye, Ye Mingxuan jogged home. The sun had fully risen, and his mood felt much lighter on the way.

events.name: After returning home, did a full stretching session and reflected on the new friendship.
events.description: When he got home at 9 a.m., Ye Mingxuan didn't sit down immediately but instead laid out a yoga mat and did a systematic post-run stretch: holding each stretch for more than 30 seconds on the front and back of the thighs, calves, hip flexors, and lower back. While stretching, he recalled the morning experience — a fun run had unexpectedly brought a new friend who lives in the same community, has a similar technical background, and is also paying off a mortgage. Chen Xiao's suggestion of a half marathon lingered in his mind, but he ultimately made a rational decision: for now, focus on core muscle and lower back rehabilitation, and seriously consider registering for a race only after the monthly mortgage payment pressure eases and the year-end bonus arrives. He created a new note in his phone memo: "Half Marathon Preparation Plan — pending start, target: Tianjin Marathon in spring 2026."

events.name: Receive the second low-frequency pulse physiotherapy session for the lower back.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Ye Mingxuan rode his e-bike to the community health service center as scheduled. Dr. Liu Wentao first asked about how he felt after the last physiotherapy session and his recent lower back condition — Ye honestly reported the faint discomfort he had felt during the basketball game. Dr. Liu had Ye lie face down on the treatment bed, placed electrode pads on the erector spinae and quadratus lumborum muscles on both sides of the lumbar spine, turned on the low-frequency pulse physiotherapy device, and set it to 20 minutes of soothing mode. The mild tingling from the electrical stimulation gradually relaxed the tense muscles. Afterward, Dr. Liu performed about 10 minutes of manual relaxation, advised him to keep up his daily stretching habits and watch his sitting posture at work, and confirmed the third physiotherapy appointment for April 27.

start_state.mood: When the alarm woke me in the early morning, I was a little drowsy but not resistant — the healthy run I had promised myself couldn't be given up just because of yesterday's basketball loss. I had a vague sense of anticipation for the new day and new interpersonal encounters.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and enriched — the refreshing five-kilometer run in the morning made his body feel light, meeting a new friend, Chen Xiao, added a touch of brightness to his tense social circle, and after lower back physiotherapy, his muscles were much more relaxed. Lying in bed thinking back on the day, he felt that despite the pressure of the mortgage, warmth and energy were still flowing into life.

state.daily_exercise: Ran 5 km (actually about 6 km including warm-up and cool-down), pace about 6:40 per km, followed by 20 minutes of systematic stretching.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature 15-25°C, light breeze in the afternoon.

2025-04.daily_overview: The day the 3D printer arrived was also the day the plan for the May Day reunion of college classmates in Tianjin was finalized. After work, he signed for the long-awaited package, and in his balcony workshop completed unboxing, assembly, and the first test print. At the same time, he communicated back and forth with Sun Jing, and proactively downgraded the reunion standard due to mortgage payment pressure, which Sun Jing understood. In the evening, he installed 3D modeling software on his computer and began learning the basics. On this day, he switched efficiently among work, social life, and hobbies. Although the financial squeeze meant the reunion plan was scaled down, the arrival of the new equipment injected new possibilities into his hobby.

events.name: Sun Jing initiated communication for the May Day gathering and together finalized the plan.
events.description: During a break in the morning, Ye Mingxuan saw a message from Sun Jing in the university classmates' WeChat group, proposing to organize a gathering of old classmates still in Tianjin over the May Day holiday. The initial idea was to have lunch together, then visit Five Avenues in the afternoon, and take a walk along the Hai River in the evening. In a private chat, Ye Mingxuan proactively mentioned his financial situation and suggested lowering the per-person meal budget from 150 yuan to 100 yuan, and recommended a few restaurants with good value. Sun Jing instantly replied, "Totally understood! I'll bring the drinks, you don't need to worry about that," and sent a pat-on-the-shoulder emoji. Ye Mingxuan used his lunch break to search online for well-reviewed fusion restaurants near the Italian Style Area. After comparing ratings and per-person costs, he chose one, confirmed the private room and menu for May Day by phone, and shared the reservation details in the group.

events.name: Plan a walking route on Five Avenue and confirm it with Sun Jing.
events.description: After booking the restaurant, Ye Mingxuan, relying on his familiarity with the Five Avenues area, planned a walking route of about 2 hours: starting from the Italian Style District, passing Marco Polo Square, Chongqing Road, Minyuan Square, and Guilin Road, reaching the waterside platform by the Hai River in the evening to enjoy the night view. He sketched the route as a simple map, marked recommended photo spots and public restrooms along the way, and sent it to Sun Jing via WeChat. Sun Jing was very satisfied after seeing it, and after synthesizing everyone's opinions, she posted a notice in the group confirming the complete itinerary: gathering at the restaurant at 11 AM on May Day, a walking tour in the afternoon, and enjoying the Hai River night view in the evening, reminding everyone to wear comfortable shoes. Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng replied "Got it" and "Looking forward" in turn.

events.name: Sign for the 3D printer and complete unpacking and assembly.
events.description: Arriving home from work at 5:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan found a medium-sized cardboard box at the door left by the courier. He carefully carried it into the living room, cut the packing tape with a utility knife, and took out the printer main unit, accessory box, consumable filament spool, and quick start guide one by one. After checking all parts against the manual, he moved the printer to the dedicated workbench on the balcony. The assembly process was not complicated—fixing the gantry frame, installing the print platform, connecting the cables—and the main assembly was completed in about 40 minutes. When powered on, the printer's self-test light came on, the fan ran normally, and he breathed a sigh of relief.

events.name: Level and calibrate the printer, then complete the first test print.
events.description: After assembly, Ye Mingxuan manually leveled the heated bed by following the video tutorial: he placed a sheet of A4 paper between the nozzle and the platform and repeatedly adjusted the four corner knobs until he felt uniform, slight resistance at every position. After leveling, he loaded the included white PLA test filament and selected the preset simplified small gear model from the SD card for a test print. Once the nozzle heated to 200 degrees Celsius, printing began layer by layer. Ye Mingxuan brought a small stool and sat beside it watching for a full 20 minutes, hardly able to hide his excitement as the molten plastic filament stacked up layer by layer into the gear outline he knew well. The first print was basically successful, except that the bottom corners of the gear curled up slightly. He wrote in his notebook: 'Bed adhesion needs to be strengthened; next time try adding one more circle to the brim width.'

events.name: Install 3D modeling software and learn basic operations.
events.description: After dinner at 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan downloaded and installed the free personal version of Fusion 360 on his desktop computer. After installation, he followed the built-in introductory tutorial to learn the basic interface layout: the toolbar area at the top, the browser tree on the left, and the central 3D viewport. He practiced basic controls such as holding down the middle mouse button to rotate the view, scrolling the wheel to zoom, and holding Shift to pan the view, then followed the tutorial to try creating his first sketch—drawing a circle on the XY plane and using the Smart Dimension tool to mark its diameter. Although these were the most basic operations, for someone accustomed to 2D engineering drawings in SolidWorks, the parametric 3D modeling mindset was not unfamiliar, and he picked it up quickly. He planned to continue learning the extrude and revolve commands tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Full of anticipation — Monday workdays usually bring slight fatigue, but the news that the 3D printer was expected to arrive today had him excited from the moment he got up.

end_state.mood: Excited but somewhat weary—the 3D printer's first successful test print gave tangible returns for the weekend's investment, and basic modeling software operations also went smoothly. The May Day reunion plan was finalized without a hitch, leaving him full of anticipation for the upcoming classmate reunion, yet a faint pang of guilt from deliberately lowering the bar also crossed his mind.

state.daily_exercise: Did not do dedicated exercise on this workday, but used the lunch break to walk around the company for 20 minutes, accumulating about 6,000 steps.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to light rain, 13-18°C, rain starting in the afternoon

2025-04.daily_overview: It was an advanced day for 3D modeling study, and also an ordinary day when the feeling of financial tightening at the end of the month gradually became apparent. In the evening, he used time after work to study extrude, revolve, and parametric sketch functions in depth, gradually building up the operational logic of 3D modeling. A light rain was falling outside, and the balcony workshop lights looked especially warm in the night. Ye Mingxuan was immersed in the creative process from flat to three-dimensional. Unlike yesterday's excitement over new equipment, today was a day to settle down and dig into technical details—solid, steady, and full of an engineer's satisfaction.

events.name: Learn to create parametric sketches and practice extrusion and revolution exercises
events.description: After leaving work at 7 PM, going home, and eating dinner, Ye Mingxuan made a cup of instant coffee and sat down at the computer. He opened Fusion 360 to continue yesterday’s learning. He watched an introductory tutorial video recorded by a Bilibili uploader (about 45 minutes) and followed along to practice creating more complex sketches in the software: using the line, circle, and rectangle tools to draw geometric outlines, using the constraint function to label the length and center position of each line, and learning to use “symmetry constraints” and “equal length constraints” to structure the sketches. He then tried the extrude command to stretch a 2D rectangle into a cuboid, and practiced the revolve command to rotate a semicircular cross-section around a central axis to generate a sphere. These operations were highly similar to his experience in SolidWorks, and the learning curve was smoother than expected. In the middle, he encountered an error message saying “the cross-section must be closed when revolving.” After troubleshooting, he found that a line in the sketch was not fully connected to the central axis. After correcting it, he successfully generated the solid.

events.name: Completed a simulated exercise on simple 3D solid modeling.
events.description: After finishing the tutorial, Ye Mingxuan set himself a small task: without referring to the video, independently complete the modeling of a cylinder, a cube, and a rectangular block with a hole. He created a new project file and created the three separate components in sequence. The cylinder modeling went smoothly—draw a circle, extrude, done in two minutes. The cube was slightly more complicated because it required a rectangular sketch; he deliberately practiced two methods: drawing a rectangle directly and extruding it, and drawing a square then using the 'Equal Constraint' to ensure all four sides were equal. When making the rectangular block with a hole, he first extruded a cuboid, then created a new sketch on the top face, drew a circle, and used the 'Cut' mode of the extrude command to create a through hole. After finishing, he rotated the view to check the model from different angles, confirmed that the hole was centered and the dimensions were accurate, and felt a familiar sense of accomplishment welling up—the same feeling as when you get over the first hurdle in learning any new skill.

events.name: Use newly learned 3D skills to re-examine the woodworking toolbox design.
events.description: After the practice session, Ye Mingxuan took the pencil-drawn woodworking toolbox design sketch from the bookshelf and began thinking about whether he could redraw it using 3D modeling software. The toolbox was a project he had started conceiving a few months ago, designed to hold hand tools such as chisels, plane blades, and try squares, but it had stayed at the paper stage. Now with a 3D printer and modeling software, he realized he could first create a digital model on the computer, check the fit of each compartment and slot, then print the parts separately and assemble them physically. On his notebook, he drew a simple module breakdown diagram, marking the estimated sizes of the four main modules—box body, partitions, handle, and hinge mounting positions—as a blueprint for the later formal design. Outside the window, the sound of rain grew denser; under the lamp in the balcony workshop, he was unaware that time had passed 10 p.m.

start_state.mood: The excitement from last night's first experience with 3D modeling still lingers, and today I am full of anticipation for in-depth study after work, with the usual Monday workday fatigue tempered by the appeal of the new skill.

end_state.mood: Solid satisfaction—tonight he gained a deep command of the two core modeling commands, extrude and revolve, and successfully completed modeling exercises for three independent entities. This step-by-step process of tackling technical difficulties felt familiar and reassuring; unlike design tasks at work with time pressure, self-study time was filled with pure joy of learning.

state.daily_exercise: Because of rain, no outdoor activities; did 10 minutes of core muscle training indoors (3 sets each of plank, side bridge, and bird dog), combined with lower back rehabilitation stretching.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, temperature 14-21°C, light breeze in the evening.

2025-04.daily_overview: A day in which family care and self-rehabilitation went hand in hand. In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan received a call from his mother asking him to go shopping at a newly opened warehouse supermarket. After work, he rode his electric bike to pick her up, and the mother and son spent more than an hour carefully selecting items among the shelves, buying seasonings and cleaning supplies for the new house. On the way home, his mother nagged him to work less overtime and come home more often, filling Ye Mingxuan's heart with warmth. In the evening, he did lumbar rehabilitation exercises at home to continue the effects of physical therapy. This was a typical workday evening in late April — no major events happened, but the accumulation of daily family care and physical recovery formed the most solid foundation of life.

events.name: Answered mother's call and arranged to buy necessities for the new home in the evening.
events.description: At 3:30 in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan received a call from his mother, Wang Xiulan, at his desk. She said that after getting the keys to the new house a couple of days ago, she had been thinking it over—the kitchen there was completely empty, with no seasonings at all, and the bathroom also needed a mop and toilet cleaner. "A new large warehouse supermarket has just opened in the west, and I heard things are cheap. After work, ride your bike back to pick me up, and the two of us will go pick things out together." Ye Mingxuan calculated the time: riding his electric bike home from work to pick up his mother and then heading over would be just right, so he readily agreed and arranged to meet downstairs at the building at 5:30.

events.name: Ride the e-bike and take my mother to the warehouse supermarket to shop.
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., Ye Mingxuan rode his bike to the entrance of his residential complex, where his mother was already waiting at the unit door with a reusable cloth bag. The two rode an electric bicycle to a newly opened large warehouse supermarket five kilometers away. His mother sat on the back seat, holding Ye Mingxuan's waist with her left hand, chatting about household matters along the way, such as the recent rise in vegetable prices and the change of the breakfast vendor at the community gate. In the cool evening breeze of April, Ye Mingxuan slowed down, and the mother and son chatted casually on and off. They arrived at the supermarket before dark.

events.name: Carefully selected condiments and cleaning products.
events.description: After entering the supermarket, Ye Mingxuan pushed the shopping cart beside his mother. She went straight to the condiment aisle and picked up bottles of soy sauce, vinegar, and oyster sauce, carefully checking production dates and ingredient lists. While choosing, she said to Ye Mingxuan, "Buying the big bottles is better value, but if they're opened at the new place and can't be finished, it's wasteful." In the end, they chose a set of small basic condiment bottles. When they moved to the cleaning supplies section, his mother squatted in front of the shelf comparing the prices and materials of several mops. Ye Mingxuan helped her analyze which spin mop was more durable. She took his advice and put one in the cart, satisfied. The two also picked out a few rags and a set of storage bins in the home goods section. An hour passed quickly, and the cart was stuffed full, but everything was practical.

events.name: When we checked out, we split the bill half and half, and I received my mother's nagging but caring attention.
events.description: While waiting in line to pay, his mother rushed to take out her wallet. Ye Mingxuan insisted on paying himself — he thought the new house was his, so these things should be paid for by him. His mother could not talk him out of it, and in the end they each paid half. On the e-bike ride home, the night had grown late. His mother began to nag from the back seat: “You work overtime so late every day, and your back is not fully recovered yet. Spend less time sitting in the office and get more exercise. Don't keep eating out all the time. Come home for meals; I'll cook for you.” Ye Mingxuan smiled and agreed, but he knew that behind every nagging word from his mother was her love and concern for him. Since buying the house, his mother had paid more attention to his health and financial situation, and this concern felt especially warm in the evening breeze.

events.name: Organized the purchased items and evaluated when the next physiotherapy session should be.
events.description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan and his mother sorted and bagged the condiments and cleaning supplies they had purchased, preparing to take them to the new house on the weekend when they had free time. After finishing, Ye Mingxuan remembered that the second physical therapy session had been completed on the 20th and the next appointment was on the 27th. He decided to do rehabilitation exercises at home to consolidate the results.

events.name: Do lumbar rehabilitation exercises at home and review physical therapy progress
events.description: After organizing the purchased items, Ye Mingxuan spread out his yoga mat and, following Dr. Liu's advice, did 10 minutes of Cat-Cow, Child's pose, and spinal twists, and used a foam roller to release his lower back. After the practice, he recorded in his phone memo: 'Core training must not stop during the interval between physical therapy sessions; the quadratus lumborum is still a bit tense, so continue with heat compresses.'

start_state.mood: Good mental state — the weather has cleared up, the lower back soreness has eased after the first physiotherapy session, and I keep a calm attitude toward the new day

end_state.mood: His heart felt warm — accompanying his mother to the supermarket may seem like an everyday chore, but her seemingly nagging reminders from the back seat of the e-bike made him truly feel his family's care. Although he did not go to physical therapy, his continued rehabilitation exercises kept his lower back relaxed, and the warmth from shopping with his mother still lingered in his heart. In April, under the pressure of the monthly mortgage payment, such an ordinary yet warm evening was like a reassurance.

state.daily_exercise: In the evening at home, did 10 minutes of waist stretching and core activation, and used a foam roller to relax.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature 16-25°C, warm and comfortable

2025-04.daily_overview: A day when rationality and restraint overcame the urge to collect. In the evening, the Hubei Double Dragon one-liang silver coin that Ye Mingxuan had been following on Weipaitang finally went up for auction. He set a strict psychological budget cap, decisively gave up once the bidding exceeded his affordable range, and wrote in his WeChat Moments, 'To have seen it is to own it,' to console himself. Afterwards, he exchanged views with his ancient-coin collector friend Zhao Jianguo in Xi'an about the principle of collecting within one's means and received understanding and resonance from an online kindred spirit. Since April, the pressure of the monthly mortgage payment and financial tightening had made him more sober and restrained in collecting. Though this rational choice carried regret, it was a mature attitude he endorsed.

events.name: In the evening, checked the auction item details on Weipaitang and set a mental budget ceiling.
events.description: After finishing dinner at 7:30 pm, Ye Mingxuan opened the Weipaitang app to check the details of the Hubei Double Dragon one-tael silver coin that was about to be auctioned that night. This machine-struck coin was a rare variety he had been following for two weeks. It had a PCGS grade of XF45, natural patina, and acceptable wear on the dragon scales. He zoomed in on the image to carefully examine the condition of the edge wear and the distribution of scratches on the surface, and checked them one by one against the authentication points for similar coins that Zhao Jianguo had previously shared on WeChat, confirming that the condition was basically consistent with the description. He then opened his self-made monthly budget spreadsheet, laid out the current account balance, the upcoming mortgage payment deduction date, and the expected living expenses for May, and finally set a firm psychological budget cap that he absolutely would not exceed—spending even one yuan more would count as breaking the rule.

events.name: Participated in real-time bidding and rationally gave up after the budget was exceeded.
events.description: The auction officially started at 9 p.m. The starting bid was 8,000 yuan. Ye Mingxuan did not rush to bid; he first observed the bidding pace in the first few minutes — four buyers were already active, and two of the IDs had an aggressive bidding style, raising the price by more than 500 yuan each time. When the auction reached the 15th minute, the price hit the psychological budget cap he had set. After bidding once, he found that he was immediately outbid. After raising the bid again, the price kept climbing. Staring at the jumping numbers on the screen, he took a deep breath, moved his finger away from the bid button, and closed the bidding page. At the moment he gave up, he did feel a pang of pain, but he soon calmed down — he clearly remembered that in four days the bank would deduct his 4,200 yuan monthly mortgage payment, and every cent in his account balance already had a designated purpose.

events.name: Posted on Moments to comfort myself and adjust my collecting mindset.
events.description: After giving up the bid, Ye Mingxuan leaned back in his chair and stared blankly for a while. Then he opened WeChat Moments and typed a line: “To see is to possess. Truly good things deserve to be met at the right time.” The attached image was the photo of the Hubei Double Dragon lot saved on his phone. After the post was sent, college classmate Zhao Xiaofeng commented with three thumbs-up emojis, Zhou Tao left a message saying, “Why buy silver coins? Save money and take care of your health, bro,” and fitness coach Wang Jian sent a face-palm laughing emoji. Sun Jing privately messaged to comfort him, saying, “Wait until the year-end bonus comes, then buy something better.” Looking at these comments, Ye Mingxuan laughed out loud, feeling even more relaxed than before the auction.

events.name: Discussed the collecting principle of living within one's means with fellow ancient coin collector Zhao Jianguo
events.description: After posting to Moments, Ye Mingxuan proactively contacted Zhao Jianguo, an ancient coin collector friend far away in Xi'an, via WeChat, and shared with him the evening's bidding experience and his mental journey of giving up on the auction. Zhao Jianguo quickly replied with a long voice message, roughly saying: collecting is a long-term pursuit; being constrained by budget means the fate isn't deep enough yet. He had also once eaten instant noodles for a month for a beloved coin, but later thinking back, it really wasn't worth it. The two talked for over half an hour about the collecting philosophy of spending within one's means. Zhao Jianguo also shared his recent experience of picking up a Jiangnan Yisi seven qian two fen coin at a reasonable price, encouraging Ye Mingxuan to focus on coins with low unit prices but research value. When the call ended, Ye Mingxuan felt the satisfaction of being understood—although they had never met in person, this online confidant's values were highly compatible with his own.

start_state.mood: Anticipation and restraint coexisted—his collecting hobby and work plans alternately came to mind, and the slight discomfort in his lower back reminded him to slow down.

end_state.mood: Rational, with a hint of regret, but mostly self-affirmation — being able to decisively give up a coveted ancient coin was a new skill honed under the pressure of monthly mortgage payments. The exchange with Zhao Jianguo made him agree even more with the collecting philosophy of living within one's means. 'To have seen it is to own it' is not just self-consolation but the mindset a mature collector should have.

state.daily_exercise: During the lunch break, did 15 minutes of lumbar rehabilitation exercises and shoulder and neck stretches in the office; after work, walked about 2 kilometers home.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, temperature 17-26°C, slightly hot at noon

2025-04.daily_overview: The last full working week of April was coming to an end. During work breaks on Friday, Ye Mingxuan completed two things that maintained relationships and discipline: in the university roommate group, he arranged an online gaming get-together with Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng for Saturday evening, reserving an outlet to release stress from his tightly scheduled life; at the same time, using the end-of-month point, he proactively sorted through his recent ancient coin collection expenses and mortgage payments, once again reinforcing the financial discipline of living within his means. There were no dramatic events that day, but with the mortgage payment date approaching, proactively maintaining friendships and proactively restraining desires were both conscious actions to resist the heavy pressures of life.

events.name: Proposed an online gaming session on Saturday night in the roommate group and confirmed the time.
events.description: During a work break at 10 a.m., Ye Mingxuan sent a message in his college roommate WeChat group: "Guys, want to get a game going this Saturday at 8 p.m.? We haven't had a proper gaming session in a while." Liu Yang instantly replied, "I couldn't agree more," and said that he had been working overtime too much in Shenzhen lately and needed to blow off steam, then asked whether to bring Zhao Xiaofeng along. Zhao Xiaofeng saw the message later and replied, "OK, OK, but I'm a bit rusty. Don't blame me if I play badly." Ye Mingxuan said if he was rusty, that was even better, so they could practice together; he also specifically confirmed they would use QQ Channel for voice that night rather than in-game voice, because "last time the in-game voice had too much lag, and team fight coordination was all guesswork." The three finally agreed to get online Saturday at 8 p.m. sharp, with Ye Mingxuan taking the lead to set up the room and invite everyone. Liu Yang also suggested that this time they not only play ranked matches—they could first play a couple of ARAM matches to warm up, and everyone agreed.

events.name: Review recent ancient coin collection expenses and strengthen financial discipline
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan sat at his desk and opened his laptop, organizing all the expenses and plans related to ancient coin collecting this month into a table: spending 80 yuan on a Xuantong Tongbao coin at the Yangliuqing market during Qingming, actually spending zero after giving up bidding on the Hubei Double Dragon on April 24, and the time cost spent browsing Weipaitang and organizing his favorites folder this month. He placed these figures alongside his mortgage payments and daily expenses for comparison, and clearly saw that his coin-related spending this month was very well controlled—the only 80 yuan was a bargain picked up during Qingming. In the monthly summary column, he wrote: "In the era of monthly mortgage payments, collecting should focus on appreciation and knowledge accumulation; large bids are postponed. The annual budget limit will be reassessed after the year-end bonus is paid." This review process made him more confident in his current financial discipline and also relieved the psychological burden of "wasting money" for tomorrow's game gathering.

start_state.mood: Steady and orderly — work pace is normal, and there's an online gaming gathering this weekend to look forward to. My mood is a bit lighter than in the past few days.

end_state.mood: Self-discipline brings peace of mind — the result of sorting out his finances left him satisfied with his self-control, and proactively arranging a gaming gathering also preserved the warmth of friendship during a tense April. The monthly payment deduction date is getting closer, but at this moment he feels even more certain than at the beginning of the month.

state.daily_exercise: After work, walked about 2 km home, took a 20-minute walk after dinner to aid digestion, and did waist stretches.

2025-04.daily_overview: Over the weekend, I found a perfect balance between hands-on 3D modeling practice and an online reunion with old friends. During the day, I used the uninterrupted break time to apply the modeling skills learned this week to a real project—designing a complete 3D model of a phone stand, practicing Boolean operations and detailed feature modifications. At 8 p.m., as scheduled, I teamed up with Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng to play League of Legends, unwinding from a week of work pressure through ranked matches and casual chat. Liu Yang talked about his career bottleneck in Shenzhen, and Ye Mingxuan shared his own ways of coping with stress. The sincere exchanges among the three during breaks in the games made the regular online gathering a spiritual anchor in the turbulent work life.

events.name: Use weekend time for hands-on 3D modeling practice.
events.description: After breakfast at 9 a.m., Ye Mingxuan made a cup of green tea, sat down at the computer, and comprehensively applied the commands he learned this week, such as extrude, revolve, and chamfer. He set himself a practical task: design a 3D model of a desktop phone stand. He first sketched the side and top views on paper—the base is an oval flat plate, the upright column has reinforcing ribs, and the phone cradle needs a certain tilt angle. Then, in Fusion 360, he started modeling from the base: he used the Extrude command to pull the oval sketch into an 8 mm thick base, created a new plane on the base to draw the rectangular column cross-section and extruded it again, and used a Boolean operation to merge the base and column into one solid. For the cradle, he used the Revolve command to create an arc-shaped support surface and then merged it with the main body. Finally, he used the Chamfer command to soften the sharp edges and the Shell command to make the column hollow to save material. After finishing, he rotated the model and examined it from various angles. Fairly satisfied with the result, he saved it in STL format, planning to print it out for a real test when he had time.

events.name: Log in on time for an online gaming get-together with Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng
events.description: At 7:55 PM, Ye Mingxuan turned on his computer, logged into the League of Legends client, created a room in QQ Voice, and invited Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng to join. As soon as Liu Yang turned on his microphone, the noisy background of his rented apartment in Shenzhen came through, while Zhao Xiaofeng, at his home in Tianjin, had a stable network and clear voice. The three first played two ARAM matches as warm-ups. About ten minutes in, Liu Yang's veteran Sion twice charged precisely into the enemy backline, making Zhao Xiaofeng laugh and slap the table. At 8:30 they moved on to ranked matches, with Ye Mingxuan choosing his familiar top laner and Liu Yang playing jungle to coordinate. During the games, they chatted about how things were going: Liu Yang complained that the ever-changing requirements of his recent project had drained him physically and mentally, and he was beginning to doubt whether he was cut out for this line of work; Ye Mingxuan shared his approach to workplace stress—breaking big problems into small steps and finding an activity after work that he could fully immerse himself in; Zhao Xiaofeng complained that the current automotive project was on a tight schedule and he hadn't had a day off in three weeks. The teamwork in the game and the mutual banter in their chat formed a wonderful rapport. By the time they finished three games, it was already past 10:30.

events.name: After the game, they agreed to meet again during the May Day holiday and said goodnight to each other.
events.description: After three ranked games (two wins, one loss), Liu Yang said, “Awesome! This is 10,000 times more fun than overtime.” Ye Mingxuan took the opportunity to suggest organizing another session during the May Day holiday, with more flexible timing and even the possibility of trying a new game mode. Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng enthusiastically agreed. It was decided that Zhao Xiaofeng would be in charge of picking the game mode — he said he had recently discovered a chess mode called “Teamfight Tactics” that was quite fun and worth exploring together — while Ye Mingxuan would take the lead in coordinating the specific time. The three said goodnight to each other and logged off one by one. Ye Mingxuan quit the game, turned off his computer, washed up briefly, and got into bed. Before sleeping, he checked his phone and saw that Liu Yang had sent a message in the group: “I'm really happy tonight. Thanks, bros. Life in Shenzhen can be really tiring sometimes, but playing a few games with you guys makes me feel like I can keep going.” Ye Mingxuan replied with a hug emoji, then turned off the light and rested. This online gathering relaxed him considerably; the exchange among old friends felt like a massage for his frayed nerves.

start_state.mood: The weekend was a mix of relaxation and anticipation — mornings without the rush of an early commute were relaxing; during the day, deep practice in 3D modeling awaited him; and in the evening, there was a gaming appointment with old friends. The schedule was full but not stressful.

end_state.mood: His heart felt full and warm—the phone stand model he completed during the day gave him more and more feel for 3D modeling, and the games and casual chat with Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng in the evening felt like opening a window in his tense life. The burden of the monthly mortgage payment and workplace changes had not disappeared, but the company of friends made his shoulders less stiff.
