2025-04.daily_overview: May Day compensatory workday, and also the day of his third lumbar physiotherapy session. Although it was a Sunday that had been adjusted to a workday, Ye Mingxuan had marked the special nature of this day on his schedule early on. After work, he still insisted on going to the gym to complete core and upper-body training. Looking at the gradually emerging muscle definition in the mirror, he realized that fitness had changed from a task requiring willpower into a natural life rhythm as effortless as breathing. After training, he went to the community health service center for his final low-frequency pulse physiotherapy, drawing a phased conclusion to his systematic rehabilitation for lumbar muscle strain. The fatigue of the compensatory workday, the satisfaction of self-discipline, and the progress of recovery interwove into the most stable and solid foundation of life in late April.

events.name: Morning of the make-up workday: pack the gym bag and confirm the training plan.
events.description: After getting up at 6:45 a.m., Ye Mingxuan made a point of packing his gym bag before washing up: a set of clean quick-dry training clothes, a sports towel, a water bottle, and portioned bags of protein powder. He opened his phone to check the adjusted training plan Coach Wang Jian sent this week — today was a combination of aerobic activation and core and upper-body strength training, including exercises such as planks, bird-dog, push-ups, dumbbell presses, and barbell rows, with 4 sets of 12-15 reps each, keeping the lumbar spine neutral throughout. Since it was a make-up workday that could easily create the confusing feeling that today was actually Sunday, he deliberately drew a circle in his phone memo and marked it with work today, gym after work, to keep himself from slacking off.

events.name: After work, walked to the gym for core and upper body training.
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., Ye Mingxuan put on his gym bag and walked from the company to Limei Fitness Center (about 10 minutes away). The gym on Sunday was noticeably quieter than on weekday evenings, with only a few regulars training in the equipment area. He greeted his coach Wang Jian, who gave a thumbs-up from afar to show he had seen him. Following the training plan, he first warmed up on the elliptical for 10 minutes, and after breaking a light sweat, started core training: 3 sets of 45-second planks, 3 sets of 12 bird-dogs, and 3 sets of 30-second side bridges on each side—these movements place very little stress on the lumbar spine but effectively activate the deep stabilizing muscles. During upper abdominal training, he paid special attention to tightening the transversus abdominis and keeping the pelvis neutral to avoid arching his lower back. After core training, he moved on to upper body strength: 4 sets of 15 push-ups, 4 sets of 12 seated dumbbell shoulder presses (using 12 kg dumbbells), and 4 sets of 10 barbell rows—the whole routine basically avoided exercises that put axial load on the lower back. During the training, Coach Wang Jian came over to correct the angle of his back drive during barbell rows, advising, "Start with the shoulder blades, then drive with the arms."

events.name: Stretch after training and feel the physical changes brought by self-discipline.
events.description: After the one-hour training session, Ye Mingxuan spread a mat in the stretching area and did a 15-minute full-body stretch. He stretched his pectoralis major, latissimus dorsi, triceps, hamstrings, and hip flexors in turn, and finally did a 5-minute targeted lower-back stretch—two sets each of Cat-Cow, Child's Pose, and spinal twists. During a break in the stretching, he happened to catch a glimpse of himself in the mirror on the wall and noticed that the deltoid lines in his arms were much more defined than two months ago, and the outline of his abdominal muscles was beginning to show faintly after his body fat percentage dropped. At that moment, he suddenly realized that fitness had transformed from a task he had to force himself to complete into a life habit that feels uncomfortable to skip—even on the exhausting makeup workdays, his footsteps toward the training ground with a gym bag on his back did not hesitate in the slightest. Discipline is not clenching his teeth and holding on; it has become part of him.

events.name: Completed the third session of low-frequency pulse physiotherapy for the lower back
events.description: After leaving the gym, Ye Mingxuan cycled to the community health service center and received his third low-frequency pulse physiotherapy session at the scheduled time. Dr. Liu Wentao placed electrode pads on both sides of his lumbar spine as usual and started a 25-minute soothing electrotherapy mode. During the treatment, Dr. Liu chatted with him about recent events. When he learned that Ye Mingxuan had been sticking with core training and regular stretching, he nodded approvingly: "With your cooperation in rehabilitation training, the results will be much better than physiotherapy alone." After the session, Dr. Liu performed a simple rehabilitation assessment—having Ye Mingxuan do several forward flexion, backward extension, and lateral bending movements—and observed that his lumbar range of motion had basically returned to normal, with the pain score dropping from 4 at the initial visit to 0. Dr. Liu officially confirmed that the entire course of physiotherapy was complete and advised him to maintain a core training habit and have a follow-up checkup every six months. Ye Mingxuan signed the treatment record to confirm, and cycled home feeling his lower back as light as if a burden had been lifted.

start_state.mood: In high spirits—even though it was a make-up workday Sunday, he didn't feel resistant; the pleasant afterglow of last night's gaming get-together with his roommates still lingered, his gym bag was already packed by the door, and he still had his last physical therapy session in the evening.

end_state.mood: His body felt light and his mind was settled—the high-quality core and upper-body training fully released endorphins, and the smooth completion of the third physiotherapy session marked the end of the systematic treatment for lumbar muscle strain. The gradually emerging muscle lines in the mirror and the freedom from soreness in his waist were both rewards from two months of self-discipline. The fatigue from the makeup workday was completely covered by a sense of achievement and physical lightness.

state.daily_exercise: About 1 hour of gym core and upper body training, including 10 minutes of elliptical warm-up, 15 minutes of core training, 30 minutes of upper body strength, and 15 minutes of full-body stretching.

2025-04.daily_overview: April's most important watershed—the first monthly mortgage payment of 4,200 yuan was automatically deducted from his account, and from that moment on, Ye Mingxuan's lifestyle officially entered 'extreme cost-performance austerity mode.' In the morning he went to work unaware, and in the evening when he opened the bank app and saw the balance had dropped from more than 60,000 yuan to less than 20,000 yuan, he sat silently at his desk for several minutes. Then he opened his self-written Python financial analysis program and faced reality with data and logic, making a series of austerity decisions: canceling game top-ups, suspending large ancient coin purchases, reducing eating out, shelving the car savings plan, and starting to make his own lunch boxes. There were no tears and no complaints that day—only an engineer's calm calculation and re-planning in the face of constraints. At the same time, due to days of dietary control and increased exercise, his weight had been steadily declining, but the psychological pressure from the mortgage payment briefly affected his sleep.

events.name: The bank automatically deducted the first monthly mortgage payment.
events.description: At 9:32 a.m., Ye Mingxuan was at his workstation processing revision comments on part drawings when his phone suddenly vibrated — a deduction notification from the China Merchants Bank app: "Your loan account has been debited 4200.00 yuan. Transaction type: mortgage monthly payment (first installment)." He tapped the details to confirm: the housing provident fund account automatically offset 2600 yuan, and the savings account was actually deducted 1600 yuan. But the total balance on the app's homepage instantly changed from 62310 yuan to 58110 yuan, and that number was more glaring than expected. He stared at the screen for a few seconds, closed the app, turned the phone face down on the desk, and continued revising the drawings. But all morning, the number 4200 ran quietly in his mind like a background process.

events.name: In the evening, re-analyzed personal financial data using a Python program
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan sat at his desk, opened his laptop, and ran the financial analysis script he had written in Python. This script was a practice project he made while learning to code last year; he never expected it to become a true decision-making tool today. The program read the monthly budget CSV file he maintained manually—the income column showed a post-tax monthly salary of about 13,000 yuan, and the expense column was read item by item: actual mortgage payment of 1,600 yuan, household daily expenses, phone and internet bills, gym monthly card, commuting fuel costs, and other fixed expenses. The program output a cash flow forecast bar chart showing that while maintaining a basic standard of living, monthly discretionary funds dropped sharply from about 7,000 yuan before buying the house to less than 1,500 yuan. Staring at the chart on the screen, Ye Mingxuan quickly made an analogy in his mind: this was like load analysis in mechanical design—with the addition of a constant load lasting 30 years, all structures had to be rechecked.

events.name: Made a series of financial austerity decisions.
events.description: After completing the financial analysis, Ye Mingxuan opened the memo app on his phone and wrote down austerity measures item by item. In-game purchases — completely canceled, switching to free-to-play mode only. Large expenditures on ancient coins — fully suspended, with a small monthly budget of up to 100 yuan allowed for bargain hunting. Eating out — reduced from several times a month to at most once, with per-person spending no more than 80 yuan. Car purchase savings plan — officially shelved; the 2,000 yuan previously transferred into the car fund each month is now entirely redirected to emergency reserves. He also made a decision: starting tomorrow, he would stop ordering takeout and instead wake up 20 minutes earlier to prepare a lunch bento box to bring to the office. After writing all this, he took a screenshot of the memo and saved it as a private collection in WeChat — not for others to see, but as a rule he set for himself.

events.name: Gather healthy bento recipes and create an ingredient shopping list
events.description: After deciding to make his own bento, Ye Mingxuan immediately opened the Xiachufang app and several recipe websites recommended by fitness bloggers, and started looking for bento plans that suited his situation. The bento had to have enough high-quality protein—chicken breast or fish—complex carbohydrates—brown rice or quinoa—and plenty of vegetables—broccoli or spinach—and also be easy to assemble quickly in the morning and still taste decent after reheating in the company microwave. He finally short-listed five or six combinations and, following the protein-to-vegetable ratio suggested by Coach Wang Jian, prepared a shopping list: skinless chicken breast, frozen shelled shrimp, broccoli, spinach, eggs, brown rice, quinoa, olive oil, and coarse sea salt. He sent the list to himself on WeChat and planned to go to a warehouse supermarket after work the next evening to buy a whole week's worth at once. Before going to sleep, he tossed and turned for half an hour, repeatedly rehearsing tomorrow's shopping and cooking process in his mind, and only gradually fell asleep around midnight.

start_state.mood: He knew the monthly mortgage payment would be deducted today but deliberately didn’t think about it—like the calm while waiting for physical exam results, focusing attention on work.

end_state.mood: Calm and clear-headed—the impact of the sudden drop in his account balance was real, but using data and logic to face the problem brought back his sense of control. The austerity decisions were harsh, but each one had a clear reason and an executable path. Rather than feeling suffocated by the mortgage, he was recalibrating his life with an engineer's mindset. Before going to bed, he glanced at the balance again: 58,110 yuan, enough to last until the year-end bonus. But because he was overthinking, he fell asleep a bit late, and tomorrow morning he would face a real sleep schedule challenge.

state.daily_exercise: Since he was busy with financial analysis in the evening and didn't do dedicated exercise, he climbed 10 floors of stairs back and forth 3 times during the lunch break as an aerobic substitute, and did 10 minutes of waist stretches.

2025-04.daily_overview: The first full working day after the monthly payment was deducted marked the real start of austerity mode. In the morning, I contacted Sun Jing via WeChat and honestly told her that the original May Day road trip was canceled for financial reasons, keeping only the low-cost dinner gathering—this was the first time the austerity decision was announced externally, and the process was calmer than I had imagined. After work, I rode to the warehouse supermarket and, following the shopping list made last night, bought a week's worth of bento ingredients and glass bento boxes, turning the decision to make homemade bento from a plan into reality through action. The day began with careful budgeting of small expenses and ended with the kitchen fridge filled with healthy ingredients, marking the official start of the 'ultimate value-for-money life.' In the evening, I also had a brief exchange with Chen Xiao on WeChat about our feelings after the weekend run, and we agreed to go morning running together in the future.

events.name: Contact Sun Jing to let her know that the May Day trip is cancelled and only the dinner gathering remains.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ye Mingxuan contacted Sun Jing via private WeChat message and honestly explained the situation: the first monthly mortgage payment had been deducted yesterday, and his current finances required strict control of non-essential spending, so the planned one-day self-drive trip to Ji County during the May Day holiday had to be canceled. However, the dinner gathering on May 1 that had already been booked would go ahead as scheduled, and he would attend on time. Sun Jing replied quickly: "Totally understand! The house just came in, everyone can empathize. Dinner follows the old rule—your per-person budget stays the same, and I'll handle the drinks." She added, "Once you've paid the mortgage for two years, you'll get used to it," along with a tear of joy emoji. Ye Mingxuan felt much lighter after replying with thanks—the first external communication in austerity mode had gone far more smoothly than expected, and his friend's understanding removed a burden he would otherwise have had to explain.

events.name: After work, went to the warehouse supermarket to buy bento ingredients and supplies.
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., Ye Mingxuan didn't go home but cycled directly to the warehouse supermarket he had visited with his mother last time. Pushing a shopping cart, he made purchases item by item according to the list on his phone: in the fresh area, he picked two large bags of frozen skinless chicken breast and two boxes of frozen shelled shrimp; then went to the vegetable area and grabbed a large broccoli, two bunches of spinach, and a bag of carrots; finally, in the dry goods area, he found a 5 kg bag of brown rice and a small bag of quinoa. Passing the daily necessities aisle, he remembered last night's plan and took two glass lunch boxes with sealed lids from the shelf—glass is safer than plastic when heated in the microwave, and although they cost 20 yuan more than ordinary lunch boxes, they are worth it for long-term use. At checkout, the total was 286 yuan. He quickly calculated in his mind: these ingredients were enough to make at least eight lunch boxes, with the cost per meal kept under 35 yuan, saving about 60% compared with ordering takeout before. Carrying two big bags of groceries out of the supermarket, he even felt a strange sense of control—austerity was not passive endurance but active design.

events.name: After returning home, sort and organize the ingredients and share post-run insights with Chen Xiao.
events.description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan sorted the purchased ingredients into the refrigerator. He first divided the chicken breast into portions of about 150 grams each in resealable bags, leaving only one pack in the refrigerator to thaw. He mixed brown rice and quinoa in a 2:1 ratio, rinsed them, and used the timer function to set the rice cooker to start cooking automatically at 7 a.m. the next morning. He broke the broccoli into small florets, washed and drained them, and cut carrots into thin strips, placing them in fresh-keeping boxes—these preparations took only 15 minutes, but would reduce the next morning's bento assembly from 20 minutes to 10. His mother, Wang Xiulan, passed by the kitchen door and saw her son methodically portioning ingredients. She froze for a second, then smiled without a word, turned around, took a few eggs from the fridge, and put them beside him: "Beat two eggs into it tomorrow morning; plain chicken breast is too bland." At 8 p.m., Chen Xiao sent a WeChat message asking about the recovery after the weekend run. Ye Mingxuan replied that the core training had made his lower back much more comfortable, and the two agreed to go for a morning run together on the first weekend after the May Day holiday.

start_state.mood: Pragmatic and clear-headed — the first day after the monthly mortgage payment was indeed a bit painful, but the whole austerity plan he made last night gave him a strong sense of direction; starting today, it's all about execution.

end_state.mood: Calm with a slight positive feeling — the communication about canceling the trip went more smoothly than expected, and his execution in buying bento ingredients exceeded his own expectations. Though the frugal life is strict, it seems not as hard to bear as imagined; he even feels a long-lost sense of control. The neatly stacked ingredients in the refrigerator look like a row of soldiers on standby, ready for battle tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: No formal exercise, but I rode an e-bike about 10 kilometers round trip to the warehouse supermarket, carried two bags of about 8 kilograms of groceries home on foot after shopping, and did 10 minutes of core training and lower back stretches before bed.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the last day of April, the trio of work, family, and social life all reached their peak. He got up early to make his first homemade bento, marking the formal shift of frugal mode from plan to daily habit. During the day he finished the last work tasks at the office before the holiday, and after work in the evening he cleaned the living room and bought supplies for tomorrow's college reunion. After dinner, he took the initiative to have a deep conversation with his father Ye Jianguo about Zhou Tao's imminent departure and the pressure of the monthly mortgage payments. His father's calm advice to 'make steady progress' put him somewhat at ease, but his mother's sudden urging after bringing tea—'If you get married earlier, the loan pressure on the two of you will be lighter'—made the living room atmosphere subtly freeze for a moment. In the evening, after confirming all the details of the May Day gathering with Sun Jing on WeChat, he sat alone at his bedroom desk staring at the note that said 'build a career first,' his mind wavering between warmth and pressure. And so April came to a close in silent contemplation. This morning his weight dropped to 72.8 kg, successfully completing April's weight-loss and recovery goals.

events.name: Made a healthy lunch bento for the first time in the early morning
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan got up 20 minutes earlier than usual. The rice cooker had already cooked the brown rice and quinoa as scheduled, giving off the distinctive aroma of grains. He took out the chicken breast that had been thawed overnight and the prepared vegetables from the refrigerator, and opened a simple recipe saved on his phone: cut the chicken breast into cubes, marinate with coarse sea salt and black pepper for 5 minutes, spray a little olive oil in a frying pan, fry over medium heat until both sides are lightly browned, then remove and set aside. Without washing the same pan, pour in the egg mixture and stir-fry quickly into soft scrambled eggs. Put the cooked multigrain rice into a glass lunch box as the base layer, then layer the pan-fried chicken cubes, scrambled eggs, blanched broccoli, and shredded carrots on top in distinct layers of color. Cover the lunch box and put it into an insulated bag; the whole process took less than 15 minutes. Before leaving, he looked at himself in the mirror at the entrance and nodded slightly to himself.

events.name: After work, clean the living room at home and buy supplies for entertaining guests at the party.
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m. and returning home, Ye Mingxuan began preparing for tomorrow's college reunion. He first spent half an hour cleaning the living room: wiping the coffee table and TV cabinet, mopping the floor, and tidying up the books and remote controls scattered on the sofa. He moved the succulents from the balcony plant stand onto the living room coffee table as decoration. Then he rode his bike to the nearby supermarket and, according to the list he had written earlier, bought drinks for the gathering — two bottles of juice, a pack of cola, and a few cans of beer — along with several bags of nuts, chips, and candy as snacks. When passing the specialty section, he deliberately bought two boxes of frozen Goubuli baozi, planning to steam them tomorrow morning so that classmates from other places could taste the authentic Tianjin flavor. At checkout, he kept the budget within 150 yuan, consistent with the rule he had set for himself.

events.name: Had an in-depth conversation with my father after dinner about job changes and mortgage pressure.
events.description: After dinner, instead of going back to his room and turning on the computer as usual, Ye Mingxuan proactively sat down on the living room sofa. After his father Ye Jianguo made tea and sat down, he began to talk about what was on his mind. He said that Zhou Tao was about to leave to start a business, and that he would take over the intelligent warehouse subsystem; the work pressure would increase, but it was also an opportunity to build achievements. He also mentioned that after the first monthly mortgage payment was deducted, his account balance had changed, and he had made a tight budget. Ye Jianguo listened with teacup in hand, and after a moment of silence said: 'When it comes to work, be steady and solid. If you take over after someone leaves, it means your leaders trust you. But don't expect to reach the top in one step. First build your skills. As for money, there's no rush. You're 26 years old, you have a house and a job. Just take it slowly.' His father's tone was as steady as ballast. Ye Mingxuan felt the weight on his shoulders lighten a little after hearing this.

events.name: Mother served tea and pressed about marriage, prompting a brief silence.
events.description: During a pause in the conversation between father and son, mother Wang Xiulan brought over two cups of freshly brewed hot tea and set them on the coffee table. Overhearing them talk about the pressure of the monthly mortgage payment, she stood by the sofa and interjected: “More than 4,000 yuan a month—of course it’s hard for one person to pay alone. You should get married earlier. With two people paying off the loan, the pressure would be less, and you’d have both a house and a family. Wouldn’t that be great?” The moment she said this, the atmosphere in the living room tightened subtly. Ye Mingxuan lowered his head and took a sip of tea without responding—he knew his mother was being caring, but he hadn’t sorted out the question of “build a career first or start a family first” in his own mind. His father didn’t say anything either, just picked up the remote and turned up the TV volume by one notch. A few minutes later, Ye Mingxuan got up, saying he needed to prepare things for tomorrow. He went back to his room and closed the door, and saw the self-written “build a career first” sticky note still attached along the lower edge of the monitor on his desk, its yellow edges slightly curled. He stared at those three words for a while, feeling both the warmth of his parents’ concern and the anxiety of real-life pressure intertwined. Finally, he took a deep breath and began organizing the details for tomorrow’s gathering.

events.name: Confirmed the final details of the May Day gathering with Sun Jing and booked the morning run.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Ye Mingxuan conducted a final round of confirmation with Sun Jing via WeChat. Sun Jing sent a detailed party flow chart: at 11 a.m. everyone would gather at the entrance of the restaurant in the Italian Style District; those confirmed to attend were Ye Mingxuan, Sun Jing, Zhao Xiaofeng, and Liu Yang, who was coming the long way from Hebei, four people in total. Lunch was expected to end before 1 p.m., then they would walk around the Five Great Avenues and Minyuan Square, and around 6 p.m. go to the Hai River bank to watch the sunset and night views. Ye Mingxuan confirmed that the restaurant reservation was fine, and added that he would bring Tianjin-style Goubuli buns as appetizers for everyone. Sun Jing replied with a thumbs-up emoji, saying Liu Yang was already on the high-speed train, and Zhao Xiaofeng would drive directly from the company tomorrow. The two agreed to meet at the restaurant at 10:30 a.m. the next day for a final check. After ending the conversation, he sent Chen Xiao a WeChat message to confirm the first weekend morning run on the morning of the 4th after May Day. events.description: In the evening, had a dinner gathering with colleagues Zhou Tao, Li Xiang and others at a mala fragrant pot restaurant near the company to celebrate the promotion. Before ordering, as usual confirmed there were no seafood ingredients (due to his allergy). During the meal everyone chatted about the future, and colleagues offered to treat, but Ye Mingxuan insisted on going Dutch. After returning home, recorded this dining-out expense in the income/expense script.

events.name: Video-called his parents to share the good news of his promotion.
events.description: After the evening dinner, I returned home. Since my parents had already gone to bed, I sent the promotion news and salary increase details through the family WeChat group. My mother then video-called back, moved to tears, and my father slapped the table in praise. The whole family shared the joy across the screen.

events.name: Adjust the household financial structure
events.description: After hanging up the video call, he opened the family budget spreadsheet, recalculated based on the 15% salary increase, and the mortgage payment share dropped to 24%. He restored the monthly 500 yuan hobby budget and optimized the emergency savings pace. Then he sent the updated asset overview to financial manager Zhang Wei for reference, and also began to think about managing some of his assets independently in the future.

events.name: Winter heating experience.
events.description: Today Tianjin officially started central heating. The radiators at home were warm, and the indoor temperature remained stable at 21°C. Father checked all the valves and confirmed they were normal. Ye Mingxuan sorted out winter clothes, mother took out the electric blanket, and the family calmly switched to winter mode.

start_state.mood: Morning after the promotion, full of ambition and confidence.

end_state.mood: Filled with a sense of happiness and planning, and full of expectations for a new chapter in life.

state.daily_exercise: Morning 10 km endurance run (pace 6 min 20 sec).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and slightly cool, north wind force 2-3, maximum temperature 12°C.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Ye Mingxuan and his father worked together to transform the balcony space, upgrading the messy corner into a tidy and orderly succulent garden and a reserved work area. Then he and his mother sipped tea, admired the new view, and chatted about everyday things. In the afternoon, he devoted himself to in-depth research and selection of a woodworking lathe. In the evening, he compared prices and reviews across several e-commerce platforms. At night, he officially started PMP exam preparation, systematically studying the first module of the project management course, and before bed he continued the regular reading time with his father. Because he had felt a slight chill when getting up in the morning, he replaced the planned morning run with light balcony-tidying activity.

events.name: Install balcony storage shelves and organize the succulent garden
events.description: At 8 a.m., Ye Mingxuan and his father Ye Jianguo first used a brush to sweep away dust accumulated in the corner of the balcony, then temporarily moved stacked old cardboard boxes, empty flowerpots, and other clutter into the living room to free up a working area about two meters wide against the wall. Ye Mingxuan then unpacked the newly purchased metal storage rack, sorted the uprights, cross braces, and shelves according to the drawings, and assembled them one by one with his father's help. His father held a power drill and marked the hole positions on the wall, while Ye Mingxuan steadied the frame; together they anchored the rack to the west wall of the balcony and tested its stability by pushing and pulling repeatedly. After confirming it was firmly installed, Ye Mingxuan moved the existing and newly added succulents—including Sedum pachyphyllum, Sedum rubrotinctum, Cotyledon tomentosa, and other varieties—onto the rack one by one, adjusting the spacing between pots according to the light gradient from the south-facing windowsill to ensure each pot received enough sunlight. After the installation, father and son cleaned up the metal shavings and debris. Mother Wang Xiulan brought over hot tea and three cups. The three of them brought out a folding table and stools, and sat in the newly refreshed balcony corner to drink tea and chat. Mother was full of praise for the neat and orderly small garden.

events.name: Balcony tea chat and family small talk
events.description: At around 10:30, his mother, Wang Xiulan, poured the just-boiled water into the teapot. The three of them sat around the small space newly cleared on the balcony, and sunlight streamed through the window glass onto the succulent leaves, reflecting soft colors. Ye Mingxuan talked with his parents about the upcoming purchase plan for the wood lathe. His father suggested giving priority to domestic brands with offline after-sales service, while his mother was concerned about whether the balcony space could still accommodate the clothes drying rack. After discussion, Ye Mingxuan agreed to replan the drying area on the other side. The conversation then turned to his mother's recent health recovery and the progress of the late Qing history book his father was reading on his Kindle.

events.name: Wood lathe research and model selection.
events.description: From 1:30 to 3:00 in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan opened his laptop in his study and logged into Taobao, JD.com, and the professional woodworking forum Woodworking Enthusiasts, searching one by one for detailed specifications of entry-level precision lathes such as the Sieg C2 and Jingong CA250, including maximum swing over bed, distance between centers, spindle speed range, stability reviews of the machine's weight, and whether matching chucks were available. He created a comparison table in Excel, recording model, price (e.g., the Sieg C2 ranging from about 2,980 to 3,200 yuan), store reputation, received reviews, and after-sales policy, and took screenshots of key pages. In the end, he marked the Sieg C2 as his preferred option.

events.name: Launch PMP exam preparation and study the Initiating Process Group.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened the PMP online course on his dual-screen computer in the study and systematically studied the first two chapters of the Initiating Process Group, focusing on the logic of project charter development and the five types of analysis methods in the stakeholder identification matrix. He used XMind to create a mind map of the Initiating Process Group, recording in detail the inputs, tools and techniques, and outputs for developing the project charter, and compared the cases cited in the course with the automation transformation project recently advanced by his own company, writing down three application ideas in his notebook. The study ended at 9 p.m. After organizing his notes, he filed them into a dedicated project management folder.

events.name: Sunday father-son balcony reading and history discussion.
events.description: After dinner, around 8:30, Ye Mingxuan and his father each carried a cup of water and went to the balcony. His father opened his Kindle and continued reading the second volume of "The Late Qing 70 Years", while Ye Mingxuan browsed a book about the local history of Tianjin during the Republic of China era. When they came to an interesting passage, his father shared an anecdote about the Tianjin Machinery Bureau during the Self-Strengthening Movement, and Ye Mingxuan added his understanding from an engineer's perspective. The father and son then discussed the relationship between technology introduction and national industrialization for about twenty minutes. In the living room, his mother occasionally chimed in while knitting, smiling from time to time at the discussion drifting over from the balcony.

start_state.mood: Full but with a touch of weekend laziness

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Balcony installation and tidying, about 1.5 hours of light physical activity

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, northeasterly wind force 3, high 10°C

2025-11.daily_overview: The workweek began on Monday. Ye Mingxuan worked normally during the day and advanced the mechanical component design project. In the afternoon, while shopping at the supermarket, he accidentally cracked his phone screen. In the evening, he rushed to get it repaired, but due to lack of parts, he had to wait two days and was forced to use his long-unused old backup phone. Later in the evening, he regained his composure, decisively ordered a woodworking lathe based on the weekend research, set up a power outlet and lighting on the balcony in advance, and then continued his PMP studies as planned, incorporating real project cases from work into the discussion.

events.name: Workday design and project advancement.
events.description: From 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Ye Mingxuan continued the detailed design work of a certain transmission shaft component at the office of Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. He used SolidWorks to complete three rounds of parameter optimization and communicated online with simulation engineer Li Xiang about the model boundary conditions. At noon, he had lunch with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang in the company cafeteria and briefly chatted about feedback on the deployment of the previous Python tool.

events.name: Supermarket shopping and accidental phone screen crack
events.description: After getting off work at six in the evening, Ye Mingxuan stopped by a large supermarket near Zhongbei Avenue to buy daily necessities for the week, including milk, whole wheat bread, eggs, and laundry detergent. While scanning the payment code at the checkout counter, he was holding a shopping bag in one hand and operating his phone with the other. The bag suddenly tore at the opening, causing him to lose his balance, and the phone slipped from his damp fingers. The screen hit the metal guide rail of the checkout counter hard, and the entire upper left corner shattered in a spiderweb pattern that extended to the middle. The touchscreen almost completely stopped working, and only the physical buttons could barely wake the screen. Ye Mingxuan calmly put the cracked-screen phone into his backpack and first drove home to put away the groceries.

events.name: Phone damage assessment and repair plan determination
events.description: Back home, Ye Mingxuan used his father's phone to log into the desktop version of WeChat, first contacting the Huawei customer service WeChat Work account he had added earlier and describing the symptoms of a cracked screen and unresponsive touch. The customer service initially determined that the screen assembly needed to be replaced, quoted about 589 yuan, but said they needed to check inventory. He then called the Huawei authorized service center near Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, confirmed it was open until 8:30 p.m., but that day's stock was used up, and it would take about two days to transfer inventory from the regional warehouse. After weighing the options, Ye Mingxuan decided to send it for repair immediately to prevent further screen damage that could make data retrieval impossible.

events.name: Take the cracked-screen phone to the repair center
events.description: At 7:15 PM, Ye Mingxuan brought his cracked-screen phone and personal ID, drove about 15 minutes, and arrived at the Huawei Authorized Service Center. When registering at the counter, he explained in detail how the phone fell, where the damage was, and what abnormal functions occurred. After inspection, the staff confirmed the screen assembly was damaged, entered a repair work order, and told him the cost was 589 yuan, with an expected pickup time on the afternoon of November 19. Ye Mingxuan paid the fee, received the repair order, and left the phone at the service center. Before leaving, he specifically asked whether data migration would be safe. The staff replied that screen replacement would not affect the stored data.

events.name: Activated the backup phone to maintain communications.
events.description: Back home, Ye Mingxuan found an old Honor phone that had been retired about three years ago from the desk drawer, wiped off the dust with a cotton cloth, plugged it in to charge, and waited half an hour before it turned on successfully. Although it ran slowly and the screen was slightly yellowed with age, WeChat, phone calls, and text messages were basically usable. He connected the old phone to the home Wi-Fi, told his parents, Zhou Tao, Zhang Wei and other close friends and relatives via WeChat that his phone had been temporarily changed, and also logged in to WeChat on the computer so he could stay in touch in work groups. He felt a bit reassured after confirming basic communication was fine.

events.name: Ordering the wood lathe and preparing the balcony workspace
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened the Sieg C2 product page on the e-commerce platform on his computer in the study. Based on his weekend research notes, he double-checked the model, price (3,120 yuan including shipping and basic chuck), and buyer reviews. After confirming with customer service that the Tianjin-region stock could be shipped within 5–7 days, he paid via online banking. After placing the order, he immediately went to the balcony. Using the power strip from his father's toolbox and the existing reserved wiring, he installed a waterproof power outlet on the wall beside the storage rack and neatly secured the cables with cable clips. He then mounted a color-temperature-adjustable LED clip lamp on the rack's crossbar to ensure sufficient direct lighting for the future lathe work area. Finally, he moved an old shoe rack piled in the corner into the storage room, freeing up about 80 cm of width for the incoming lathe.

events.name: Continued PMP study with project case analysis
events.description: From 9:00 to 10:15 pm, Ye Mingxuan continued studying the remaining content of the Initiating Process Group in his study, delving into the stakeholder analysis matrix and analyzing how the power-interest quadrant applies to real projects. He then pulled up the weekly meeting minutes of the company's ongoing transmission system optimization project, tried to reorganize the project using the project charter template, listed assumptions and constraints, compared them with the course standard template in his notes, marked three differences between company practice and theory, and organized them into a one-and-a-half-page learning reflection.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to executing today's plan

end_state.mood: Slightly bumpy, but all key matters were advanced.

state.daily_exercise: Commuting walk to and from the office, about 5,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to scattered light showers, northeast wind force 3-4, maximum temperature 9°C

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Tianjin experienced damp, cold weather with light rain. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan completed the checking and calculation of a transmission component at the company and attended the project's midterm progress review meeting, where his project progress control was praised by the project manager. Because of the rain, the regular lunchtime badminton activity was canceled, so he did a set of neck and shoulder stretches in the office. In the evening, while using his backup phone to handle communication matters, he unexpectedly discovered a large amount of unorganized ancient coin catalogs in the cloud backup. So, taking advantage of the time while waiting for his phone to be repaired, he systematically sorted through this material and imported it into the coin chain project library, turning waste into treasure and advancing the digital collection progress. Afterwards, he studied the PMP planning process group as planned and built an overall knowledge framework.

events.name: Rainy workday and project review meeting.
events.description: Early Tuesday morning, fine raindrops hit the office window glass. Ye Mingxuan spent about an hour and a half at his workstation completing a fatigue strength check calculation for a set of drive shafts, then compiled last week's test data into a PPT for the project mid-term review at 10:30 a.m. At the review meeting, he reported the project progress and current technical difficulties to project manager Wang Peng and his direct supervisor Gao Zhiyuan. Wang Peng recognized Ye Mingxuan's clear progress control and risk identification and agreed to add some simulation analysis resources. After the meeting, Gao Zhiyuan briefly reminded him to follow up on the supply chain progress.

events.name: Indoor neck and shoulder stretches at noon instead of badminton
events.description: At noon, the originally scheduled departmental badminton activity was canceled due to wet courts and persistent light rain. Ye Mingxuan and Zhou Tao quickly ate their homemade bento lunches in the break room, then spent about fifteen minutes doing shoulder and neck stretching exercises in the open space by the office windows, including lateral neck flexion, shoulder circles, and cat stretches, to relieve the stiffness caused by sitting for a long morning. Zhou Tao joked that this was a low-budget version of a healthy mid-work exercise routine.

events.name: Discovered the cloud backup on the backup phone and organized the ancient coin catalog.
events.description: Around 7:40 p.m., Ye Mingxuan was at home checking WeChat on his backup phone when he accidentally tapped into the cloud album. He found that, thanks to data synchronization, about two hundred high-definition images of ancient coins taken on several previous phones were still fully preserved in cloud storage, including macro detail shots of his collection of Yuan Datou, Sun Xiaotou, sailing ship dollars, and several Guangxu Yuanbao coins. He immediately logged into his cloud account on the study computer, batch-downloaded the images, and organized them into folders by coin type (silver coins, copper coins) and era (late Qing Dynasty, Republic of China). He then opened the feature library spreadsheet for the Coin Chain project, checked the images against the existing entries one by one, added three missing variety records, and added condition grades and weight data for each coin. The entire sorting process lasted about two hours and unexpectedly advanced the digital collection project by at least a week.

events.name: PMP Planning Process Group first lesson study
events.description: From 9:10 to 10:40 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened the Planning Process Group module of the PMP course in his study and focused on learning the framework processes for developing the project management plan, scope planning, and requirements collection. He used Mubu to create hierarchical notes, expanding the inputs, tools, and outputs of the planning process layer by layer. Combined with practical cases from the evening review meeting, he recorded five communication barriers that exist in practice but were not emphasized in the textbook for the requirements collection phase. After the study session, he exported the mind map to PNG format and saved it on his phone, planning to review it quickly during his subway commute.

start_state.mood: Adapted to the inconvenience of the backup phone, but mood remained stable.

end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied with the results of sorting the ancient coins.

state.daily_exercise: Due to overcast and rainy weather, walked about 4,000 steps all day and did 15 minutes of stretching at noon.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning cloudy, northerly wind force 2, maximum temperature 11°C.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday, the clouds gradually cleared and the work pace remained steady. During the day, Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang jointly optimized the simulation model of the transmission structure, improving the analysis accuracy. In the evening after work, he went to the Huawei Service Center to pick up his phone, which had been repaired and looked as good as new. After two days without his phone, he felt relieved to have it back. Once home, he carefully applied a screen protector, put on a case, and restored the backup data. Later that evening, feeling energized, he first completed his usual home core and stretching routine, then delved into the PMP Planning Process Group content. He proactively created a WBS for a virtual project, turning theoretical knowledge into practical skills.

events.name: Weekday simulation collaboration and departmental coordination
events.description: From 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Ye Mingxuan had a face-to-face discussion with Li Xiang in the office about the drive shaft optimization plan. For the areas where stress concentration appeared in last week's analysis, they reset the chamfer parameters and imported them into ANSYS for verification. Before 3:00 PM, they obtained converged results, with the maximum stress reduced by about 18% compared with the original plan. In the afternoon, he also spent about an hour on the phone with a colleague from the purchasing department about ordering a special steel, confirming that the delivery date would not affect the overall project schedule, and then updated the milestone status in the project management software.

events.name: Picked up the repaired phone and inspected it.
events.description: After leaving work at 6 p.m., Ye Mingxuan drove directly to the Huawei Authorized Service Center. After retrieving his phone with the repair order and ID, he pressed the screen at the counter to check touch sensitivity at the four corners and center, tested multi-finger swiping and long-press response, and opened a white-background page to check for dead pixels or light bleeding. Only after confirming everything was fine did he sign the customer service confirmation form. The repair staff reminded him to avoid squeezing and water contact for 48 hours with the new screen, and Ye Mingxuan took note.

events.name: Phone protection and data recovery after returning home
events.description: After returning home and having dinner, Ye Mingxuan carefully aligned and applied the tempered glass screen protector he had bought in advance in his study, using a rubber band to help eliminate air bubbles, then put on a heavy drop-resistant protective case. He then used the Phone Clone feature built into his Huawei phone to sync the past two days of call logs, WeChat chat history, and new photos from his backup phone to his primary phone. He also opened the original full backup file and checked item by item that contacts, notes, and favorite images had all been restored correctly. Finally, he recorded the repair cost of 589 yuan and the 28 yuan screen protector expense in the family bookkeeping script.

events.name: Evening home core and stretching routine
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan changed into his workout clothes, spread a yoga mat in the living room, and did his regular Wednesday home training plan of core strength and full-body stretching. The plan included 3 sets of planks, Russian twists, glute bridges, and lower-body stretches for the hamstrings and iliopsoas, totaling about 40 minutes. During the workout, he clearly felt that his muscles were a bit stiff from the lack of systematic activity over the previous two days, and he felt much more relaxed after finishing the stretching.

events.name: In-depth study of the PMP planning process group and WBS creation
events.description: From 9 p.m. to 10:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan studied the chapters on Define Scope, Create WBS, and Define Activities in the Planning Process Group. He first drew on paper the preparation of a small community handicraft exhibition he envisioned as a virtual project, breaking it down into a total of 32 work packages along four main branches: venue, exhibits, publicity, and reception. After coding them by hierarchy in Excel, he organized them into a WBS tree diagram. Then, based on the WBS, he tried to draw a simple schedule network diagram, marked four critical paths, and applied the learned Precedence Diagramming Method directly to practice. The whole process lasted nearly two hours, and his notes filled four pages of A4 paper with dense writing.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to picking up my phone, anticipation building up.

end_state.mood: The joy of recovering what was lost, and the double rewards of learning and training

state.daily_exercise: 40 minutes of core and stretching training at home, about 7,000 steps of commuting walking and midday stroll

2025-11.daily_overview: Thursday saw the return of sunshine, and daytime temperatures rose slightly. In the early morning, Ye Mingxuan completed a 3-kilometer tempo run at a pace of 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer, an improvement from the beginning of the month. During the day, he spent the morning working with Gao Zhiyuan on an internal review of the department's technical issues, and the afternoon preparing materials for the weekend Python salon talk, turning the core logic of the recently developed parametric tool for mechanical standard parts into a presentation PPT. In the evening, he continued his PMP study as planned, tackling two key modules, cost estimation and risk identification, and recorded several methods that could be used in the current project. He also gave the final polish to his speech for the weekend sharing session.

events.name: Morning tempo run training
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan got up, put on his running gear, and went for a 3-kilometer tempo run on the Zhongbei Avenue trail. After a sufficient warm-up, he maintained a pace of 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer, with his heart rate remaining at around 155 bpm. Although the morning temperature was low, the sun was rising, and his body gradually warmed up; on the last kilometer he even felt a bit relaxed. After the run, he did 10 minutes of stretching, then went home to take a shower and have breakfast.

events.name: Department technical issues review and follow-up action organization.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Gao Zhiyuan convened Ye Mingxuan and two other engineers on the team for a small but focused technical retrospective meeting to trace the causes of abnormal vibration that had appeared during an earlier gearbox test. Ye Mingxuan proactively presented a fault tree analysis diagram he had drawn, proposing that the accumulation of assembly tolerances was likely the root cause, and this was unanimously recognized. After the meeting, Gao Zhiyuan privately praised him for thinking more systematically and suggested using a more standardized risk register in future retrospectives, hinting that he could develop in the direction of project management in greater depth.

events.name: Prepare materials for the Python tech salon sharing session.
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan had dinner at home early and entered the study before 7 p.m. to work on the sharing materials. He divided the functional modules of the parametric Python tool he had developed for mechanical standard parts into four main blocks: parameter reading and cleaning, 3D interface calls, calculation engine, and report output. He took screenshots of each and wrote annotations. Using PowerPoint, he made a concise but technically deep presentation of about 25 slides, including two directly runnable code examples and a before-and-after efficiency comparison table from real usage (saving about 70% of repetitive calculation time). Then he wrote a 10-minute presentation outline and rehearsed it once against the study wall, adjusting his speaking pace and two terminology explanations so that listeners from different backgrounds could also understand. Because the new efficiency comparison chart was added, the production time ran about half an hour longer than expected.

events.name: Study the second half of the PMP Planning Process Group
events.description: From about 9:25 PM to around 11:00 PM, Ye Mingxuan watched the video course on the latter half of the Planning process group, focusing on cost estimation (including the distinction between analogous estimation, parametric estimation, and bottom-up estimation), the S-curve analysis method for budgeting, and tools such as the Delphi technique and SWOT analysis for risk identification. In his notes, he recorded the standard template for the risk register and four risk response strategies (avoid, transfer, mitigate, accept), and specifically noted that he would try applying analogous estimation to calibrate the initial budget during the upcoming launch phase of a new company project. After studying, he closed his eyes and silently recited the applicable scenarios of the five estimation methods.

start_state.mood: Energetic and ready for speed training

end_state.mood: Share the sense of accomplishment after the material takes shape and the fulfillment after digesting knowledge

2025-11.daily_overview: Although Friday's work was tight, the atmosphere was relaxed. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan sent the draft of his weekend salon sharing talk to Gao Zhiyuan for feedback; in the afternoon, he wrapped up end-of-day work and refined the presentation details. In the evening, he formally invited close colleagues from his department to a dinner celebrating his promotion. The mala xiangguo dinner had a lively atmosphere, with friends talking freely about technology trends and side-business interests, and potential collaboration plans for the team surfaced. After dinner, he went home and tidied up a bit. In the evening, he kept studying the Executing Process Group and, by connecting it to real work, found several areas where practices could be improved. Because the dinner ended late and his mood was high, he fell asleep later than usual.

events.name: Colleague dinner invitation and reservation after the promotion news was confirmed.
events.description: The official notice of the promotion to Senior Engineer was sent out last week, but it was after HR sent the electronic job-level adjustment confirmation letter to the company email at around 4:30 PM on Friday afternoon that Ye Mingxuan's expectation finally became reality. He then @-mentioned Zhou Tao and Li Xiang in the work group, and verbally invited Gao Zhiyuan (Senior Engineer Gao declined the dinner because he had to pick up his child from school, but expressed congratulations). After that, he called the Mala Xiangguo restaurant near the company and booked a semi-open booth that could seat six for 6:30 PM.

events.name: Promotion celebration dinner and in-depth exchange with the team.
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan arrived at the Mala Xiangguo restaurant with Zhou Tao, Li Xiang, and another familiar young colleague. The four ordered a hot pot with a mildly spicy soup base and a rich mix of meat and vegetables. To show his sincerity, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to pay the bill. During the meal, the conversation naturally moved from Ye Mingxuan's promotion insights to the future optimization direction of the Python tool. Zhou Tao enthusiastically proposed that he give a small-scale technical sharing session within the department. Li Xiang, in turn, asked about the details of Ye Mingxuan's woodworking side business, saying that his fiancée's birthday was approaching and he really wanted to commission a wooden ornament, and he actively asked to help share and promote it. Encouraged by his companions' recognition and expectations, Ye Mingxuan sincerely thanked them for their support. At the end of the dinner, the four shared a pitcher of sour plum juice and raised their glasses, and the atmosphere reached its peak. After the dinner, Ye Mingxuan felt slightly bloated, likely because the food was a bit heavy.

events.name: Tidying up after returning home and evening study of the Executing Process Group
events.description: The dinner gathering ended at 8:30 p.m. Ye Mingxuan walked with Li Xiang for about fifteen minutes and said goodbye at the Zhongbei Avenue intersection in Xiqing District. After getting home, he washed his face with warm water to freshen up, changed out of his coat, and opened the study window to let in some air. After resting briefly, at 9:45 he opened the PMP Executing Process Group course and studied two core processes: Direct and Manage Project Work, and Manage Quality. In his notebook, he wrote down the key theoretical points and his own actual practices in executing company projects in left and right columns. He circled three practices worth improving in red pen, numbered them, and wrote down corresponding adjustment ideas, filling about one and a half pages in total.

start_state.mood: Friday's ease interwoven with the realness of the promotion.

end_state.mood: Warm satisfaction from friendship and recognition; a little full but not enough to affect falling asleep

state.daily_exercise: Commute plus walking to the appointment totaled about 8,000 steps.

2025-11.daily_overview: Saturday was a day full of technical exchange and professional visibility. Early in the morning, Ye Mingxuan completed an 11 km endurance run according to his long-distance running plan, with a steady pace of 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer, further strengthening his aerobic base. In the morning, after checking the family first aid kit, he went to a tech entrepreneurship café in Zhongbei Town to attend the bimonthly Python technology salon. As one of the guest speakers, he systematically explained to more than forty local developers the architecture and practical value of a parametric tool for mechanical standard parts, demonstrated code, and answered questions. After the event, he gained new contacts and collaboration invitations. In the afternoon, he returned home, summarized the salon notes, and joined the group. In the evening, he capitalized on the momentum to finish the remaining content of the Executing Process Group and simulated a small case using project management software, consolidating a week of PMP study.

events.name: Morning 11 km long-distance running training.
events.description: At seven o'clock on Saturday morning, after a full warm-up downstairs in his residential community, Ye Mingxuan set off along the Zhongbei Avenue trail toward South Canal Park. He kept a relaxed pace of 6:25 per kilometer, with a heart rate of 140 bpm for the first 5 kilometers. In the middle section he sped up slightly to 6:20 per kilometer, and completed the 11 kilometers in about 1 hour 10 minutes. Today the temperature was slightly lower but windless, and it felt comfortable. There was no obvious fatigue after the long distance, indicating that his endurance was steadily improving. After the run, he did a systematic 15-minute stretch on a bench in Canal Park and drank the warm water he had brought to rehydrate.

events.name: Check the family first-aid kit and restock supplies.
events.description: Before breakfast, while he was clear-headed on Saturday morning, Ye Mingxuan took out the family first-aid kit from the living room storage cabinet and spread it on the coffee table to check item by item. He found that only one tourniquet was still intact, gauze and elastic bandages were insufficient, and the dressing scissors were a little rusty, so he made a shopping list in the memo app on his phone. After breakfast, he went to a pharmacy near his residential community and bought two tourniquets, four packs of sterile gauze, three rolls of elastic bandages, and a new pair of scissors. After returning home, he neatly restocked the first-aid kit and stuck a note in the first-aid manual marking the date of this restock and a reminder for the next check.

events.name: Preparation before leaving for the Python technical salon
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ye Mingxuan checked the items in his backpack: the laptop was fully charged, the PPT was on the desktop and backed up to a USB drive, adapters and chargers were all there, and he also put in some business cards and a paper notebook for taking notes. He confirmed the event venue was the multifunction room on the second floor of Kechuang Cafe, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, about 8 km from home, and planned to drive there and leave early.

events.name: Python Technical Salon topic sharing
events.description: After arriving at the café at 10:30 a.m., Ye Mingxuan picked up his speaker badge at the registration desk, then chatted briefly with the organizers and a few other speakers in the tea-break area. At 11:00 sharp, the tech salon officially began. The event was organized by the local Python community, with more than forty participants. When it was Ye Mingxuan's turn, he used a projector to present for nearly twenty minutes on the development history, core logic, and code examples of the parametric tool, and especially demonstrated how to automatically generate part parameter tables by calling the Runge-Kutta numerical method. Several developers in the audience who were interested in digital transformation in the manufacturing industry took notes attentively and snapped photos. Although he spoke a little fast due to occasional nervousness, the overall logic was clear and the demonstration went smoothly.

events.name: Post-salon follow-up exchanges and building new contacts.
events.description: After the talk, the session moved to free interaction. Ye Mingxuan was surrounded by six participants near the projection screen, answering questions one after another. The answers involved the tool's adaptability to non-standard parts, whether it could be extended into a general-purpose library, and the exchange format for test data. He calmly answered each question and showed rough sketches of his ideas. Through introductions and exchanging WeChat contacts, he met three local developers who also lived in Tianjin. One of them, Fang Chen, head of a small software company, invited him to join a WeChat group for potential cooperation on the automated testing tool. Ye Mingxuan happily joined and agreed to discuss further online later.

events.name: Returned home, sorted things out, and archived the salon takeaways
events.description: After the event officially ended at 2 p.m., Ye Mingxuan drove home. In his study, he first photographed and archived the paper business cards he had received that day, entered the information of three new contacts from the WeChat group into his address book and noted the date of first meeting. Then, on a new page of his personal project document, he recorded two new inspirations proposed by someone at the salon: standardized interfaces and modular expansion. Finally, he renamed the final version of the PPT, which included the Q&A content from the audience, as Python Salon 1122 Final Draft and filed it away.

events.name: Executing Process Group wrap-up and hands-on practice with project management software
events.description: Starting at 7:40 p.m., Ye Mingxuan studied content from the Executing Process Group, including Acquire Resources, Develop Team, and Manage Communications. During this process, he opened ProjectLibre and, following the steps taught in the course, added resource sheets, assigned roles, and set hourly rates and calendars for his preset community craft exhibition mini-project. Then, combining all the process group knowledge he had learned that week, he reviewed the case, tried to identify two risk points for human resource conflicts, and recorded countermeasures. The whole session lasted until about 10 p.m., bringing a complete end to the week's PMP study.

start_state.mood: Focused and slightly excited anticipation of sharing

end_state.mood: Sense of accomplishment and satisfaction from expanded professional influence

state.daily_exercise: Morning 11 km long run (pace 6:25 per km), 15 minutes of stretching, about 4,500 steps walked during the activity day.

2025-11.daily_overview: Sunday focused on family care and knowledge consolidation. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan organized and implemented the third family first-aid drill as planned. The whole family took turns practicing bleeding control and bandaging and the procedure for handling sudden fainting. His mother proactively improved the way first-aid supplies were stored, and the family safety culture became increasingly solid. In the afternoon, he devoted himself to studying the PMP Monitoring and Controlling Process Group, marking key points in the textbook and comparing them with actual projects. In the evening, father and son continued the balcony co-reading ritual, and because his father's pace had picked up, their discussion developed into a deeper exploration of modern historical figures. As he was a little sleepy on Sunday morning, he got up half an hour later than usual and did not schedule a morning run, mainly doing light activities.

events.name: Third family first aid drill—special session on bleeding control and bandaging
events.description: On Sunday at 9:30 a.m., Ye Mingxuan arranged the chairs by the dining table into a temporary operation area and announced the start of the third family first aid drill. The theme this time was upper limb bleeding control and bandaging. Ye Mingxuan first gave a brief review of the direct pressure method and key points for using a tourniquet, lasting about five minutes. Then his father, Ye Jianguo, acted as the casualty and sat on a chair, with a red simulated wound drawn on his left arm. His mother, Wang Xiulan, had to take the tourniquet out of the first aid kit within the specified time and apply it accurately at the designated position to complete pressure bandaging. During her operation, she first tied the tourniquet too high. Ye Mingxuan immediately stopped her and helped her redo it properly at the correct position on the distal biceps. His father maintained a serious expression throughout and cooperated, occasionally correcting his mother's judgment on the tightness of the bandage. After the operation, the three of them reviewed and summarized together. Ye Mingxuan praised his mother for making obvious progress compared to last time, but emphasized that the tourniquet should not be used for more than two hours.

start_state.mood: Wake up from the weekend rhythm feeling calm and at peace.

end_state.mood: Deep satisfaction from family security and spiritual communication

state.daily_exercise: First-aid drill practice and cleanup, about 30 minutes of light activity.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, westerly wind force 2, maximum temperature 12°C

2025-11.daily_overview: On Monday, a working day with calm weather, Ye Mingxuan handled some technical correspondence from suppliers in the morning, then in the afternoon attended a year-end milestone sprint meeting convened by the project manager. After work, as planned, he first did core and stretching exercises at home, then continued studying the PMP Closing Process Group, focusing on sorting out the differences between contract closure and administrative closure. He also combined the review records of a project closed last year to try to identify shortcomings in its closing phase, as advance preparation for his expanded role after promotion.

events.name: Workday correspondence processing and sprint mobilization meeting.
events.description: From 9:00 to 12:00 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan replied to three emails from suppliers consulting on machining processes, and communicated by phone with the procurement and quality departments about a batch of bearing orders in transit that did not meet standards. At 2:00 PM, project manager Wang Peng convened all project team members in a small meeting room for an approximately one-hour year-end sprint mobilization meeting, clarifying that trial production and verification of the current batch of parts must be completed by mid-December. At the meeting, Ye Mingxuan was assigned to follow up on test bench resource allocation, and he and Li Xiang immediately checked the simulation machine-time schedule after the meeting.

events.name: Evening home core and stretching routine
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did core strength training according to his fixed Monday plan, including dynamic planks, lying leg raises, side bridges, etc., combined with targeted stretching after running, focusing on releasing the iliotibial band and piriformis muscle. The session lasted 45 minutes; his heart rate rose slightly but was overall low-intensity.

events.name: Learning PMP Closing Process Group standards.
events.description: From 8:00 to 9:30 in the evening, Ye Mingxuan studied the two main modules of the Closing Process Group: contract closure and administrative closure. Following the course handouts, he mapped out the steps in contract closure, such as delivery acceptance, final payment settlement, and warranty terms, as well as lessons learned summary and organizational process asset updates in administrative closure. Then he took out the review report of a transmission case optimization project closed in 2024 and checked, according to what he had learned that day, what steps had been missed. He found that the original report lacked systematic stakeholder satisfaction confirmation records, so he noted in his notebook that a clear stakeholder acceptance confirmation form should be added before project closure in the future.

events.name: Evening reading and a brief conversation with my father
events.description: After studying, Ye Mingxuan walked from the study to the living room, where his father was reading content about warlords under the floor lamp with reading glasses. He sat on the opposite sofa, spent about twenty minutes reading a chapter of Mechanical Design in Plain Language, and casually asked his father a question about the comfort of reading devices. He felt reassured after confirming that his father had become skilled at adjusting the font size and brightness.

start_state.mood: Dawn of a goal-oriented workday

end_state.mood: The fulfillment of internalizing knowledge and reflecting on practice

state.daily_exercise: 45 minutes of core and stretching exercises at home; about 7,000 steps from commuting and a midday walk around the park.
