2025-11.daily_overview: Tuesday's work progressed in an orderly manner. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan completed the initial coordination of test bench resource allocation. At noon, he attended the department's regular badminton gathering and played doubles with colleagues from the sales department, with moderate exercise. After work, mindful of his childhood friend Zhang Wei's repeated reminders about his seafood allergy, he carefully checked the menu and logged the dining expense before meeting Zhang Wei in person for barbecue in the evening. After returning from the dinner catch-up, he made the most of his time to review the five PMP knowledge areas for reinforced memorization. Before bed, he also led a family drill on first aid for sudden fainting, putting the airway simulation scenario set last week into practice, and the family's emergency coordination further improved.

events.name: Lunchtime cross-department badminton social
events.description: At twelve noon, Ye Mingxuan and several colleagues from his department went to the badminton hall near the company for a friendly doubles match with three colleagues from the sales department. The atmosphere was relaxed. Ye Mingxuan partnered with Zhou Tao and won two games. During the activity, he mainly controlled backcourt clears; his physical exertion was moderate, lasting about 45 minutes.

events.name: Allergen check before a dinner with childhood friend Zhang Wei.
events.description: At 5:40 p.m., Ye Mingxuan received a WeChat message from Zhang Wei confirming the evening barbecue gathering, set for 7 o'clock at a newly opened wire-grill barbecue restaurant in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District. Remembering that Zhang Wei had once had an allergic reaction after accidentally eating a sauce containing oyster sauce, Ye Mingxuan specifically called the restaurant in advance to ask about the ingredients in the signature dishes. After confirming there were no seafood ingredients, he contacted Zhang Wei again to tell him it was safe to go.

events.name: Barbecue and catching up with childhood friend Zhang Wei
events.description: At 6:50 p.m., Ye Mingxuan met Zhang Wei at a barbecue restaurant. They ordered safe dishes such as grilled skewers, grilled potato slices, and grilled chicken wings, and chose two bottles of soda water. During the meal, Zhang Wei mentioned that he had been paying attention to the used car market recently. Based on his knowledge of mechanics, Ye Mingxuan shared his views on the durability of several common car engines. Zhang Wei then asked about Ye Mingxuan's work situation, and when he heard about the promotion, he enthusiastically slapped the table to congratulate him. The gathering lasted about two hours. At the end, Zhang Wei paid and split the bill, and Ye Mingxuan expressed his thanks.

events.name: Archive meal records and allergy screening results.
events.description: After returning home at 9 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened the household income and expense script in his study, recorded tonight's barbecue expense of 86 yuan (his share) under the food and socializing category, and noted in the remarks column that he had checked the allergens and the store's safety record. After entering it, he quickly browsed the past two weeks' spending on dining out.

events.name: Review of the five PMP knowledge areas and clarification of confusing concepts.
events.description: From 9:45 to 10:40 p.m., focusing on the five knowledge areas he had learned the previous week—scope, time, cost, quality, and human resources—Ye Mingxuan organized the key inputs, tools, and outputs of each area into a comparison table in his notebook, and specifically highlighted the differences among the scope baseline, schedule baseline, and cost baseline. He then randomly selected five cross-knowledge-area scenario questions from the course practice question bank, completed them closed-book, and reviewed the wrong answers afterward, using a highlighter to mark easily confused concepts such as the difference between quality assurance and quality control.

events.name: Family Drill: Sudden Syncope Response Procedure
events.description: At 10:50 p.m., Ye Mingxuan told his parents to do a brief family drill. This time he set up a scenario where his mother, Wang Xiulan, suddenly fainted in the bathroom, requiring his father to respond immediately. Ye Mingxuan demonstrated the whole process: checking consciousness, calling for help and dialing 120, and gently placing his mother in the recovery position. Then he had his father repeat the steps under supervision. This time his father was calmer and the steps were smooth, except that he hung up the emergency call too quickly; Ye Mingxuan reminded him to wait for the dispatcher's permission before hanging up. The drill lasted only fifteen minutes. Afterward, his mother got up and said with a smile that she was now even more familiar with the fainting procedure than they were. After the drill, he recorded the completion in his health diary.

start_state.mood: Stable condition; looking forward to meeting old friends in the evening.

end_state.mood: Satisfaction of balancing friendship and family safety.

state.daily_exercise: 45 minutes of badminton at noon, 6,500 steps walked throughout the day

date_attribute.weather: Overcast, northeast wind level 3, maximum temperature 9°C

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday, the weather was overcast and windy, and a cold snap hit Tianjin with the actual temperature dropping below freezing. Ye Mingxuan decisively canceled his outdoor morning run. The pace of work during the day was a bit tight. During test bench debugging, he encountered a control card compatibility issue; after coordinating with the supplier by phone, he temporarily avoided the blockage through a firmware downgrade. After returning home in the evening, he first completed a home core workout and 30 minutes of indoor cycling trainer practice as a substitute for running. At night, he devoted all his time to PMP study, reviewing the remaining five knowledge areas (communications, risk, procurement, stakeholders, and integration). Using a classic smart city project case study, he tried to connect the various processes from an integration management perspective while reading, and his overall understanding deepened significantly.

events.name: Cold wave caused the morning run to be canceled; switched to indoor training preparation.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan checked the weather on his phone and saw that the outdoor temperature was -3°C with strong winds, so he decisively gave up his planned morning run. He decided to do indoor alternative exercise during his evening home training time and checked the old bike trainer he had assembled earlier to make sure it would be usable in the evening. After breakfast, he left early and drove to work with the car heater turned up full.

events.name: Troubleshooting compatibility issues with the test bench control card.
events.description: At 10 a.m., while assisting the quality department with data acquisition testing on the test bench, Ye Mingxuan discovered a driver compatibility issue between the new control card and the existing data acquisition software, causing unstable sampling frequency. He contacted the supplier's technical support by phone, and they suggested temporarily downgrading the firmware from v3.2 to v3.0 to avoid the conflict. After a brief confirmation with Gao Zhiyuan, he implemented the plan and restored stable operation of the test bench before noon. He then organized the operating steps into a concise document and shared it in the project technical group.

events.name: Evening indoor cycling and core training.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan set up the modified bike trainer in the living room and did 30 minutes of moderate-intensity cycling, with an average cadence of 85 rpm and a heart rate maintained at 135 bpm. Afterwards, he continued with his regular Wednesday home core and stretching routine, including stability exercises such as dead bugs and bird dogs, as well as stretches for the chest muscles and hip flexors that were tight from prolonged sitting. The total session lasted about 40 minutes. After training, he took a shower, feeling warm and relaxed.

events.name: Systematically review the remaining five knowledge areas of PMP
events.description: From 8:30 to 10:00 in the evening, Ye Mingxuan continued his systematic PMP knowledge area review, focusing on communications, risk, procurement, stakeholder, and integration management. He downloaded an online smart city project case study and read it alongside the course materials, sketching two A3 mind maps summarizing the communication channel calculation formula, the classification of risk response strategies, and a comparison of contract types. In the integration management section, he highlighted the role of the CCB (Change Control Board) in the change control process, recalled how a design change at the company had caused chaos due to loose processes, and wrote down two organizational improvement thoughts for later discussion with Gao Zhiyuan.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but driven by the plan; the cold weather made him somewhat daunted.

end_state.mood: The sense of ease after completing indoor training and the grounded feeling of a knowledge system gradually taking shape.

state.daily_exercise: Indoor cycling for 30 minutes, home core work and stretching for 40 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, westerly wind force 2-3, maximum temperature 11°C

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thursday, the weather cleared up but the temperature was still low. In the early morning, Ye Mingxuan put on his newly purchased windproof jacket and completed an easy 6 km run, feeling comfortable. During the day, he took part in the initial data collection from the test bench and prepared a report. In the evening, he watched the new episode of This! Is Iron Armor with a relaxed mood. The exquisite fighting mechanical structures in the show inspired him, so he drew some feasible mechanism sketches in his woodworking notebook and searched for reference materials on wooden robotic arms. After recording his ideas, he decisively switched to a PMP mock test and completed a full set of mock exam questions within the allotted time, paving the way for a systematic review to identify and fill gaps.

events.name: Morning easy 6-kilometer run
events.description: At 6:40 a.m., Ye Mingxuan, wearing his newly arrived windproof running jacket and touchscreen gloves, did a 6-kilometer easy run on the Zhongbei Avenue trail at a pace of 6:10 per kilometer and a heart rate of 138 bpm. The new gear provided good wind protection and kept his hands warm enough; he never felt cold throughout the run. After the run, he stretched for 10 minutes and went home for breakfast.

events.name: Weekday debugging and initial test data collection
events.description: From 9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan followed up on the preliminary data collection work for the test bench. During this period, he recorded a batch of valid vibration spectrum data and, using his lunch break, organized it into chart form and sent it to Li Xiang for further spectrum analysis. At around 4:00 p.m., project manager Wang Peng briefly listened to Ye Mingxuan's progress report and acknowledged the standardization of the test data collection.

events.name: Watching the variety show “This! Is Iron Armor” and preparing the stand.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan fixed the tablet to one side of the desk with a metal stand, adjusted the volume and brightness, and took out his well-worn cowhide-cover woodworking notebook and a 0.5 mm mechanical pencil, placing them close at hand. He deliberately turned off work WeChat notifications in advance to focus on watching the latest episode of "This! Is Fighting Robot".

events.name: Variety show sparks creativity — combat mechanism analysis.
events.description: Midway through the show, Ye Mingxuan was deeply attracted by a fighting robot that used a crank-rocker mechanism to achieve high-frequency hammering. He repeatedly rewound and forwarded the footage to watch its motion trajectory. He paused the video and quickly sketched a simplified kinematic diagram of the mechanism in his notebook, marking the approximate proportions of the crank radius and connecting rod length and the possible stroke distance. Later in the show, another creative robot using a four-bar linkage to flip itself over appeared. Ye Mingxuan immediately drew a second mechanism sketch beside the first and wrote a note suggesting a simplified wooden version. In just one episode of the variety show, he recorded a total of 4 pages of mechanism ideas.

events.name: Wooden mechanical arm material collection and feasibility assessment for production
events.description: After the show ended, while the creative inspiration was still fresh, Ye Mingxuan searched keywords such as wooden robotic arm and wooden crank linkage on Bilibili and woodworking forums, and found three tutorial videos with high view counts, including a series on making a three-degree-of-freedom robotic arm from birch. He copied the video links into the woodworking favorites folder in his browser, and noted in his notebook possible wood choices (beech or maple), expected joint load capacity, and required hardware. A preliminary estimate showed that the difficulty and cost of making a simple linkage demonstration model were within a controllable range, and he planned to refine it further after the lathe arrived.

events.name: Complete PMP mock exam practice
events.description: From 9:10 to 11:00 in the evening, Ye Mingxuan calmed down, logged into the PMP mock exam system on his computer, and completed a full 200-question practice test within the time limit. Throughout the process, he tried to simulate the real exam pace, marking uncertain questions first and reviewing them together later. After submitting, the system showed a correct rate of about 70%. He briefly browsed the error distribution, categorized the question types, saved them as a PDF, and planned to analyze them in detail the next day.

start_state.mood: Anticipation for the evening variety show coexists with the desire to create.

end_state.mood: The excitement of ignited creativity and the composure after the mock exam

state.daily_exercise: Morning easy 6 km run, midday walk and light stretching, about 6000 steps.

2025-11.daily_overview: Friday marked the end of the workweek. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan participated in the annual fire evacuation drill organized by the department, which enhanced his practical awareness of disaster response. In the afternoon, he focused on completing the interim report on the test bench and submitted it to Gao Zhiyuan for review. In the evening after work, he devoted himself to reviewing PMP mistakes, going back to the textbook for each weak knowledge point from last night's mock exam, and systematically recording error-prone points in his mistake notebook. His overall exam preparation approach became increasingly clear.

events.name: Annual departmental fire evacuation drill.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the company organized the annual fire evacuation drill. After the alarm sounded, Ye Mingxuan, along with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, followed the fire exit signs and evacuated from the third-floor office to the assembly point on the east side of the factory, taking about 3 minutes. At the assembly point, the safety officer conducted hands-on training on using fire extinguishers. Ye Mingxuan tried operating a CO2 fire extinguisher to put out an oil pan fire, deepening his memory of the key steps: pulling the pin, pressing the handle, and sweeping. After returning to the office, he joked with Zhou Tao that this drill and the family first aid drill were essentially both muscle memory training.

events.name: Submit the interim report for the test bench
events.description: From 2:00 to 4:30 in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan compiled this week's test data, control card degradation records, and preliminary conclusions into an interim report of about 12 pages, including charts and suggestions for follow-up test plans, and sent it by email to Gao Zhiyuan for review, copying Wang Peng and Li Xiang. Around 5:00, Gao Zhiyuan replied on WeChat that the content was solid and the project could be concluded next week, which gave Ye Mingxuan a clear sense of next week's work pace.

events.name: PMP wrong-question analysis and textbook review
events.description: From 7:30 to 9:30 in the evening, Ye Mingxuan opened the PDF list of wrong answers from last night’s mock exam and classified the errors into three types: concept confusion, calculation mistakes, and situational judgment errors. Using a red pen, he went through each question one by one against the textbook, summarizing the correct explanation for each wrong question into one or two lines of key points, which he transcribed into his loose-leaf mistake notebook, noting the source page numbers. For example, he recorded the concise contrast that control quality focuses on checking compliance, while management quality focuses on process improvement. After two hours of focused organizing, he added about fifteen entries to the mistake notebook, and the review structure became clearer.

start_state.mood: Pacing when wrapping up work

end_state.mood: A clear sense of direction after the review.

2025-11.daily_overview: Saturday was a day that combined physical exertion and family warmth. In the early morning, Ye Mingxuan completed a long-planned 12-kilometer training run. Along the greenway of Nan Canal Park, he steadily increased his pace, and his body data showed continued progress in endurance. In the afternoon, he accompanied his mother by bus to Ancient Culture Street. While browsing for old coins and checking out the succulent market, the mother and son interacted with bargaining and discussions about aesthetics. They returned with one copper coin and three new succulents. After getting home, he carefully repotted the succulents and cleaned the old coins. In the evening, he did targeted PMP review based on analysis of his wrong answers, and before bed, he briefly discussed next week's family plans with his parents.

events.name: Morning 12 km long-distance running training.
events.description: At 7:00 on Saturday morning, the temperature in Tianjin was about 3°C. Ye Mingxuan put on a fleece-lined compression long-sleeve running top and a windbreaker, then did about 15 minutes of dynamic warm-up downstairs in the community on Zhongbei Avenue, including high knees, jumping jacks, and lunge twists. After warming up, he set off from home and ran along the newly explored extension of the South Canal Park greenway. He kept a pace of about 6:30 per kilometer for the first five kilometers, then slightly increased it to 6:25 as his body warmed up. There were not many morning runners in the park, and sunlight filtered through thin clouds, reflecting a glimmer on the water. At the turnaround point, he briefly refueled with a few sips of warm water and half a banana, then maintained a steady cadence on the way back. He covered a total of 12 kilometers in about 1 hour and 18 minutes. His sports watch showed an average heart rate of 150 bpm, which was in the aerobic endurance zone.

events.name: Stretching recovery and data recording after a long run
events.description: At about 8:15, Ye Mingxuan did about 15 minutes of systematic static stretching in the park rest pavilion, covering the quadriceps, hamstrings, glutes, and other key running muscle groups, while checking the lap data on his sports watch to confirm that his heart rate in the last three kilometers had not spiked abnormally. After returning home, he recorded the running data (distance, time, average pace, heart rate changes) in the monthly training list of the family health diary, and wrote down a small goal: 12 km felt good, with a December target of increasing to 14 km. After taking a hot shower, he had breakfast with his parents.

events.name: Accompanied his mother to Ancient Culture Street — hunting for ancient coins.
events.description: At about one o'clock after lunch, Ye Mingxuan and his mother dressed neatly and went out. After a bus ride of about forty minutes, they arrived at the Ancient Culture Street in Nankai District. The two strolled slowly through the antique stall area. Ye Mingxuan crouched down and rummaged through an old man's box of copper coins, and finally bought a ten-wen copper coin from the tenth year of the Republic of China (1921) with even wear and clear inscriptions for 30 yuan. On the spot, he used his phone's magnifier function to examine the coin's die mark, and nodded with satisfaction after confirming there had been no repairs. His mother watched him concentrate and teased that he was as serious as your father was when picking out parts.

events.name: Selecting succulent plants at the flower market.
events.description: After browsing the ancient coin stall, the mother and son walked along the street to the nearby flower market and spent more than half an hour in the warm, humid indoor nursery area choosing succulents. Mother instinctively liked the chubby Bear's Paw, while Ye Mingxuan rationally chose a full-leaved Haworthia and a Moonstone that was about to show variegation. In the end, they settled on three pots for 80 yuan, and his mother paid happily. On the way home, she carefully held the Moonstone on her lap and joked that it was the new winter member of the balcony succulent collection.

events.name: After returning home: repotting succulents and cleaning ancient coins
events.description: After arriving home at 4:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan placed the three new succulents on the small balcony table and repotted them one by one using prepared granular soil and small terracotta pots. He noticed that the Bear's Paw roots were slightly wet and sticky, so he added extra Kanuma soil to improve drainage and gently brushed the powdery dust off the leaves of the Moonstone. After finishing, he took a soft brush and pure cotton cloth from the drawer, and under the tap, gently scrubbed the newly acquired Republic of China ten-cash copper coin two or three times with a slightly damp brush. After removing the surface dirt, he set it in a ventilated place to dry, then put it into an album insert and wrote beside it in pencil, "2025-11-29, bought at Tianjin Ancient Culture Street, 30 yuan."

events.name: Intensive Review of PMP Weak Areas
events.description: From 8:30 to 10:00 pm, based on yesterday's mistake notebook records, Ye Mingxuan opened the corresponding chapters of the PMBOK Guide and did a second close reading focusing on communication channel calculation, contract type selection, and the distinction between transference and mitigation in risk response strategies, writing brief annotations in the margins. Afterward, he logged into the course app and did 10 targeted practice questions for each of the three topics. His accuracy rate rose to above 90%. He checked off the items in his mistake notebook that he had confirmed mastering, and finally wrote down that schedule, cost, and integrated management would be the review focus for next week.

start_state.mood: In the early morning's slight chill, I was full of determination to take on the running mileage challenge

end_state.mood: A triple reward of physical fulfillment, family warmth, and the satisfaction of collecting.

2025-11.daily_overview: On the last day of November, Ye Mingxuan closed out the month with a systematic month-end review. In the morning, he organized his side-business accounts, updated his personal kanban board, and planned key milestones for December, making arrangements for the lathe that was about to arrive, further planning for the tech sharing session, and the timeline for the patent draft. In the afternoon, he spent half an hour browsing the table of contents of the entire PMP book for a framework-level review and adjusted his mindset. In the evening, the father-son balcony reading entered a new stage; his father had already started a second book, and their habit of exchanging thoughts had become part of daily family life. Before bed, Ye Mingxuan also reviewed the month's income and expenses and compared his weight and exercise data with his goals, drawing a steady close to November's gains and growth.

events.name: End-of-month systematic review and December planning
events.description: At nine o'clock on Sunday morning, Ye Mingxuan spread out his notebook, side-business ledger, and PMP study progress chart on the study desk and began a comprehensive review of November. He spent the first half hour updating the woodworking side-business accounts: this month he received one custom pen holder order with income of 500 yuan; after deducting 135 yuan for materials and tool consumables, the net profit was 365 yuan, bringing cumulative side-business income to 1,300 yuan. He then updated the Python tool improvement requirements list, adding the standardized interface discussion, a suggestion from last week's salon. Next, he used Excel to draw a rough Gantt chart from December to January on his personal goal kanban: complete lathe installation and commissioning before December 7; hold an internal Python tool sharing session on December 15; and start organizing the patent draft outline at the end of December. Finally, he marked next month's weekly plan on the board with different colors.

events.name: Quick overview of the entire PMP book and mindset adjustment.
events.description: From 1:00 to 2:00 p.m. after lunch, Ye Mingxuan brewed a cup of black tea on the sofa, browsed the table of contents of the PMP textbook and the core formula cards he had made earlier, and orally recited the correspondence between the five process groups and the ten knowledge areas, trying to build a complete knowledge network diagram in his mind. He did not dig deep into details, but focused on consolidating his sense of framework and confidence, preparing for the next stage of intensive practice and mock tests. His mindset was stable and positive the moment he closed the book.

events.name: Sunday father-son balcony in-depth reading and periodic review chat
events.description: At 7:30 after dinner, father and son arrived at the balcony on time. Father had finished reading a book about the Beiyang warlords and officially opened a second work on the financial history of the Republic of China, while Ye Mingxuan leafed through a self-driving travel guidebook as a relaxing change of pace. Father told him on his own accord that he had finished his fourth book of the month and was fairly critical of Kong Xiangxi's financial reform measures. Ye Mingxuan then talked about the importance of institutional constraints from the perspective of modern financial management. Their discussion was more composed and fluent than before. Mother still sat in the living room knitting a sweater, occasionally leaning over to glance toward the balcony, listening to the father and son's alternately impassioned and calm conversation.

events.name: November income and expenditure review and health data comparison.
events.description: Around nine in the evening, Ye Mingxuan returned to his desk, opened the family income and expense script, and checked this month's records one by one: salary income 12,000 yuan (new standard to be implemented next month), phone repair expense 589 yuan, wood lathe prepayment 3,120 yuan, dining and social about 650 yuan, hobby spending on ancient coins and succulents 110 yuan, family shopping and daily necessities share about 1,500 yuan, and savings and regular fund investment as usual. At the end, in the remarks column, he wrote that the November savings rate was about 36%, slightly below the average because of the lathe expense, and it would recover next month. Then he opened the family health journal, compared this morning's fasting weight of 70.6 kg with 71.2 kg at the beginning of the month, and found a monthly decrease of 0.6 kg, basically achieving the goal of the body fat improvement plan. His total running mileage was about 80 kilometers, an improvement over October. After completing the records, he went to the living room and briefly explained this month's financial and health situation to his parents. His father nodded in approval, while his mother reminded him to put on more clothes as temperatures would drop in December. The family chatted for about twenty minutes and then said goodnight to one another. He deliberately set the alarm to 06:30, ready to start a new month of regular routine.

start_state.mood: All geared up for the month-end final day.

end_state.mood: The certainty of clear goals and accumulated achievements.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the first day of the May Day holiday, Ye Mingxuan had a college reunion. In the morning, he went to Tianjin Station to welcome six classmates, including Sun Jing, Liu Yang, and Zhao Xiaofeng, and then started an immersive one-day tour of Tianjin: strolling along the Five Great Avenues to admire the foreign-style villas, exchanging stories about work and life changes since graduation, having dinner together in the Italian Style District in the evening, and going to Mingliu Teahouse at night to listen to crosstalk. The per-person cost of the gathering was kept to 100 yuan, and Sun Jing voluntarily paid for the drinks. The laughter and joy of the day temporarily relieved the tension caused by his mortgage. When they parted, Sun Jing said, “At least you have roots in Tianjin now,” which warmed his heart.

events.name: Go to Tianjin Station to welcome college classmates
events.description: On the morning of May 1, Ye Mingxuan set off half an hour early and went to Tianjin Station to meet Sun Jing, Liu Yang, Zhao Xiaofeng, and three college classmates working in Beijing: Wang Fang, Li Ming, and Zhou Jie. After getting out of the station, the classmates were especially happy to see each other, exchanged pleasantries about their recent lives, and then took a taxi together to the Five Avenue Scenic Area.

events.name: Strolling through the Five Great Avenues with classmates, exchanging updates on life and work.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan and his classmates took a leisurely stroll through the Five Avenues Historical and Cultural District, admiring the various styles of small Western-style buildings and taking photos. As they walked, they chatted, sharing recent job changes and life situations. Sun Jing shared an amusing story about changing jobs from Beijing, Liu Yang talked about the tech environment in Shenzhen, and Zhao Xiaofeng asked Ye Mingxuan about his mortgage. The atmosphere was relaxed and candid.

events.name: Dinner gathering at a restaurant in the Italian Style District
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan and a group of seven arrived at a courtyard restaurant in the Italian Style District for dinner. During the meal, everyone chatted freely about college memories and their respective developments. Sun Jing proactively offered to cover the cost of drinks to lighten Ye Mingxuan's burden, and the per-person spending was kept to 100 yuan. The gathering took place in a relaxed and warm atmosphere, and Ye Mingxuan felt the tension from his mortgage temporarily ease.

events.name: Plan the 3D model of a small storage box
events.description: After returning home from the gathering, Ye Mingxuan, though somewhat tired, turned on his computer and, using the modeling techniques he had learned before, independently designed a small storage box model with a drawer, sized to fit the tool storage needs on his workbench. When finished, he exported it in STL format and carefully set up the slicing parameter presets, ready to print and test another day.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but full of anticipation, looking forward to seeing old classmates.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and content, Sun Jing's words kept echoing in her mind, bringing a feeling of grounded steadiness.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day of the May Day holiday, Ye Mingxuan continued to host his college classmates. In the morning he took them to taste authentic Tianjin breakfast, and at noon he held a farewell meal at a local restaurant; the atmosphere was warm and touching. After seeing off his classmates in the afternoon, he steadied himself and began preparing for the next day's family finance meeting. That evening, he organized the household income and expense details and mortgage repayment plan from the past six months and created a clearly structured PPT. At the same time, he kicked off the 3D printing test for a storage box, monitoring and documenting issues throughout—a typical engineer's approach.

events.name: Take classmates to experience authentic Tianjin breakfast.
events.description: On the morning of May 2, Ye Mingxuan took his classmates to a street-side shop he had grown up eating at, where they tried authentic Tianjin breakfast items such as jianbing guozi, guobacai, and Erduoyan fried cake. The classmates couldn't stop praising the rich flavors of the Tianjin breakfast, and Ye Mingxuan rushed to pay for the meal.

events.name: Farewell lunch where classmates expressed sincere good wishes
events.description: At noon, Ye Mingxuan hosted a farewell lunch for his classmates at a local Tianjin restaurant. During the meal, everyone recalled moments from the past two days of gathering. Sun Jing raised a glass and said, "Mingxuan, at least you have your roots in Tianjin now—take root and grow well." The atmosphere was warm and sincere, and Ye Mingxuan felt a surge of warmth in his heart.

events.name: Seeing off a classmate, feeling the solidity and warmth of being rooted.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan saw his classmates off at Tianjin Railway Station, watching them check in and board the train before waving goodbye. Standing in the station square and watching the bustling crowd, he suddenly felt a sense of stability and warmth from being rooted here, and the pressure of the mortgage seemed to lighten a bit. After returning home, he began to compose himself and prepare for the upcoming family financial matters.

events.name: Organized the family income and expense details and prepared the financial meeting PPT
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan used the nighttime hours to carefully organize the household income and expense details and mortgage repayment plan for the past six months at his desk. He consolidated the data in Excel, then transferred it into PPT to create a concise and clear financial presentation document, listing in detail the principal, interest rate, monthly payment, and various fixed daily expenses. He also designed a 60,000-yuan emergency fund plan and budget adjustment suggestions, preparing for the family financial meeting the next day. While he was working, his mother brought him a cup of hot tea and told him not to stay up too late.

events.name: 3D-printed a storage box and monitored the printing process.
events.description: After finishing the PPT, Ye Mingxuan transferred the G-code he had sliced the day before to the 3D printer, leveled the heated bed, loaded the PLA filament, and started the print. He stayed beside the printer and monitored the whole process; while running quietly, there was only a faint motor sound. When printing was complete, he removed the part and carefully checked the surface quality and dimensional accuracy. He found slight warping at the bottom and stringing on the sides, so he took photos with his phone to document them and prepare for subsequent optimization.

start_state.mood: Feeling happy about the extended gathering, but also faintly concerned about tomorrow's financial matters.

end_state.mood: Felt fulfilled after completing the finance PPT and 3D printing tests; feel both confident and a little nervous about tomorrow's family meeting.

In the morning, he organized his thoughts on the module design for the parametric script of the part family, preparing for the subsequent Python project. Then he formally hosted the family financial meeting in the living room, clearly presenting the family income and expenditure situation to his parents with a PPT, and proposed setting up a 60,000 yuan emergency fund and adjusting the daily budget. His mother, Wang Xiulan, initially had concerns about reducing expenses, but after discussion she accepted the plan. After the meeting, Ye Mingxuan immediately archived the consensus notes and set up an initial framework for the family income and expenditure dashboard. In the afternoon, he turned to his woodworking hobby, drew a design for a succulent plant stand, and went to the lumber market to buy materials, preparing for a Mother's Day gift. The focus of his life shifted from financial strain to orderly planning and emotional expression.

events.name: Organize the script's module breakdown and data flow.
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan sat in his study and, based on the previously organized parameter characteristics of the part family and the documentation knowledge learned from the online course, sketched on paper the module division, data flow, and interface design for the parametric script, preparing for the subsequent formal coding.

events.name: Chair the family finance meeting and promote the creation of an emergency fund.
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan formally chaired a family financial meeting in the living room. Using a projector, he showed his father Ye Jianguo and mother Wang Xiulan a detailed data summary of household income, mortgage, and fixed expenses, explained in depth the changes in cash flow after using the housing provident fund to offset the mortgage, and proposed setting up a 60,000-yuan family emergency fund and adjusting the daily budget. His mother was initially concerned about cuts to food and daily expenses, but after Ye Mingxuan's patient explanation and his father's approval, she finally nodded in acceptance. The meeting marked the upgrade of family financial management from vague austerity to a transparent, three-party coordinated model.

events.name: Archived meeting consensus; set up the framework for the income and expenditure dashboard
events.description: As soon as the family financial meeting ended, Ye Mingxuan sat down at his computer and recorded and archived the agreements reached during the meeting: the specific plan for transferring the emergency fund from the demand deposit account, the monthly plan to cut food and daily expenses, and each parent's budget limit. He set up a preliminary framework for a family income and expense dashboard in Excel, with three core sections: monthly income and expense overview, mortgage repayment progress, and emergency fund accumulation. He promised to update the data every month for his parents to review at any time.

events.name: Drew the mortise-and-tenon design for a succulent plant stand and selected wood
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan changed his mood and used a pencil, ruler, and compass in the study to draw the mortise-and-tenon design for a succulent plant shelf, carefully calculating the dimensions of each piece of wood and the position of each mortise groove. After finishing the drawing, he rode a shared bike to the wood market in Xiqing District. After comparing several stalls, he selected high-quality pine with fine grain and two grades of sandpaper, and returned home fully loaded with wood.

start_state.mood: A bit nervous but clear-headed, ready for today's financial discussion

end_state.mood: Felt relieved after the family financial plan was adopted, and also felt satisfied with the preparations for the Mother's Day gift.

The decision made at the financial meeting was executed within two days. In the afternoon, he went to the supermarket to buy low-fat, high-protein ingredients, beginning preparations to adjust his diet to support half-marathon training. In the evening, he tried 3D printing again and successfully improved the printed storage box by adjusting the parameters, showing the engineer's iterative mindset even in his hobbies. Later that night, he made the final confirmation with his father about the plan to use the housing provident fund to offset the mortgage loan, and his father expressed full support.

events.name: Configure the Python development environment and write test code
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan installed Python 3.10 and third-party libraries such as numpy and cadquery on his laptop, and configured FreeCAD's Python interface. To ensure the environment was fully working, he wrote a simple parametric cylinder test code and ran it successfully, then recorded several common problems and precautions from the installation process in his notebook.

events.name: Formally transfer funds to set up an emergency fund account
events.description: After completing the development environment setup, Ye Mingxuan came to the computer accompanied by his mother Wang Xiulan, logged into online banking, and transferred 60,000 yuan from the family demand deposit to the newly opened dedicated emergency fund account. After the transfer succeeded, he took a screenshot to save the receipt and sent it to his father Ye Jianguo via WeChat. Seeing the change in the account balance, his mother sighed with relief, "This time I feel much more at ease."

events.name: Purchase low-fat, high-protein ingredients and make a meal plan.
events.description: After the lunch break, Ye Mingxuan went to the supermarket near his home. Based on the advice of his fitness coach Wang Jian, he carefully purchased low-fat, high-protein ingredients such as chicken breast, eggs, oats, whole wheat bread, broccoli, and fresh fish. After returning home, he made a weekly meal plan based on these ingredients, and took out a food scale and a calorie tracking app, preparing to officially start the diet plan from tomorrow.

events.name: Improved the 3D printing parameters and successfully printed a storage box
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan carefully analyzed the reasons for the previous day's failed 3D-printed storage box—warped bottom edges and stringing on the sides. He modified the local wall thickness of the model, added fillet optimization at sharp corners, and in the slicer parameters raised the bed temperature by 5 degrees and enabled a brim to aid adhesion. After reslicing, he printed it again. This version’s surface finish and dimensional accuracy were noticeably better than the previous one. He measured it with a caliper and recorded the comparison data with satisfaction.

events.name: Discussing the provident fund loan offset plan with my father
events.description: After finishing the printing in the evening, Ye Mingxuan had an in-depth discussion with his father in the living room about the specific procedures and subsequent effects of using the housing provident fund to offset the monthly mortgage repayment. His father shared his experience with provident fund business in his early years and encouraged him to go through the process as soon as possible to ease the family's cash flow pressure. After reaching a consensus, Ye Mingxuan listed the required materials and planned to go to the provident fund center in the coming days.

start_state.mood: Energy restored, with a clear sense of purpose about the to-do list

end_state.mood: The successful implementation of the financial plan and the print test brought a double sense of accomplishment; I feel both anticipation and slight pressure about the diet plan

events.name: Published the first edition of the family income and expenditure dashboard.

events.name: Processing wood for a flower stand at Master Qian's carpentry workshop

events.name: Day one of following the low-fat, high-protein diet plan.

events.name: Colleague Zhou Tao formally completed his resignation procedures.

Watching this scene, a complex feeling surged in his heart; the partner who had worked side by side discussing technology and projects every day for more than two years had simply left.

events.name: Organizing project handover checklist and transition plan

events.name: Persuaded by Zhou Tao, he made up his mind to sign up for the half marathon.

events.name: Early morning 5 km run

2025-05.daily_overview: On Mother’s Day, Ye Mingxuan carried out a carefully prepared expression of affection. At 6:00 in the morning, he and his running buddy Chen Xiao went on their first long-distance training run, completing an easy 8 km run at a pace of 6:10 per kilometer. After the run, the two agreed to continue next week. When he got home, he measured his body weight and body fat percentage on an empty stomach and made adjustments to the overly oily cooking of dinner. In the morning, he formally gave his mother Wang Xiulan a succulent plant stand that he had spent two weeks of his spare time carefully making. His mother said, “Don’t waste money,” but turned around and secretly wiped away tears. At noon, he accompanied his mother to the Goubuli Bun shop on Nanshi Food Street and ordered her favorite steamed buns and braised pork; mother and son chatted about everyday life as they ate. When he came home in the evening, Ye Mingxuan found that his mother had placed the plant stand in the most prominent spot in the living room, with a note beside it that read, “Xuanxuan has grown up.” He stood under the living room light looking at these words, his heart swelling with emotion, and could not fall asleep for a long time.

events.name: First long-distance training run with running partner Chen Xiao

Chen Xiao shared some of his running experience and tips for avoiding injuries, while Ye Mingxuan talked about his newly made training plan. After the run, they did full stretching at the finish and agreed to run 10 kilometers together next Saturday.

He reviewed the diet tracking app and calorie intake charts for the past week and found that the fish at dinner was cooked in a greasy way (his mother was used to braising it). He decided to switch to steaming or baking next week and appropriately increase the proportion of vegetables at lunch to keep daily total calories within 2,000 kcal.

events.name: Gave the carefully carved flower stand to his mother.

The stand's pine grain was warm, the mortise-and-tenon joints were even, and the cloud-pattern decoration was understated and elegant. As his mother took it, she muttered, "Don't spend money recklessly; we're not that hard up," but the corners of her eyes had already become moist. She turned and stood by the kitchen door, secretly wiping her tears with the back of her hand.

events.name: Lunch with his mother, warm mother-son exchange

During the meal, mother and son chatted about funny stories from Ye Mingxuan's childhood, his father's retirement life, and small memories from his mother's younger days. His mother burst out laughing several times.

events.name: Found mother's note and was overcome with emotion.
events.description: When he got home in the evening, Ye Mingxuan found that his mother had placed the plant stand in the most prominent spot on the living room combination cabinet, with a note held down by a small piece of paper beside it. On the note, his mother had written character by character: "Xuanxuan has grown up." He stood under the living room light and read it several times, feeling an indescribable mix of emotion and bittersweetness. He sat on the living room sofa for a long while before silently going back to his room.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to Mother's reaction when she receives the flower stand, feeling a little nervous.

end_state.mood: His mother's words and note lingered in his heart like a warm current. His emotions surged with gratitude and warmth, and he could not fall asleep for a long time.

2025-05.daily_overview: It was an important day for the direction of his career. During the day, Ye Mingxuan continued his detailed design work and received the preliminary simulation report sent by Li Xiang. After discussion, the two confirmed that the structural solution was feasible. After work in the evening, he attended a personal training class and, under the guidance of Coach Wang Jian, completed his first 6-kilometer tempo run training at a pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, followed by core stability training. After the training session, Zhou Tao, who had left his job a week earlier, invited him to meet at a restaurant and formally invited him to join the smart warehousing startup project he was preparing as a technical co-founder, introducing in detail the project prospects and the equity distribution plan. Ye Mingxuan felt flattered and overwhelmed by the sudden invitation, but after going home he carefully calculated the risks in Excel and rationally judged that he could not currently afford to leave his job to start a business. He sincerely declined Zhou Tao's invitation to join as a technical equity partner via a WeChat voice call, but promised to provide technical consulting and solution support in his spare time. After telling his father about the decision, Ye Jianguo praised him for being “steady first and not rash.”

events.name: Receive the simulation report and confirm the design plan.
events.description: During the day at his workstation, Ye Mingxuan received the initial finite element analysis draft for the key component from his colleague Li Xiang. The report showed uniform stress distribution and safety factors meeting the requirements, with only slight stress concentrations in a few sharp-corner areas. After a brief discussion in the conference room, the two decided to add a small fillet optimization and freeze the design for the rest, then officially entered the detailed drawing phase.

events.name: Evening personal training session: 6 km tempo run and core training.
events.description: After work in the evening, Ye Mingxuan braved the light rain and rushed to Limei Fitness Center. Coach Wang Jian was already waiting for him. The focus of today's personal training session was the half-marathon specialty — a 6 km tempo run. He ran steadily at a 5:50/km pace on the treadmill for 6 km, while Coach Wang observed his running form and reported heart rate data every kilometer. After the run, he was drenched in sweat, and then completed three sets of core stability exercises under the coach's guidance. Coach Wang was satisfied with his pace control and encouraged him to continue following the training plan.

events.name: Zhou Tao invited Ye Mingxuan to join the startup as a technical co-founder.
events.description: After working out, at about 8:30, Zhou Tao used WeChat to arrange a meeting with Ye Mingxuan at a restaurant near the company they often visited. During the meal, after catching up on each other's recent situations, Zhou Tao got down to business—he was preparing a smart warehousing startup project, had secured seed investment, and the team still lacked a technical core in mechanical structure. He formally invited Ye Mingxuan to join as a technical co-founder and introduced in detail the project prospects, target customer groups, and equity distribution plan.

events.name: Returned home to assess financial risks and determined he could not bear the risk of resigning.
events.description: It was nearly 10 p.m. when he got home. Ye Mingxuan sat in the study and opened his laptop. In Excel, he carefully listed the monthly mortgage payment, minimum living expenses, his parents' daily expenses, and the zero-income period of up to six months that might come in the early stage of starting a business. He compared these figures one by one with the stable annual salary of 200,000 yuan from his current job. The calculation showed that if he quit to start a business, the family emergency fund could run out within six months, and he truly could not afford such a risk at the moment.

events.name: Politely and rationally declined the equity investment invitation, promising to support in spare time
events.description: After careful consideration, Ye Mingxuan called Zhou Tao via WeChat voice and sincerely expressed his decision: his family's current finances did not yet allow him to take on the risk of starting a business, but he was very grateful for the trust. He rationally declined the invitation to join as a technical co-founder, while proactively promising to provide Zhou Tao with technical consulting and mechanical solution support online in his spare time. Zhou Tao expressed understanding and respect, and their relationship became more mature and stable under the new boundaries.

events.name: Inform his father of the decision
events.description: After hanging up, it was already past 11 p.m. Ye Mingxuan walked into the living room, where his father Ye Jianguo was watching TV. He briefly told his father about the decision he had just made. Ye Jianguo nodded and said in his usual calm tone, "Putting stability first is not retreating. A young person should first build a solid foundation; it's not too late to talk about it once you have stronger risk resilience." The father and son exchanged a look, and their deep alignment on career values turned from tacit understanding into an explicit exchange.

start_state.mood: His curiosity was piqued by Zhou Tao's dinner invitation; he vaguely guessed it might be related to a startup invitation, and he felt both anticipation and a hunch.

end_state.mood: After making the rational decision, the feeling of groundedness outweighed regret; my father's approval made the choice more decisive, and the career path appeared clearer.

events.name: Showed the initial version of the Python tool to the supervisor and received approval
events.description: On the morning of May 16, at the department's technical sharing session, Ye Mingxuan demonstrated the initial version of the 'Parametric Design Tool for Mechanical Parts' under development to his direct supervisor Gao Zhiyuan and several key colleagues. Using a screen projection, he showed how the software automatically generated 3D previews of common parts such as flanges and shafts after entering parameters. Gao Zhiyuan praised it on the spot as 'efficient and practical' and put forward two specific suggestions: add an automatic assignment function for part material properties, and optimize the fault tolerance of the user input interface. Gao Zhiyuan then, on behalf of the department, agreed to provide a test server resource for subsequent development and stress testing, and clearly stated that if the integration test passed at the end of June, the tool would be formally incorporated into the department's standard tool library. This recognition greatly motivated Ye Mingxuan, and immediately after lunch he recorded the new functional requirements in his notebook.

events.name: Confirmed the details of the colleagues' dinner during the lunch break.
events.description: At 12:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan used a WeChat group chat in the staff lounge to quickly finalize with Li Xiang and Zhou Tao (though he had left the company, he was still in the colleague group) the time for dinner after work (6:30 p.m.), the place (the 'Spicy Time' dry pot restaurant they often went to near the company), and dish preferences (extra-spicy pot base, must-order beef tripe and lotus root slices). The three also agreed that Ye Mingxuan would take a number online in advance in the afternoon to avoid waiting too long during the Friday evening rush.

events.name: Casual dinner with Li Xiang and Zhou Tao.
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang walked together from the company to 'Spicy Time'. On the way, Li Xiang mentioned a convergence issue he had recently encountered in simulation analysis, and Ye Mingxuan suggested that he try adjusting the mesh density. At the restaurant entrance, the two met Zhou Tao, who arrived a bit later, and then sat down to order. During the meal, the three chatted freely while eating heartily: Li Xiang enthusiastically shared a scripting technique for improving simulation efficiency; Zhou Tao, who had left his job to start a business, gave a detailed account of the registration progress of his new company and the interesting stories he had encountered. The atmosphere was candid and relaxed. When the conversation turned to life, Ye Mingxuan, asked by his friends, frankly talked about his monthly budget control and financial planning under the pressure of his mortgage, and how to find a balance between cutting expenses and maintaining his quality of life.

events.name: Walk home after the gathering and talk with parents
events.description: Around 9 p.m., the three of them split the bill and went their separate ways. Ye Mingxuan walked home alone for 20 minutes along Zhongbei Avenue, using the time to digest and organize his thoughts. After arriving home, his mother Wang Xiulan was watching TV in the living room, and his father Ye Jianguo was repairing an old electric fan on the balcony. Ye Mingxuan proactively mentioned the pleasant dinner with his colleagues. Wang Xiulan reminded him to manage his finances sensibly and not be too stingy, and that when it comes to friendships, he shouldn't skimp on necessary expenses. Ye Jianguo nodded, saying that socializing is only natural. The brief exchange put Ye Mingxuan at ease. Then he went to wash up and prepare for the next day.

events.name: Confirm weekend Red Cross first aid training arrangements.
events.description: At 10 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened his computer in the study, logged on to the Red Cross official website, and reconfirmed the detailed arrangements for the first aid training on May 18 (Sunday): the theory class starts at 8:30 a.m. at the Xiqing District Red Cross Training Center, and he needs to bring his ID card and one one-inch photo. He screenshotted the training location and the list of required materials and sent them to his phone memo, then set an alarm for 7 a.m. Sunday to be absolutely sure.

events.name: Accepted Li Xiang's invitation to attend the Saturday baking class.
events.description: At 10:30 PM, just as Ye Mingxuan was about to shut down his computer and go to bed, Li Xiang sent him a WeChat message with a link to register for the Saturday morning adult baking experience class at the Zhongbei Town Community Service Center, and urged him to go together. Li Xiang said, "The success rate of making cookies is much higher than debugging simulation models." Ye Mingxuan thought about it, felt that relaxing on a weekend morning was a good idea, clicked the link to register online, and the two agreed to meet at the community center entrance at 9:00 the next morning.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Ye Mingxuan experienced unexpected fun with baking; making cookies by hand brought a healing feeling that an engineering-minded guy rarely touches. In the afternoon, he returned to daily routines and bought ingredients for next week's meal plan. The whole day was relaxing, a typical rest day to unwind and recharge outside of work.

events.name: Morning 6km varied-pace run
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan did a 6-kilometer interval run according to his half marathon training plan, including 4 sets alternating 400 meters fast (4 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer) and 400 meters slow. After the run, he stretched thoroughly and felt his leg strength gradually recovering.

events.name: Attended a community adult baking class with Li Xiang.
events.description: At 9 a.m. on May 17, Ye Mingxuan arrived on time by bike at the Zhongbei Town Community Service Center, met up with Li Xiang, and together checked in and entered the baking classroom. The room was filled with the aroma of butter and flour. Following the baking teacher's step-by-step demonstration, Ye Mingxuan somewhat clumsily learned to weigh cake flour, soften butter and powdered sugar, and then used an electric mixer to cream the butter. When mixing the dough and pressing out cookie shapes with molds, he mishandled it and sprinkled some flour onto the countertop, drawing quiet laughter from students at the neighboring table. Even so, he still enjoyed it, and finally joined the other students in sliding the baking tray full of cookie dough into the oven.

events.name: Tasted the cookies and packed them up to share.
events.description: About 20 minutes later, the oven went ding, and the whole room filled with aroma. Ye Mingxuan couldn't wait to taste the first butter cookie he had baked himself. Although its shape was irregular, it was crisp and sweet, and a wonderful feeling of achievement and comfort welled up in him. He smiled and said to Li Xiang that the feedback loop on this thing was much faster than writing code. After the class ended, he carefully packed the remaining cookies into food bags, cleaned and returned the tools, and said goodbye to Li Xiang. Back home, he shared the cookies with his parents. His mother smiled and said they were more satisfying than store-bought ones, while his father quietly ate several. Ye Mingxuan briefly told them about the interesting moments from the class, and the home was filled with a warm weekend atmosphere.

events.name: Purchase ingredients for the diet plan
events.description: At 3 p.m., Ye Mingxuan walked to the nearby vegetable market according to the latest diet plan that coach Wang Jian adjusted last week. He bought lean pork, two chicken breasts, a tray of eggs, instant oatmeal, broccoli, purple sweet potatoes, and several seasonal leafy green vegetables. He specifically checked the price tags to compare prices and estimated that the total cost was kept within 80 yuan. He took a photo of the shopping receipt and sent it to his WeChat File Transfer, planning to enter it into the family financial spreadsheet at the end of the month.

2025-05.daily_overview: For the entire Sunday, Ye Mingxuan participated in Red Cross primary first-aid training, fully engaged from morning theory study to afternoon practical assessment. He not only obtained the certificate, but also unexpectedly met new community friends, setting the stage for potential public welfare activities. In the evening, he started by reviewing his body data, strictly ended the 14-day intensive diet cycle, and prepared to begin the next stage of his plan.

events.name: Early morning 3 km recovery run.
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Ye Mingxuan jogged 3 kilometers along the river at a pace of 6:30 per kilometer as active recovery after yesterday's interval run.

events.name: Attended Red Cross first-aider theoretical training.
events.description: At 8:15 a.m., Ye Mingxuan arrived early at the Xiqing District Red Cross Training Center. The theory class ran from 8:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. He sat in the front row and studied the basic principles of first aid, the physiological mechanisms of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), the steps for using an automated external defibrillator (AED), and the four major trauma care techniques (bleeding control, bandaging, immobilization, and transport). The bespectacled instructor explained things vividly. Ye Mingxuan frequently used his phone to photograph key PPT slides and quickly took notes in the distributed textbook.

events.name: Participated in practical exercises and assessment and obtained the certificate.
events.description: The hands-on skills session was from 1:30 to 4:00 pm. Ye Mingxuan repeatedly practiced the compression depth and frequency of CPR on a manikin, and under the instructor's corrections, standardized his rescue breathing technique. In the trauma care session, he partnered with a community volunteer and practiced different bleeding control and bandaging methods with each other. In the end, he passed both the theory and practical assessments and happily received the Red Cross First Aid Certificate valid for two years on the spot. After receiving the certificate, he also exchanged WeChat contacts with several community volunteers who trained at the same time, and agreed to exchange ideas about public welfare projects when they had the chance.

events.name: Review the 14-day diet plan and formulate a new plan.
events.description: After returning home at 8 PM and taking a shower, Ye Mingxuan stood on the bedroom scale and measured his weight (73.0 kg) and body fat percentage (23.8%). He opened the health app on his phone and generated charts of the past 14 days' diet and weight changes. In the notebook beside him, he wrote a stage reflection: "The hunger was strongest on the third day, then gradually adapted; the chicken breast and broccoli combination has moderate cost, but lacks flavor variety." Based on this, he decided to start an alternate-day controlled diet in the next phase — all protein one day and a small amount of carbohydrates the next — to break through a possible weight plateau, and entered the new plan into the app.

His meticulous and responsible character showed in his repeated confirmation of best-man duties and strict self-discipline regarding diet. It was a day to stay in peak condition for the wedding.

events.name: Try on the best-man suit and confirm the final arrangements with Zhang Wei.
events.description: On the evening of May 19, after dinner, Ye Mingxuan took out the complete dark blue groomsman suit prepared for Zhang Wei's wedding from his wardrobe and carefully dressed from top to bottom, including the bow tie and cufflinks. He checked the overall effect in front of the mirror and confirmed it fit well and had no wrinkles. He then contacted Zhang Wei via video call, and the two once again confirmed the next day's gathering time for the bridal pickup (7:00 a.m.), the specific process (knocking on the door, finding the shoes, serving tea), and the specific tasks Ye Mingxuan was responsible for—keeping the rings and managing the bridal pickup red envelopes. Zhang Wei looked a little nervous in the video, and Ye Mingxuan smiled and told him to relax.

events.name: Strictly adhere to the diet plan
events.description: To keep in shape for the wedding day, Ye Mingxuan strictly controlled his diet throughout the day. At noon, he ordered steamed fish and stir-fried broccoli in the company cafeteria and specifically asked the cook to use less oil. For dinner, he made a simple but high-protein salad at home using chicken breast, lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and vinaigrette, strictly keeping the total calories within 1,800 kcal. His mother, Wang Xiulan, watched him eat "grass" and muttered, 'Eat more good food at tomorrow's wedding banquet to make up for it.'

events.name: Personal training class (half-marathon-specific strength training)
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan went to Limei Fitness Center and did a 1.5-hour strength training session under the guidance of coach Wang Jian. In the second half of the session, he added running-specific stability exercises such as single-leg deadlifts and lateral band walks. After the workout, he felt a strong pump in his core, but his right calf was slightly tight, and Wang Jian helped him with fascia release.

2025-05.daily_overview: Today was a big day for his childhood friend Zhang Wei. Ye Mingxuan devoted himself to the wedding all day as a groomsman. From the lively fun of the bridal procession to the emotion and tears during the ceremony, he was truly happy for his closest friend's happiness. The wedding not only touched his deepest emotions, but also led him to have a warm conversation with his mother on the way back, significantly strengthening the mother-son relationship.

events.name: Served as best man throughout the wedding of a childhood friend and witnessed the ceremony
events.description: At 6:30 in the early morning of May 20, Ye Mingxuan left home to gather at Zhang Wei's house. At 7:00 sharp, as a member of the groomsmen, he followed Zhang Wei and rode together to the bride's home for the bridal pickup. Downstairs at the bride's house, he actively helped call for the door, cleverly handed out red envelopes, and took part in all the traditional customs, including finding the shoes and serving tea to the bride's parents. He witnessed Zhang Wei kneel on one knee, his voice trembling with excitement, during the bridal pickup. At 10:00 a.m., at the wedding ceremony, he stood behind Zhang Wei the whole time, solemnly holding the rings. When the newlyweds exchanged rings and made their vows, Ye Mingxuan looked at the happy tears shining in the eyes of his childhood friend and could not help feeling his own eyes sting and his nose tingle, deeply moved. During the luncheon, he accompanied the newlyweds as they toasted each table and thoughtfully deflected some overly enthusiastic guests. Zhang Wei's mother quietly patted him on the shoulder and gently urged him to settle down and start a family. Though a little flustered, Ye Mingxuan nodded politely in response, suddenly gaining a more empathetic understanding of his own mother's usual nagging.

events.name: Proactively called his mother to share joy and insights.
events.description: After the wedding banquet completely ended at 3 p.m. and he helped see off the main guests, Ye Mingxuan took a taxi back. On the way, soft music was playing in the car. Looking out the window at the familiar streets passing by, he felt a mix of emotions. He took the initiative to call his mother, Wang Xiulan, and for the first time, in such a gentle tone, he proactively told her about the touching details of the wedding and shared the excitement in his heart. Out of character, he also took the initiative to say, 'Mom, I understand what you mean when you urge me. I'll work hard.' On the other end of the phone, Wang Xiulan was stunned for a moment, and then her voice showed clear happiness and relief. This phone call truly shifted the mother-son communication about 'urging marriage' from the sharp tension of the past to warm understanding and resonance.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District

Ye Mingxuan immediately logged into the server remotely, spent more than an hour locating and fixing the bug in the parameter validation module, and added unit tests. By the time he finished it was almost 11 PM, which made him go to bed half an hour later than usual.

2025-05.daily_overview: After work on Friday, Ye Mingxuan quickly switched into 'hardware engineer' mode, excitedly tore open the package, and started modifying the home lighting system. From screwing in bulbs and pairing the network to teaching his parents how to use it, the whole process not only completed the initial deployment of the smart home devices but also brought a tech-filled family interaction. The evening basketball training was led by Ye Mingxuan for the first time since Zhou Tao resigned last week, and he felt a heavier sense of responsibility.

events.name: Unpacked and installed smart home devices.
events.description: At 5:30 p.m. on May 23, Ye Mingxuan returned home and saw a delivery package at the door, exactly the smart device he had ordered two days earlier. He quickly washed his hands, opened the package, and checked that the bulbs and socket were intact and all accessories were complete. Then he brought over a stepladder and, as if carrying out a precision engineering task, removed the old bulbs in the living room, bedroom, and kitchen one by one, replaced them with the new smart bulbs, and powered them on to test that they all lit up properly. Next, he plugged the smart plug into the living room wall socket and connected a desk lamp as a demonstration prop, and everything was ready.

events.name: Configure and debug the smart home network
events.description: After installing the hardware, Ye Mingxuan sat down on the sofa and opened the app he had already downloaded on his phone. Following the instructions in the manual, he added the bulbs and smart plugs in the living room, bedroom, and kitchen one by one to his home's 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network. He renamed each device, such as 'living room main light' and 'Ye Mingxuan bedroom light', and then used the app to test each bulb's on/off, color temperature, and brightness adjustment, as well as the smart plug's scheduled on/off function, until all devices responded quickly with no delay, and only then nodded with satisfaction.

events.name: Show and teach parents the smart home features
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan gathered his parents Ye Jianguo and Wang Xiulan in the living room and excitedly began his 'tech demo.' With his phone, he easily demonstrated functions such as remotely turning off the living room light and adjusting the light to warm yellow reading mode. At first, his parents waved their hands repeatedly, thinking, 'Why make it so complicated? Isn't it easier to just walk over and press a switch?' But under Ye Mingxuan's patient guidance, they each picked up the phone and, clumsily yet curiously, operated the 'one-touch living room light switch' and 'scheduled kitchen light on'—when Ye Jianguo swiped his finger on the screen and the living room light went out with a click, he widened his eyes and then burst out laughing. Wang Xiulan also couldn't help testing it repeatedly and marveled, 'Technology changes life.'

events.name: Set up a personalized scheduled task.
events.description: After the lesson, Ye Mingxuan, based on his parents' daily habits, worked with them to make settings in the app: the living room light would automatically turn off at 10 PM every night as a reminder to rest; the kitchen light and the small night light connected to the smart socket would turn on at 6:45 AM to match the time his mother got up to cook; and the bedroom light would automatically dim at 9:30 PM to create a pre-sleep atmosphere. These thoughtful automated tasks prompted his father to praise, for the first time, "this thing is actually useful." Ye Mingxuan's home transformation was a great success.

events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan hurried to the gymnasium of Tiangong University for basketball practice. Since Zhou Tao left, the team lost an active member, so Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to arrange warm-ups and tactical drills. During practice, he scored multiple fast-break points, and his shooting touch recovered to about 80%. After practice, he discussed the next training session's content with his teammates.

2025-05.daily_overview: Saturday's focus was the long-awaited Model Y test drive, followed by a series of rational actions. The thrill of the test drive and the strict financial calculations formed a huge tension. Ye Mingxuan once again showed the pragmatic nature of his ISTJ personality and postponed the car purchase plan. In the afternoon, he turned his attention to the more realistic formaldehyde problem of the new house, booked a test for the next day, and made down-to-earth preparations for moving in.

events.name: Morning 6km varied-pace run
events.description: At 7:00 a.m., Ye Mingxuan completed a 6-kilometer interval run workout, including five 200-meter sprints. The temperature had already risen; he sweated heavily after the run and promptly supplemented with an electrolyte drink.

events.name: Went to the experience center to test drive a Model Y with Zhang Wei.
events.description: At 9 AM on May 24, Ye Mingxuan arrived on time at the Tianjin Tesla Experience Center and met Zhang Wei, who was dressed in professional attire. Accompanied by Zhang Wei, Ye Mingxuan first got a static feel of the vehicle's interior space and minimalist center console design. Then he took the driver's seat and drove himself for about 30 minutes along the designated extended test-drive route, including a stretch of expressway and several street sections. He deeply experienced the smooth adaptive cruise and automatic lane changes of Autopilot, as well as the linear thrust and quietness the moment the accelerator was pressed, and inwardly admitted that this was indeed a driving pleasure completely different from traditional fuel vehicles.

events.name: Postpone the car purchase plan again based on financial reality.
events.description: After the test drive, Ye Mingxuan didn't let the excitement last too long. He sat in the rest area of the experience center, took out his phone, and calmly did the math in the family financial spreadsheet he had already built: if he bought the Model Y now, the monthly payment after the down payment would be about 2,500 yuan, which, added to the current 1,200 yuan actual monthly cash mortgage payment, would bring the total fixed monthly car and housing expenditure to 3,700 yuan. This would obviously severely crowd out the monthly accumulation goal for the family emergency fund (800 yuan for the travel investment plan and 1,000 yuan in cash savings). In less than five minutes, he updated the car purchase status in the plan table again to 'postponed', with a remark: 'Goal: re-evaluate after the emergency fund reaches 60,000 yuan.' He put away his phone, stood up, and said to Zhang Wei, 'The car is good, but financial planning comes first. I'll wait a bit longer.'

events.name: Book a formaldehyde test for the new house the next day and prepare in advance
events.description: At 4 p.m., Ye Mingxuan, back at home, didn't sit idle. He called a professional formaldehyde testing company he had found in advance, explained the address and requirements, and booked an in-home test for 9:30 a.m. Sunday. Per their request, he went alone in the evening to the new house in another location in Xiqing District, closed all windows and doors to keep the rooms completely sealed, preparing for the accurate test the next day. Gazing at this future harbor of his own, he temporarily set aside his enthusiasm for buying a car and concentrated on the more practical steps at hand.
