He also wrote his feelings in his electronic diary, giving poetic expression to rational decisions.

events.name: Morning 5 km easy run
events.description: At 7 a.m., Ye Mingxuan jogged 5 kilometers along the river at a pace of 6:20 per kilometer as this week's recovery run, and stretched briefly after the run.

events.name: After discussing with his travel buddy Wu Bin, he announced the postponement of the Northwest self-driving trip and set up a travel fund.
events.description: On the morning of May 25, Ye Mingxuan had a voice call on WeChat with Wu Bin, a road-trip buddy far away in Chengdu. The two candidly exchanged their recent financial situations and career pressures, and agreed that rushing the Northwest Grand Loop during this year's National Day holiday would reduce the fun of the trip itself because of the financial burden and psychological pressure. They both agreed to rationally postpone the plan to the summer of 2026. Afterwards, Ye Mingxuan officially posted an announcement in the travel buddies' group chat, postponing the original plan and giving a new time frame for the summer of 2026. After doing this, he opened Excel on his laptop, created a new worksheet named "Travel Fund," entered "=800*12" in the savings summary column, and immediately set up an automatic transfer of 800 yuan on the 1st of every month to a dedicated savings sub-account in mobile banking, as the special funding source for the trip. After completing this, he opened his digital diary, thought for a while, and typed a reflection: "The dream wasn't canceled; it just became a to-do item for tomorrow."

events.name: Conduct formaldehyde testing and treatment for the new house
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., the staff from the booked formaldehyde testing company arrived on time. Ye Mingxuan led the technicians in taking air samples in each room and explained that his family attached great importance to his health. The laboratory's rush analysis showed that the formaldehyde concentration in the master bedroom was 0.12 mg/m³, slightly exceeding the national standard (≤0.08 mg/m³), while the living room and the second bedroom passed. He made an immediate decision, contacted a treatment company, and arranged for photocatalytic spraying in the master bedroom that afternoon. He then placed numerous individually packaged activated carbon packs, purchased online, in cabinets and corners throughout the house.

events.name: Record the treatment costs and adjust the move-in plan
events.description: After everything was handled, Ye Mingxuan sat on a chair in the living room of the new house, which still had its windows open for ventilation, opened the bookkeeping app on his phone, and recorded in detail the testing fee, photocatalytic treatment fee, and activated carbon purchase cost, totaling 2800 yuan, categorized as “Emergency Medical/Health Expenses,” and confirmed that the expense would be paid from the emergency fund. Based on his mindset that “everything must be supported by data,” he revised the dates on the original move-in schedule, officially postponing the move-in date from the end of July to the beginning of September, and added a new column, “Daily Ventilation Check-in Table,” planning to have his father serve as the supervisor for airing out the new home.

He integrated the independent Python scripts he had previously written for generating various mechanical parts such as flanges, shafts, and gears into a unified project framework one by one. He carefully checked the module import paths, function naming conflicts, and global variable dependencies among the scripts to ensure they would run correctly when called from a unified entry point. Watching the code structure become well organized in the IDE, he felt a sense of satisfaction similar to completing a precise assembly.

They played three ranked matches in a row. In the second match, Ye Mingxuan picked Viktor, the Machine Herald. In a key team fight in the late game, he precisely calculated his skill combo, dealt huge damage, and saved the situation. Zheng Kai laughed and shouted in the voice channel: ‘That damage calculation — as expected of an engineer!’ Throughout the game, the voice channel was full of tactical commands and banter, and the fatigue from work was swept away.

events.name: Commit the code and end the day

Instead, out of habit, he opened the command line, committed the freshly integrated Python project code, and pushed it to his private GitHub repository, keeping his learning records continuous and error-free. When he was done, he let out a long breath, turned off the computer, and went to wash up, bringing an eventful and well-regulated day to a close.

events.name: Run a Python script to generate a monthly family finance dashboard
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened the command line and, with a sense of ceremony, ran the Python automation script he had written himself, importing the May CSV billing file he had organized the previous night. The script smoothly performed data cleaning, classification and summarization, and statistics, and finally generated a visual HTML dashboard. The pie chart and bar chart on the page clearly showed that dining and entertainment expenses together exceeded the monthly budget by 8.3%. In the June Plan sheet of the family finance Excel spreadsheet, he accordingly made a slight 5% downward adjustment to the next month's dining and entertainment budgets, and added notes with the specific amount and reasons for May's overspending, planning to explain them to his parents at the end-of-month family finance meeting and to make up the difference with next month's surplus. 2025-05.daily_overview: On a rainy day, Ye Mingxuan's attention was focused on two things: meticulously optimizing the response speed of his Python tool, and establishing a long-term health monitoring system for the new home he was about to move into. He demonstrated an engineer's dedication to efficiency and discipline.

events.name: Optimize the runtime efficiency of the Python part-generation tool.
events.description: After dinner on Thursday, Ye Mingxuan focused on code performance optimization with the sound of rain outside the window. He noticed that when generating complex gear profile curves, the tool took nearly 10 seconds to respond, which was a poor experience. He opened the profiler and located the cause of the slowness: extensive use of traditional loop calculations. Taking a deep breath, he spent more than an hour rewriting that part of the calculation logic to use NumPy for vectorized computation, and eliminated several redundant intermediate file reads/writes. After the optimization, the generation time for the same parameters dropped to under 3 seconds, a significant improvement in efficiency.

events.name: Buy a portable formaldehyde detector and create a ventilation record template.
events.description: After achieving results in code optimization, Ye Mingxuan switched his focus to life planning. He went online and ordered a well-reviewed portable formaldehyde detector, planning to use it for long-term monitoring after moving in. Then he opened Excel and created a new template named 'Ventilation Record Before Moving Into the New House,' with fields for date (starting from June 1), window-opening period, window-closing period, outdoor weather, and subsequent daily self-measured formaldehyde readings. He had already mentally assigned this task to his retired father, Ye Jianguo, and planned to discuss it with him at the Dragon Boat Festival gathering.

events.description: Since it was raining and he could not run outdoors, Ye Mingxuan did a 40-minute core and lower-body strength routine at home: plank, glute bridge, single-leg deadlift (bodyweight), and resistance-band lateral walks, followed by 15 minutes of hip flexibility exercises.

He saved a screenshot of the test report to send to Gao Zhiyuan before the next technical sharing session.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the fourth day of the Chinese New Year, Ye Mingxuan and his family of three drove to a long-established Tianjin cuisine restaurant in Nankai District to reunite with his cousin Ye Mingyuan's family, who had returned to Tianjin to visit relatives. During the meal, his cousin spoke enthusiastically about development opportunities in the Shenzhen Greater Bay Area, which strengthened Ye Mingxuan's resolve to stay rooted in Tianjin and focus on precision machinery through comparison. After returning home in the afternoon, he carefully organized his thoughts from the exchange and wrote down his reflections on future career paths in his notebook. In the evening, he finalized the February training plan with fitness coach Wang Jian, laying the groundwork for the busy life after the holiday.

events.name: Welcome my cousin and his family for lunch.
events.description: At 11 a.m., Ye Mingxuan and his parents arrived early at the time-honored Tianjin restaurant in Nankai District and waited at the private room entrance for his older paternal cousin Ye Mingyuan and his family. At 11:30, the cousin's family arrived. Ye Mingxuan warmly shook hands and exchanged greetings with his cousin; his mother Wang Xiulan chatted solicitously with the cousin's wife; and his father Ye Jianguo patted his nephew on the shoulder. After exchanging New Year greetings, they entered the private room, which was decorated with Chinese knots and 'Fu' character posters, full of a rich New Year atmosphere.

events.name: A clash of industry perspectives with his cousin
events.description: During the meal, his cousin Ye Mingyuan shared in detail his work experiences in Shenzhen and the Greater Bay Area—from smart manufacturing to unmanned production lines, from fast-iterating project cycles to the high-intensity competitive environment. Ye Mingxuan listened attentively, nodding from time to time, and in his mind compared the state of Tianjin's precision machinery industry: although the pace was not as fast as Shenzhen's, the foundation was solid and the industrial chain complete. He became more determined to stay rooted in Tianjin and deepen his expertise, while also realizing that he must stay keenly aware of new technology trends. He proactively asked several technical details about smart manufacturing; his cousin answered them one by one, and his father, Ye Jianguo, also chimed in with memories of the old machine tool factory, creating a warm and lively atmosphere.

events.name: Saw off his cousin's family and returned home.
events.description: After the lunch gathering ended at 2 p.m., Ye Mingxuan and his parents saw his older cousin's family off at the restaurant parking lot. Ye Mingyuan rolled down the car window to say goodbye again, urging Ye Mingxuan to visit Shenzhen when he had time. Ye Mingxuan nodded and said he would. After watching the car drive away, the family of three drove back home in Xiqing District under the afternoon sun. On the way, his mother remarked that his cousin had lost a lot of weight and must be very busy at work.

events.name: Consolidating insights and reflecting on career planning
events.description: Returning home at 3:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan went straight into the study, took the dark blue-covered work notebook from the bookshelf, and sat down to calmly sort through the insights from the exchange. He drew a simple comparison table in the notebook: Tianjin (solid precision machinery foundation, complete industrial chain, mild competition) vs Shenzhen (fast pace, many opportunities, high pressure). Below the table he wrote, “Staying in Tianjin and deepening expertise is the direction, but I can’t work behind closed doors. I need to browse industry information on a fixed weekly basis to maintain technical acuity.” He once again confirmed his goal of being promoted to senior mechanical engineer within three years, and added beside it, “Pay attention to cross-disciplinary fields such as intelligent manufacturing and automated testing.”

events.name: Discuss the February training plan with the coach
events.description: At 5 p.m., Ye Mingxuan contacted fitness coach Wang Jian via WeChat voice. The two reviewed his intermittent training status in January. Wang Jian pointed out that his body fat percentage needed to be controlled and suggested strengthening the combination of strength and cardio in February. After discussion, they decided that starting from February 3 (the first workday after the holiday), he would do strength and cardio training every Monday and Wednesday, one hour each session; on the Lantern Festival (February 12), he would rest and adjust. Ye Mingxuan synced the training schedule to his phone calendar and set reminder alarms for every Monday and Wednesday.

events.name: Organizing personal finances and New Year plans
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened the China Merchants Bank app to check the balance of his salary card, and mentally calculated the progress of his savings for the house down payment, factoring in the February salary that was about to be credited. He updated his annual financial goal in his phone memo—save 8,000 yuan every month for the down payment—and set a reminder for the salary credit on February 10. He then browsed the Python course learning path to mentally prepare for studying after the holiday.

In the afternoon, he hurried to a barbecue restaurant in the city center for a small gathering with his college roommate Liu Yang, who had detoured from Shijiazhuang, and his local old classmate Zhao Xiaofeng. Liu Yang shared the fast pace of Shenzhen's IT industry and the widespread use of Python in automation, giving Ye Mingxuan a more concrete picture of the Python he was learning. After the meal, the three took a group photo, and Liu Yang headed straight to the station to continue his southbound journey. In the evening, Ye Mingxuan returned home and began planning tomorrow's house-viewing route with his father, officially putting the home purchase on the agenda.

events.name: Confirm the details of the gathering in advance.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ye Mingxuan @-mentioned Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng in the three-person group chat to confirm a get-together at 6:30 p.m. at a well-known barbecue restaurant near Tianjin Station. Liu Yang replied that he would arrive at Tianjin Station at 3 p.m., and Zhao Xiaofeng said it would take about 40 minutes to get there from Dongli District. Ye Mingxuan told Zhao Xiaofeng to be on time and sent the barbecue restaurant's location to the group.

events.name: Spent the day with parents making dumplings to welcome the God of Wealth.
events.description: At 11 a.m., his mother Wang Xiulan was preparing the dumplings for the fifth day of the Lunar New Year. Ye Mingxuan volunteered to help knead the dough and mix the filling (pork and cabbage), while his father Ye Jianguo was in charge of rolling out the wrappers. The family of three was busy in the kitchen. His mother chatted about recent happenings in the community, mentioning that Aunt Liu upstairs had recently started learning ballroom dancing. His father discussed with Ye Mingxuan the properties to view the next day — there were three new developments near Zhongbei Town and one old factory renovation project. While wrapping dumplings, Ye Mingxuan mentally calculated the house-buying budget and felt he should go see the places in person before making a judgment.

events.name: He went to the barbecue restaurant to meet up with Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng.
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan left home, took Subway Line 6, transferred to Line 3, and arrived at the barbecue restaurant near Tianjin Station about 40 minutes later. Zhao Xiaofeng had arrived early and was waiting at the door. The two chatted about recent work. At 6:20, Liu Yang arrived from West Station, carrying a backpack and with hair shorter than before. The three warmly hugged at the restaurant entrance.

events.name: Barbecue get-together and an in-depth discussion on Python applications.
events.description: After sitting down at the barbecue restaurant, the three of them chatted while grilling skewers. Liu Yang shared the high-intensity pace of his embedded development work in Shenzhen—996 was the norm, but he had been exposed to many new technologies. He mentioned that his team had recently introduced Python for automated test scripts, saving a lot of manual labor. This sparked strong interest in Ye Mingxuan, who asked in detail about Python's specific application scenarios in automation. Liu Yang explained while flipping the skewers, and Zhao Xiaofeng said their factory was also pushing forward with automation, but slowly. The three chatted until after 9 p.m., and Ye Mingxuan felt he had gained a more intuitive understanding of Python's practical value, feeling that his learning direction was right.

events.name: Take a group photo, say goodbye, and continue south with Liu Yang.
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., the three of them asked a staff member to take a group photo in front of the barbecue restaurant. Liu Yang said he had a 10 p.m. high-speed train to Shenzhen and needed to get to the station. Ye Mingxuan and Zhao Xiaofeng patted him on the shoulder and said take care, they'd meet again next time. Liu Yang smiled and said he would bring back a bottle of Shenzhen specialty lychee wine next time. After watching Liu Yang leave by taxi, Ye Mingxuan and Zhao Xiaofeng each took the subway back.

events.name: After returning home, planned a house-viewing route with his father.
events.description: At 10:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan returned home in Xiqing District and found his father still awake, sitting in front of the living room coffee table browsing property advertisement pages. He went over and sat down, and the father and son began to plan the next day's house-viewing route: in the morning they would first look at new and nearly new developments east of Zhongbei Town, and in the afternoon at the old factory renovation projects to the west. 2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of the Spring Festival holiday, Ye Mingxuan and his father went out early and visited three residential developments in a row in Zhongbei Town. In front of one development converted from an old factory, his father was stirred by the scene and recalled his struggling years as a technician at a machine tool plant in his youth, and the father-son bond grew closer through their shared goal. Along the way they met warm-hearted neighborhood Auntie Liu, who mentioned that the community lacked instructors for youth handicraft classes; Ye Mingxuan silently noted this. Back home in the evening, he screened more listings online and organized information on the developments he liked into his phone memo, preparing for the next day's family discussion about buying a home.

events.name: Set off with father to view a house
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., after breakfast, Ye Mingxuan and his father Ye Jianguo left home. His father wore a dark gray down jacket and carried the property brochures printed yesterday. The two first walked to the first newly developed residential area east of Zhongbei Town and met the appointed agent at the sales office around 9 o'clock. The agent showed them three different layouts. Ye Mingxuan photographed the floor plans and price lists with his phone and briefly noted each apartment's area, orientation, and unit price in his notebook.

events.name: Inspect the old-factory-converted residential project and reminisce about old times with father.
events.description: At 11 a.m., father and son arrived at the second property — a loft project converted from an old machine tool parts factory. The project retained the steel structural frames of some old factory buildings, and the slogans from those years were still faintly visible on the red brick walls. The father stood silently in front of an old wall for a while, then slowly began to tell Ye Mingxuan about his younger days as a senior technician at the machine tool factory: how he worked his way up from apprentice to senior technician step by step, and how he worked in the roaring workshop for thirty years. He said seeing these old things made him feel as if he had returned to those days. Ye Mingxuan listened attentively, feeling that the distance between him and his father had suddenly shrunk a lot. He made a special note for this property: "It has a sense of history; soundproofing and insulation need to be evaluated."

events.name: On the way, met Auntie Liu, a warm-hearted woman from the community.
events.description: At 2 p.m., on the way to view the third housing development, father and son met a warm-hearted woman in her 50s at the entrance of the residential community. She took the initiative to greet them and introduced herself as Auntie Liu from the owners' committee. She said the community was organizing extracurricular activities for teenagers and needed an arts-and-crafts instructor, but had not been able to find the right person. When Auntie Liu learned that Ye Mingxuan worked in mechanics, she suggested he consider teaching the children crafts when he had free time in the future. Ye Mingxuan smiled and replied that he had some basic carpentry skills, and would seriously consider it after he got through this busy period. Inwardly, he thought that once he had systematically learned carpentry, this was indeed something worth trying.

events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened his laptop in the study, logged into the Lianjia and Beike apps, and filtered second-hand housing information in Xiqing District, Tianjin and surrounding areas. He focused on relatively new resale homes near Zhongbei Town, specifically checking 90-110 square meter two-bedroom and three-bedroom units. He favorited all 12 qualifying listings one by one, and organized each property's unit price, total price, estimated down payment, and surrounding amenities in his phone memo. He labeled this memo folder: 'Family home purchase discussion candidates — updated 2025.02.03'.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day before returning to work after the holiday, Ye Mingxuan spent the morning at home configuring the Python development environment and downloading the required libraries to prepare for the next day. In the afternoon he continued inspecting the remaining two residential developments with his father. At 7 p.m., the family held their first formal meeting about buying a home. His mother, Wang Xiulan, strongly opposed a commercial loan because she was worried about the monthly payment pressure, and the atmosphere was tense for a while. Ye Mingxuan stayed up late to create a detailed Excel comparison of the developments and calculations for monthly payments under three different down-payment ratios, explaining feasibility to his mother with data and logic. The family finally reached a consensus to prioritize buying a home, leaning toward a second-hand nearly new property. He worked on the figures until 1 a.m. to finish all the data, showing the leading role of a rational, pragmatic ISTJ in family financial decisions.

events.name: Final preparation before the holiday: Python work environment setup
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ye Mingxuan prepared for returning to work after the holiday the next day. He opened his work laptop, downloaded the backlogged test data files from before the new year from the company cloud drive to his local machine, and checked file sizes and formats. Then he opened the PyCharm editor and used pip to install Python libraries for Excel processing, such as openpyxl and pandas. He set up the script working directory, quickly wrote a test script for file reading and traversal, and confirmed the environment configuration was correct. The whole process took about 1 hour.

events.name: Continue looking at the remaining two residential developments.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ye Mingxuan and his father went to two residential developments west of Zhongbei Town. The fourth property was a nearly new resale community built in 2018, with mature surroundings, schools and a vegetable market nearby; his father was quite satisfied. The fifth was a more remote new development, cheaper but with inconvenient transportation. Ye Mingxuan recorded the data, pros and cons of both properties in detail, and took photos of the community environment and hallway conditions with his phone. On the way back, the father and son continued discussing while waiting at the bus stop, and initially narrowed the options down to three candidates: the old renovation project, the nearly new resale home, and the third new development.

events.name: Family meeting about buying a house, with mother strongly opposed
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan held the first formal house-buying discussion meeting with his parents in the living room. His mother, Wang Xiulan, turned pale as soon as she heard that most of the family savings might be used and a loan would be needed. She repeatedly said that a monthly payment of 6000-7000 yuan would drag the family down, and said anxiously: 'If we have to pay that much every month for 20 years, what if something happens?!' His father, Ye Jianguo, was calmer, and took out a calculator to work out the down payment ratio, the provident fund loan limit, and how much of his pension could be put in. Ye Mingxuan showed the 12 alternative property listings he had organized the night before, and patiently explained to his mother that they could choose a second-hand quasi-new home priced at 1.5-1.8 million yuan, and with a down payment plus a combination of provident fund and a small commercial loan, a monthly payment of under 5000 yuan was affordable. His mother kept muttering that it was too much pressure. After more than an hour of discussion, with his father mediating, the whole family reached a consensus to prioritize buying a home, preferring a second-hand quasi-new property. For the first time, Ye Mingxuan deeply felt the gap between the two generations' perceptions of loan risk, and resolved to make a solid financial plan to put his mother at ease.

events.name: Stayed up late creating an Excel spreadsheet comparing properties
events.description: After the family discussion ended, his mother went back to her room but was still worried. Ye Mingxuan returned to the study, opened Excel, and began making a detailed property comparison table. He listed the unit price, total price, area, down payment ratio (30%/40%/50%), monthly repayment amount, and the difference between the provident fund loan amount and the commercial loan for the six candidate properties, and simulated the monthly payment pressure under three different down payment ratios. He repeatedly checked the formulas and marked risk points and precautions in red font below the table. Before he knew it, time had passed midnight. His father knocked and came in midway, saw Ye Mingxuan still buried in calculations, patted him on the shoulder, and told him not to stay up too late. Ye Mingxuan nodded and said he would be done soon. Finally, at 1 a.m., he completed all the data, saved the file, and then washed up and went to bed.

events.description: At 6 p.m., his phone beeped and the China Merchants Bank app popped up a salary notification: 16,700 yuan after tax had been credited to his salary card. Ye Mingxuan quickly checked the details at his desk and confirmed it was correct. After getting home from work, he immediately opened the China Merchants Bank app and transferred 8,000 yuan from his salary account to the pre-set special savings account for home down payment (fixed deposit rate). After the transfer, the savings account balance increased to 24,000 yuan. He updated his personal finance ledger in his phone notes, marking the remaining approximately 8,700 yuan as 2,000 yuan for daily expenses, 3,000 yuan for regular fund investment, and 3,700 yuan as discretionary reserve.

events.name: Dined with colleagues and agreed on a monthly technical exchange meeting
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan met Zhou Tao and Li Xiang in a private room at the reserved Hunan restaurant. The three ordered chopped pepper fish head, stir-fried pork, and two vegetable dishes. During the meal, Zhou Tao shared his experience writing simple crawlers in Python to scrape industry news, and Li Xiang explained the application of pandas in data analysis modules and demonstrated a small trick for quick statistics with groupby. Ye Mingxuan listened while taking notes on his phone. As the meal was ending, the three formally agreed to hold a similar technical exchange gathering every month, taking turns to share. Ye Mingxuan said that next time he would share practical Excel automation.

events.name: Evening gym machine training and aerobic exercise.
events.description: After the dinner ended at 9 p.m., Ye Mingxuan went directly to Limei Fitness Center. According to Monday's training plan, he did strength training under coach Wang Jian's guidance: four sets of squats, four sets of bench press, four sets of rows, plus core planks. Then he did 35 minutes of cardio on the treadmill. Because the dinner ran late, the training started later than usual, but he maintained the intensity. After finishing, he felt a little bloated in the abdomen and thought that in the future he should control how much he eats when there is a dinner on a training day.

events.name: Start a healthy eating plan and communicate with my mother
events.description: After returning home from training, Ye Mingxuan opened the calorie-tracking app on his phone and recorded approximate calories for that day's breakfast (whole wheat bread + milk), lunch (company cafeteria set meal), and dinner (Hunan cuisine). He noted that the chopped chili fish head at the dinner gathering was not low in calories. Then he seriously talked with his mother, Wang Xiulan, saying that from today he would start implementing a healthy eating plan and asked her to reduce the frequency of the braised pork belly she often made and instead make more steamed sea bass and fruit salad. At first, his mother was a little reluctant, afraid that her son would not enjoy his food. After hearing Ye Mingxuan's serious explanation of his fat-loss goal, she nodded and said she would try.

2025-02.daily_overview: Tuesday was the first day of Ye Mingxuan's healthy eating plan. For breakfast he had whole wheat bread and milk; for lunch he chose a light set meal in the company cafeteria; and for dinner his mother indeed made steamed sea bass and salad. He successfully resisted the temptation of takeout and recorded the day's calories using an app. At 7:30 pm he attended a live Python online course and learned to create data visualizations with Matplotlib and Seaborn. After class, he shared the charts he had made with his fellow student Xu Ming, and they commented on each other's work. His programming advancement and health management efforts went hand in hand.

events.name: First day of implementing the healthy diet plan
events.description: In the early morning, prepared breakfast for himself: whole wheat bread, a boiled egg, and a glass of low-fat milk. In the morning, recorded the breakfast with the app, about 380 kcal. At noon, he actively chose lighter dishes in the cafeteria — stir-fried seasonal vegetables, sliced white-cut chicken breast, and a small bowl of rice, avoiding the braised and fried sections. When he felt hungry mid-afternoon, he drank a large glass of warm water and did not eat snacks. For dinner, his mother Wang Xiulan made steamed sea bass and a large plate of vegetable salad (lettuce, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers) for the first time according to the new plan. Ye Mingxuan thought it tasted great and calculated with the app that the day's total calories were about 1,850 kcal, within the target range. After the meal, he thanked his mother for her support, and she said with satisfaction that it really didn't taste bad.

events.name: Learning data visualization in the Python live online course.
events.description: At 7:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan joined the live Python online course on time in his study. Today's lesson was about data visualization with Matplotlib and Seaborn. The instructor started with line charts, then covered the creation and beautification of bar charts and scatter plots. Ye Mingxuan opened Jupyter Notebook and followed along, plotting several charts with test data; one trend line clearly showed the temperature fluctuation of a certain experiment. The course lasted until 9 o'clock. He wrote in his notes: Visualization is more intuitive than raw numbers and can be used for project reports.

events.name: After class, exchanged ideas with fellow student Xu Ming on visualization and charting.
events.description: After the course ended, Ye Mingxuan sent several diagrams he had just drawn to his fellow student Xu Ming on WeChat. Xu Ming also shared a set of scatter matrix charts he had made. The two commented on each other's color schemes and the reasonableness of the axis labels. Xu Ming pointed out that the X-axis labels in one of Ye Mingxuan's charts overlapped and taught him to fix it by rotating them 45 degrees. Ye Mingxuan tried it and it indeed worked; he replied with thanks and saved the corrected version. The two also discussed boundary handling in data cleaning for a while, and the exchange lasted until 10:00.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the day of the Lantern Festival, Ye Mingxuan spent the daytime at the company handling the final preparations before the project review and left work early at 4 p.m. In his spare time, he successfully used Python to write a small program called “Flower Lanterns Reflecting the Moon,” which generated personalized Lantern Festival lantern patterns with his family surname. At 6 p.m., after work, he met up with his parents and together they went to Yangliuqing Ancient Town to enjoy the lantern exhibition. Amid the dazzling sea of lanterns, he sent several generated lantern patterns to the family WeChat group. His father praised them with surprise, and his mother kept saying, “My son is a programmer now.” The atmosphere was warm and touching. After viewing the lanterns, the family walked home together, and his mother was visibly much happier than at the beginning of the month. Ye Mingxuan did not schedule any fitness training today; Coach Wang had previously agreed to let him rest and adjust during the Lantern Festival.

events.name: Final preparations before the project review.
events.description: From 9 am to 4 pm, Ye Mingxuan went through the simulation data needed for the project midterm review with Li Xiang at the company. They found that several parameters needed optimization and discussed an adjustment plan. Ye Mingxuan organized the module design prototype PPT and added a comparison of the efficiency of using Python scripts to process data in the test plan document. At 4 pm, the company allowed employees to leave early for the Lantern Festival, so Ye Mingxuan rode his bike home.

events.name: Wrote a small Python program to generate Lantern Festival lantern patterns.
events.description: Returning home at 4:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan used the two hours before going out to write a small Python program in his study. He used the turtle library for graphical drawing, designed several lantern patterns, such as lotus lanterns and fu-character lanterns, and added the character Ye and the words Happy Lantern Festival to each image. He debugged until 6 p.m., generated several small and lovely lantern images, felt quite satisfied with the results, and saved the images to his phone album.

events.name: Went with his parents to Yangliuqing Ancient Town to enjoy the lantern displays
events.description: At 6 p.m., Ye Mingxuan met up with his father Ye Jianguo and mother Wang Xiulan, and they took the subway together to Yangliuqing Ancient Town. The ancient town was festively decorated with lanterns and colored ribbons; all kinds of shaped lanterns hung along the streets, and crowds of people streamed by. The three of them strolled and admired the lanterns. His mother pointed at a set of doll lanterns and said that when she was little, she had also carried such paper lanterns.

events.name: Python lantern chart surprise and family tech warmth
events.description: While admiring the lanterns, Ye Mingxuan sent several Python-generated lantern images to the family WeChat group, with the note: "These are Lantern Festival lanterns drawn by a little program I wrote with Python." His father, Ye Jianguo, zoomed in and said in pleasant surprise, "This lotus lantern is really good." His mother, Wang Xiulan, saw the pattern with the character "Ye" and the "Happy Lantern Festival" greeting, smiled from ear to ear, and praised, "My son is a programmer!" An elderly neighbor lady passing by also came over for a look at the screen and gave a thumbs-up. Ye Mingxuan felt warm inside seeing his parents' happy expressions.

events.name: After enjoying the lanterns, walking home
events.description: The lantern viewing lasted until 9 p.m., and the family of three slowly walked back along the streets of the ancient town. His mother linked her arm with Ye Mingxuan's and said that this had more New Year flavor than watching the Spring Festival Gala. His father walked beside them, occasionally looking up at the scattered sky lanterns rising in the distance. On the way home, his mother was clearly in a very good mood, in sharp contrast to the look of anxiety about the loan at the beginning of the month.

events.name: Bedtime diary: positive changes in Mom’s mood
events.description: When he got home at 11 p.m., Ye Mingxuan took a shower, sat on the edge of the bed, and briefly wrote today's diary. He specifically noted: Today, my mother was especially happy to see the festive lanterns drawn by the program. From the anxiety at the beginning of the month to genuinely being proud of me today, this change made the atmosphere at home suddenly feel lighter. From now on, I should use technology more to add little surprises to life.

2025-02.daily_overview: Thursday was an important work milestone and a day for deepening relationships. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan organized the report document for tomorrow's project mid-term review, repeatedly checked the simulation data charts with Li Xiang, and rehearsed the presentation process; the atmosphere was tense. In the afternoon, while scrolling through his Moments, he saw a user experience design case shared by his elementary school classmate Li Na. Interested, he commented below to discuss it, and the conversation then moved to private chat. Li Na suggested he combine Python with test automation or data analysis, which happened to coincide perfectly with his work needs. He immediately sorted out a learning path for test automation at his desk. In the evening, he stuck to a healthy diet and declined a colleague's invitation to have Mala Xiang Guo. At 7:30 p.m., he continued his online Python course, learning functions and module imports. After class, he collaborated with Xu Ming to complete a small project: a simple calculator module.

events.name: Organize midterm review materials for the project and rehearse.
events.description: From 9 a.m. to 12 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened a PPT at his workstation and integrated the module design prototype, test plan documents, and the latest simulation data charts into a complete set of mid-term report materials. Later, he rehearsed with Li Xiang in the small meeting room using the projector. Wang Peng came in midway to sit in and sharply asked two questions about deviation risk. Ye Mingxuan answered them, but his palms were sweating. After the rehearsal, Gao Zhiyuan patted him on the shoulder and said the data was solid, not to be nervous.

events.name: Li Na suggested a direction for Python development through WeChat Moments interactions
events.description: At 2 p.m., during a work break, Ye Mingxuan was browsing his Moments feed when he saw an article shared by his elementary school classmate Li Na about combining user experience design with data analysis. After briefly exchanging thoughts with Li Na in the comments section, Li Na proactively started a private WeChat chat. During the chat, Li Na learned that Ye Mingxuan was self-teaching Python. Based on her own work experience, she seriously suggested he go deeper in the direction of test automation or data analysis, saying it was a pain-point skill at the intersection of many internet and manufacturing industries. Ye Mingxuan felt the advice was very pertinent, thanked her on the spot in the chat, and wrote down the direction. Their relationship was upgraded from a long-term likes-only acquaintance to a connection with substantive technical exchanges.

events.name: Organizing the learning path for test automation and data analysis
events.description: After chatting with Li Na, Ye Mingxuan opened a browser at his desk and searched for classic cases of test automation frameworks (such as pytest) and manufacturing data analysis. He found two good introductory documents and bookmarked them in the Python learning folder in his browser bookmarks. Then, in his work notebook, he drew a learning path diagram for the two branches of test automation and data analysis, incorporated the new direction into this quarter's personal study plan, and noted: invest at least 3 hours per week.

events.name: Stick to a healthy diet and resist the temptation of takeout.
events.description: At 5 p.m., colleague Zhou Tao passed by Ye Mingxuan's desk and invited him to have Mala Xiang Guo as an overtime meal. Ye Mingxuan thought for a moment and politely declined, saying he wouldn't go because he was going to eat steamed fish at home tonight. Zhou Tao joked that he had changed his ways. Ye Mingxuan cycled home. For dinner, his mother had indeed made steamed sea bass and vegetable salad. He carefully recorded it in the app, with about 1,800 kcal for the whole day.

events.name: Completed a small project with fellow students in the Python live class.
events.description: At 7:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan attended the weekly Thursday online live Python class. Tonight he learned function definitions, parameter passing, and module imports. The teacher used a calculator module as an example to explain function encapsulation and import calls. After class, Ye Mingxuan and his classmate Xu Ming worked together to expand the classroom example into a simple multi-function calculator module. They each wrote four functions for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, merged them, and tested each other's code; they found and fixed a bug where division by zero was not handled. After finishing, both felt this collaboration model was good and agreed to find a small project to practice every week.

2025-02.daily_overview: Friday afternoon was a key milestone in the February technical breakthrough — the mid-project progress report. In the company conference room, Ye Mingxuan presented the module design prototype and test plan to his immediate superior Gao Zhiyuan and project manager Wang Peng, supporting the report with data from Python script efficiency optimization. The proposal received preliminary approval, but the discussion revealed a risk point where the simulation data deviated from expectations. After the meeting, he immediately met with simulation engineer Li Xiang, preliminarily agreed on an optimization and verification plan, and confirmed the focus for the next two weeks. At 6:30 p.m., the department basketball team had its second training session. Ye Mingxuan's active performance on the defensive end blended increasingly well with his teammates. After training, he booked crosstalk tickets at Mingliu Teahouse, preparing for tomorrow's Tianjin-style crosstalk trip with his childhood friend Zhang Wei.

events.name: Project mid-term progress report and exposure of simulation deviations
events.description: At 2 p.m. in the company meeting room, Ye Mingxuan, as the lead of the key technical module, gave a roughly 40-minute presentation to his direct superior Gao Zhiyuan and project manager Wang Peng. He demonstrated the module design prototype, test plan, and simulation data charts, and highlighted how a Python script improved data processing efficiency from half a day to 45 seconds. Gao Zhiyuan and Wang Peng approved the solution framework, but while reviewing the simulation data, Wang Peng found a set of stress distributions that clearly deviated from expectations and frowned. Gao Zhiyuan reminded that this must be resolved as the highest priority in the next phase. Ye Mingxuan calmly noted the feedback and mentally marked the risk point in red.

events.name: After the meeting, had an urgent discussion with Li Xiang about simulation data discrepancies.
events.description: After the meeting, Ye Mingxuan went directly to Li Xiang's desk. He briefly described the deviation issue exposed during the meeting, and the two immediately opened the simulation model and performed a preliminary check of the boundary condition settings and material property parameters. After half an hour of intense discussion, they agreed on an optimization and validation plan: Li Xiang would recalibrate the parameters, and Ye Mingxuan would adjust the corresponding part of the design model, completing the first round of iteration before next Wednesday. The two agreed to each work half a day overtime on Sunday, and Ye Mingxuan immediately felt that his weekend plan would need to be adjusted.

events.name: Compiled the breakthrough plan and submitted it to superiors.
events.description: At 4 p.m., based on the meeting conclusions and the results of his communication with Li Xiang, Ye Mingxuan listed a detailed plan of attack in his work notebook, including the time milestones for simulation iteration verification, design adjustment plans, and required resources. He turned the electronic version of the plan into an email and sent it to Gao Zhiyuan for review; Gao Zhiyuan replied 10 minutes later saying he had received it and would discuss it in detail next Monday.

events.name: Basketball team training
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., the department basketball team trained at the Tiangong University Gymnasium. Tonight, Ye Mingxuan was more active on the defensive end than last week: his close man-to-man defense and help-side rotations were noticeably smoother, and his defensive coordination with Li Xiang and Zhou Tao became increasingly in sync. During the scrimmage, he made two steals and had one fast-break assist. After training, everyone drank water at the sideline. Zhou Tao said they should rest well over the weekend, and Ye Mingxuan smiled wryly, saying he might have to work overtime. Only after being drenched in sweat was the pressure of work somewhat relieved.

events.name: Book crosstalk show tickets at Mingliu Teahouse and contact Zhang Wei.
events.description: Returning home at 9 p.m., Ye Mingxuan took a shower, then booked two tickets for tomorrow's 2:30 p.m. session through the official WeChat account of Mingliu Teahouse. After payment, he received a confirmation SMS. Then he sent a WeChat voice message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei, confirming they would meet at Xiqing District Metro Station at 1:40 p.m. the next day. Zhang Wei replied with a thumbs-up emoji. Ye Mingxuan saved the e-ticket QR code to his phone album for easy display tomorrow.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Ye Mingxuan went to the Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop to experience mortise-and-tenon craft. He made a small stool and expressed his wish to join the training class; in the afternoon he accompanied his mother on a brief grocery run, then watched crosstalk with his childhood friend Zhang Wei at the Mingliu Teahouse, and afterward went for a walk and shopped; in the evening he sorted photos and posted them on WeChat Moments, logged his meals, and before bed found a clue about a misprinted ancient coin and decided to investigate it further. The day was full of activities and he felt relaxed, but he was still under pressure about the simulation work.

events.name: Set off for the Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop
events.description: At 8 a.m., Ye Mingxuan got up, had a quick breakfast, and drove to a woodworking workshop in Yangliuqing Town. He had booked an experience course online before and wanted to make a piece of mortise-and-tenon furniture with his own hands. He felt excited on the way and planned to spend the morning at the workshop.

events.name: Under the guidance of Master Qian, meticulously crafted a small mortise-and-tenon stool
events.description: From 9 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., Ye Mingxuan learned traditional mortise-and-tenon techniques under the guidance of Master Qian at the woodworking workshop. He selected a piece of wood, marked lines, chiseled mortises, and sanded according to the drawings, finally assembling a small mortise-and-tenon stool. During the process he was focused and meticulous, and felt the joy and sense of accomplishment of handcrafting.

events.name: Expressed a wish to attend a woodworking training class.
events.description: After finishing the piece, Ye Mingxuan chatted with Master Qian and expressed his wish to systematically learn woodworking skills and join a long-term training course. Master Qian welcomed this and told him the next class would start early next month. Ye Mingxuan left his contact information, planning to think it over at home before signing up.

events.name: In the afternoon, accompanied mother to buy additional groceries.
events.description: After returning from Yangliuqing, at around 2 p.m., Ye Mingxuan accompanied his mother Wang Xiulan to the community vegetable shop to buy a small supplement of vegetables and sea bass. While his mother was selecting, she chatted with the shopkeeper, and Ye Mingxuan helped carry the bags. After getting home, he cleaned and organized the refrigerator and neatly sorted the fresh ingredients.

events.name: Went with childhood friend Zhang Wei to Mingliu Teahouse to watch crosstalk.
events.description: At 2:30 pm, Ye Mingxuan met his childhood friend Zhang Wei at the subway station and took the subway together to Heping District. From 3 pm to 5 pm, the two watched traditional routines performed by a local Tianjin crosstalk troupe at Mingliu Teahouse. The lead comic and his straight man had great chemistry, delivering punchline after punchline, and laughter and applause rose and fell throughout the venue. Ye Mingxuan felt the charm of Tianjin-style folk performance that he had missed for a long time, and temporarily forgot the work pressure of simulation deviation.

events.name: Walking and shopping with Zhang Wei after the performance
events.description: After the performance ended at 5 p.m., the two walked out of the teahouse and strolled slowly along Heping Road Pedestrian Street. The weather was much warmer than a few days earlier. Passing a time-honored dried fruit shop, Zhang Wei bought a bag of sugar-roasted chestnuts, and Ye Mingxuan couldn't help buying a small bag as well. The two shelled and ate them as they walked. Zhang Wei shared his experience using inventory management software in his shop, while Ye Mingxuan mentioned that he was stressed about finishing a simulation by next Wednesday. They talked until it began to get dark, then parted at the intersection and went home separately.

events.name: After returning home, organized the photos and posted them on Moments
events.description: At 7 p.m. he returned home. Sitting on the sofa, Ye Mingxuan selected a few photos taken during the day of performances and a group photo with Zhang Wei, and posted a nine-photo grid on WeChat Moments with the caption "Tianjin-flavored crosstalk, old tradition, new laughter." Before long, he received likes from Zhao Xiaofeng and Li Xiang. He also sent one candid shot of an actor on stage to his father Ye Jianguo, who said he hadn't heard crosstalk live for years.

events.name: Evening healthy eating record and family cooperation
events.description: All-day diet: For breakfast, Ye Mingxuan made himself multigrain porridge with boiled eggs; for lunch, he had a simple sandwich near the woodworking workshop; in the afternoon before the performance, he had a cup of tea with Zhang Wei at a teahouse; for dinner, his mother made steamed sea bass and a vegetable salad. He recorded it all using an app. The total calories for the day were about 1,950 kcal, slightly higher than his usual target, but still within a controllable range. Seeing this, his mother said eating a little more occasionally was fine. Ye Mingxuan smiled and thanked her, but decided inwardly to resume strict tracking tomorrow.

events.name: In the evening, while browsing an ancient coin forum, found a clue about a mint error.
events.description: At 10 p.m. before bed, Ye Mingxuan leaned against the bed scrolling through an ancient coin collecting forum and came across a featured post about misstruck machine-made coins from the Republic of China era, which listed the features of several rare error coins, including missing strokes in the letter 'A' and reverse die rotation. He read it carefully, saved it, and took out a Sun Yat-sen Founding of the Republic commemorative coin he had bought cheaply a few years ago, examining it closely under the desk lamp. Although he couldn't be certain without a magnifying glass, the character 'yuan' on the coin's surface seemed to have a possible missing stroke. His heartbeat quickened slightly, and he decided to buy a high-power magnifying glass and an electronic scale next week to systematically study error coins. This small discovery might turn his ancient coin collecting hobby into a deeper, more specialized field.

In the afternoon, he organized his ancient coin tools to prepare for systematic sorting. In the evening, he went to the supermarket with his mother to buy high-protein ingredients, and after returning home, made a weekly meal plan. events.name: Test-drive a family SUV and decide to put the car purchase on hold.

Zhang Wei enthusiastically recommended the car for its space and value for money, saying it would be suitable for taking his parents out in the future. events.name: Took out the ancient coin sorting tools to prepare for systematic organization.

He sent a WeChat message to his collector friend Zhao Jianguo, arranging a video call on Wednesday or Thursday to ask about the variety of a batch of nickel coins.

events.name: Weekly diet summary and supermarket shopping

events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan returned home, opened his laptop to check the network, and installed the test lecture platform software. He took out more than twenty modern machine-struck coins from his collection, arranged them on the desk, and prepared a magnifying glass, vernier caliper, and notebook.

events.name: Online ancient coin appraisal lecture and personal collection appraisal
events.description: At 3 p.m., the first lecture of the series, “Scientific Methodology for Identifying Machine-Struck Coins,” began. The instructor explained the key points of distinguishing authenticity, starting from material density, casting process marks, and patina oxidation patterns. Ye Mingxuan tested his collection one by one according to the method and found that the edge tooth density of a “Yuan Datou” from the third year of the Republic of China deviated from the genuine standard — it was a counterfeit. He investigated further and found that the counterfeit's field texture matched the characteristics of temporary coins struck by the Chongqing Mint during the War of Resistance, leading him to speculate that there might be a hidden history of supplementary wartime coinage. He recorded it in detail in his notebook, elevating his appraisal approach from a binary genuine/fake judgment to analysis within a historical context.

events.name: Tianjin - Tianjin Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. - workstation

He scanned down line by line: low-density lipoprotein cholesterol 3.8 mmol/L (slightly high), BMI 24.4 (borderline overweight), average sleep time 6.2 hours per day over the past 30 days, and a high mental fatigue score. At the end of the report, a red advice column read: It is recommended to increase aerobic exercise, reduce high-fat diets, and ensure at least 7 hours of sleep per day. Ye Mingxuan stared at the screen in silence for a moment, then screenshotted the key data and saved it to his phone's photo album.

Dr. Liu quickly replied with a long message: a sedentary lifestyle, uncontrollable oil and salt in takeout, and long-term sleep deprivation are precursors to metabolic problems. He suggested bringing lunch from home, doing aerobic exercise at least three times a week, and going to bed before 11 p.m. Ye Mingxuan replied to each point to ask about implementation details, and finally wrote: Thank you, Dr. Liu, I will start changing tomorrow.

I want to increase training frequency and intensity, with the goal of losing fat and gaining muscle. Is tomorrow evening convenient for a session?” The two confirmed the specific times for two personal training sessions on March 4 and 6.

At the top of the spreadsheet, he wrote in red: Goals: reduce LDL to below 3.0 and BMI to below 24 by the end of June.

events.name: At the traditional woodworking techniques training class, studied right-angle straight tenon joints.
events.description: At nine o'clock on Saturday morning, Ye Mingxuan went to the training class to learn the right-angle straight mortise-and-tenon joint. From depth control for the mortise to leaving extra width on the tenon, the teacher demonstrated hand-over-hand. Ye Mingxuan held his breath, concentrated, and chiseled into the beech square timber. After carefully removing the wood chips, he did an initial assembly, and the fit was a bit loose. After adjusting the marking allowance on the second attempt, the tenon fit firmly into the mortise, and the teacher nodded approvingly.

Zhang Wei tried on three navy-blue groom’s suits with different cuts in succession. Ye Mingxuan carefully compared them and gave suggestions, taking front and side photos with his phone for comparison. In the end, the two agreed on a slim-fit single-breasted style.

events.name: During a break in the fitting, they had a lively discussion about career transition and life planning.
events.description: During the twenty-minute break while the tailor was adjusting the waistline, the two sat in the sofa area and chatted. Zhang Wei described in detail his decision to switch from a traditional 4S store to a Tesla Experience Center, valuing the growth potential and training system of the new energy track. Ye Mingxuan listened attentively, moved by his childhood friend's courage to step out of his comfort zone, and admitted that he had recently been thinking about whether he was staying too comfortably at his current company. Zhang Wei suggested that after buying a house, he could consider a new energy vehicle, and perhaps expand his network through the car owner community.

events.name: On the way home, reflected on career situation and recorded it
events.description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Wei, Ye Mingxuan took the subway back alone. Zhang Wei's words kept replaying in his mind. When he got home, he closed the door, sat at the desk, opened his notebook, and wrote down a few questions: ‘Am I too content with the status quo? Is there enough room for promotion at my current company? If I'm still in this situation three years from now, will I regret it?’ These questions had no answers, but writing them down made him feel clearer.

He quickly listed the website addresses to crawl, the list of crosstalk performers, and a photo selection plan in his notes.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Tuesday, the lightweight design project continued to advance, and Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang finalized the plan over lunch. In the evening, he completed the third private training session of March, with increased weights and noticeably improved physical fitness. After training, he measured himself with a body fat scale: his weight dropped from 73.3 kg at the beginning of the month to 73.0 kg, and his body fat percentage improved initially. However, in the evening, because his boss treated everyone to Mala Xiangguo to celebrate the plan's approval, Ye Mingxuan broke his discipline and ate some greasy food, leading to stomach bloating before bed.

events.name: During lunch, had an in-depth discussion and finalized the lightweight solution.
events.description: At noon, the two met again in the canteen. Li Xiang brought his laptop and opened the preliminary finite element analysis results. The simulation showed that the material replacement solution proposed by Ye Mingxuan still had weak points in the stress concentration areas. After discussion, the two decided to add stiffeners to that area and fine-tune the thickness parameters. Li Xiang modified the geometric model on the spot, and Ye Mingxuan recorded the parameter comparison before and after the modification. After verification, the solution was feasible, and the two agreed to adopt a hybrid solution of 'high-strength alloy steel replacement plus stiffeners at key locations.'

events.name: The intensity of the third personal training session was increased.
events.description: At seven in the evening, Ye Mingxuan arrived at Limei Fitness Center. Coach Wang noticed that his training log showed improved physical fitness, so he increased the load for squats and bench press by 5 kg each. Under the new weights, Ye Mingxuan's forehead veins showed slightly as he completed each set, but his form remained standard. By the end of the 30-minute elliptical session, he was noticeably more relaxed than in his first class.

events.name: Recorded fitness test progress after working out
events.description: After training, Coach Wang took Ye Mingxuan to the body composition testing area and used a professional body fat scale to measure him. The data came out: weight 73.0 kg (down 0.3 kg from the beginning of the month), body fat percentage 25.6% (down 0.2 percentage points from the beginning of the month), and skeletal muscle mass up slightly by 0.2 kg. Coach Wang nodded and said, "It's good to see this change in a week. Keep controlling oil and salt and maintain protein intake." Ye Mingxuan took a photo of the data and saved it to his phone.

events.name: The boss treated everyone to mala xiang guo to celebrate the plan being approved.
events.description: After the plan was finalized in the afternoon, Project Manager Wang Peng announced in the group chat that evening that, to celebrate the initial finalization of the lightweight solution, he would treat the project team to Mala Xiang Guo near the company. Ye Mingxuan hesitated for a moment but did not want to spoil the mood, so he went along. During the meal, he tried to choose chicken and vegetables, but still unavoidably took in quite a bit of oil and spice. After eating, he felt somewhat bloated and had more trouble falling asleep than usual.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Wednesday, the lightweight design was wrapping up. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan organized the solution data to prepare for the next day's departmental weekly meeting. In the afternoon, he found an omission in the document and made an urgent correction. In the evening, he was supposed to go to his personal training session, but because the urgent correction had taken time and he was experiencing muscle fatigue, he had no choice but to cancel it, instead doing stretching at home and going to bed early. Consecutive days of healthy eating made him noticeably less sleepy in the afternoon, and his energy was more sustained.

events.name: Prepare weekly meeting materials for lightweight solution data preparation.
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan organized the key parameters of the finalized design plan into a table, including comparison data between the raw material plan and the optimized plan across three dimensions: weight, maximum stress, and safety factor. He saved it as an Excel document to provide data support for tomorrow's weekly meeting.

events.name: Discovered a dimension annotation deviation while urgently revising the document
events.description: At 3 p.m., Li Xiang reminded Ye Mingxuan that the diameter annotation of a connecting hole in the archived materials had a 0.05 mm deviation. Although very small, it could affect the precision fit. Ye Mingxuan's heart tightened. He immediately opened the original model to check. It was indeed a typo made while organizing the data — he had typed one extra digit. He spent nearly an hour correcting the four related tables and re-ran the simulation verification. He only felt at ease after confirming everything was correct. This incident made him break out in a cold sweat.

events.name: Cancel personal training and switch to home recovery
events.description: Because the revision work delayed his originally scheduled off-work time, and two consecutive days of training left his muscles still sore, Ye Mingxuan sent a WeChat message to Coach Wang to explain the situation and moved tonight's training to tomorrow (Thursday). After going home and having dinner, he did ten minutes of shoulder, neck, and leg stretches on a yoga mat in the living room, soaked his feet in hot water, and went to bed about forty minutes earlier than usual.

events.name: Self-check the past week's healthy eating implementation.
events.description: Before going to bed, Ye Mingxuan opened the diet tracking app and reviewed the past week's data: average daily calorie intake was 1,800 kcal, protein accounted for 35%, oil and salt were well controlled, with only one over-target day yesterday. Satisfied with his persistence, he wrote in his diary: A week of healthy bento lunches and regular exercise, no more afternoon drowsiness, noticeably better energy. Keep going.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Thursday, Ye Mingxuan reached the career highlight of March — at the department weekly meeting, the lightweight design results he co-presented with Li Xiang were publicly praised by supervisor Gao Zhiyuan. But before he could savor the sense of accomplishment, project milestones pressed in. He rushed through the archiving and still worked overtime until 9 p.m. Even so, he insisted on completing the fourth personal training session in March, releasing stress through exercise. Late at night, he received a call from the rental agent and learned that the apartment he had his eye on was taken. A strong sense of loss led him to have a long conversation with his father in the living room until nearly midnight.

events.name: Received public praise for the department weekly meeting report
events.description: At 2 p.m., the department's weekly meeting was held on time. When it was Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang's turn to jointly present the lightweight design results, Ye Mingxuan cast the PPT to the screen and explained everything step by step, from the problem background and scheme comparison to the simulation verification results. Gao Zhiyuan was the first to applaud after they finished. In front of a dozen or so colleagues in the department, he praised them: Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang cooperated very well this time. They worked out a lightweight design in one week, with solid data and efficient collaboration, which is worth learning from. After sitting down, Ye Mingxuan's heart was still racing, and he drew a checkmark in the blank space of his notebook.

events.name: Worked overtime to complete the final archiving wrap-up
events.description: After the meeting, it was nearly 4:30 p.m. Ye Mingxuan found that the archived report still had one appendix unfinished, and it needed the final data from the testing team. He waited until a little after five to receive the data, then spent two hours organizing and uploading it to the project management system. He didn't leave the office until after 7 p.m., nearly two hours later than usual.

events.name: Persisted and completed the fourth personal training session.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan arrived at the Limei Fitness Center, exhausted. Coach Wang noticed he was not in good shape and appropriately reduced the number of strength training sets, but insisted that he complete 30 minutes of cardio on the elliptical machine. On the elliptical, Ye Mingxuan gradually adjusted his mindset, and the sweat washed away some of his anxiety. After the workout, he felt his mind had actually become clearer.

events.name: The desired property was snatched up, and a feeling of disappointment spread.
events.description: At 10 p.m., Ye Mingxuan received a call from the real estate agent, telling him that the two-bedroom apartment in the community he had been following in Zhongbei Town had been bought in full, 200,000 yuan above his budget. After hanging up, he sat silently in the room for a long time — he had been planning the down payment for this apartment for several months, and now everything had to start from zero. His mother noticed he was upset, gently knocked on the door and asked what was wrong, but Ye Mingxuan just said, "Nothing."

events.name: Re-discussed the Home Purchase Plan with Father Late at Night
events.description: At 10 p.m., after his mother went back to her room to rest, Ye Mingxuan and his father Ye Jianguo sat facing each other on the sofa in the living room. He told his father the news that the house listing had been snatched away, his tone tinged with reluctance. His father silently took a sip of tea, then said calmly: This one is gone, we will find the next. The money is in your hands, so the initiative is in your hands. Tomorrow I will go ask around for information. Ye Jianguo's steady tone gradually calmed Ye Mingxuan down. The two circled several alternative residential communities on the phone map and agreed to go see houses on Sunday.

events.name: Leave work early in the afternoon to get into the right state.

During the lunch break, he rested with his eyes closed for twenty minutes. At 4 p.m., after confirming that all necessary work for the day was done, he reported to his supervisor and left work one hour early. When he got home, he fell onto the bed and caught up on two hours of sleep; when he woke up, his head didn't feel as heavy.

events.name: Maintaining performance in basketball team training.
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan had recovered a good deal of energy and arrived on time at the Tiangong University gymnasium for team training. After the one-and-a-half-hour training session, he felt his body full of vitality again, and the gloom that had lingered during the day was swept away.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ye Mingxuan attended the woodworking training class as usual to learn dovetail joint making. In the afternoon, he had a brief meeting with coach Wang Jian, showed his two weeks of diet records, and received advice for the next stage. In the evening, he prepared for the upcoming house viewing next week by organizing personal documents and carefully re-reading the provident fund loan policy. events.name: Learning dovetail joint making in the woodworking training class
events.description: On Saturday morning, Ye Mingxuan went to the training class to attempt the more difficult dovetail joint. Compared with last week's right-angle straight tenon, the dovetail's angled sawing and fine trimming demanded much better hand-eye coordination. He repeatedly practiced the layout angle, sawing direction, and chisel trimming force. After the first test piece was assembled, the gap was too large. The teacher re-demonstrated the grip for the backsaw. On Ye Mingxuan's second attempt, it was significantly better; after the tenon was inserted, the gap was reduced to less than half a millimeter. The teacher took the piece, turned it around in his hand, and said that there was progress.

events.name: Show the coach diet records and plan the next phase
events.description: At 4 p.m., Ye Mingxuan had a brief meeting with Coach Wang in the rest area of Limei Fitness Center. He opened the health diary on his phone and showed 19 consecutive days of detailed diet records and a weight change curve; every day's three meals since March 5 were recorded. After reviewing it carefully, Coach Wang gave suggestions for the next stage: maintain the current diet structure, add a set of single-leg exercises to the strength training to improve lower-limb balance, and aim to reduce body weight to below 73.0 kg by the end of March. Ye Mingxuan entered the suggestions into his phone.

events.name: Prepared home-buying related materials in the evening
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan organized his personal income certificate, bank statements, and housing provident fund contribution records at his desk, preparing the documents to submit to the agent when viewing houses with his father on Sunday. He also carefully re-read the latest Tianjin housing provident fund loan policy on his computer, calculated the differences in monthly payments under different down payment ratios, and drew a comparison table in his notebook.

events.name: Autonomous core training and cardio
events.description: To maintain his exercise habit, Ye Mingxuan did 20 minutes of self-directed training at home at 9 p.m., including planks, supine crunches, and mountain climbers, then followed a 5-minute yoga stretching routine on his phone app to close out the day.

The three-way pooling of the down payment boosted the family’s sense of responsibility and cohesion to an all-time high. In the evening, the family of three celebrated warmly at a restaurant. His father recalled the past, his mother repeatedly urged frugality, and Ye Mingxuan, moved, became even more determined to repay the money.

events.name: Three family parties pooled their resources to make up the down payment
events.description: In the morning, the final pooling of the down payment took place at home. Father Ye Jianguo unhesitatingly took out 150,000 yuan from his retirement savings; mother Wang Xiulan, though reluctant, allocated 80,000 yuan from the family savings. Together with Ye Mingxuan's own 220,000 yuan in savings, the three sides pooled 450,000 yuan for the down payment. His father emotionally recalled how, when he got married, Grandfather had only given a camphor wood chest and 500 yuan. Ye Mingxuan was deeply moved.

events.name: Seriously recorded the loan from his parents and drafted a repayment plan.

His mother repeatedly said, “No rush,” but Ye Mingxuan insisted on repaying, and secretly decided to repay his father's portion first.

events.name: Final confirmation of home purchase within the family

events.name: Reserved a restaurant and confirmed the menu.

Then he replaced all the activated carbon packs to ensure the adsorption effect.

events.name: Calculate family emergency needs and re-examine the coin purchase plan
events.description: After lunch, Ye Mingxuan used Excel in his study to carefully calculate recent expenses, the mortgage, and his mother's possible future rehabilitation costs, and found that the current emergency fund of 23,000 yuan was still insufficient. He opened the ancient coin trading group, added the long-coveted 'Guangxu Yuanbao, Beiyang Mint' to the shopping cart, and hovered his finger over the payment button for a long time before finally closing the page. He opened the family emergency fund account, looked at the balance of 21,000 yuan, calculated again the physical therapy costs his mother might need for rehabilitation, and let out a soft sigh.

events.description: In the evening, Zhang Wei forwarded a registration link for an improvisational theater workshop in the childhood-friends WeChat group with the message: 'Does Engineer Ye, who draws all day, dare to take on the challenge? Don't stay cooped up!' Ye Mingxuan was stirred up and replied, 'Then I'll go.' He then confirmed with Zhang Wei in a private chat and decided to sign up for the afternoon session on July 12.

events.name: Transfer the funds intended for buying coins into the emergency fund, and make my intentions clear to my mother.
events.description: That evening, having made up his mind, Ye Mingxuan used mobile banking to transfer 2,000 yuan from his ancient coin collection budget into the family emergency fund account, and simultaneously updated the Python financial script, bringing the emergency fund total to 32,000 yuan. He went to his mother's bedside and said softly, "We'll talk about that ancient coin another time. Your health can't wait. We can save money again." His mother's eyes welled up, and she held his hand tightly. When his mother squeezed his hand, Ye Mingxuan suddenly felt that spending the 2,000 yuan on something unseen made him feel more at ease than locking it away in a collection album.

start_state.mood: Self-disciplined and resolute
