He then opened the workshop link and used WeChat Pay to complete the registration for the improv theater experience, confirming the spot for July 12.

events.name: Gather and set off for the Jizhou team-building base.
events.description: Departed from home at 8:00, drove to the company gate to gather, and boarded the bus with colleagues including Zhou Tao and Li Xiang. On the bus everyone sang and chatted, and arrived at the team-building site in the Jizhou mountain area about two hours later.

events.name: During the hike, had an in-depth exchange with project manager Wang Peng, and the relationship eased.
events.description: During the morning mountain hike, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to walk alongside Wang Peng. At first, the two walked in silence. Ye Mingxuan recalled the time he had been publicly criticized over a progress disagreement and still felt a little uneasy. It was not until Wang Peng proactively handed him a bottle of water and mentioned that Gao Zhiyuan had privately told him before the team-building event, 'Mingxuan has improved a lot these months,' that Ye Mingxuan relaxed. They talked from outdoor gear to improv theater, and Wang Peng encouraged him, 'Just give your mind a break.' The topic then turned to self-driving trips. Wang Peng shared his experience cycling the Sichuan-Tibet route, while Ye Mingxuan described in detail his initial idea of self-driving around Qinghai Lake. Wang Peng appreciated his steady planning and frankly said that the previous project pressure was never personal. The rift caused by the earlier progress disagreement clearly melted away.

events.name: Relaxed socializing over lunch at a farmhouse restaurant.
events.description: At noon in a farmhouse restaurant, Ye Mingxuan sat around a table with Wang Peng, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang, tasting stewed free-range chicken and wild mountain vegetables. They talked about their various hobbies and interests in a harmonious atmosphere.

events.name: Bonfire party and personal hobby showcase.
events.description: In the evening, as the bonfire was lit, Ye Mingxuan was a little reserved during the interactive games but still tried hard to participate. During the free chat, he took out a mortise-and-tenon wood sample and assembled and disassembled it on the spot. Li Xiang marveled, “It's so solid without a single nail.” He then displayed several machine-struck silver dollars and explained the varieties and edge-teeth features, drawing admiring gasps from many colleagues.

events.name: Continuing the conversation on the return coach
events.description: At 20:30, took the bus back. Ye Mingxuan sat together with Wang Peng and Li Xiang, continuing to discuss complex surface machining technology and possible future collaboration. The three agreed to hold a short technical meeting after returning to the company.

events.name: Searched for improvisational theater principles late at night and went to sleep feeling anxious.
events.description: At 23:00 he got home. Although tired, he wasn't sleepy at all. Ye Mingxuan turned on his computer, searched for “improv theater yes and,” watched related videos, and got a preliminary understanding of its basic principles. Lying in bed, he had a feeling he would perform poorly, and with the expectation that “it might be terrible,” he tossed and turned for a long while before falling asleep.

The two discussed breathing rhythm and cadence optimization techniques via voice messages.

Ye Jianguo nodded. Ye Mingxuan remembered the pressure of having insisted on buying this apartment at the start of the year against everyone's objections. At this moment, all the disputes had turned into the peace of the bright and clean view before him.

events.name: Early morning 13 km long-distance run
events.description: Woke up at 5:30 a.m., had half a banana and warm water, set off from the community gate at 5:50, and completed a 13 km long run along Zhongbei Avenue–Outer Ring Road with an average pace of 5:50/km, slightly slower than in June due to the heat. Rehydrated once at the 7 km mark. After finishing, used a foam roller and stretched thoroughly.

events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan gave the phone stand gift another look, then went to the neighborhood cake shop and ordered a low-sugar cream cake for his mother, agreeing to pick it up tomorrow morning. After returning home, he carefully placed the gift box on the top shelf of the bookcase.

events.name: Prepare woodworking tools and drive to Master Qian's workshop.
events.description: In the morning, I organized the chisels, planes, and try square, and confirmed with Master Qian on WeChat that I would arrive at the workshop by 1 PM. After having lunch early, I drove for 20 minutes and arrived at the backyard of Master Qian's home in Yangliuqing Town.

events.name: Learning to make a dovetail storage box
events.description: Under Master Qian's guidance, Ye Mingxuan first used a marking gauge to draw the tenon lines on the beech board, then used a fine-tooth saw and a chisel to cut the dovetail grooves. After several adjustments, the three side panels were assembled smoothly. He then sanded the surfaces and installed the bottom plate and handle, and a neat storage box took shape. Master Qian commented, 'This time the tenon shoulder lines are very even — you've made good progress.' He also gave Ye Mingxuan a piece of African blackwood offcut as encouragement.

events.name: Take photos and post to Moments; maintain tools
events.description: After finishing, Ye Mingxuan placed the storage box on the workshop table, took a photo, and posted it on WeChat Moments: "Sunday woodworking: first experience with dovetail joints, smooth and warm to the touch." It drew likes from Wang Peng, Sun Jing, and others. After returning home, he washed all the tools, oiled them for maintenance, and put the new storage box in his work area for storing carving knives.

2025-07.daily_overview: Monday was his mother's 59th birthday. After work, Ye Mingxuan picked up the cake and presented the phone stand he had carved himself. His mother was moved to tears. He thought of the running around over the past two weeks, and the tension between mother and son caused by the disagreement over buying a house completely melted away. Late at night, he continued refining the Python 3D dynamic health chart, planning to present it to his father the next day.

events.name: Optimize the fixture design based on the finite element analysis results.
events.description: In the morning, Li Xiang sent an analysis report pointing out stress concentration at a cantilever of the fixture body. Ye Mingxuan immediately increased the fillet radius in the model and increased the local thickness by 2 mm. After regenerating the model, the stress dropped to a safe range.

events.name: Picked up the cake and celebrated mother's birthday
events.description: After work, he stopped by the cake shop on the way to pick up the low-sugar cake. By the time he got home, his father had already cooked several signature dishes. Ye Mingxuan helped his mother to the head of the dining table and lit the candles. When his mother unwrapped the gift and saw the adjustable phone stand engraved with "Mom, keep going" and auspicious clouds, she gently rubbed it with her hand, her eyes turning red: "Son, this gift is better than anything else." The mother and son embraced, and all the previous tension completely dissipated. Ye Mingxuan felt a warmth in his heart. He recalled the bench in the emergency room on July 1, the reluctance and relief when transferring money on July 5, and the moment on July 9 when his mother said "You have good taste, son" in the new house. Half a month of running around and exhaustion turned into something worthwhile at this moment.

events.name: Sat chatting with his mother until late at night
events.description: After clearing the table, Ye Mingxuan sat with his mother on the sofa and chatted, from his mischievous childhood stories to the arguments over buying the new house, and then to decorating the new home. His mother said gently: “As long as you live a steady and secure life, I'm not in a hurry for you to find a partner.” Ye Mingxuan felt a warmth in his heart, and the long-missed closeness flowed again.

events.name: Completed a Python 3D dynamic health chart.
events.description: After his mother went to rest, Ye Mingxuan continued writing the script in his study. He introduced the Plotly library to generate a 3D dynamic curve chart containing blood pressure, body weight, and exercise frequency, added mouse interaction and a play button, and tested repeatedly until it displayed perfectly, then closed the computer with satisfaction.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

2025-07.daily_overview: Tianjin was hit by a rare rainstorm. Ye Mingxuan's morning commute was tough and he was late, but he still pushed the work forward. In the evening, he found rainwater backing up into the residential complex. Without a word, he joined the emergency response, carrying sandbags and pumping out water until the early morning. Covered in mud, he earned the admiration of his neighbors.

events.name: Braved heavy rain to go to work and adjusted work plans.
events.description: Rain poured down in torrents in the early morning. Ye Mingxuan drove into severe traffic congestion, with many road sections flooded and his car nearly stalling in a low-lying area. The commute that usually took 40 minutes took 1.5 hours, making him nearly an hour late. He dried his hair and changed into a spare T-shirt, then discussed fixture trial production process deviations with Gao Zhiyuan and Zhou Tao and formulated contingency plans. During the lunch break, he called to confirm that his parents were fine.

events.name: In the evening, noticed rainwater backing up into the residential complex and took the initiative to join the emergency response.
events.description: On the way home from work, near home, Ye Mingxuan found that the community was in a low-lying area; rainwater had flooded over the curb, and the underground garage and first-floor hallway were taking in water. Property management staff urgently set up pumps. Ye Mingxuan rolled up his trouser legs and ran over to help. Together with several young neighbors, he moved flood-prevention sandbags to block the entrances and helped start the pumps to drain the water. He kept working until 11 p.m., when the flooding was finally brought under control.

events.name: After the emergency rescue ended, returned home late at night to rest.
events.description: In the early morning, the danger was lifted, and the property manager and neighbors thanked him repeatedly. Ye Mingxuan dragged his heavy steps home, and his mother handed him hot ginger soup and a towel. While taking a shower, he came back to himself; although extremely exhausted, he felt a sense of fulfillment from helping the community.

2025-07.daily_overview: On the last day of July, Ye Mingxuan summarized in his diary the innovation in communication patterns and reviewed the entire month's understated upgrades—from his mother's emergency visit to the new home's formaldehyde reaching the standard, from fixture design to running progression. Then he enjoyed the neighbors' gratitude and went for an easy recovery run of 5 km in the evening, bringing his monthly mileage to 72.5 km and his weight down to 71.5 kg. The moving and training plans for August are advancing steadily.

events.name: Monthly reflection: affirming the effectiveness of the [yes, and] practice and reviewing growth in July.
events.description: In the early morning, Ye Mingxuan sat in his study and wrote the last diary entry of July, reviewing two experiences of deliberately practicing the [yes, and] principle of improvisational theater: once during an initial attempt at a workshop, and once on July 24 when he resolved a disagreement in a technical debate with Li Xiang. He wrote: 'This way of thinking is like leaving a window open in a conversation, reducing defensiveness and making the other party more willing to cooperate. Even an ISTJ can learn to catch the other person's ball and gracefully throw it back.' Before closing the diary, he looked through this month's records: his mother going from anxiety in the emergency room to teary smiles under birthday candlelight, the new home's formaldehyde level going from exceeding the standard to fully meeting it, and the fixture design going from sketches to passing review. That ordinary mechanical engineer he had thought himself to be seemed to have completed a quiet upgrade in July. He decided to continue applying it in future cross-department coordination and family communication.

events.name: Neighbors' gratitude and sense of community belonging.
events.description: When going out, Ye Mingxuan ran into several neighbors who had joined him in the emergency rescue last night. They thanked him in person, and multiple @-mentions of thanks for him popped up in the owners' group chat. Someone called him 'the most handsome person rushing to danger.' He responded modestly, feeling warm inside.

After it ended, he wrote in his diary: "Listening to your body is also part of training. The record is waiting for me to break it next month."

He exchanged thoughts on recovery runs with Xiao Chen over WeChat, and they agreed to adjust the training rhythm in August. Before bed, he went through the moving checklist again. With moving and training both in full swing in August, life felt full of upward momentum.

start_state.mood: Still felt tired when getting up early, so decided to focus on recovery today.

end_state.mood: Although his body still felt a bit fatigued, he accepted the imperfect ending and remained confident about the future.

2025-10.daily_overview: The day of his first half marathon. Ye Mingxuan finished the race in 2 hours and 12 minutes, broke through the wall at the 15-kilometer mark, and sprinted in the last 3 kilometers. At the finish line, he hugged and celebrated with his father, supervisor Gao Zhiyuan, and colleague Li Xiang. Afterward, his family and colleagues had a celebration dinner together. He hung the medal in the living room and set the goal of a full marathon in 2026 that night, officially upgrading from a fitness runner to a race competitor.

events.name: Participating in the Tianjin Marathon half marathon
events.description: Woke up at 5:30 a.m., had a light meal of bread and a banana, and arrived at the starting point at 6:30. The half marathon started with the gun at 7:30. Ye Mingxuan followed his plan and kept a steady pace of 6:15 per kilometer. The first 10 km felt smooth. At 15 km he hit the wall, with rapid breathing and heavy legs, so he proactively slowed to a 6:40 pace and gradually recovered after taking an energy gel. In the final 3 km, he accelerated and sprinted amid the crowd's cheers, crossing the finish line with a gun time of 2 hours 12 minutes. His net time was 2 hours 10 minutes 38 seconds, completing a qualitative transformation from fitness runner to race competitor. After the race, he felt no discomfort in his right wrist, proving that the overuse injury had basically healed.

events.name: Reunion with family and friends at the finish line and celebration dinner
events.description: After finishing the race, Ye Mingxuan met up in the finish-area rest zone with his father Ye Jianguo, who had been waiting there early, his direct superior Gao Zhiyuan, and his colleague Li Xiang. His father excitedly patted him on the shoulder, while Engineer Gao and Li Xiang held up the cheering signs they had prepared and took smiling group photos. Then the group drove to a frequently visited Tianjin restaurant, where his mother Wang Xiulan had already ordered his favorite dishes such as steamed sea bass and braised pork. During the meal, there was laughter and cheerful conversation; Ye Mingxuan shared his mental journey along the course, and his sense of support from family and work circles reached a new high.

In the evening, he wrote in the family health diary: 'Today proved that I can break through my own limits; the 2026 full marathon is not a dream.' Then he took out a marathon training book, sketched out a preliminary preparation framework for the 2026 full marathon, and officially wrote the new goal into his journal.

2025-06.daily_overview: During the Dragon Boat Festival, the father's morning blood pressure reading was within the normal range. The whole family stopped work for the day and sat together wrapping low-salt zongzi, passing on the traditional craft while adding a healthy twist. In the evening, they enjoyed the fruits of their labor together, and family affection warmed in the aroma of zongzi. Ye Mingxuan also remembered to browse tech forums to stay professionally sharp.

events.name: Mother prepares ingredients in the early morning.
events.description: At dawn, my mother scrubbed the bamboo leaves one by one and soaked them in a large basin. After rinsing the glutinous rice three times in clean water, she also soaked it in a basin. She removed the pits from the red dates one by one, and rolled the red bean paste into small balls for later use. All kinds of ingredients were neatly arranged across the kitchen counter.

events.name: Father's morning blood pressure measurement was within the target range.
events.description: After getting up early, he measured his father's blood pressure at 142/90 mmHg, a clear drop from 145/95 at the beginning of the month. His father happily said he would wrap a few more zongzi today to celebrate, connecting with the earlier health intervention.

events.name: The whole family sat together making low-salt zongzi
events.description: After breakfast, Ye Mingxuan sat around the dining table in the living room with his parents. His mother demonstrated the standard triangular zongzi wrapping method and required every one to be tied tightly; his father showed off the slender four-cornered zongzi technique he had mastered when he was young, and told funny stories about helping out in the factory canteen in the old days. Given his father's high blood pressure, she specifically confirmed with the vendor that the red dates had no added sugar, and planned the ingredients for a low-salt version of lean pork zongzi. Ye Mingxuan learned to wrap, leaking rice from time to time, which made his mother laugh. This year they specially made a low-salt recipe: red date zongzi had no extra sugar, and the lean pork zongzi used only a little light soy sauce instead of dark soy sauce, with chopped shiitake mushrooms added to enhance the flavor. The three worked well together and wrapped two large platters of zongzi in various shapes in less than two hours.

events.description: During a break from making zongzi, Ye Mingxuan used his phone to film clips of his parents giving guidance, the details of shaping the zongzi, and his father telling old stories. He then spent a quarter of an hour using a mobile video editing app to quickly cut a warm two-minute short video, added the blessing text "Wishing you peace at the Dragon Boat Festival and health along the way", and sent it to the "Ye Family Big Family" WeChat group. Relatives all liked and replied.

events.description: The wrapped zongzi were neatly arranged by his mother in a large stainless steel pot, with enough cold water added to cover them. After the water boiled over high heat, it was turned down to a low simmer. Ye Mingxuan sat on a small stool in the kitchen to tend to the heat, while his father brought over a teacup and sat beside him, judging the water level and heat by experience and talking about old times cooking zongzi on a coal stove. About two hours later, the aroma of bamboo leaves filled the room, and the zongzi were taken out of the pot.

In the evening he did a recovery easy run, and after dinner walked with his father to talk about health. The multi-track tasks progressed in an orderly manner.

events.name: Ancient Coin Notes was officially released and attracted a lot of attention.
events.description: In the morning, Zhao Jianguo published the full text of "Notes on Anti-Counterfeiting and Die Varieties of Modern Machine-Struck Coins in Tianjin" on the Huaxia Collection website forum in both their names. Ye Mingxuan immediately reposted it on his own account and wrote a recommendation, emphasizing the innovation of scientific appraisal. Within a few hours of the post going live, reads exceeded 10,000, and the comments section was flooded with hundreds of questions and compliments from fellow collectors. The two shared the good news with each other on WeChat.

events.name: Schedule quarterly communication with the financial advisor
events.description: During his lunch break, Ye Mingxuan contacted Zhang Wei, the wealth management manager at China Merchants Bank, via WeChat to confirm a quarterly financial review at 3 p.m. on June 20, and specifically mentioned that he wanted to consult about optimizing the emergency reserve and money fund allocation. Zhang Wei replied that everything had been properly arranged.

events.name: Handling design requirements for special-shaped parts in project work.
events.description: During the day at the office, Ye Mingxuan received a redesign task for an irregular bracket. He used the existing parametric drafting tool to try semi-automatically adjusting the dimensions. Although he did not fully use version 0.5, he already experienced the advantages of parametric thinking. He briefly briefed Li Xiang on the simulation requirements, and the two agreed to align on the model tomorrow morning.

events.name: Evening easy recovery run, 3 km
events.description: To allow the body to fully recover from the half marathon, today's personal training session was adjusted to an easy 3 km jog at a pace of 7 min/km, with a focus on stretching and relaxation. After work, Ye Mingxuan went to the park near Limei Fitness Center for a recovery run and stretched thoroughly afterward.

events.name: After dinner, accompanied my father on a 2 km walk around the neighborhood and discussed blood pressure management.
events.description: At 7:45 p.m., Ye Mingxuan and his father took a 2-kilometer walk in the community. Along the way, they exchanged knowledge about blood pressure management, and his father said he felt relaxed after the walk.

events.name: Optimized the parametric tool code in the evening.
events.description: After taking a shower following his walk, Ye Mingxuan opened his laptop and refactored the code for version 0.5 beta of the parametric design tool: he improved the handling of abnormal user input and added simple slider interaction for adjusting several core parameters. After an hour of polishing, the tool's stability had noticeably improved.

start_state.mood: Focused, looking forward to the response to the journal.

end_state.mood: A sense of accomplishment intertwined with peace of mind

state.daily_exercise: Recovery easy run of 3 km; walk 2 km with father

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, high of 35°C, strong UV, hot wind in the evening

2025-06.daily_overview: The journal remains popular. Ye Mingxuan focused on the project during the day and further studied Ansys material properties and assembly analysis, steadily improving his skills. After work, he replied to collector friends and received the first draft outline for Sichuan copper coins. In the evening, he ventilated the new house and did light study as planned.

events.name: Batch-reply to questions from collectors of his handwritten notes
events.description: At noon and after work, Ye Mingxuan logged in to the Huaxia Collection Network and, under the post, replied one by one to fellow collectors' questions about rust color analysis methods and Tianjin Mint varieties, replying to more than fifty in total. He especially thanked Zhao Jianguo for his academic support.

events.name: Received the outline of Sichuan copper coin handwritten notes sent by Zhao Jianguo.
events.description: In the evening, Zhao Jianguo sent a draft outline of "A Preliminary Study of Sichuan Military Government Copper Coins" on WeChat. After reading it carefully, Ye Mingxuan replied with some thoughts from the perspective of mechanism analysis, and they agreed to discuss in depth over the weekend.

events.name: Studying finite element analysis basics in the workplace.
events.description: After finishing the parts drawings at hand during the day, he took advantage of a lull in the project to continue studying Chapter 2 of Ansys Workbench on material property settings on the company intranet, and completed a simple static analysis of an assembly. Li Xiang passed by and shared a case of complex contact settings, suggesting starting with bolt pretension.

events.name: Go to the new house in the evening to air it out and record data.
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan went to the new apartment again, opened all the windows to air it out for an hour, and used a detector to record data in the master bedroom and second bedroom. The formaldehyde level in the master bedroom had dropped to 0.105 mg/m³, just one step away from the national standard of 0.10. He sent the trend line chart to his father, who replied, 'Almost there, almost there.'

events.name: In the evening, studied advanced Python data visualization.
events.description: Back home, Ye Mingxuan spent an hour watching an advanced Python data visualization tutorial video, learning to make Plotly dynamic charts, planning to apply it later to the family health diary display. His mother brought him a bowl of mung bean soup and reminded him not to get too tired.

start_state.mood: Energetic, with a good work rhythm.

end_state.mood: Gained new insights; looking forward to the new cooperation.

state.daily_exercise: Evening: 15 minutes of slow walking and stretching in the neighborhood.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to overcast, with afternoon showers, temperatures 24-30°C

2025-06.daily_overview: A milestone day: the review meeting clarified my development path for the second half of the year, financial optimization strengthened the family emergency reserve, my evening long run broke through 15 kilometers and I met a new running friend, Chen Xiao, and both my tools and personal abilities were recognized.

events.name: The first monthly mortgage payment was automatically deducted and recorded.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the mortgage bank automatically deducted the first monthly installment from the repayment account, totaling 3,698.74 yuan in principal and interest. After receiving the text message, Ye Mingxuan immediately logged into mobile banking to confirm, and recorded the expense under the "Mortgage" category in his Python ledger, with a note saying, "After the housing provident fund offset, the cash outlay is about 700 yuan." He checked the account balance and confirmed that subsequent monthly cash flow remained within budget.

events.name: Prepare a written outline for the quarterly review meeting
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan systematically organized at his workstation the progress of the parametric tool development, the results of reshaped collaboration after Zhou Tao's departure, and his personal need for finite element analysis skills, forming a two-page A4 outline that highlighted quantified achievements and a growth plan.

events.name: Conduct quarterly one-on-one meeting with Gao Zhiyuan
events.description: At 2 pm, Ye Mingxuan had his quarterly interview with his direct supervisor Gao Zhiyuan in the meeting room. Following an outline, he reported in detail on the results of the parametric tool and project delivery. Gao Zhiyuan clearly praised the tool's efficiency and his contribution to team stability, suggested focusing on improving finite element analysis skills in the second half of the year, promised support for enrolling in external Ansys Workbench training, and reminded him that delivery documents need to be standardized.

events.name: Met with financial manager Zhang Wei and optimized the emergency reserve
events.description: At 4 p.m., Ye Mingxuan arrived at China Merchants Bank Tianjin Branch and had a quarterly review with Zhang Wei. After analyzing the current money market fund yields, Zhang Wei suggested transferring 20% (about 30,000 yuan) of the demand savings to purchase a highly liquid money market fund. Ye Mingxuan completed the subscription on site via online banking.

events.name: In the evening, completed a long run of over 15 kilometers at Nanyunhe Park and met fellow runner Chen Xiao.
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan changed into his gear and went to South Canal Park, preparing for a long-distance run. While warming up, he met Chen Xiao, a fellow runner also training there (an IT engineer at a nearby company). Since their paces were similar, they ran together. They completed 15 kilometers at an average pace of 5:52 per kilometer. Ye Mingxuan timed 1 hour 28 minutes with his phone, with an average heart rate of 148 bpm, setting a personal record for the longest distance. After the run, they added each other on WeChat and agreed to arrange another run another day.

events.name: Record running data and share the breakthrough
events.description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan entered the detailed data (distance, pace, heart rate, split times) into his Python running log and generated a trend chart. He sent screenshots of the record to the family group and shared them with Chen Xiao. His mother praised the father and son for "looking more and more like athletes," and his father repeatedly expressed his delight.

events.name: Added a fund return tracking module to the family ledger
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan added a new module to his Python household income-and-expense script that reads the money market fund's daily yield-per-10,000 data and automatically calculates and updates the seven-day annualized yield every month. When his mother saw the newly added "Fund Returns" column in the ledger, her initial doubts turned into ease.

start_state.mood: A little nervous but well prepared

end_state.mood: The direction is clear, with the joy of a new record interwoven with the delight of meeting new running friends.

state.daily_exercise: Long-distance run of 15 km (including 1 km warm-up)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, high 36°C, with thin clouds in the afternoon and rather muggy conditions

2025-06.daily_overview: Tool integration testing completed, formaldehyde levels in the new house continued to improve, and in the afternoon he accompanied his father on a recovery jog and exchanged running tips. The weekend pace was well balanced between work and rest.

events.name: In the morning, perform complete functional testing and integration of the parametric tool.
events.description: On Saturday morning, Ye Mingxuan focused on integrating the independent modules of the parametric design tool into a unified interface and tested all core workflows. He simulated three common flange design scenarios, confirmed stable operation, took screenshots of the successful results, and saved them for a demo to Gao Zhiyuan next week.

events.name: In the morning, read the new house's sealed-room test data and ventilated the rooms.
events.description: During a break in the testing, Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike to the new house and read the formaldehyde values after it had been sealed for 12 hours the night before: master bedroom 0.100 mg/m³, second bedroom 0.098 mg/m³, living room 0.101 mg/m³, all stable at the critical safety line. Overjoyed, he took photos and sent them to the family group chat, then opened the windows to air out the rooms for two hours, and also opened the drawers in the second bedroom wardrobe one by one to release the smell.

events.name: In the afternoon, accompanied my father on a 4 km recovery run.
events.description: At 4 p.m., to help himself recover and continue his father's exercise habit, Ye Mingxuan jogged 4 km with his father along the South Canal, keeping the pace at 7:20 per kilometer. The run was easy, and his father's breathing was steadier than last week. As he ran, Ye Mingxuan shared his experience of breaking the 15 km mark the day before, which made his father very happy.

events.name: Exchanging training experience with running buddy Chen Xiao on WeChat
events.description: After the run, Ye Mingxuan sent yesterday's 15 km data to Chen Xiao. Chen Xiao replied with admiration and shared his experience preparing for a full marathon. The two agreed to attempt a 16 km long-distance run together in July.

events.name: In the evening, organize the financial ledger and plan the monthly balance
events.description: After his evening shower, Ye Mingxuan opened the family ledger and calculated income and expenses from early June to now. Seeing that after major items such as the mortgage and fund conversions, the monthly balance was still positive, he felt much relieved. He also manually entered the seven-day annualized yield data for the money market fund sent by Zhang Wei, preparing for the official launch of the script.

start_state.mood: Energetic and full of plans.

end_state.mood: Gratified by father's progress and delighted by the connection with new running partners

state.daily_exercise: Jog 4 km with father, plus 1 km brisk walk as warm-up.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Sunday, I worked overtime due to an urgent task, which happened to verify the practical power of the parametric tool. In the afternoon, I went with my childhood friend Zhang Wei to a 4S store for a static experience of an SUV. My father's health trend is improving, and the family intervention is beginning to show results.

events.name: A tool used for the first time in the urgent special-shaped flange design task.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Ye Mingxuan received a call from project manager Wang Peng. A partner manufacturer urgently needed a retrofit design for a special-shaped flange and required drawings by 3 p.m. Ye Mingxuan immediately opened the parametric design tool version 0.5 online, imported the existing standard flange template, quickly generated a new model by adjusting a few core parameters, and then fine-tuned the details. The process that would originally have required at least 4 hours of repeated modeling took only 3 hours and 12 minutes to complete and send for simulation, shortening the time by about 20%, and the parametric model could be directly used for subsequent modifications. At noon he received Wang Peng's reply, "Good work, very efficient," and felt greatly encouraged.

events.name: Compile practical tool case studies and update personal performance records.
events.description: After lunch, Ye Mingxuan compiled the before-and-after design comparison screenshots, time-consumption comparison, and client feedback from the day's real-world work into a brief case report and saved it into his personal promotion materials folder. He felt that the value of the tool had crossed from 'it works' to 'it can put out fires'.

events.name: In the afternoon, went to a 4S store with childhood friend Zhang Wei to test-drive SUVs.
events.description: At 2 PM, Ye Mingxuan and Zhang Wei went to the domestic SUV 4S dealership Zhang Wei had previously recommended. They had a static experience with three models in the 150,000-yuan class. Ye Mingxuan focused on driver's seat space and trunk capacity to prepare for buying a car after moving. Zhang Wei explained in detail the configuration differences between the models. In the waiting area, the two also tried a demo of the latest fighting game. Ye Mingxuan bought a posable mechanical figure at the 3D printing area, intending to take it apart at home to study the structure. Zhang Wei, meanwhile, purchased a game OST. They agreed to come back for a test drive later.

events.name: Measure my father's blood pressure and weight, and generate a one-week trend chart.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Ye Mingxuan used an electronic blood pressure monitor and a body fat scale to take measurements for his father: blood pressure 142/91 mmHg, weight 78.2 kg, both slightly lower than at the beginning of last week. He entered the data into the shared Excel, used the charting skills he learned last week to generate a dual-axis blood pressure trend line and a weight bar chart, printed them out, and stuck them on the refrigerator. Seeing the downward arrows, his father smiled.

events.name: In the evening, the family watched a competitive variety show and discussed mechanical design.
events.description: An evening thunderstorm washed away the heat. After dinner, the whole family sat in the living room watching a robot combat reality show. His father was very interested in the robots' joint design. Ye Mingxuan opened his laptop and used simple sketches to explain the principle of differential drive, and the father and son shared a strong spirit of inquiry.

start_state.mood: Received the task in a calm state, with a sense of challenge.

end_state.mood: The fulfillment after a successful practice, the warmth of parent-child time

state.daily_exercise: Walked 1.5 kilometers with parents

After work, they continued airing out the new house and began self-studying finite element analysis. In the evening, a personal training session recharged his body, making the pace of life tight.

events.name: Morning alarm failed—a small hiccup while rushing to work
events.description: In the morning, his phone alarm unexpectedly did not go off. Ye Mingxuan woke up 20 minutes later than usual, hurriedly washed up, and his mother had already prepared a lunchbox. He grabbed a piece of bread and left, finally reaching the company at 7:50 to clock in. Fortunately, it did not affect the morning meeting.

events.name: Morning project stand-up meeting to set this week's delivery milestones
events.description: At Monday morning meeting, project manager Wang Peng clarified the three key part drawings that needed to be completed this week. Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to claim the most complex adapter flange, and agreed with Li Xiang on a simulation plan: submit the preliminary model by tomorrow morning and complete the analysis by Wednesday.

events.name: Adjusting to the new collaboration process with Li Xiang
events.description: In the morning at their workstations, Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang aligned in detail on the interface parameters of the adapter flange. They adjusted dimensions in real time through a shared screen and decided to apply a parametric approach to use the standard parts library in the project. Collaboration efficiency was significantly higher than at the beginning of the month, and the two also agreed to hold a brief technical sync every Monday morning going forward.

events.name: After work, went to the new house to air it out and test it.
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan braved the lingering heat and went to the new house, opened the windows to ventilate for about 40 minutes, and tested the data in each room; all were below 0.10 mg/m³, especially the master bedroom, which had stabilized at 0.095. In his notebook, he selectively took a few photos of the second bedroom and began planning the soft furnishing layout.

events.name: In the evening, start learning the basics of Ansys finite element analysis.
events.description: After showering in the evening, Ye Mingxuan sat in his study and, following the learning path recommended by Gao Zhiyuan, registered for the course Ansys Workbench Basics and Applications on the MOOC website. He spent an hour learning the first chapter of static structural analysis and completed the cantilever beam case along with it. He felt the interface had a lot of English, but the logic was not difficult.

events.name: Evening Personal Training Session
events.description: At 7:30 PM, Ye Mingxuan went to Limei Fitness Center and completed 1.5 hours of strength training under the guidance of coach Wang Jian. Focusing on core and lower-limb stability for recovery after long-distance running, the stretching was especially thorough.

events.name: Helped my mother log this week's low-salt recipes.
events.description: After training, he returned home. His mother brought a handwritten weekly recipe, and Ye Mingxuan helped enter it into the meal plan sheet in the shared Excel, which automatically calculated the estimated daily sodium intake. His mother was satisfied with the figures for tofu shrimp soup and decided to make it more often.

start_state.mood: He woke with a start and was in a hurry, but quickly adjusted his state.

end_state.mood: A sense of fulfillment from learning new things, and anticipation of the new house nearing move-in

events.name: Pressing forward with the detailed design of the adapter flange

events.name: Completed a 6 km interval run after the rain.

events.name: In the evening, had an in-depth discussion with Zhao Jianguo about the outline of the Sichuan copper coin notes.
events.description: After the run, Ye Mingxuan went home. The two finalized their collaboration framework.

events.name: Organize and store summer clothes
events.description: Before bedtime, Ye Mingxuan helped his mother compress the last batch of thick winter blankets into vacuum bags and store them in the top cabinet. As she tidied up, his mother said, "Summer is really here; you start sweating at the slightest movement."

2025-06.daily_overview: High-temperature exposure caused an air conditioner failure; handled it calmly, completed the repair, and added a home maintenance budget item. Also organized father's two-week health report, received doctor's confirmation of improved blood pressure, and did preliminary research on the patent application process.

events.name: First time using the air conditioner in hot weather, found it not cooling.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the temperature in the living room at home rose to 32°C. Ye Mingxuan turned on the air conditioner for the first time, but found that the air blowing out was not cool at all. The outdoor unit hummed but never cooled. After checking that the remote control settings were correct, he concluded that it was probably a hardware failure.

events.name: Contacted home appliance repair and scheduled a home visit.
events.description: Ye Mingxuan found a highly rated home appliance repair shop nearby on his phone map, called to explain the malfunction. The technician preliminarily judged it might be a start capacitor issue and agreed to come over at 1 p.m.

events.name: The repairman replaced the air conditioner start capacitor
events.description: The repairman arrived on time, skillfully removed the outdoor unit cover, and after testing with a multimeter confirmed that the start capacitor had aged and failed. He took a new capacitor of the same model from his toolbox and replaced it. It took less than twenty minutes, and cold air came out immediately after testing.

events.name: Pay the repair fee and record it under the new maintenance category
events.description: After the repair was completed, Ye Mingxuan paid 300 yuan via WeChat (including the service visit fee and material cost) and asked for a receipt. In the afternoon, he added a first-level category called “Home Maintenance” to his Python ledger, recorded the expense, and reflected on the need to reserve a hidden maintenance budget. His mother proactively wrote down the repair details to help with the entry.

events.name: Organize father's two weeks of health data and communicate with the doctor.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan measured his father's blood pressure as 141/90 mmHg and weight as 78.0 kg. He generated a report from the two weeks of data and sent it to family doctor Liu Wentao via WeChat. Dr. Liu replied that the systolic blood pressure trend was good, encouraged him to continue exercising and eating low-salt food, and said no medication was needed for now. Ye Mingxuan relayed this to his parents, and the whole family was delighted.

events.name: Look up the utility model patent application process online.
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan searched online for the patent application process, costs, and timelines, and got a preliminary understanding of the requirements for utility model patents. He planned to consult with Sun Jing in detail next month before deciding whether to proceed.

events.name: In the evening, sat on the balcony with his father to enjoy the cool air and discussed home maintenance.
events.description: In the evening, the father and son sat on the balcony to enjoy the cool air. Drawing on his experience as a veteran technician, the father analyzed the cause of the air conditioner capacitor's aging and suggested a comprehensive inspection of the old house's plumbing and electrical systems before moving into the new house. Ye Mingxuan noted the key points and decided to arrange a full inspection in July.

start_state.mood: Feeling a bit irritable in the heat

end_state.mood: Relief after solving the problem, and satisfaction with the improvement in his father's health.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-06.daily_overview: End-of-month wrap-up day: After work, went to a personal training session first, then hurried to the new house to do the final ventilation and formaldehyde check, confirming it was safe. After dinner, demonstrated the 3D printing design process to his father; printing a small pendant took only 25 minutes, and his father became very interested. Summarized this month's diet and running data, planned July training, and updated the family health diary. At the end of the month, weight was 71.8 kg, same as the beginning of the month, but body fat percentage had dropped about 0.8%, and muscle mass had increased, laying a solid foundation for the second half of the year.

events.name: Evening personal training session (leg relaxation and core strengthening)
events.description: At 6 p.m., Ye Mingxuan went directly to Limei Fitness Center after work and completed the last personal training session of the month under the guidance of coach Wang Jian. The focus was on leg foam roller relaxation and core strength building to protect his body under the increased running volume. The session lasted 1.5 hours.

events.name: After the personal training session, completed the final ventilation and formaldehyde inspection of the new home
events.description: After the 7:30 personal training session ended, Ye Mingxuan rode his bike to the new apartment, performed the final full ventilation, and tested all the rooms. Master bedroom: 0.078 mg/m³; second bedroom: 0.075 mg/m³; living room: 0.080 mg/m³. All sampling points had been below the 0.10 standard for several consecutive days. He exported all the June monitoring data to an Excel file, marked it as “Move-in evaluation passed,” and planned to bring his parents for an official visit in early July.

events.name: After dinner, he gave his father a complete demonstration of the 3D printing design process.
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan opened Fusion 360 in his study. Starting from creating a sketch and extruding it into a solid, he designed a simple phone stand step by step, exported the STL, and imported it into slicing software to set parameters. His father put on his reading glasses, leaned in toward the screen, watched attentively, and asked questions from time to time. Ye Mingxuan started the 3D printer, and printing a small pendant took only about 25 minutes. His father picked up the warm finished piece and marveled at the fusion of technology and craftsmanship.

events.name: Father became very interested in 3D printing and wanted to learn design
events.description: During the printing process, Ye Mingxuan explained the principles of FDM and the characteristics of PLA, giving examples such as making furniture repair parts. His father excitedly said he wanted to learn and also wanted to design a fishing tackle storage box. Ye Mingxuan promised to first teach him basic sketching on the weekend. His father's eyes were full of anticipation.

events.name: Summarized dietary data from June 23-30 and compared trends over two weeks.
events.description: After training and returning home, Ye Mingxuan compiled the second week's diet records; his father's average daily salt intake was 4.7 grams. He merged the two weeks' data to generate a complete curve chart, which clearly showed stable salt control. The whole family confirmed that the low-salt, low-fat diet plan was effective and unanimously decided to stick with it long term.

events.name: Organize June running data and plan July training.
events.description: Ye Mingxuan retrieved the full-month data for June from his Python running log: cumulative running volume 80 kilometers, end-of-month weight 71.8 kg, the same as the 73.0 kg at the start of the month, but body fat percentage decreased by about 0.8% (19.8% at the start of the month), and muscle mass increased somewhat. Based on his plan, he set a July target of 85 kilometers, preset Wednesday interval runs and Saturday long-distance training in the fitness app, and reminded himself to aim for 18 kilometers at the end of the month.

events.name: Update the family health diary and back up all data.
events.description: Finally, Ye Mingxuan backed up his father's blood pressure, weight, salt intake, and his own exercise data to the cloud, and sent this month's health summary chart to the family group. His father replied with a thumbs-up, and his mother sent a clapping emoji.

start_state.mood: Feeling energetic and ready to wrap things up.

end_state.mood: Full of accomplishment and confident about the future.

events.name: Received the company's official salary adjustment notice; the promotion to Senior Mechanical Engineer took effect.

His monthly salary was officially adjusted to 13,800 yuan, confirming his promotion to Senior Mechanical Engineer effective immediately. He wrote down this milestone in his work notebook and mentally calculated how to replan his finances.

events.name: Write a Python script to build a forecasting model for the car-purchase special fund pool.
events.description: During the lunch break, Ye Mingxuan turned on his computer and wrote a Python script. He entered parameters such as a monthly forced transfer of 3,000 yuan, a current savings balance of 102000 yuan, and an expected wealth-management return rate of 3.2%, and built a forecast model for a dedicated car-purchase fund. The script projected that by August 2026, enough funds would accumulate for the down payment on a used four-wheel-drive SUV. He saved the script and named it car_fund_forecast.py.

events.name: Organized exam preparation notes and made an intensive review plan

He contacted the training class administrator via WeChat to confirm the registration deadline and required materials for the March 2026 exam session.

events.name: Share the good news of the promotion with parents
events.description: During dinner, Ye Mingxuan told his parents the news of his promotion to senior engineer. His father, Ye Jianguo, happily patted his shoulder and said he was going to buy a bottle of good wine to celebrate, while his mother, Wang Xiulan, specially made his favorite braised pork in addition. After the meal, the father and son chatted on the balcony about the new responsibilities and challenges at work; his father encouraged him with his own experience of mentoring apprentices at the machine tool factory back then.

start_state.mood: Expectant and a little sleepy; I went to bed a bit late last night because I was thinking about the promotion plan.

events.name: Scheduled recovery training at the gym and organized gear.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Ye Mingxuan reached the high point of his career: he independently led the first technical review meeting for outsourced parts, and his calm, steady performance won recognition from his superiors. Because the review meeting made him miss the lunchtime badminton game, he celebrated in the evening with colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang over dinner, then studied the PMP course after returning home.

events.name: Independently chaired the technical review meeting for the outsourced precision shaft project.
events.description: From 10 a.m. to 12 p.m., Ye Mingxuan chaired the technical review meeting for the outsourced precision shaft component project in the conference room. Facing six representatives from four suppliers, he calmly introduced the review criteria and agenda, guided the discussion, and confirmed key technical details one by one, including material selection, heat treatment process, and fit tolerances. Throughout the process, he kept referring to the comparison table and question list he had prepared in advance, and finally completed the review smoothly. Gao Zhiyuan sat nearby, nodding from time to time.

events.name: Organize the review records and produce preliminary selection recommendations.
events.description: After the review meeting, Ye Mingxuan returned to his workstation and, while his memory was still fresh, organized the suppliers' commitments and the issues still needing clarification into written minutes, and attached his preliminary selection recommendation — recommending the second supplier, which was best overall in quality and delivery time, while also requiring a supplemental fatigue life test report. He sent the document to Gao Zhiyuan, who replied: 'Clear thinking. Proceed with this.'

events.name: Had a brief exchange with Gao Zhiyuan and received encouragement.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to go to Gao Zhiyuan’s office to report his selection recommendations. Gao Zhiyuan read them carefully, then patted him on the shoulder and said, “Some people were worried that you were too young to command respect, but today you silenced them all—you’re like a senior engineer now.” Ye Mingxuan felt an indescribable sense of professional pride swelling in his heart.

events.name: Dinner with colleagues to celebrate the successful review.
events.description: After work in the evening, Ye Mingxuan had dinner with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang at a small restaurant near the company. He proactively confirmed with the waiter that the dishes contained no seafood and asked the chef to use less oil and salt. The three chatted about the details of the review meeting; Zhou Tao joked that Engineer Ye had become famous in one battle, while Li Xiang asked a few technical questions. The meal ended in a relaxed atmosphere, and Ye Mingxuan paid the bill and recorded the expense.

events.name: Study Chapter 2 of the PMP knowledge system in the evening
events.description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan rested briefly, then sat down at his desk, opened the PMBOK Guide, and studied Chapter 2, Project Operating Environment. He used a highlighter to mark the difference between Enterprise Environmental Factors and Organizational Process Assets, and organized a mind map in his notebook. He planned to keep studying every day to build a solid foundation for the exam next March.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but well prepared, like going into an exam room.

end_state.mood: Extremely proud, professional confidence greatly boosted.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise; used a lot of mental focus

2025-12.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Ye Mingxuan balanced work and family: during the day he handled follow-up matters from the review meeting and discussed with his parents about starting a low-oil, low-salt family diet plan because of his father's high blood pressure; in the evening he kept up his usual workout and began studying PMP course materials. In the morning, because of the low temperature, he replaced his morning run with indoor training.

events.name: Follow up on supplier feedback and improve project documentation.
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan formally sent the review meeting minutes to the selected supplier, requiring it to submit a supplementary report within one week. He then updated the project technical documents and archived the review process and decision rationale. When project manager Wang Peng ran into him in the hallway, he specifically mentioned Gao Zhiyuan's recognition of Ye Mingxuan and encouraged him to keep working hard.

events.name: Discussed implementing a low-oil, low-salt diet plan with parents
events.description: During dinner, based on the recent blood pressure readings that showed his father's blood pressure was on the high side, Ye Mingxuan formally proposed adjusting the family's diet structure to his parents. He took out his phone and showed some healthy eating information, and discussed it with his parents, Ye Jianguo and Wang Xiulan. They decided to start low-oil, low-salt cooking from this week. It was agreed that his mother would be the main cook but would use an oil-control spoon, Ye Mingxuan would be responsible for planning the menu and weekend shopping, and his father would be responsible for reminding them to take after-meal walks. Although his father found it troublesome, he agreed to cooperate.

events.name: Continue muscle-building training at the gym in the evening.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan continued his three-times-a-week fitness plan. Under the guidance of coach Wang Jian, he completed strength training exercises such as squats, bench press, and dumbbell rows, followed by 30 minutes on the elliptical trainer. During the workout, he felt that his strength had improved slightly compared to last week—he did two more reps on his last set of bench press—and he excitedly recorded it in his training log.

events.name: Early morning indoor core training.
events.description: In the morning, because the temperature was below -3°C, Ye Mingxuan followed the winter exercise support plan and did 20 minutes of core and stretching training in the living room, including alternating supine leg raises, side bridges, and planks, and did some leg stretches to stay active.

start_state.mood: Concerned about family health, slightly worried

end_state.mood: Fulfilling: family health and personal growth are both moving forward.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Thursday, amid his busy work, Ye Mingxuan carefully prepared a week-long healthy menu with low oil and low salt for his family, balancing nutrition and family preferences. In the evening, he helped Zhao Xiaofeng analyze a technical problem, and also had a gentle conversation with his mother because she still wasn't used to the light flavors, finally reaching an agreement.

events.name: Draw engineering drawings for the new fixture assembly and submit for review.
events.description: In the morning, based on the plan approved in last week's review, Ye Mingxuan used SolidWorks to complete a detailed engineering drawing for the new fixture assembly, specifically labeling the key welding symbols and inspection datums. After self-checking, he submitted the drawing to the PLM system and waited for standardization review.

events.name: Look up nutrition materials and create a one-week healthy menu
events.description: During the lunch break, Ye Mingxuan looked up the Chinese Dietary Guidelines and low-oil, low-salt recipe websites on his computer, used Excel to create a weekly menu covering whole wheat bread, chicken breast, steamed bass, blanched greens, mixed grain rice, and other dishes, and calculated approximate calories and sodium content. He printed it out and took it home.

events.name: Talked with his mother about adapting to a light diet
events.description: During dinner, his mother Wang Xiulan complained that the dishes had been too bland for two consecutive days. Ye Mingxuan patiently explained the importance of blood pressure management and suggested adding a moderate amount of vinegar, lemon juice, or herbs to enhance the flavor, while promising to have braised pork once a week to satisfy cravings. His mother finally smiled and agreed to try for another week.

events.name: Discuss technical issues with college classmate Zhao Xiaofeng via WeChat
events.description: In the evening, college classmate Zhao Xiaofeng sent a schematic diagram of an automobile door lock mechanism on WeChat, asking him to help verify the spring force calculation. Ye Mingxuan opened a calculator, applied the formula, and worked through it step by step. He found the original design value was too large and suggested reducing the wire diameter. Zhao Xiaofeng thanked him repeatedly and said he would treat him to hotpot another day.

start_state.mood: Positive, ready to solve practical problems.

end_state.mood: Satisfied; both family and friendships have been maintained.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast, scattered light snow in the afternoon, north wind level 3, temperature -2°C to 2°C.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Friday, after finishing his regular work and workout, Ye Mingxuan took a detour to buy healthy ingredients. In the evening, he video-chatted with an old classmate, sharing progress in their respective fields and encouraging each other. He slipped on the icy pavement while walking, apples rolled out of the shopping bag, and he later took the bus back.

events.name: Handled the technical replies for outsourced parts and communicated with the supplier by phone.
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan received a supplementary technical explanation email from the supplier selected at yesterday's review meeting. He read it carefully and annotated it with a red pen, then called the supplier's technical supervisor to clarify misunderstandings about two dimensional tolerances, and asked him to submit a revised drawing according to the new requirements.

events.name: Video call with Liu Yang and Sun Jing to discuss industry trends.
events.description: Before leaving work, Ye Mingxuan initiated a video chat with Liu Yang and Sun Jing in the WeChat group. Sun Jing shared a new project management methodology she had heard at an industrial internet conference in Beijing, while Liu Yang showed the embedded control module their team had recently developed. Ye Mingxuan also talked about his experience chairing a review meeting for the first time. Sun Jing teased, "From now on, we'll call you Engineer Ye." The three encouraged each other and ended the call.

events.name: Go to Limei Fitness Center for muscle-building training
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan walked into Limei Fitness Center amid scattered light snow. Today's training intensity was slightly increased; he completed 4 sets each of squats, bench press, and barbell rows, and tried a new exercise—lunges. Then he did 30 minutes of elliptical cardio. After training, he felt muscle soreness but refreshed.

events.name: Purchased healthy ingredients according to the homemade menu.
events.description: After finishing his workout, Ye Mingxuan did not go straight home. Instead, he walked to a nearby large supermarket and vegetable market. Following the printed weekly menu, he bought whole-wheat bread, skinless chicken breast, broccoli, fresh sea bass, apples, oatmeal, and other ingredients, and specifically selected a graduated oil-control jug and a salt-limiting spoon. On the way, because of thin ice on the road, he accidentally slipped and fell. One apple rolled out of a shopping bag. He picked it up and continued on. After finishing the shopping, he took a bus back home.

start_state.mood: The weather is cold, but I feel warm inside. Looking forward to the weekend.

end_state.mood: Pleasant and fulfilled; the friend's encouragement and family actions were both inspiring.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ye Mingxuan completed an 8 km tempo run in light snow in the morning, with a pace of 5:50 per kilometer. Then he went to Master Qian's Woodworking Workshop to learn traditional mortise-and-tenon joinery. In the afternoon, he stayed home writing a small ancient-coin management program. In the evening, he met up with his childhood friend Zhang Wei for barbecue and relaxed. After the run, his phone got damp and briefly malfunctioned, but he recovered it with a hairdryer.

events.name: 8km morning tempo run
events.description: At 7 a.m., despite light snow, Ye Mingxuan did the tempo run as planned. He put on a windbreaker and completed 8 kilometers on the trail at an average pace of 5:50 per kilometer. The first 4 kilometers were steady at 5:45, with a slight slowdown in the latter part but overall intensity was on target. After the run, he quickly returned home, changed out of his wet clothes, and used a hair dryer to save his damp phone.

events.name: Went to Master Qian Jianguo's workshop to learn woodworking.
events.description: At 10 a.m., after the snow stopped, Ye Mingxuan took the bus to Master Qian Jianguo's workshop on the first floor of an old residential community. Master Qian taught him to make a traditional dovetail wooden box today, guiding him hands-on through marking lines, sawing tenons, and chiseling mortises. Ye Mingxuan calmed down and worked slowly. Although the tenon was still a little tight, the box finally came together smoothly. Master Qian said approvingly, “Your hands are accurate now; a few more practice sessions and you'll be ready to graduate.”

events.name: Write a simple ancient coin collection management program in Python.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan sat at his desk at home, turned on his computer, and used Python and SQLite to write a simple ancient coin collection management program that could enter coin type, year, condition, and purchase price, and filter by dynasty or province. He imported the Republican-era machine-struck coin data he had previously organized to test it. Looking at the neat list, he felt a strong sense of accomplishment. He took a screenshot and sent it to his collector friend Zhao Jianguo in Xi'an, who praised it, saying, "It's better than my Excel."

events.name: Had a dinner gathering with childhood friend Zhang Wei at a barbecue restaurant near the community
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan met his childhood friend Zhang Wei at a barbecue restaurant near the neighborhood. The two ordered lamb skewers, grilled chicken wings, and grilled bun slices. Ye Mingxuan specially asked for a cup of warm water (in order to follow his low-oil, low-salt principle, he tried not to eat anything too salty). They chatted about cars, games, and daily life trivia. Zhang Wei said he was recently thinking about switching to a new energy vehicle company, and Ye Mingxuan helped him analyze the pros and cons. Their friendship continued in the warm, lively atmosphere.

start_state.mood: Anning, snowy days are good for tempo runs and handicrafts.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and relaxing, skills improving, friendships warm

2025-12.daily_overview: Sunday was packed: in the morning, Ye Mingxuan screened travel insurance for next year's road trip; at midday, he attended a family gathering and calmly faced questions about marriage; in the afternoon, he had a deep talk with his father on the balcony and reached mutual understanding; in the evening, he cooked a healthy dinner himself. It was a gentle upgrade of family relationships. While trying a new dish in the kitchen, the oil got too hot and smoked, triggering the smoke alarm—a false alarm.

events.name: Compared multiple travel accident insurance plans and selected one.
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan opened the insurance channel on Alipay and compared annual travel accident insurance from three companies: Allianz, Ping An, and Pacific Insurance. He focused on coverage amount, whether it covered self-driving and high-risk activities (such as high-altitude hiking), emergency rescue services, and other terms, and finally chose a comprehensive accident insurance with a coverage amount of 500,000 yuan and an annual premium of 380 yuan. The coverage included self-driving and high-altitude activities up to 5,000 meters, perfectly matching his self-driving travel needs in Qinghai.

events.name: Family gathering with relatives and friends, and calmly responding to marriage pressure.
events.description: At noon, family relatives gathered for a meal at Jinweixuan Restaurant. During the meal, several elders again asked about Ye Mingxuan's marriage prospects. His aunt joked, 'If you wait any longer, you'll be thirty.' This time, instead of avoiding the topic or getting irritated as in previous years, he put down his chopsticks and said calmly, 'I want to improve myself first; fate can't be rushed. I want to be more mature financially and mentally before I can be responsible to my future partner.' Seeing his sincerity, the elders stopped pressing him.

events.name: Reached consensus on views of marriage and relationships during a deep conversation with his father on the balcony.
events.description: After the meal, they returned home, and Ye Mingxuan and his father Ye Jianguo tacitly went to the balcony. In the winter afternoon sunlight, he candidly shared his thoughts: he wanted to first take his income to the next level, realize his dream of self-driving travel, save up for a down payment, and then seriously consider marriage—he didn't want to get married just for the sake of marriage. His father looked into the distance, shared how he too had married late in his youth because of his career, and nodded, saying, "Just make up your mind. It's good to be steady. Dad supports you." When they went back to the living room, his mother Wang Xiulan still grumbled a little, but her eyes already showed understanding and a smile. The family had reached a new understanding amid the pressure to get married.

events.name: Balcony reading time and continued sharing with my father
events.description: In the evening, father and son returned to the balcony bathed in the afterglow of sunset. His father had already finished reading that historical novel and was now browsing a new collection of storytelling scripts, while Ye Mingxuan continued reading the professional manual from last week. His father enthusiastically talked about the Chu-Han Contention he had just read, and Ye Mingxuan listened with interest, occasionally adding his own insights. This reading time together had become their most cherished family ritual.

events.name: Personally cook a healthy dinner that is low in oil and low in salt
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan put on an apron and went into the kitchen. Following the menu he had planned, he steamed a sea bass, blanched broccoli and wood ear mushrooms, pan-fried chicken breast slices with onions using less oil, and also cooked a pot of multigrain rice. Before serving, he strictly controlled the seasonings with a salt-control spoon. While trying to pan-fry the chicken breast, the oil was too hot and produced smoke, setting off the kitchen smoke alarm. His mother hurried over and turned off the alarm, saying with a smile, “Next time, lower the heat.” Everyone chatted and laughed at the table, and his father took several helpings with his chopsticks, showing that he accepted the new flavors.

start_state.mood: Calm, ready to handle various topics at the dinner gathering

end_state.mood: Relieved and warm, the family relationship was gently recalibrated.

events.name: Book annual physical exam at the community hospital

events.name: Pay online and activate annual travel accident insurance

The electronic policy was then sent to his email, with coverage from January 1 to December 31, 2026. He carefully checked his personal information and the insurance terms to make sure everything was correct.

events.name: Archive the electronic insurance policy and record it in the road trip preparation notes.

As he closed the notebook, he felt one step closer to Qinghai Lake.

events.name: Dined with colleagues Li Xiang and Zhou Tao and checked dietary risks.

The three chatted about their project progress, and Ye Mingxuan shared his experience chairing the review meeting. After dinner, on his way home, he used his phone to record this expense in the family income and expenditure script.

events.name: Did winter muscle-building training at the gym.

Under the guidance of coach Wang Jian, he completed his first full training session of the week: 4 sets of squats, 4 sets of bench press, 4 sets of barbell rows, and 30 minutes of elliptical cardio. After training, he measured his body fat percentage and saw a slight decrease. Coach Wang encouraged him, saying that if he kept it up, he could reach his goal before the Spring Festival.

2025-12.daily_overview: On a workday Tuesday, Ye Mingxuan took a half day off to receive community staff at home and formally accepted the letter of appointment as an instructor for the intangible cultural heritage handicraft course. It was a key day for his woodworking hobby to extend into a social role. In the morning he weighed himself and found he was 0.2 kg lighter than yesterday, which lifted his mood. His phone call with Master Qian steered his woodworking path toward a new direction where restoration skills and commercial value go hand in hand. In the evening, he returned to his regular work rhythm with excitement, and was too excited to fall asleep before bed.

events.name: Received community staff and accepted the appointment letter as a lecturer for the intangible cultural heritage course
events.description: At 10 a.m., two staff members from the Xiqing District Community Center came to Ye Mingxuan's home on Zhongbei Avenue as scheduled, officially handed him the appointment letter for the spring 2026 intangible cultural heritage handicraft course instructor, and verbally invited him to help prepare the parent-child lantern-making experience activity at the New Year's Day Lantern Festival. After accepting the letter, Ye Mingxuan read the terms one by one, asked in detail about class frequency, student age groups, venue and equipment, and after a brief pause solemnly accepted the invitation and agreed on the spot to take part in preparing the New Year's Day Lantern Festival. His ISTJ personality showed fully here - everything had to be clear and actionable.

events.name: Called carpenter Qian Jianguo to share the good news and discuss future directions.
events.description: After the community staff left, Ye Mingxuan could hardly contain his excitement and immediately called his carpentry master, Qian Jianguo. He described in detail how he had been hired as a lecturer for an intangible cultural heritage course and invited to help prepare for the New Year's Day lantern fair. On the other end of the phone, Master Qian first offered hearty congratulations, then changed the subject and suggested taking him to the Tianjin antique furniture market after the New Year to see traditional restoration craftsmanship firsthand. He also advised that in the future he could try taking on some small private restoration jobs, combining the inheritance of craftsmanship with commercial value. Drawing on his instincts as an old craftsman, Master Qian pointed out that with his new status as a lecturer and his lathe equipment, he could easily teach while repairing.

events.name: Respond to Master Qian's suggestion and think about curriculum integration.
events.description: Ye Mingxuan was very interested in Master Qian's suggestion and immediately said that the idea of going to the antique furniture market together after the New Year was excellent. The two initially agreed on the phone to choose a day to go together after the weather warms up in early spring. After hanging up, Ye Mingxuan jotted down the key points of Master Qian's advice in a work notebook in his study and began to think about how to incorporate furniture restoration cases and techniques into future intangible cultural heritage handicraft courses, so that the teaching would include both traditional mortise-and-tenon knowledge and hands-on restoration demonstrations, adding depth and appeal to the course.

events.name: Browsing web pages to find a wood supplier for teaching.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan searched online in his study for local lumber markets and online suppliers, comparing prices and availability of boxwood and pine from several companies, doing preliminary research for upcoming course materials, and listing contact information and quotes from three potential suppliers in his notebook.

start_state.mood: Calm and expectant, because he knew in advance that community staff were coming.

events.name: Apply to the company for compensatory leave on the lathe installation day.
