His direct supervisor Gao Zhiyuan quickly approved it online and casually asked what equipment needed leave. Ye Mingxuan smiled and explained it was a small woodworking lathe. Gao Zhiyuan looked surprised and asked, You know how to do this?

events.name: Handled minor technical issues at work
events.description: At 10 a.m., Zhou Tao came over with a drawing, saying that a fastener's tolerance did not match the mating part. After careful inspection, Ye Mingxuan found that it was caused by the new supplier's different labeling conventions. He quickly contacted the supplier's engineer to confirm and resolved the issue within half an hour, avoiding a project delay.

events.name: Noon: reviewed PMP materials and sorted out incorrect questions
events.description: During the lunch break, Ye Mingxuan took out his PMP exam prep materials in the office, organized and reviewed the incorrect questions from previous mock tests, focused on the risk management chapter, highlighted key concepts with a marker, and wrote analyses in his mistake notebook. He plans to pass the PMP certification before the Spring Festival, so he insists on spending 30 minutes every midday reviewing.

events.name: Carry out Wednesday evening fitness training.
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan went to Limei Fitness Center as arranged and, under the guidance of coach Wang Jian, completed machine training including squats, bench press, and rows, followed by 30 minutes of elliptical aerobic exercise. This was one of his three fixed training sessions per week. He consistently recorded the weight and reps for each set, sent the data to Wang Jian via WeChat after the session, and briefly mentioned that his shoulders had felt a bit tight recently. The coach replied that he would add rotator cuff warm-up exercises before the next session.

events.name: Compiled the family's annual health data and made a summary report.
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan turned on his computer and consolidated the annual physical exam reports, blood pressure monitoring records, sleep logs, and several medical visit records from this year that he had collected in advance for himself, his father Ye Jianguo, and his mother Wang Xiulan into an Excel spreadsheet, checking data completeness item by item. Based on the consolidated data, he used PPT to create an illustrated family annual health summary, including a line chart of his father's blood pressure trends, his mother's ankle rehabilitation milestones, a comparison of his own BMI dropping from 25.06 to 24.5, LDL returning to normal, improved sleep quality, and only 2 colds throughout the year. It also included records of dietary improvements, marking the time points of the low-oil and low-salt plan and the family's blood pressure response curves.

events.name: Shared annual health results with parents and coach in the evening
events.description: Ye Mingxuan cast the health summary report to the living room TV, invited his parents to review it together, and sent it to personal trainer Wang Jian via WeChat. His father, Ye Jianguo, nodded repeatedly when he saw his blood pressure line chart gradually drop from the dangerous range at the beginning of the year to normal values; his mother, seeing her ankle recovery made into a milestone chart, smiled and said he had drawn her like a project schedule. Wang Jian replied with praise for the health improvements of Ye Mingxuan's whole family, saying it was the most hardcore client health annual report he had ever seen. The whole family watched and chatted, satisfied with the year's health results, and the data visualization further strengthened their awareness of health management.

start_state.mood: Calm; proceeding with today's tasks as planned.

2025-12.daily_overview: Thursday was a day worth marking—the small woodworking lathe bought online arrived and was installed amid the whole family's anticipation, marking that Ye Mingxuan's woodworking ability had officially moved from the pure handcraft era to the era of precision machining. In the afternoon, the annual physical examination brought good news; the improvement in health indicators was deeply gratifying to the whole family. The moment in the evening when he turned the first round rod out of scrap wood became a warm milestone in family memory. Due to the nervousness of the physical exam and physical exertion, his weight had dropped noticeably.

events.name: The lathe was delivered to the home, and the whole family worked together to move it to the garage.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the logistics company's truck stopped punctually in front of Ye Mingxuan's house, unloading a heavy wooden crate—the SIEG C2 small woodworking lathe had finally arrived. Ye Jianguo was already waiting at the door, and Wang Xiulan also set down her work to come out and help. The three of them worked together to carefully move the wooden crate to the semi-open garage workspace on the first floor.

events.name: Father led the fixing and leveling of the machine base
events.description: After unboxing, Ye Jianguo rolled up his sleeves without a word, took out his own spirit level and a set of wrenches, and took the lead in the installation using his years of machine tool operation experience at Tianjin No. 1 Machine Tool Plant. He fixed the lathe base to the workbench that had been reinforced in advance, repeatedly calibrated the four corners with the spirit level, and only nodded in satisfaction after shimming it twice with copper sheets: it was level. During the process, Ye Mingxuan watched carefully from the side, occasionally lending a hand.

events.name: Mother helped pass tools and clean up the work area
events.description: Wang Xiulan was present throughout the installation, handing over tools such as wrenches, screwdrivers, and rags, and from time to time using a broom to clean up the sawdust and packaging waste from unpacking and installation. While working, she kept muttering that this thing would take up quite a large space, but she had a smile on her face, because she knew it was the big-ticket item her son had been longing for.

events.name: Ye Mingxuan completed the electrical wiring and no-load test run.
events.description: After the stand base was secured, Ye Mingxuan took over the electrical part—connecting the power lines, checking the motor terminals and control system, and ensuring reliable grounding. After powering on, he first ran the motor unloaded for about five minutes, listening closely for any abnormal sounds and feeling the bearing area by hand for abnormal heat. After confirming everything was normal, he announced: installation successful.

events.name: Go to the community health service center for the annual physical examination.
events.description: At 2:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan went to the Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center as scheduled and met his family doctor, Liu Wentao. Dr. Liu first checked the expiration date of the epinephrine pen he carried, confirmed proper usage, and updated the allergy history in his medical record. He then completed routine checks such as height, weight, blood pressure, and complete blood count. While the nurse drew blood, they chatted a bit about precautions for blood vessel constriction in winter. Because he was nervous and fasting, he felt a little dizzy after the blood draw, and the nurse gave him a cup of sugar water.

events.name: Physical examination results confirm improvement in health indicators.
events.description: The physical examination results showed: BMI dropped from 25.06 at the beginning of the year to 24.5, LDL cholesterol returned to normal levels, and blood pressure was stable. Dr. Liu affirmed his strict dietary management and told him to continue maintaining a low-oil, low-salt diet. Ye Mingxuan carefully recorded the data on his phone, planning to go back and update the family health record.

events.name: Fine-tune the lathe and prepare test-run materials
events.description: Around 4 p.m. after returning from the hospital, Ye Mingxuan and his father continued fine-tuning the lathe — checking belt tension, oiling the guide rails, and adjusting the tailstock centering accuracy. He picked out several leftover pine scraps from the woodworking scrap pile, in various sizes, suitable for practice turning.

events.name: The first round rod was successfully turned out, a memorable moment for the whole family.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan started the lathe and focused intently on turning a piece of scrap pine wood. A few minutes later, a smooth cylindrical wooden rod took shape under the blade—this was his first workpiece made on his own lathe. Wang Xiulan clapped and cheered: “It's done!” Ye Jianguo captured the moment with his phone and sent it to a WeChat group of a few old workmates, with a note saying that his son had installed his own lathe at home. Though the rod was small, it carried a sense of family ritual—the whole family had worked together to achieve a small technological milestone.

events.name: Enter the physical examination results into the family health record.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan entered the day's physical examination results and the updated allergy response procedure into the family health archive on his computer, replacing the data for himself in the annual report made on December 17. He also noted in the remarks that the epinephrine pen is valid until June 2026, and set a replacement reminder one month in advance.

events.name: Confirm the three-day year-end dinner arrangements
events.description: Before going to sleep, Ye Mingxuan contacted via WeChat his childhood friend Zhang Wei, college classmates Zhao Xiaofeng and Sun Jing, colleague Zhou Tao, and others, and finally settled the specific arrangements for three year-end dinners: Saturday evening, December 20, with Zhang Wei at the Old Place Mutton Hot Pot Restaurant; Sunday evening, December 21, a small college gathering with Sun Jing and others; and Monday evening, December 22, a dinner with colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang. He entered the times and places of the three dinners into his phone calendar.

start_state.mood: Excited and nervous; the lathe arrives today and there is a physical examination scheduled.

end_state.mood: Extremely satisfied: the lathe was installed successfully, and the physical exam results are encouraging.

state.daily_exercise: The day was mainly physical activity, with no dedicated training.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast, northwest wind force 3 to 4, temperature -4°C to 2°C

2025-12.daily_overview: On Friday, after-work time was filled with a ceremonial sense of father-son inheritance. Ye Jianguo formally taught the core techniques of lathe operation, condensing his decades of experience in the machine tool factory into a few key movements and one ironclad maintenance rule. Ye Mingxuan, under his father's guidance, turned a small wooden spinning top as a thank-you gift, and the two established a monthly routine of maintaining the lathe together. In the evening, the online get-together with Liu Yang and Sun Jing extended from technical discussion to project management perspectives, showing the diverse value of his social circle. At noon, received the sharpening stone purchased online, preparing for lathe tool maintenance.

events.name: Received the package for the sharpening stone purchased online.
events.description: At noon, the courier delivered a small package: the fine oil stone and knife sharpening guide that Ye Mingxuan had bought online a few days ago for use with the new lathe. He opened it, checked the contents, and put them into the toolbox, planning to ask Master Qian for knife sharpening tips over the weekend.

events.name: After work, clean the lathe area for inspection.
events.description: After getting off work at 6 p.m. and arriving home, Ye Mingxuan first went to the garage work area, thoroughly cleaned up the packaging residue around the newly installed lathe, prepared inspection tools such as wrenches, an oil can, and clean cloths, and turned on the heater to slightly raise the temperature in the work area, waiting for his father to arrive after work to conduct a safety inspection and operational guidance.

events.name: Father thoroughly inspected all parts of the lathe.
events.description: After getting off work, Ye Jianguo went to the garage and carefully conducted a full inspection of the lathe: whether the guide rails were smooth, whether the lead screw was loose, how the chuck's concentricity was, and whether the motor sounded normal. As he inspected, he muttered the key points of inspection, just like when he mentored apprentices back in the day. After confirming everything was firmly installed and running properly, he said with satisfaction, "The machine is good. Now it depends on the operator's skill."

events.name: Father demonstrated the core operating techniques and explained the key points.
events.description: Ye Jianguo gave a hands-on demonstration at the machine, focusing on the correct clamping force of the chuck when securing the workpiece—too tight will damage the wood, too loose and it will fly out—and the key points of controlling the feed handwheel speed: the tool must be steady, the hand gentle, and the mind calm. Drawing on his experience as a senior technician at the former Tianjin No. 1 Machine Tool Plant, he explained many practical details, such as the differences in cutting speed for different woods and how to judge the feed force based on the cutting sound. Ye Mingxuan listened attentively and jotted down key points in his notebook.

events.name: Under his father's guidance, he turned a small wooden spinning top as a thank-you gift.
events.description: After the explanation, under his father's watchful gaze, Ye Mingxuan picked a piece of scrap oak and, using the technique he had just learned, turned a small wooden spinning top—narrow at the top, wider at the bottom, with a pointed tip and smooth lines. He handed the top to his father and said, "Dad, this was made with the technique you taught me. It's for you." Ye Jianguo took the top, gave it a spin in his hand, and showed a rare smile: "Steady hands, not bad." Father and son had completed a silent transfer of skill and an emotional connection.

events.name: Father and son agreed to maintain the machine tool together every month.
events.description: As the activity was drawing to a close, Ye Jianguo earnestly reminded about maintenance points such as daily lubrication, regular removal of metal chips, and belt inspection, and proposed a monthly systematic maintenance of the lathe together. Ye Mingxuan immediately agreed and wrote in his notebook the suggestion of the second Saturday afternoon of each month as the monthly maintenance day, listing it as a fixed family activity. This agreement not only ensured equipment maintenance, but also added an institutionalized inheritance ritual to the father-son relationship.

events.name: Organizing notes and cleaning the work area
events.description: After the father and son finished talking, Ye Mingxuan organized the operating tips and maintenance checklist his father had taught him into a complete electronic note, marking key steps and safety reminders. Then he put all the tools back in place, used a vacuum cleaner to clean the wood shavings around the lathe, and made sure the garage was tidy.

events.name: Online meetup with Liu Yang and Sun Jing to discuss technical challenges
events.description: Around 9 p.m. Friday, Ye Mingxuan started an online gaming session with his college roommate Liu Yang as planned. After a few rounds, his college classmate Sun Jing also joined the voice channel. As they chatted, the topic turned to a mechanical design optimization problem Ye Mingxuan had encountered at work recently—a weight reduction solution for a transmission component had been stuck for two days. Liu Yang, from his embedded software perspective, suggested using a topology optimization approach to reshape the structure, while Sun Jing, from a project management viewpoint, reminded him to first clarify the client's tolerance boundary for weight before optimizing. The three discussed it in the voice channel for nearly forty minutes. Ye Mingxuan benefited a lot and wrote down the key points of their suggestions.

events.name: Do a brief core workout at home
events.description: Before the online gathering began, Ye Mingxuan followed the adjusted plan and did 20 minutes of home core training at home, including planks, alternating supine leg raises, and glute bridges. After the workout, he briefly recorded his completion status and sent feedback to Coach Wang Jian. The coach reminded him to also watch his diet on the weekend and not let the dinner disrupt the plan.

start_state.mood: Calm, looking forward to my father's evening guidance

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and warm; the deep father-son exchange gave the lathe a soul.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of core training at home (plank, alternating supine leg raises, glute bridge).

2025-12.daily_overview: On the Saturday rest day, I practiced lathe work at home in the morning and got a wood splinter in my finger. In the afternoon, I went to the gym for a weekend makeup training session. In the evening, I had dinner with my childhood friend Zhang Wei at the Laodifang Shuanrou Restaurant. Li Na, far away in Shenzhen, mailed a hand-drawn Qinghai route postcard.

events.name: On the weekend morning, while cleaning up the lathe and practicing trial runs, my finger was scratched by a wood splinter.
events.description: With no schedule on Saturday morning, Ye Mingxuan practiced lathe operation alone in the garage. Using a few scraps of material, he practiced the chuck clamping and tool feed techniques his father had taught him the day before, turning several cylinders of different sizes. While handling a piece of wood with burrs, his left index finger was pricked by a fine wood splinter. He immediately removed it with tweezers, disinfected the spot, and applied a band-aid, reminding himself to develop the habit of sanding rough stock in the future.

events.name: Afternoon gym visit for weekend make-up training
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ye Mingxuan went to his usual gym and did a weekend makeup training session under the guidance of coach Wang Jian. The training included 4 sets of squats, 4 sets of bench presses, 4 sets of barbell rows, and 30 minutes of elliptical aerobic exercise. After training, he felt physically fulfilled and built up energy for the self-driving trip.

events.name: Dinner with childhood friend Zhang Wei at the usual hot pot restaurant
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan and Zhang Wei met at their usual instant-boiled mutton restaurant in Xiqing District. A steaming copper hot pot was brought to the table, and the two chatted while cooking meat. Ye Mingxuan opened his phone album and showed photos of the three family members installing the lathe after it arrived, as well as the first round rod and the small wooden spinning top he had turned under his father's guidance. Zhang Wei was amazed: 'You've really upgraded—from a handmade workshop to precision machining!' The two talked about Ye Mingxuan's woodworking, Zhang Wei's recent car sales performance, and plans for next year's road trip. The atmosphere was relaxed and lively, and Ye Mingxuan ate a bit more lamb.

events.name: Li Na mailed the Qinghai road trip postcard from Shenzhen.
events.description: In Shenzhen on the same day, her friend Li Na, in the apartment she rented, put the hand-drawn Qinghai route guide postcard completed the previous night into an envelope. This is a hand-drawn map carefully outlining the route around Qinghai Lake and key landmarks. On the back, she wrote in neat handwriting that if UI design was needed, she would provide support for free. She walked to the nearby post office and mailed the postcard to Ye Mingxuan's home address in Tianjin. A postcard carrying twenty years of childhood friendship and current professional support is on its way.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, no work pressure on the weekend.

end_state.mood: Pleasant. Dinner with a childhood friend was relaxing.

state.daily_exercise: Afternoon make-up gym session: 4 sets of squats, 4 sets of bench press, 4 sets of barbell rows, 30 minutes on the elliptical.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, light breeze, temperature -2°C to 5°C

2025-12.daily_overview: On Sunday, the day had a well-balanced rhythm — during the day he cooked to continue promoting healthy family eating, and in the evening a balcony reading debate with his father sparked lively arguments, showing a new level of intergenerational communication. Afterwards he hurried off to the year-end gathering of college classmates, where Ye Mingxuan recounted in detail how he had independently designed a mechanical component and passed acceptance this year, becoming the focus of the evening's conversation. He openly shared the details of technical problem-solving in front of friends, displaying the confidence that comes with being a senior engineer. In the afternoon, when helping his mother pickle vegetables, he deliberately reduced the amount of salt, showing how his health philosophy had permeated every corner.

events.name: On Sunday, cook and continue following a low-oil, low-salt diet.
events.description: At noon, Ye Mingxuan put on an apron again and cooked two dishes: chicken breast stir-fried with vegetables and tomato egg soup. He used a small amount of olive oil instead of the traditional lard stir-frying method, and cooked a pot of rice alongside. While cooking, he reminded his mother, who was helping, to reduce the frequency of preserved foods, and suggested that pickled vegetables only be served once or twice a week at the table. His parents had gradually adapted to the low-oil, low-salt taste. His father, Ye Jianguo, picked up a piece of chicken and said, 'Actually, a lighter taste is not bad. After eating, it doesn't feel greasy, and the body does feel lighter.'

events.name: Helped Mom pickle potherb mustard with light salt.
events.description: After the meal, his mother Wang Xiulan wanted to pickle a small jar of mustard greens. Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to help wash and dry the vegetables, insisting on using only half the usual amount of salt, and adding Sichuan peppercorns and chili peppers for flavor. Mother and son pressed the vegetables down and sealed the jar together. His mother joked: 'This might be the mildest pickled vegetable in our family's history.'

events.name: Reading on the balcony and debating historical perspectives with Father
events.description: Reading on the balcony after dinner has been a fixed habit between father and son for the past two months. Tonight the two read different chapters of the same history book, and their views clashed on how to evaluate one historical event — the father tended to understand it from a traditional perspective, while Ye Mingxuan introduced an alternative analytical framework from the book. The debate lasted about twenty minutes. Although each held his own ground, the tone remained rational and respectful throughout, and both sides ultimately gained something. This debate marked a significant improvement in the quality of intergenerational communication between father and son: it went from one speaking and the other listening to an equal exchange of ideas.

events.name: Year-end dinner with college classmates, recounting personal technical problem-solving experiences.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan had dinner with Zhao Xiaofeng, Sun Jing, and two other university classmates in Tianjin at a Chinese restaurant in Nankai District, Tianjin. During the meal, Sun Jing took on the roles of ordering dishes and keeping the atmosphere lively. After a few rounds of drinks, the conversation turned to everyone's work achievements this year, and Ye Mingxuan was chosen to share. He described in detail the entire process of independently designing a mechanical component for the first time this year—a precision transmission assembly—and successfully passing acceptance: from the initial design proposal being questioned, to repeatedly performing finite element analysis and optimization, to the final sample passing the test on the first try. His account was logically rigorous and the data clear; his classmates listened intently, and Zhao Xiaofeng led the applause. This sharing made Ye Mingxuan clearly feel his transformation from an executor to a technical decision-maker.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, the leisurely feeling of a Sunday morning.

end_state.mood: Content and confident; sharing career achievements with friends brought a sense of recognition.

state.daily_exercise: No specialized training was conducted

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to light snow, temperature -5°C to 0°C

2025-12.daily_overview: On Monday, the first light snow of the winter fell in the afternoon. In the morning, he completed his work tasks efficiently; in the afternoon, he took compensatory leave and took a bus to the lumber market to buy boxwood, preparing materials for the subsequent batch production of lantern connectors and teaching models. In the evening, he did comprehensive maintenance on the lathe. At the evening gathering with colleagues, he unexpectedly became the center of a Python technical sharing session, and Zhou Tao and Li Xiang showed strong interest in his automation scripts. On the way to work, traffic was slow because of icy roads, and he was nearly late.

events.name: Encountered heavy traffic on the way to work and nearly arrived late.
events.description: During Monday morning rush hour, because of the icy roads from last night's snowfall, traffic on Zhongbei Avenue was slow. Ye Mingxuan spent 20 minutes more than usual getting to the company and nearly arrived late. As he entered the office, Gao Zhiyuan happened to be passing by, so he quickened his steps.

events.name: Go to the Xiqing District lumber market to purchase boxwood timber.
events.description: After finishing the day's work in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan took advantage of flexible working hours to leave the company early and took a bus to the timber market near the outer ring road in Xiqing District. He carefully browsed several familiar stalls and eventually bought three high-quality boxwood logs about 4 cm in diameter and 30 cm in length, plus a few acrylic rods as backup material. Boxwood has a fine texture and is suitable for turning precision parts, while the acrylic rods were intended for trial-making lantern connectors. He specifically asked for a receipt so he could keep track of expenses.

events.name: Clean and calibrate the lathe and replace cutting tools
events.description: Back home, Ye Mingxuan put away the newly purchased wood and began the day's cleaning and maintenance of the lathe: he wiped the guide rails with a cotton cloth, added lubricating oil, checked the belt tension, and replaced the tool with a sharper high-speed steel turning tool in preparation for subsequent precision turning. He carefully stored the old removed tool and planned to ask Master Qian how to hand-sharpen it next time.

events.name: Year-end dinner with colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang; shared Python experience.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan dined with his department colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang at a mala xiangguo restaurant in downtown Tianjin. Over the mildly spicy pot, the conversation quickly turned from year-end project wrap-up to automation tools. When Zhou Tao heard that Ye Mingxuan had written a financial analysis script in Python, he was very curious and kept pressing him to explain. Ye Mingxuan patiently shared his experience learning Python, from following online courses for basic exercises to now being able to actually use it in work and family financial analysis, and recommended a few introductory books and online courses. Li Xiang, from the perspective of simulation analysis, asked about the pros and cons of Python and MATLAB in data processing. The three chatted with great enthusiasm. This dinner made Ye Mingxuan realize that his accumulated programming skills could already influence and help his colleagues.

events.name: Completed Monday evening training as planned.
events.description: After the dinner gathering, Ye Mingxuan returned home for a brief rest, then followed his three-times-a-week training plan and went to the gym for his evening workout — strength training such as squats, bench press, and rows, plus 30 minutes on the elliptical. Even though the training session started a bit later than usual after the gathering, he still completed it and recorded the data. When giving feedback to the coach, he specifically noted that today’s meal had included mala xiangguo. Wang Jian replied that he only needed to drink more water.

start_state.mood: Stable, started the new week of work on Monday, got up a bit hurriedly and rushed to work

end_state.mood: Lively and fulfilling; the technical sharing during the team dinner gave a sense of accomplishment.

state.daily_exercise: Gym machine training: squats, bench press, rows, plus 30 minutes of elliptical aerobic

date_attribute.weather: Light snow turning to cloudy, temperature -4°C to 1°C

2025-12.daily_overview: Late Tuesday night, Ye Mingxuan burned the midnight oil in his studio—designing a detachable teaching model for intangible cultural heritage teaching aids, with five complex mortise-and-tenon structures. Applying an engineer’s precise thinking, he annotated and trial-assembled each structure. During the day, the family completed the final first-aid drill, bringing two months of family safety capability building to a successful conclusion. In the evening, he had the last online gathering of the year with Liu Yang and Sun Jing, discussing a possible in-person meeting next year, and ended the day’s multiple tasks with warm reflection and anticipation. In the afternoon, a senior engineer assigned an urgent task, so he worked an extra hour.

events.name: Urgently handled the urgent task assigned by a superior
events.description: At 4 pm, Gao Zhiyuan hurriedly brought a customer feedback document that required an immediate change to the material parameters of a transmission part. Ye Mingxuan put down the work at hand, checked the inventory specifications, recalculated the stress, and submitted the revised plan within half an hour, also helping Zhou Tao update the BOM.

events.name: Design five types of detachable teaching models using mortise-and-tenon structures
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan opened CAD software in his study, which also served as his workshop, and combined his hand-drawn sketches to start designing a set of detachable teaching model drawings containing five complex joints: dovetail, mitered corner tenon, sliding dovetail, wedge-pinned tenon, and clamp-head tenon. He annotated each structure's dimensions, tolerances (required to be within 0.1 mm), assembly sequence, and teaching demonstration key points. During the design, he repeatedly rotated the model in CAD to check the mating surfaces, ensuring that the theoretical gap between each tenon and mortise did not exceed 0.1 mm. After completion, he printed the drawings and bound them into a booklet, ready as a working drawing set for subsequent machining.

events.name: Completed the final comprehensive family first-aid drill
events.description: After work in the evening, the whole family conducted the fifth home first aid drill in two months, and also the final comprehensive drill. This time, the simulated scenario was upgraded to a complex one involving kitchen gas leak poisoning and a family member falling and fracturing a bone, with multiple people injured at the same time. The entire process was organized and handled by Ye Jianguo and Wang Xiulan on their own—Ye Jianguo was responsible for turning off the gas valve, opening the windows for ventilation, and bandaging and immobilizing the injured person; Wang Xiulan was responsible for calling the emergency number and assisting with transfer. Ye Mingxuan only observed and recorded the whole process. After the drill, he commented: the coordination was more than a minute faster than last time, and the division of duties was clear. Afterward, the three of them confirmed their mastery of various first aid knowledge and wrote a final summary in the family health diary: after five drills over two months, the whole family has basic emergency response capability.

events.name: The last online gathering of the year: 2025 Review
events.description: At nearly 10 p.m., Ye Mingxuan, Liu Yang, and Sun Jing gathered online as promised for their agreed final online gathering of the year. They took turns reviewing their respective 2025: Liu Yang talked about the challenges he faced in the electronics industry in Shenzhen and the lesson learned from a project delay; Sun Jing shared her management insights after being promoted to project manager; Ye Mingxuan recounted his experience of being promoted to senior engineer and independently leading technical review meetings. They exchanged New Year greetings and briefly discussed the possibility of an offline gathering next year — Sun Jing suggested holding a college classmates' reunion in Beijing or Tianjin during the May Day holiday in 2026. Ye Mingxuan and Liu Yang both expressed support and agreed to continue discussing it in the group chat after the New Year.

start_state.mood: Steady; Tuesday workday went by the book.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and reflective; the various year-end reviews make one feel the power of time.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated training, but did 15 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching in the evening.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature -6°C to 2°C.

2025-12.daily_overview: Wednesday was the annual performance review day. In a formal interview with Gao Zhiyuan, Ye Mingxuan received an A rating and formally proposed his 2026 career goals of passing the PMP certification and leading automation projects, obtaining a commitment for institutionalized resource support. Outside work, he started precision machining of the teaching model, and the lathe played a core role for the first time in making mortise-and-tenon joints. Monitoring of evening training and family diet adjustments continued in parallel, with data continuing to improve. After the interview, he treated the team to coffee to celebrate.

events.name: Prepared materials for the annual performance review
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ye Mingxuan organized all the materials needed for his annual performance review at his desk: a list of the year's project achievements, meeting minutes from the external technical review he independently chaired, case descriptions of cross-department collaboration, a completed self-assessment form, and a discussion outline for 2026 career goals. He specifically wrote the December 9 review meeting, which he independently chaired and for which he received recognition, as a key case in his self-assessment, and in the goals section he listed the timeline for applying for the PMP certification and the initial resource requirements for the automation project.

events.name: Had the annual performance review with direct supervisor Gao Zhiyuan.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ye Mingxuan and Gao Zhiyuan held the annual performance review in a small meeting room. Senior Engineer Gao first commented on his work performance throughout the year item by item, especially praising his ability to chair outsourcing review meetings as a senior engineer and his cross-departmental collaboration spirit in proactively helping Zhou Tao and Li Xiang solve technical problems, and finally gave him an A rating. Ye Mingxuan then formally proposed his 2026 career development goals: apply for the PMP project management certification in the first half of the year, and strive to lead a complete automation transformation project in the second half. Senior Engineer Gao immediately expressed support, promised to give priority in project assignment and resource coordination, and suggested he first sit in on two internal project management training courses.

events.name: Organized interview notes and drafted the Q1 action plan.
events.description: After the interview ended, Ye Mingxuan returned to his workstation and, instead of immediately moving on to the next task, spent about twenty minutes organizing the interview notes. He recorded the senior engineer’s feedback point by point—what was praised, the improvement suggestions, and the support promised for the PMP and the project—and then drafted an initial action plan for the first quarter of 2026, including checking the PMP registration time and exam outline in January, contacting training courses in February, and completing initial requirements research for the automation project by the end of March. He saved the plan in his personal work folder, ready to submit after the New Year.

events.name: Treated teammates to coffee to celebrate.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan ordered four lattes via a food delivery app to be delivered to the office, one for each of Zhou Tao, Li Xiang, and Gao Zhiyuan. He shared the good news of an A-level performance rating, and they chatted briefly in a relaxed atmosphere.

events.name: Turned five types of mortise-and-tenon parts on the lathe according to the drawings
events.description: After getting home from work, Ye Mingxuan turned on the lathe in the garage, took out the teaching model drawings he had designed the night before, and began turning the tenons and mortises of five joint types, including dovetail and three-way miter joints, according to the drawings. The boxwood stock was precisely cut and shaped under his lathe chisel. He precision-turned the dowel sections and repeatedly measured with calipers to ensure dimensional tolerances were kept within 0.1 mm. The garage heater fan whirred, blending with the sound of the lathe cutting into a focused rhythm.

events.name: Perform evening training and record data
events.description: After the machining work came to an end, Ye Mingxuan went to the gym according to his training plan, completing equipment training such as squats, bench press, and rows, as well as 30 minutes of elliptical aerobic exercise. After training, he recorded the data as usual and gave feedback to the coach. Wang Jian replied that the body fat percentage data continued to show a downward trend, and the goal of reaching below 18% before the Spring Festival should be achievable.

events.name: Measure father's blood pressure to confirm the effect of dietary adjustment.
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan helped his father Ye Jianguo measure his blood pressure. Since implementing the low-oil, low-salt diet more than two weeks ago, the readings have shown a noticeable decline—his systolic pressure, which had been fluctuating near the high end of the borderline range early in the year, has dropped to near the normal range. Mother Wang Xiulan also took a measurement on her own initiative, and the result was normal. Looking at the numbers on the blood pressure monitor, Ye Jianguo remarked with a sigh, 'It seems that using less salt really works.' The whole family was satisfied with the effect of the dietary adjustment, and their health awareness was further strengthened. Ye Mingxuan entered the measurement data into his phone, ready to add it when he next updates the family health record.

start_state.mood: Focused and slightly nervous, the day of the annual review

end_state.mood: Confident and grounded; the A-level evaluation and formal confirmation of career goals are inspiring.

state.daily_exercise: Gym machine training: squats, bench press, rows, plus 30 minutes of elliptical aerobic

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature -3°C to 3°C.

2025-12.daily_overview: Thursday, Christmas. Ye Mingxuan didn't care about this Western holiday, but he had arranged family time for dining out with his parents. Before the meal, he rigorously checked the dishes for allergens, continuing his usual cautious style. In the evening, he completed the assembly and final verification of the teaching model. After seeing the finished product over video, Master Qian praised it highly and, for the first time, formally expressed his intention to jointly take on repair orders. Also on this day, the postcard Li Na had sent—a Qinghai route guide—finally arrived in the mailbox, and a friendship spanning twenty years landed warmly in the form of a hand-drawn map. In the afternoon, he discovered that the lathe chuck was slightly loose and adjusted it in time.

events.name: Inspect and tighten the lathe chuck
events.description: After returning home in the afternoon, before Ye Mingxuan prepared to assemble the model, he habitually checked the lathe and found slight radial runout in the chuck. He re-tightened it with a special wrench and corrected it with a dial indicator, confirming that the concentricity was restored.

events.name: Have a family dinner out before Christmas and identify allergens.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan took his parents to the reserved restaurant for a family dinner. Before leaving, he specifically called the restaurant to confirm that every dish on the reserved menu was free of seafood. During the meal, he carefully checked each dish that was served to ensure no seafood or shellfish had been mistakenly included. After dinner, he went home and recorded the meal cost in the family income and expense management script he had written, and noted in the remarks that no seafood issues were found. His mother laughed at him for being too careful. He replied seriously that even though he carried the epinephrine auto-injector, he hoped it would never have to be used.

events.name: Completed trial assembly and fine-tuning of the full teaching model set.
events.description: At about 8 p.m. after dinner, Ye Mingxuan trial-assembled all the turned mortise-and-tenon components at the garage workbench. The dovetail joints were a bit too tight, so he lightly sanded the contact surfaces with fine sandpaper and tried again, and they fit together smoothly. One dowel in the corner mortise-and-tenon joint was too loose, so he turned a new one slightly larger to replace it until it felt snug. After disassembling and reassembling twice, the entire set of five mortise-and-tenon teaching models achieved the desired effect—smooth disassembly, tight joints, and solid structure. He took several high-definition photos of the models for archival.

events.name: Showed the finished product to Master Qian and received high praise.
events.description: After the assembly was complete, Ye Mingxuan immediately showed the physical teaching model to Master Qian Jianguo over a WeChat video call. Master Qian put on his reading glasses and carefully examined the close-ups of each mortise-and-tenon joint, repeatedly praising the fit precision and craftsmanship: "With your skills and this lathe, this has reached teaching-grade level. This is good enough to display anywhere without embarrassment." Master Qian then formally mentioned the intention to take on small folk furniture restoration orders together, saying, "You take care of the precision machining, and I'll handle the overall control and surface finishing. With us working as master and apprentice, we're ready to take on work." Ye Mingxuan was greatly encouraged and said he would definitely push it forward after the new year.

events.name: Received Li Na's hand-painted Qinghai road-trip postcard in the mailbox.
events.description: On the same day, after work, Ye Mingxuan found an envelope from Shenzhen in the mailbox downstairs in his residential compound. When he opened it, it was a Qinghai route-map postcard hand-drawn by his elementary school classmate Li Na — a delicately drawn map with the lake-loop route and landmarks along the way marked on it. On the back was written: if you need UI design, free support. He read it twice under the streetlight, feeling warm support from afar, and the corners of his mouth rose involuntarily.

events.name: Replied to Li Na to express gratitude and share the progress of the self-driving trip preparations.
events.description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan sent Li Na a thank-you message via WeChat, saying that he was very moved to receive the postcard and that the hand-drawn route was very clear. He also briefly shared the recent progress of his self-driving plan around Qinghai Lake—the car-buying fund had reached its target, and he and his travel buddy had settled on the August 2026 time window. Li Na quickly replied: Great, if you need route visualization or infographics along the way, feel free to contact me. The two chatted briefly about their recent lives, rekindling their childhood friendship in a modern context.

events.name: Put the postcard into the road-trip preparation notebook
events.description: Before going to bed, Ye Mingxuan took the notebook exclusively used for recording road-trip preparations from the bookshelf, carefully tucked Li Na's postcard into the first page of the Qinghai Lake route guide chapter, and hand-wrote next to it the date received and notes: hand-drawn by Li Na, sent from Shenzhen, promise of UI design support. This postcard became a precious keepsake of the dream journey.

start_state.mood: Calm, ordinary workday mindset

end_state.mood: Moved and inspired, the successful acceptance of the model and the support of friendship from afar arrived together.

2025-12.daily_overview: Friday was a day running in parallel between online socializing and hardcore programming. During the evening year-end online gathering of the ancient coin group, Ye Mingxuan was publicly praised by senior collector Zhao Jianguo, and the two started an in-depth private chat, agreeing to meet in person in Tianjin in the spring of 2026. Fragments of time during the day and evening were spent exploring Python-based CNC—he used matplotlib to write a lathe path simulation script and received feedback in the programming study group, taking the first step in deeply combining mechanical automation with programming. During the day, he helped Zhou Tao solve a mechanical problem.

events.name: Helped colleague Zhou Tao solve the hydraulic valve sticking problem
events.description: In the afternoon, during the test of a small hydraulic device that Zhou Tao was responsible for, the valve spool stuck. Ye Mingxuan helped him disassemble and inspect it, and found that the sealing ring had been assembled too tightly. After re-lubricating and adjusting, the two restored it to normal.

events.name: Prepare the technical environment for the online gathering in advance.
events.description: After returning home from work, Ye Mingxuan checked the computer camera and microphone in the study in advance, logged into the ancient coin appraisal enthusiasts WeChat group and the Tencent Meeting software to be used, and confirmed that the network was stable and the picture and sound were normal. He also took out several Beiyang dragon dollars he had collected this year, preparing to show the physical details at the gathering.

events.name: Ancient coin group's year-end online gathering and public praise from Zhao Jianguo
events.description: At 8 p.m., the ancient coin appraisal enthusiasts group held its annual online review gathering. During the speech segment, senior collector Zhao Jianguo publicly praised Ye Mingxuan as the member who had made the most progress this year, specifically mentioning his rapid growth in authenticating machine-struck coins and several accurate judgments. Ye Mingxuan then spoke, sharing his experience of systematically learning authentication knowledge from scratch over the past year, and showed several pieces from his collection in his phone album that he had cleaned and sorted.

events.name: Have an in-depth private chat with Zhao Jianguo to exchange collecting insights.
events.description: After the group activity ended, Zhao Jianguo took the initiative to start a private chat, and the two immediately started a video call. They talked from distinguishing the varieties of Beiyang dragon dollars to the minting characteristics of the Jiangnan Province issues, and from maintenance methods for machine-struck coins to new trends in counterfeit coins on the current market. The topics grew deeper, and before they knew it, the call lasted nearly two hours. The level of their professional dialogue was no longer comparable to the start of the year; Ye Mingxuan could casually cite die numbers and variety details, and Zhao Jianguo nodded frequently.

events.name: Agreed that Zhao Jianguo will come to Tianjin in spring 2026 to hunt for coins in person.
events.description: When the video call was nearing its end, Zhao Jianguo took the initiative to propose: 'Around Qingming Festival I'll take my annual leave. When the time comes, I'll fly to Tianjin, and we'll go to the Shenyang Road Antique Market for a real treasure-hunting trip. You know the place better than I do since you're local.' Ye Mingxuan gladly agreed and promised to prepare a guide to the Shenyang Road market in advance, including reliable stall layouts and recent price trends. After hanging up, he immediately noted the agreement in the ancient coin collection section of his work notebook, marking the expected visit by Zhao Jianguo in April 2026.

events.name: Study the CNC principles of lathes and write a path simulation script
events.description: During fragmented moments at work during lunch break and before the evening gathering, Ye Mingxuan had been doing one thing: inspired by 3D printing and CNC machining concepts, he searched the internet to review the basic principles of lathe machining, revisited the G-code format, and used Python's matplotlib library to write a simple lathe path simulation script — after inputting the workpiece diameter and length parameters, the script automatically draws a schematic of the machining path. He debugged it repeatedly for about half an hour to ensure the line generation logic was correct.

events.name: Share the script with the programming study group and get optimization suggestions.
events.description: After the script debugging succeeded, Ye Mingxuan sent the code screenshots, generated path diagram, and photos of his lathe to the programming study group WeChat chat, asking Xu Ming and other peers for optimization suggestions. Xu Ming quickly replied, praising the idea of combining lathe machining with Python visualization as creative, and suggested the possibility of a low-cost CNC retrofit using a Raspberry Pi — using the Raspberry Pi to control a stepper motor to drive the lead screw feed. Ye Mingxuan carefully noted this suggestion and asked several technical details about stepper motor selection.

events.name: Organize learning insights and incorporate them into the 2026 plan.
events.description: Before going to bed in the evening, Ye Mingxuan turned on his computer and organized tonight's takeaways in his personal study notebook: he recorded the improvement directions for the script (supporting more complex contour input), the feasibility of modifying the Raspberry Pi and the required hardware list, and the technical points discussed with Xu Ming. At the end of the notes, he wrote: this experience is the initial practice of the 2026 plan to deeply integrate mechanical automation with Python, and later he could consider applying for internal innovation projects at the company.

events.name: Complete Friday evening fitness training
events.description: Before the ancient coin gathering, Ye Mingxuan completed his evening workout according to the training plan—machine exercises such as squats, bench press, and rows, plus 30 minutes of elliptical cardio. After training, he recorded the data and reported back to the coach. Wang Jian said his training attendance at the end of the year remained good, and the final physical fitness test before the Spring Festival is scheduled for the end of January.

start_state.mood: Focused, workday rhythm

end_state.mood: Excited and fulfilled; the recognition from the ancient coin community and the exploration of programming combined to bring strong positive feedback.

2025-12.daily_overview: Saturday was a day when a dream was anchored. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan ran a Python model to confirm that his car-purchase funds had reached the budget target, and then had a video call with Wu Bin, a travel buddy far away in Chengdu, to finalize the specific timetable for the August 2026 Qinghai-Tibet loop self-driving trip. For the first time, this dream that had been vague for three years had a definite departure date. During the day, he also went to the community center to coordinate the specific requirements for the New Year's Day lantern fair. When he returned, he immediately started designing the lantern frame connection joints and purchasing materials—the lathe had transformed from a toy into a productivity tool. In the evening, he updated the road-trip preparation notebook and organized the equipment list, making the dream more concrete. In the morning, he ran outdoors instead of going to the gym, starting an energetic weekend.

events.name: Morning outdoor jog of 3 km
events.description: At 7:40 on Saturday morning, Ye Mingxuan changed into running shoes and jogged on the sidewalk along Zhongbei Avenue. His ears, red from the cold, reminded him to keep warm when exercising in winter. He used a phone app to record a pace of about 6 and a half minutes per kilometer, with a stable heart rate.

events.name: Review the car purchase budget and confirm that the funds are sufficient.
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan turned on his computer, logged into online banking to check the account balance item by item, and simultaneously ran his self-developed Python prediction model for the car-purchase fund pool. After entering the confirmed savings balance and post-promotion monthly salary, the model showed that the current funds plus the plan to save 3,000 yuan per month in the coming months were enough to cover the full budget for buying a used four-wheel-drive SUV before August 2026. He stared at the green 'goal reached' indicator on the screen and fell silent for about half a minute—this number meant his road-trip dream had a reliable financial foundation.

events.name: Video-called with hiking buddy Wu Bin to finalize the August 2026 Qinghai-Tibet loop route plan.
events.description: After confirming that the funds met the requirement, Ye Mingxuan immediately started a WeChat video call with his Chengdu travel buddy Wu Bin. The two spent nearly two hours discussing and deliberating item by item the route for the Qinghai-Tibet loop, departure date, vehicle plan, and equipment list. Wu Bin offered several camping and communication plans he had evaluated from the perspective of an outdoor equipment manager, while Ye Mingxuan shared his detailed breakdown of car purchase budget and time window. In the end, they solemnly finalized: depart from Tianjin on August 1, 2026, enter the Qinghai-Tibet route via Xining, with an estimated total of 20 days. After hanging up, Ye Mingxuan opened the self-driving trip preparation section of his work notebook and wrote '8/1/2026 Departure' in red pen on the Qinghai Lake route page, in neat, forceful handwriting. For the first time, the dream had a concrete time anchor.

events.name: Recorded the Shenyang Road appointment with Zhao Jianguo.
events.description: After handling the self-driving trip matters in the morning, Ye Mingxuan opened the ancient coin collection section of his work notebook and formally recorded the plan agreed with Zhao Jianguo the night before to hunt for coins at the Shenyang Dao Antique Market in April 2026. He began thinking about what strategy points needed to be prepared in advance—listing the main stall layout of Shenyang Dao, recent market price reference websites, and a checklist of appraisal tools to bring. He wrote these drafts in the notebook, planning to refine them during the New Year's Day holiday.

events.name: Went to the community center to coordinate the requirements for the New Year's Day lantern show.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Ye Mingxuan went to the Xiqing District Community Center as scheduled and discussed in detail with Director Wang, the person in charge, the specific arrangements for the parent-child lantern-making experience activity at the New Year's Day Lantern Festival. Director Wang asked to prepare material kits for 50 lanterns, to be provided in semi-finished form so parents and children could assemble them on site. The two discussed the structure of the lantern frames (using a simple cylindrical frame), the assembly method (plug-in connectors), and the event schedule (from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m. on New Year's Day). Ye Mingxuan carefully recorded the requirements and promised to deliver all the connectors by December 30.

events.name: Design the connector head for the lantern frame and purchase materials
events.description: After returning home from the community center, Ye Mingxuan opened CAD software and designed a cylindrical plug-in connector with holes to connect and secure the upper and lower bases of the lantern to a vertical wooden stick. The drawing marked key hole diameters and tolerances. He then went to a nearby hardware market and bought enough acrylic rods and auxiliary tools according to the design parameters, preparing to start batch processing. Back in the garage, he printed out the CAD drawing and taped it to the wall next to the lathe, and sorted the acrylic rods into batches by size.

events.name: In the evening, update the self-driving trip preparation notebook and organize the equipment checklist
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan took out his road-trip planning notebook and, next to the departure date he had just written down, began listing item by item the equipment needed for the Qinghai-Tibet loop: vehicle modifications, camping gear, high-altitude medicine, communication tools, and so on. He compared it with the recommended list Wu Bin had given him and, in light of his budget after buying the car, selected the highest-priority items. He also drew a simple equipment preparation timeline in the notebook, planning to complete one purchase each month starting in January 2026. After finishing, he closed the notebook with satisfaction, feeling that the outline of his dream was becoming clearer.

start_state.mood: Awake and calm, with the leisurely feeling of a Saturday morning.

end_state.mood: Excited and resolute — a strong thrill after anchoring the road-trip dream to a definite date.

2025-12.daily_overview: Sunday was the hardcore money-management day that wrapped up the year. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan ran a Python script to generate an illustrated annual family finance report, and in the evening projected it onto the white wall of the living room for the whole family to review. The data-driven family economic governance model was formally established—his mother handed the authority over the accounts to her son's script. Meanwhile, at Master Qian's workshop, the lathe was producing connectors in batches for the public welfare lantern festival, and the father-son balcony reading also officially concluded that day, with two months of reading time condensed into the family's intellectual asset. In the afternoon, he went with his father to visit a distant great-uncle who was hospitalized.

events.name: Check the integrity of financial data sources
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ye Mingxuan sat at the computer in his study and checked, one by one, whether the bank card e-statements and the annual transaction records from Alipay and WeChat had all been imported into the data source folder of his Python financial script. After confirming nothing was missing, he ran the script's validation module to ensure the data format was consistent and free of duplicates or abnormalities. Everything was ready.

events.name: Run Python script to generate annual financial report
events.description: The script ran for about three minutes, automatically scraped the full year's income and expenditure data, and after cleaning and calculation, generated an illustrated annual family financial report PDF. The report showed: total annual income increased by about 15% due to the promotion, controllable expenditures decreased by 15% year-over-year, the emergency fund balance reached 55,000 yuan (only 5,000 yuan short of the 60,000 yuan goal), and the first-year income from the woodworking side business was 1,300 yuan—small, but marking the opening of a new income channel. The expenditure category pie chart and monthly trend line chart were all included.

events.name: The whole family reviewed the annual financial report together.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan projected the generated annual financial report onto the white wall of the living room and invited his parents to watch together. His father, Ye Jianguo, pointed at the cumulative curve chart of the emergency fund and said, "This is a hundred times clearer than the bills sent by the bank." When his mother saw the entry for carpentry side income, she laughed and said, "My son can earn money doing carpentry too." When Ye Mingxuan turned to the expenditure structure analysis page, his mother mentioned that spending on soy sauce and seasonings seemed higher than last year. Ye Mingxuan explained that it was because he had switched from ordinary soy sauce to a more expensive additive-free soy sauce, but the overall proportion of seasoning spending was still manageable and consistent with his healthy eating goals. The data transparency brought unprecedented family financial consensus.

events.name: Mother made the decision to fully digitize the family accounts.
events.description: After reading the report, his mother, Wang Xiulan, made the decision on the spot: the family accounts will be managed with this from now on — it's a hundred times clearer than my handwritten ledger. The three then discussed and adjusted the family bookkeeping method: daily expenses are uniformly entered into a shared Excel, and a Python script automatically generates a monthly financial summary at the beginning of each month. They also agreed on daily record-keeping rules (enter all records uniformly on weekends). Ye Mingxuan's mother formally handed over the family's bookkeeping authority to her son in digital form, and family financial governance entered a new phase.

events.name: Two-month balcony reading wrap-up summary
events.description: On Sunday after dinner, the last regular reading session of the two months took place in the balcony reading area. Father Ye Jianguo finished the third book he had read in these two months tonight. Closing the last page, he remarked with emotion: "Reading with you these past two months has been more than I would read by myself in a year." The father and son used the post-dinner time to exchange what they had gained from two months of reading, sorted out a complete book list of everything they had read, and jointly decided to continue this half-hour after-dinner reading habit every Sunday. The balcony's role as a space for spiritual exchange became even more firmly established.

events.name: Batch processing lantern connectors at Master Qian's workshop.
events.description: During the day, Ye Mingxuan took acrylic rods to Master Qian Jianguo's woodworking workshop in Xiqing District. The master and apprentice worked together — Ye Mingxuan used the larger lathe in Master Qian's workshop to batch-produce the first 25 lantern-frame connectors, while Master Qian guided him on optimizing material-change efficiency during batch processing. After finishing each connector, Ye Mingxuan measured the diameter and hole size with calipers and tested the insertion fit with a wooden stick. In the afternoon workshop, the sound of the lathe tool and the rhythmic clicking of the measuring gauge were interwoven as the public service task moved forward in a professional atmosphere.

events.name: Visit the hospitalized great-uncle with father.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Ye Mingxuan and his father Ye Jianguo went to Tianjin People's Hospital to visit his distant grand-uncle Ye Dehou, who was hospitalized with pneumonia, bringing fruit and soup stewed by his mother. The grand-uncle was in good spirits, and they chatted about family matters for half an hour. Ye Mingxuan noticed that the call system in the ward was not well designed and, out of professional habit, mentally noted the improvement points.

events.name: Cooking on Sunday as a wrap-up of the three-week dietary adjustment
events.description: At noon, Ye Mingxuan cooked again, making steamed chicken breast with cucumber salad and a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup. After the meal, the three of them summarized their three-week experience of adjusting to a low-oil, low-salt diet — his father's blood pressure had dropped, his mother's weight was down two jin, and Ye Mingxuan's body fat percentage continued to decline. The family unanimously decided to make healthy eating a regular practice and continue following the low-oil, low-salt principle. His mother said she had gotten used to the taste and would use less oil during Chinese New Year in the future.

start_state.mood: Leisurely; no pressing schedule on Sunday.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and grounded. The formal handover of financial governance and the wrap-up of reading time made the family system feel upgraded.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Monday, after finishing work in the morning, he continued at Master Qian's workshop in the afternoon to complete the remaining 25 lantern connectors. With that, all 50 connectors needed for the public welfare activity were finished and passed quality inspection. In the evening, he did his routine training, and the gym had a growing year-end atmosphere. There were many work emails, and he dealt with them until late, but he still kept up his workout.

events.name: Deal with a large number of work emails and reports at the end of the year
events.description: In the office in the morning, Ye Mingxuan spent nearly three hours replying to supplier emails, organizing project archive documents, and helping Manager Wang Peng compile the data tables for the department's annual summary. It was busy but organized.

events.name: Finish machining the remaining 25 connectors
events.description: After getting off work in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan went to Master Qian's workshop again and continued working on the remaining 25 lantern frame connectors. Thanks to the previous day's experience, he completed them more smoothly this time, with a steady rhythm, finishing all in two hours. While he worked, Master Qian was repairing an old chair nearby; the master and apprentice each busied themselves, occasionally exchanging a few technical insights.

events.name: Conduct quality inspections on all 50 connectors
events.description: After the machining was completed, Ye Mingxuan spread out all 50 connectors on the workbench. He felt the openings one by one by hand for burrs, used calipers to spot-check that the hole diameters were uniform, and used pre-made wooden sticks to randomly test the insertion fit. He found that two connectors had oversized hole diameters causing loose insertion, so he immediately marked them and reworked replacements during the subsequent repair. In the end, all 50 connectors passed inspection—smooth, burr-free, and uniform in size—and were arranged in a clean small cardboard box. With the lid closed, they were ready to be delivered to the community center on the 30th.

events.name: Completed Monday evening routine training
events.description: After returning home from the workshop at 8:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan changed into his workout clothes and went to the gym. Following the training plan, he completed machine exercises including squats, bench press, and rows, plus 30 minutes of elliptical aerobic training. After training, he recorded the data and reported it to the coach. The year-end atmosphere at the gym was getting stronger, and several regular members were chatting about New Year's Eve plans. Coach Wang Jian reminded him that the gym would shorten its business hours during the New Year holiday, so training could be moved to the morning.

start_state.mood: Steady, Monday work pace

end_state.mood: Solid: volunteer tasks completed on time, training followed through

2025-12.daily_overview: Tuesday was the year-end inventory day. In the evening, Ye Mingxuan held a personal intangible asset registration ceremony in his study, formally writing his Python programming ability and systematic woodworking skills into the family balance sheet as skill assets. Then, on a new notebook, he listed the four major goals for 2026 one by one, each interlinked. In the afternoon, he successfully delivered the lantern connectors to the community center and finalized the New Year's Day activity process. Near the end of the year, he also bought a domain name after work and built a personal blog, preparing a publishing platform for tomorrow evening's annual long article. He went to the bank to ask about a PMP training loan.

events.name: Inquire at the bank about PMP training loan products.
events.description: In the morning, he made time to visit a China Merchants Bank branch near the company and consulted with a financial manager, Zhang Wei (same name), about education installment loans. He learned that enrolling in PMP training could qualify for an interest rate discount, so he took a brochure back to study.

events.name: Year-end review of annual achievements in woodworking and programming
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan sat at the workbench in his study, with three items in front of him: a photo of a finished imitation Ming-style small offering cabinet, a repair record for a small wooden table marked with flaws, and a Python data analysis certification. He quietly examined these objects and reviewed his growth over the past year in both woodworking and programming—from being able to make only simple mortise-and-tenon joints at the beginning of the year to now designing and assembling teaching models of five types of complex mortise-and-tenon joints; from zero Python foundation to being able to write financial analysis scripts and lathe path simulation tools. This contrast made him clearly see the accumulation of time.

events.name: Formally entered two skills into the books as intangible assets.
events.description: After the review, Ye Mingxuan brought out the family's paper asset and liability ledger, and solemnly wrote two new lines under the asset column: possessing basic programming skills (Python data processing and tool development) and mastering systematic woodworking craftsmanship (mortise-and-tenon joints, sanding, wax finishing, and simple repairs), formally recording these two skills as personal intangible assets. This was the first time he incorporated non-financial skill accumulation into the family's wealth perception framework, marking a re-evaluation of his own self-worth.

events.name: Determine the four major goals for 2026 item by item.
events.description: After closing the asset ledger, Ye Mingxuan opened a brand-new notebook and wrote down his four major goals for 2026 on the first page: first, drive around Qinghai Lake in August (the exact time has been set); second, advance his furniture restoration skills by learning systematically from Master Qian and taking on at least two small restoration orders; third, earn the PMP project management certification (complete registration and exam prep in the first half of the year); fourth, double his woodworking side-business income to more than 3000 yuan (set up an online showcase channel and use the lathe to increase production capacity). When he wrote the final period, he felt a solid sense of direction.

events.name: Purchase a domain name and set up a personal blog.
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan spent about an hour and a half at the computer to purchase a .cn domain name, built a personal blog system based on an open-source framework, and completed a minimalist style customization of the theme and homepage functionality testing. His purpose in building the blog was to prepare a platform for publishing his annual long-form article on New Year's Eve, and it was also the first step in upgrading his personal brand building from short WeChat Moments posts to a public writing space. He thought about the blog name for a long time, and finally decided to simply use his personal name in pinyin combined with technical thinking.

events.name: Deliver lantern connectors to the community center and agree on the event process
events.description: Before leaving work that afternoon, Ye Mingxuan delivered a small cardboard box containing 50 connectors to the community center. He showed Director Wang the finished products and randomly tested the plug-in performance of several connectors. Director Wang was pleasantly surprised to see the precise acrylic connectors, and after learning they were machined on a lathe, he proposed adding a mini-lathe demonstration segment to the intangible cultural heritage mini-class on New Year's Day, so the children could see the precision machining process with their own eyes. Ye Mingxuan thought it was a great idea, and the two agreed on the demonstration flow and required materials — he would bring a small lathe and a piece of soft wood to the site to do a simple cylindrical turning demonstration.

start_state.mood: Contemplative with no sense of urgency, the natural reflective mindset at the end of the year

end_state.mood: Resolute and energized, with a clear goal list and the blog completed, ready to ring in the New Year

2025-12.daily_overview: New Year's Eve. As the last day of the year, this day carried the dual nature of both a workday and New Year's Eve. The most critical event occurred in the evening: Ye Mingxuan published a long annual reflection titled "2025, I Bought Regrets and I Bought Growth" on his newly built personal blog, weaving the year's bittersweet experiences into a public written narrative. He listed the lathe as the year's key personal asset and ended the article with "Next year, see you at Qinghai Lake," as his spiritual anchor for 2026. During the day, he organized all the materials for the New Year's Day lantern show, and also completed the summary and filing of the family first-aid drill and a comparative analysis of the monthly training data across the year. In the evening, the family of three watched the New Year's Eve gala in their new home, completing the first full cycle of seasons there with his father's toast and his mother's humorous urging to get married. His weight stayed at 70.4 kg, a healthy finish to the year.

events.name: Wrote and published the annual blog post 2025: I Bought Regret and I Bought Growth.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Ye Mingxuan sat down at the computer in his study, opened the admin backend of his newly built personal blog, and began writing his annual long article. It took him about an hour and a half to write more than 5,000 words, reviewing the key moments of 2025: the excitement and pressure of buying a house at the beginning of the year, the tension from his father's suddenly high blood pressure in the middle of the year, the worry when his mother injured her ankle, the joy of being promoted to senior engineer, the recognition of being patted on the shoulder by the senior engineer when he independently led a technical review meeting, the income from the first woodworking order, the whole family working together on the day the lathe arrived, and the data on the physical examination report showing that his cholesterol had returned to normal. He deliberately used one sentence to summarize the lathe's symbolic meaning: this small lathe was not just equipment; it was a key addition to the year's personal assets—it represented the end of the handcraft era and the beginning of precision manufacturing. At the end of the article, he wrote: "See you at Qinghai Lake next year." After publishing it, he shared the blog link on WeChat Moments.

events.name: Took out Li Na's postcard and put it into the road-trip preparation notebook.
events.description: One small act after publishing the article: Ye Mingxuan carefully took out the hand-drawn Qinghai road trip guide postcard sent by Li Na from a document envelope in the study’s drawer, examined the delicate lines and the encouraging words on the back once again, then formally placed it on the first page of the Qinghai road trip chapter in his self-driving preparation notebook, as a token for setting out next year. He lightly tapped the spot of Qinghai Lake on the postcard with his fingertip, as if marking a coordinate in his heart.

events.name: Complete the family first aid drill summary and archive it

events.description: After the analysis, Ye Mingxuan organized the root cause, scope of impact, abnormal duration, affected sensor numbers, and recommended solution—rewriting calibration parameters and adding an automatic verification step after maintenance—into a concise formal report and emailed it to Gao Zhiyuan. He then shared the key conclusions by phone, confirming there was no need for immediate on-site repair and that the production line could resume on Monday. Gao Zhiyuan repeatedly said over the phone, [Good, handled cleanly].

events.name: Received a commendation email from my supervisor
events.description: Around 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan received a reply email from Gao Zhiyuan, copied to project manager Wang Peng. The email read: [This time it was handled beautifully — the root cause was accurately identified, and the report was written clearly.] Ye Mingxuan saved a screenshot of the email to the [Work Results] folder.

events.name: Brief evening celebration at home with parents
events.description: At about 8:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan walked out of the study and into the living room. His father took the initiative to open a bottle of beer, and his mother took out the cold cake she had prepared earlier and cut fruit from the refrigerator. The three sat on the sofa, and Ye Mingxuan briefly told them about the day's work. His parents praised his ability to handle emergencies. In a relaxed way, they made up for the disappointment of the missed appointment, enjoying dessert and beer and chatting for about 30 minutes. Ye Mingxuan felt the support and warmth of his family.

events.name: Prepare for tomorrow's 18-kilometer long run
events.description: At 9 p.m., after getting himself ready, Ye Mingxuan began preparing for the next morning's long run. He checked the tightness of his running shoe laces, put energy gels and salt tablets into his waist pack, filled his water bottle with electrolyte water, and put it in the fridge. He charged his watch to full, set the alarm for 5:30 a.m., and at dinner deliberately ate an extra half bowl of rice to replenish carbohydrates. Before bed, he did 10 minutes of stretching to relax.
