2025-08.daily_overview: Sunday was a rewarding day for Ye Mingxuan. He got up at 5:30 in the morning, completed an 18-kilometer long run on Zhongbei Avenue, setting a new personal longest distance, and achieved his monthly goal with a pace of 5 minutes 55 seconds per kilometer. In the morning, he attended the final defense of the Python course. Two practical projects were recognized, and he successfully obtained the basic programming certificate. In the evening, he made up for yesterday's family dinner, celebrating his father's stable blood pressure and his own certificate at a fusion restaurant on Five Avenues. During the meal, he showed the certificate and self-written scripts; his father happily called him "the first programmer in the Ye family," and his mother carefully examined the financial analysis function. After returning home, he sent a photo of the certificate to his older male cousin and enjoyed the recognition.

events.name: Completed an 18 km long run in the early morning.
events.description: Woke up at 5:30 in the morning and did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up: high knees, joint circles, and jumping jacks in rotation, followed by a 5-minute static stretch focusing on the hip joints and Achilles tendons. At 6:00 sharp, he started from home on Zhongbei Avenue and ran west along the planned route to near Caozhuang Flower Market, then turned back. The total distance was 18 km, with a controlled pace of 5 minutes 55 seconds per kilometer. At 9 km and 14 km, he took half a pack of energy gel and some electrolyte drink respectively. In the last two kilometers, his pace dropped slightly due to fatigue, but he stuck with it. When he pressed the stop button on his watch, he saw 18.01 km and achieved his August goal.

events.name: Post-run recovery and data recording
events.description: After arriving home, walked slowly for 5 minutes to cool down, did 15 minutes of static stretching in the community garden, focusing on the front and back of the thighs, calf gastrocnemius, and glutes. Back home, used a foam roller for deep pressure on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and iliotibial band, feeling overall comfortable but with moderate muscle soreness. Recorded the training distance, time, split pace, average heart rate (152 bpm), and perceived exertion rating (8/10) into the training log in detail.

events.name: Completed the final defense of the Python course and obtained the certificate.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Ye Mingxuan changed into a neat polo shirt and attended the final defense of his Python course at the computer in his study. Through a video conference, he comprehensively presented to his instructor the results of two months of study: two hands-on projects, a home finance analysis script and a mechanical parameterization tool, and answered live questions about code structure and application scenarios. The instructor spoke highly of the practical application value of the parameterization tool and considered him to have a solid foundation in Python programming. About half an hour after the defense ended, the electronic certificate of programming fundamentals was sent to his email. He saved a backup of the certificate and printed a copy to put in his file folder.

events.name: Make up the family dinner in the evening and show the certificate
events.description: At 6 p.m., Ye Mingxuan accompanied his parents from their home in Xiqing District and took a taxi to a newly opened fusion restaurant in the Five Great Avenues area. After they were seated, he ordered according to the menu he had prepared in advance, and the family ate and chatted in a warm atmosphere. His father was in a good mood and brought up the old days when he had overcome technical difficulties at the machine tool plant when he was young. During the meal, Ye Mingxuan took out a printed basic programming certificate to show his parents, and then opened his phone to demonstrate the monthly balance feature of the family financial analysis script. His father looked at it carefully, smiled and praised, [That's great, the Ye family now has a programmer too]. His mother then carefully swiped the screen several times and said repeatedly about the expense category chart, [This is practical; grocery accounting will be much clearer from now on]. In this shared joy, the family made up for the regret of yesterday's missed appointment.

events.name: Took a walk after the meal and went home.
events.description: After the meal ended, at about 8:30, the family strolled along the Five Avenues area to aid digestion. Father pointed at a few old Western-style houses and talked about old stories of Tianjin. Around 9:30, they took a taxi back to their home in Xiqing District.

events.name: Sharing the certificate with his cousin
events.description: At 10 p.m., Ye Mingxuan sent a photo of his programming certificate to his cousin Ye Mingyuan in Shenzhen via WeChat. Ye Mingyuan quickly replied, [Awesome, cross-disciplinary engineers are in the greatest demand], and half-jokingly invited Ye Mingxuan to consider coming to Shenzhen, [People here who understand both mechanics and coding are highly sought after]. Ye Mingxuan replied, [Haha, I'll gain experience first, maybe I'll really go someday]. The two chatted about recent news for a few minutes before going to rest.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday, Ye Mingxuan returned to work with the sense of achievement from Sunday's running breakthrough and programming certificate, and officially started the trial production of fixture samples. In the morning, he organized the ancient coin sample data accumulated recently to prepare data for the acquisition decision. In the afternoon, he operated a CNC machine tool in the workshop to perform rough and finish machining of the fixture body, while Li Xiang carried out simulation verification at the same time. In the evening, he still attended the personal training class, focusing on hip flexibility training for recovery after long-distance running. After returning home, he updated his personal skills resume.

events.name: Organize ancient coin sample data
events.description: Using the fragmented time of the morning commute and before work, Ye Mingxuan opened his phone's photo album and notepad, and compiled data from 37 recently collected samples of the same edition of Guangxu silver coins minted in Jiangnan Province—including photos, weight, diameter, and edge-teeth photos—into an Excel spreadsheet. He classified and arranged them by edition characteristics, preparing for subsequent data comparison and condition assessment.

events.name: Start rough machining and finish machining of the fixture body
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ye Mingxuan changed into work clothes and protective goggles in the workshop and clamped the special steel that had been put into storage onto the CNC machine. According to the machining program written last week, he first performed rough machining to remove most of the allowance, then changed tools for partial finishing operations to machine the datum surface and key locating features. Meanwhile, Li Xiang used software in the office to simulate and verify the tool path, and fed the simulation results back to Ye Mingxuan through internal instant messaging to ensure that the machining parameters were consistent with the actual machine tool operation.

events.name: Evening personal training session (recovery workout)
events.description: After work, went to Limei Fitness Center. Coach Wang Jian arranged a one-hour recovery session based on Ye Mingxuan's recovery from yesterday's 18-kilometer long run, focusing on hip mobility, gluteus medius activation, and lower limb stretching, and provided detailed guidance on iliotibial band fascial release.

events.name: Organized Python course materials and updated the skills resume
events.description: After the personal training class, Ye Mingxuan returned home. In his study, he sorted and archived two months of Python course study notes, project codes from each stage, the defense PPT, and electronic certificates into a folder named [Python Study], and backed them up to the cloud. Then he opened his resume document, added [Python Programming Basics (Certified)] to the skills section, and added two practical cases - a parameterization tool and a family finance script - to his project experience. He saved the updated resume as a new version.

2025-08.daily_overview: Tuesday was an important day for Ye Mingxuan's ancient coin collecting hobby. In the evening, at home, he systematically compared and analyzed data on 37 samples, and through condition scoring and rarity weighting calculations, identified a target silver coin in excellent condition. He then contacted collector friend Zhao Jianguo in Xi'an to discuss the purchase. Zhao Jianguo carefully reviewed the analysis data Ye Mingxuan sent and gave the high praise "[You've mastered the craft]." The two successfully concluded the deal. During the day, he finished the remaining finishing and drilling operations on the fixture in the workshop; in the evening, he did variable-speed running training, but because the purchase data analysis took longer than expected, the training was delayed by half an hour.

events.name: Complete the remaining finishing and drilling of the fixture
events.description: During the day in the workshop, Ye Mingxuan continued machining the fixture body. In the morning, he completed the remaining precision surface grinding, ensuring the flatness of the critical mating surfaces was within 0.01 mm. In the afternoon, he performed all drilling operations, including locating pin holes and threaded pilot holes, and after each hole was drilled, he used a measuring tool to check positional accuracy. Li Xiang continued simulation verification, and the two worked well together. After the day's machining was completed, Ye Mingxuan used an air gun to clean the chips and placed the workpiece in a rust-proof box for storage.

events.name: Performed a comparative data analysis of ancient coin samples
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan opened the 37 sample data entries he had organized the night before on his computer. Using a self-written scoring formula, he scored each silver coin on four dimensions: surface condition, patina completeness, edge tooth clarity, and number of surface scratches, then multiplied by the rarity weight based on the market circulation data Zhao Jianguo had shared earlier to obtain a composite score. After an hour of careful comparison, he identified sample [JN-1898-023] as having the highest composite score; its dragon pattern was crisp, the underlying luster was intact, and the edge teeth were complete—a rare example of excellent condition.

events.name: Communicated with fellow collector Zhao Jianguo and reached an acquisition agreement.
events.description: At 9 PM, Ye Mingxuan sent high-definition photos of the target silver coin, the four-dimension rating table, and the overall ranking to Xi'an collector friend Zhao Jianguo via WeChat, asking if he was interested in purchasing. After carefully reviewing the data, Zhao Jianguo replied, [Your analysis is more detailed than many seasoned collectors], and then gave the evaluation [You've mastered it]. The two briefly discussed a reasonable price range and reached a transaction agreement. Ye Mingxuan transferred the payment via mobile banking, and Zhao Jianguo confirmed receipt and said he would ship it tomorrow with SF Express insured delivery. Ye Mingxuan saved a screenshot of the conversation.

events.name: Record the collection archive and share
events.description: After the transaction, Ye Mingxuan added a new row to the personal collection archive Excel spreadsheet, entering the silver coin's variety number, condition grade, purchase price, transaction counterparty, and date. He took high-definition photos of the silver coin and data analysis screenshots with his phone, posted them to the [Machine-Struck Coins section] of the ancient coin collecting forum as a memento, and briefly added his acquisition notes. By the time he finished, it was almost 11 p.m., but he felt happy.

events.name: Evening interval run (postponed)
events.description: Because the data analysis and communication for the ancient coin acquisition took longer than expected, Ye Mingxuan postponed his originally scheduled 20:00 interval run to 21:30. He ran 8 sets of 200-meter fast-slow alternating intervals along Nan Canal Park, covering a total of 5 kilometers. Due to the late hour, he moderately reduced the intensity and focused on maintaining the training rhythm. After the run, he stretched briefly and went home.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, the fixture prototype entered the assembly stage. Ye Mingxuan manually assembled the components according to the assembly drawings, while Li Xiang helped check the fit clearances and record the data. After assembly, they ran manual operation tests to confirm that all moving parts moved smoothly. After work, he attended a personal training session; the coach did preventive training in advance for the physical fatigue that moving might cause. In the evening, he accompanied his father as he resumed a 3 km jog along the South Canal, and his father's blood pressure remained stable. After returning home, he contacted a moving company to book Saturday's service, then went to a nearby supermarket to buy packing materials for the move, and his mother also joined in to help organize kitchen items.

events.name: Manually assemble the fixture and test the smoothness of movement.
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan laid out the machined fixture body, locating pins, clamping blocks, springs, and other parts on the workbench and installed them one by one in the order shown on the assembly drawing. He first fixed the reference part with locating pins, then installed the movable clamping blocks and return springs in sequence, and finally tightened all the fastening screws. Li Xiang assisted by measuring the mating clearances, using a feeler gauge to check the gap values at key positions, and recording the data in the assembly record form. After assembly, Ye Mingxuan manually operated the clamping handle several times to observe whether the moving parts moved smoothly and without sticking. After confirming smooth motion and proper reset, he signed the assembly sheet and moved to the next stage.

events.name: Evening Personal Training Session
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan went to the Limei Fitness Center. Coach Wang Jian arranged a 1-hour preventive training session focused on the physical demands of moving, including core stability, lower back strength protection, and posture guidance for correctly lifting heavy objects. Ye Mingxuan carefully noted the key points.

events.name: Jogging with Dad to help him recover.
events.description: After the personal training session, he hurried home. At about 20:30, he went to South Canal Park with his father for a 3 km jog. Because last Saturday's dinner had been canceled and there was urgent work, this was the first time in nearly a week that he had run with his father. His father was in good condition, with blood pressure still maintained at 135/88 mmHg. After the run, the father and son chatted on a park bench, and Ye Mingxuan shared the story of how he had acquired his collection of ancient coins.

events.name: Contact a moving company and purchase packing materials

events.name: Sorting and packing together with mother
events.description: After returning home from shopping, Ye Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiulan wrapped infrequently used tableware, condiment bottles, and small appliances in bubble wrap in the kitchen and packed them into cardboard boxes. His mother was responsible for wrapping the porcelain, handling it with great care; Ye Mingxuan was in charge of packing and labeling, writing the contents and a [Fragile] notice on the outside of the boxes with a marker. During a break, his mother mentioned that some of these dishes and bowls were old items from her wedding years, and Ye Mingxuan listened with great interest. Afterwards, he sorted out the out-of-season clothes in the bedroom wardrobe on his own, compressed them into vacuum bags, and put them into large cardboard boxes.

2025-08.daily_overview: Thursday's work focus was the stress loading test verification of the fixture. Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang used a universal testing machine in the workshop to apply multi-level stress loading to the assembled fixture, collected strain data at key points, and compared them one by one with the previous simulation results. All test data were within the design allowable tolerance range, verifying the reliability of the design. The interval run originally scheduled for Wednesday was postponed to this morning because of the acquisition; Ye Mingxuan got up at 5:50 and completed a 400m x 8 interval run. In the afternoon, a shower disrupted his original plan to ventilate the new apartment, so he instead confirmed the moving company reservation details and notified the residential property management. In the evening, he organized his personal valuables.

events.name: Early-morning interval running workout
events.description: Woke up at 5:50 in the morning. After warming up, he went to the South Canal Park greenway for interval running training: alternating 400 meters of fast running (pace 4:50 per kilometer) with 200 meters of slow jogging recovery, for a total of 8 sets, covering about 5 kilometers. After finishing, he stretched thoroughly. This interval run was originally scheduled for Wednesday, but was postponed to today because of the ancient coin purchase. Overall, the quality was good and the target pace was achieved.

events.name: Complete the fixture stress loading test
events.description: At 9 a.m., Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang fixed the assembled precision fixture onto the universal testing machine. According to the test plan, a preload was first applied to eliminate gaps, then the loading force was increased step by step in 5 levels, holding each level for 30 seconds. Strain gauges were pre-attached at key stress-bearing parts of the fixture, and the data acquisition instrument recorded stress changes in real time. Li Xiang imported the experimental data into the software and compared it point by point with the previous finite element simulation results. The deviations at all measurement points were within 5%, within the allowable tolerance range of the design. Ye Mingxuan recorded in the test report '[Sample stress test passed, design reliability verification qualified]', and the two high-fived to mark the staged success.

events.name: Confirmed moving details and notified the property management office.
events.description: Before the afternoon shower began, Ye Mingxuan called the moving company again to confirm the specific arrangements for Saturday at 9 a.m., told them that both the old and new places had elevators, and discussed details such as furniture dimensions. Then he mentioned the property manager in the homeowners' WeChat group, informed them about the move on August 16, and asked whether a release pass or other procedures were needed. After the property replied to confirm, Ye Mingxuan set a reminder for moving day in his phone calendar.

events.name: Organize personal valuables.

He made a [self-carry list for the 16th] in his phone's memo app to make sure no important items were left out.

After work, Ye Mingxuan officially launched the moving and packing sprint, focusing on sorting out books, woodworking tools, and ancient coin collection. His mother helped tidy the bedroom, and his father took charge of the living room. Engineer Gao's praise brought a perfect end to the week's work, and the whole family's joint packing effort served as a prelude to the next day's move. Since moving was starting the next day, morning running and basketball training were suspended.

events.name: Gao Zhiyuan conducted an on-site review of the fixture sample and praised it.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan, Ye Mingxuan's direct superior, arrived at the workshop. Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang were already waiting at the workbench. Senior Engineer Gao carefully inspected the surface machining quality of the fixture sample, checked several key threaded holes with a thread gauge, and went through the assembly records and stress test report. He specifically compared the deviation range of the test data against the design requirements and nodded with satisfaction. [The schedule from design to prototype to testing was well controlled, and the data is clear,] Senior Engineer Gao said to Ye Mingxuan. [The project was managed well, and this sample lays a good foundation for the upcoming mass production.] Ye Mingxuan modestly said that Li Xiang's simulation verification was also crucial. After Gao Zhiyuan left, Ye Mingxuan wrote in the project log: [August 15: the sample passed the superior review, and mass production can be launched.]

events.name: Gathered and packed personal belongings.
events.description: After returning home from work at 5:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan changed out of his work clothes and began the final push before the move. He neatly packed all the mechanical engineering books from the bookshelf into two large cardboard boxes by size, sealed them with tape, and marked them “[Study – Books]”. The woodworking toolbox was placed intact into a sturdy medium-sized cardboard box, with bubble wrap stuffed into the gaps for shock absorption. Ancient coin albums, coin appraisal tools, and a magnifying glass were placed into a small storage box with locking clasps, marked “[Carry with me]”. His father helped gather Ye Mingxuan’s belongings in the living room, while his mother folded the remaining clothes from her son’s wardrobe in the bedroom, put them into a box, and added mothballs. By 9:30 p.m., except for a few items needed for tomorrow’s breakfast, his personal belongings were basically packed. Eight clearly labeled cardboard boxes and two suitcases were neatly arranged in the living room.

Several neighbors who had already moved in replied [Welcome], and Ye Mingxuan politely replied [Please look after me from now on].

2025-08.daily_overview: His 27th birthday coincided with the joy of moving to a new home, and Ye Mingxuan spent a ceremonial day in his new residence. In the early morning, he briefly admired his ancient coin collection as a birthday ritual; in the morning, he directed the moving company with his parents to complete the furniture placement; at noon, he took his parents to a time-honored copper-pot instant-boiled mutton restaurant to make up for last week's missed appointment; in the afternoon, he organized the kitchen and master bedroom; in the evening, he had dinner with his parents using the ingredients packed from lunch plus a few simple hot dishes; at night, he teamed up with online friends for gaming and received a custom skin gift.

events.name: Appreciating ancient coins on the morning of the birthday
events.description: Early in the morning in the study of the new home, Ye Mingxuan opened his collection box, took out several ancient coins he had recently collected, and examined them carefully, feeling their historical charm and patina texture as a ritual on his birthday. After about 15 minutes, he put the coins away.

events.name: Finishing the move and putting furniture back in place
events.description: At 8 a.m., the moving company truck arrived at the new residence downstairs at No. 128, Zhongbei Avenue. Ye Mingxuan and his father, Ye Jianguo, directed the workers downstairs as they moved the master bedroom bed, living room leather sofa, rosewood wardrobe, and large appliances from the old residence into the corresponding rooms one by one. His mother, Wang Xiulan, guided the workers in the new home to place the items properly and avoid scratching the newly laid wood floor and walls. By 11 a.m., the furniture was basically in place.

events.name: Celebrate the birthday with parents, enjoying copper-pot instant-boiled mutton.
events.description: Around noon, Ye Mingxuan invited his parents to a time-honored restaurant in Xiqing District that had been serving copper-pot hotpot for thirty years. When the steaming copper pot was brought to the table, he took the initiative to cook lamb slices for his father and picked vegetables for his mother, and sincerely apologized for missing the family dinner last Saturday due to handling an urgent production-line issue at the company. His father, Ye Jianguo, took a sip of baijiu and praised his recent ability to take charge in the project, while his mother smiled and reminded him to take care of his health. The family atmosphere was warm and lively.

events.name: Afternoon tidying of the kitchen and master bedroom
events.description: After a short rest following lunch, Ye Mingxuan and his parents began to systematically organize the kitchen and master bedroom. He placed dishes, seasonings, and cookware into the cabinets according to their usage flow. His mother was responsible for folding clothes and laying out bedding, while his father used a toolbox to adjust the hinges of the wardrobe doors. With the three of them dividing the work clearly, the new home gradually felt more lived-in.

events.name: The whole family had a simple meal to celebrate the housewarming and birthday.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan reheated the ingredients from the copper pot hotpot he had packed at noon, quickly stir-fried two vegetables, and prepared a table of home-style dishes. At seven in the evening, the family of three sat around in the living room of the new house under the lights. His parents raised their teacups to wish him a happy birthday and congratulate him on the housewarming. Ye Mingxuan served food to his parents, his heart full of expectations for this new stage of life.

events.name: Teaming up online and earning a custom skin.
events.description: After dinner and cleaning up the kitchen, Ye Mingxuan went back to the study and turned on the computer. At nine in the evening, friends including college roommate Liu Yang and gaming teammate Zheng Kai came online on time, and the five of them formed a team to play League of Legends. After the third round, Zheng Kai suddenly said in team voice chat that he had a birthday gift — based on the mortise-and-tenon wooden cabinet Ye Mingxuan had shown on Moments, he had designed a 'Soul of the Craftsman' skin in the game workshop as a gift for the team. Delighted, Ye Mingxuan posted the game screenshot on Moments with the caption: 'This is the most hardcore birthday skin I've ever received.' Soon, colleague Li Xiang commented, 'This skin has soul — the details are spot on.' The Moments post quickly collected a lot of likes and good wishes.

In the afternoon, he returned to working on the new home, creating a dedicated woodworking corner on the balcony and installing smart home devices throughout the house, switching naturally from his community-service role to his tech-enthusiast side.

events.name: Preliminary planning for a balcony woodworking corner in the early morning.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan took a tape measure and notebook to the balcony to measure the space, sketching a layout for the workbench and tool rack, planning a place for the newly arrived woodworking tools.

events.name: Visit Master Qian and accept the community teaching recommendation
events.description: At nine in the morning, Ye Mingxuan rode a shared bicycle to the home of Master Qian Jianguo in the neighboring district. In the workshop, Master Qian was sanding a small rosewood box with sandpaper while telling him that the neighborhood committee was looking for someone to teach a youth handicraft class. Ye Mingxuan remembered that he had promised something similar when registering at the community earlier in the year, so he readily agreed and thanked Master Qian for his trust and recommendation. Master Qian nodded with satisfaction and reminded him to pay attention to safety precautions in teaching. On the way, he ran into Auntie Wang, a neighbor, who greeted him warmly and asked concernedly about the move.

events.name: Go to the community committee to discuss teaching matters.
events.description: After leaving Master Qian's home, Ye Mingxuan went directly to the neighborhood committee. He talked in person with Director Li, who is in charge of cultural and sports activities, and confirmed that he would serve as the lead teacher for two trial sessions in the autumn. He carefully learned the key information: each session lasts one and a half hours, is aimed at teenagers aged 8 to 12, and the classroom is equipped with a projector and basic workbenches, but participants need to bring their own tools. He recorded it all in the memo on his phone.

events.name: Afternoon rain shower interrupted the shopping trip
events.description: At around 1 p.m., Ye Mingxuan headed to a nearby hardware store to buy tool rack accessories. On the way, a sudden shower hit, so he could only take shelter under the eaves of a convenience store for twenty minutes. He then checked the weather forecast on his phone and decided to go home first.

events.name: Set up a woodworking corner on the balcony
events.description: After the rain stopped in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan moved the solid wood workbench, which he had temporarily placed in the living room corner in the morning, to the balcony and positioned it. He used an electric drill to drill holes in the wall and install a tool rack, hung the handsaw, plane, chisel, file, and other tools on it according to how often they were used, and sorted sandpaper and glue into drawers. The balcony's fresh air system kept the space ventilated, and the work corner began to take shape. Satisfied, he placed a pot of succulent on the work surface as a finishing touch.

events.name: Whole-house smart home system installation and commissioning
events.description: After finishing the woodworking area, Ye Mingxuan took out the smart light control switch, smart speaker, and security camera kit he had bought earlier. He paired each device one by one with the phone app: he installed smart bulbs with adjustable color temperature in the living room and bedroom and tested the switches with voice commands; he placed the smart speaker on the TV cabinet in the living room and debugged the sound quality and wake-up response; finally, he installed the security camera above the entry door and set up motion detection alerts. His father, Ye Jianguo, watched from the side and marveled at the voice-controlled lighting.

start_state.location: Master bedroom of the new home, belongings basically in place after the move
start_state.mood: Feeling refreshed, ready to spend Sunday on woodworking and smart home tasks.

end_state.location: The woodworking corner on the new home's balcony has been set up, and the whole-house smart system has been debugged successfully.

2025-08.daily_overview: Monday started with the routine rhythm of a mechanical engineer, but in the evening an unexpected turn came when he opened a seafood gift sent by a friend. After tasting dried shrimp at night, he suddenly developed an acute allergic reaction — making it the most significant health turning point of the year for Ye Mingxuan. He had never expected to be severely allergic to seafood protein. After an emergency medical visit, the allergy was diagnosed, and from then on his dietary management would be completely rewritten.

events.name: Weekday commute and morning project follow-up
events.description: At 7:20 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan walked from his new home to the subway station, commuted by metro for about forty minutes, and arrived at his company on Haitai Development Sixth Road. In the morning, he first checked the approval status of the precision fixture trial production summary report submitted last week in the document system, and found that Gao Zhiyuan had commented: "The data is detailed and can serve as a basis for subsequent mass production." He then began working on the newly assigned design tasks.

events.name: In the evening, signed for the seafood package sent by Zheng Kai.
events.description: After work, he returned home. Around 6 PM, the doorbell rang. Ye Mingxuan signed for a foam insulated box delivered by an SF Express courier at his door. The sender address showed Shenzhen, and the sender was his gaming teammate Zheng Kai. He opened the package. Inside were neatly arranged Shenzhen specialties: fresh sea urchin, vacuum-packed dried shrimp, and dried scallops, along with a note that read, 'Happy birthday, Brother Ye. A little Shenzhen specialty. Next time we play, I'll use a new skin.'

events.name: Took a photo and posted it on Moments to thank for the gift.
events.description: Ye Mingxuan neatly arranged the seafood specialties on the dining table. The orange-red dried shrimp and the dark green sea urchin looked very appetizing under the light. He took a top-down photo with his phone, captioned it 'Sincere food delivery from my Shenzhen teammate, full of the taste of the sea,' and posted it on Moments to publicly thank Zheng Kai. After posting, he sent Zheng Kai a WeChat voice message, thanking him for the gift in a relaxed tone. Zheng Kai replied with a voice message saying there would be more surprises next time they teamed up, and the two agreed to team up for ranked games next weekend.

events.name: Had a sudden acute allergic reaction after tasting dried shrimp.
events.description: At around eight in the evening, Ye Mingxuan opened a package of dried shrimp and tried a few while watching TV. The dried shrimp were salty and crispy, and he thought he might have them with congee another day. However, about an hour later, he began to feel tingling and itching on his facial skin. Looking in the mirror, he found large red wheals on his cheeks and neck, and then his breathing became rapid with a noticeable tightening sensation in his throat. Ye Mingxuan immediately realized that he might be having a severe allergic reaction. His father heard the noise and came over, and immediately called 120.

events.name: Emergency first aid, hospital transport, and emergency department treatment
events.description: About fifteen minutes later, the ambulance arrived. On the way, the emergency medical personnel monitored Ye Mingxuan's blood oxygen saturation and asked about his food intake history. After arriving at the emergency department of Xiqing Hospital, the doctor quickly diagnosed a severe allergic reaction based on the symptoms, and immediately administered an intramuscular injection of epinephrine and an intravenous infusion of antihistamines. Half an hour later, the rash gradually subsided and his breathing gradually stabilized. Ye Mingxuan lay on the emergency observation bed, still feeling shaken.

start_state.location: At the new residence at No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, getting ready for work on Monday
start_state.mood: Work status is good, looking forward to interacting with online friends this evening.

end_state.location: Xiqing Hospital emergency observation ward, receiving vital signs monitoring.
end_state.mood: Relieved to be out of danger but still shaken, feeling confused and fearful about the sudden onset of the allergy.

state.daily_exercise: Commuted on foot about 6,000 steps, light exercise load

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, temperature rising to 30°C, good air quality.

2025-08.daily_overview: The allergy symptoms did not completely subside in the morning but instead flared up again, prompting Ye Mingxuan to return to the hospital for systematic treatment. That day he struggled to balance illness and work: in the morning he had further diagnosis at the hospital, after returning home and resting briefly he started designing the course outline for the community handicraft class, and in the evening he still managed to finish the final part of the project summary report, showing the resilience and orderliness of an ISTJ personality in adversity.

events.name: Noticed recurring allergy symptoms in the morning
events.description: After returning home from the hospital in the early morning and resting briefly, Ye Mingxuan woke up in the morning and found a few new rashes on his arms and abdomen. Although they were not as severe as last night, the itching was obvious, and he realized the allergy symptoms were not fully under control. His mother was very worried and cooked him plain congee for breakfast, avoiding any potentially allergenic foods.

events.name: Went to the Emergency Department of Xiqing Hospital again for treatment
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Ye Mingxuan took a taxi by himself to the emergency department of Xiqing Hospital. After learning about his condition the previous night, the attending doctor prescribed an additional oral anti-allergy medication and a topical calamine lotion to relieve itching from the rash, and arranged a blood draw for allergen screening. The doctor clearly told him that he strongly suspected seafood was the cause, and advised him to stop eating all shrimp, crab, shellfish, and other seafood and observe for at least a week. While waiting for the test results, he explained his condition to Project Manager Wang Peng via WeChat and applied for half a day of remote work.

events.name: Inform Zheng Kai about the allergy condition
events.description: While waiting to see the doctor, Ye Mingxuan sent Zheng Kai a WeChat message, trying to keep his tone light, telling him that he had an allergic reaction after eating the dried shrimp Zheng Kai had sent and was receiving treatment at the hospital. Zheng Kai was very surprised when he received the message and sent a series of voice messages to express his apologies and concern, telling Ye Mingxuan to rest well. Ye Mingxuan replied to reassure Zheng Kai that no one could have predicted this and their friendship would not be affected; it was just that next time, the gift could be changed to ordinary snacks.

events.name: After returning home, design the outline for the community handicraft class.
events.description: After returning home from the hospital, Ye Mingxuan opened his laptop in the study and started to design outlines for two trial sessions based on the information provided by Director Li. He consulted basic woodworking textbooks and online teaching resources and determined that the first session, themed "Understanding Wood and Making a Small Wooden Spoon," would cover wood identification, sandpaper use, and oiling and maintenance; the second session, themed "Advanced Small Furniture: My Own Little Stool," would introduce simple mortise-and-tenon structures and assembly steps. In the outline, he noted in detail the tools and consumables needed for each class.

events.name: Completed and submitted the project summary report in the evening
events.description: Around 8 p.m., despite still being somewhat tired and the rash itching affecting his concentration, Ye Mingxuan insisted on opening the company document management system to do the final organizing of the process parameters, test data, and modification records accumulated during the precision fixture trial production, adding the simulation analysis results attachment completed in collaboration with Li Xiang, writing a complete project summary report, and formally submitting it to the company document library. After clicking submit, he breathed a sigh of relief and made himself a cup of light honey water.

start_state.location: At home in the master bedroom, returned from the hospital in the early morning, still feeling weak
start_state.mood: Tired but alert, uneasy about the unknown allergen

end_state.location: Home study; project report submitted, first draft of the handicraft class outline completed.
end_state.mood: Although I felt unwell, my work efficiency did not suffer, and I was satisfied with the initial results of the course design.

2025-08.daily_overview: This was the day Ye Mingxuan's health faced its most severe test. During the day he handled work and Python community matters as usual, and in the evening went to the vegetable market to buy daily ingredients to prepare a home-cooked dinner for his parents. However, at around 7 p.m., a sudden delayed allergic reaction struck, with symptoms more severe than on August 18: a full-body rash, laryngeal edema, and difficulty breathing. His father urgently called 120 and took him to the emergency department of Tianjin People's Hospital. After emergency treatment with epinephrine and other measures, he was kept under observation. When the doctor asked about the dinner ingredients, they discovered that a newly purchased bottle of discounted soy sauce contained oyster extract, which was considered the culprit behind the second, more severe allergic reaction. Ye Mingxuan deeply realized that even if he avoided dried shrimp, seafood ingredients could be hidden in seasonings.

events.name: Morning: check the teaching aid inventory and purchase plan
events.description: Before going to work in the morning, Ye Mingxuan checked the craft class syllabus item by item and sorted out the list of teaching aids and consumables, including small saws, sandpaper, wood glue, protective gloves, pre-cut wood blocks, and more than ten other items. In the notes app on his phone, he marked the items already at home and those that needed to be purchased, planning to make supplementary purchases at the hardware market and stationery store over the weekend.

events.name: Signed up for the Python tech salon during the lunch break.
events.description: During the lunch break, Ye Mingxuan opened the registration page for the Tianjin Python Enthusiasts community's bimonthly tech salon on his company computer, filled in his personal information, and confirmed he would attend the offline salon on August 23 at a maker space in Nankai District. He then opened the family financial analysis Python script he had written, organizing its data scraping, classification statistics, and visualization report modules, preparing to make a sharing PPT.

events.name: After work, went to the vegetable market to buy daily groceries.
events.description: After getting off work at 5:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan took the subway to a large vegetable market near his residence. He planned to make a home-style non-seafood dinner for his parents and bought pork, pork ribs, cucumber, tomatoes, eggs, and other ingredients. He also grabbed a bottle of a new brand of discounted soy sauce without carefully checking the ingredient list.

events.name: A sudden delayed allergic reaction occurred after dinner
events.description: At around 7 p.m., while Ye Mingxuan was resting at home, he suddenly developed facial wheals and itchy skin. The condition then rapidly worsened to extensive rashes over the body, laryngeal edema, and difficulty breathing. The symptom progression was similar to August 18 but much more severe. His parents immediately realized it was a relapse of the allergy. His father tried to calm him while preparing to take him to the hospital.

events.name: His father made an emergency call to 120 and accompanied him to the hospital.
events.description: His father, Ye Jianguo, saw that his son’s symptoms were more severe than the day before and did not hesitate to call 120. While waiting for the ambulance, he followed the emergency dispatcher’s instructions, having Ye Mingxuan sit upright and lean forward to ease breathing, and reassured him not to panic. When the ambulance arrived, Ye Jianguo accompanied his son to the emergency department of Tianjin People's Hospital.

events.name: Emergency treatment and hospitalization at the People's Hospital
events.description: After arriving at the Emergency Department of the People's Hospital, the doctor quickly diagnosed anaphylactic shock (suspected delayed allergic reaction or contact with trace seafood ingredients) and immediately administered emergency measures including intramuscular epinephrine injection, oxygen therapy, and intravenous fluid replacement. Because the reaction was severe and related to a previous episode, the doctor required hospital observation to guard against a late-phase allergic reaction. Ye Mingxuan was transferred to the emergency observation ward, connected to a cardiac monitor, and received vital-sign monitoring throughout the night. During this time, the doctor asked about the detailed ingredients of dinner. When Ye Mingxuan mentioned that he had just bought a bottle of discounted soy sauce, the doctor asked his father to go home and take a photo of the ingredient list — the ingredients column clearly read [Oyster Extract]. This discovery sent a chill down Ye Mingxuan's spine. He had thought that avoiding dried shrimp would be safe, but had overlooked the seafood ingredients that might be hidden in seasonings.

start_state.location: At home, the rash has subsided but pigmentation remains.
start_state.mood: Cautiously optimistic; the body has recovered well on the surface, but potential risks were not taken seriously.

end_state.location: Emergency observation ward at Tianjin People's Hospital, receiving vital signs monitoring
end_state.mood: Extremely weak and scared in hindsight, I deeply realized the life-threatening danger of allergies and regretted not having taken the potential allergy risk seriously enough.

state.daily_exercise: Illness flare-up; no exercise all day.

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy, temperature 31°C, the ward air conditioning was cool and comfortable.

2025-08.daily_overview: The theme of the second day in the hospital was diagnosis confirmation and skill learning. In the morning, the doctor said his condition was stable. Family doctor Liu Wentao also arrived and held a joint consultation with the hospital. Through a skin prick test, they finally confirmed that shrimp and other crustacean seafood proteins were the main allergen, with sea urchin posing a risk of cross-allergy. In the afternoon, under guidance from the medical staff, Ye Mingxuan learned the life-saving skill of self-injecting with an epinephrine auto-injector. In the evening, during his parents' visit, he gave a detailed account of the terrifying emergency rescue process. His mother held his hand tightly and did not let go for a long time.

events.name: The doctor's ward round informed us that the condition is stable.
events.description: At 8 a.m., during ward rounds, the attending physician checked Ye Mingxuan's rash regression and blood count report, told him that his condition was stable and his vital signs were normal, and that discharge could be considered if there were no special changes tomorrow. Ye Mingxuan felt somewhat relieved but still had lingering fear about last night's ordeal.

events.name: Joint consultation between the family doctor and the allergy department
events.description: At around 10 a.m., the notified family doctor Liu Wentao came from the community hospital and held a joint consultation with Li Min, an allergist from the People's Hospital. Dr. Li asked in detail about the types of food, time intervals, and symptoms of the two allergic episodes, then performed a skin prick test on Ye Mingxuan—dropping more than ten common seafood protein extracts, including shrimp, crab, marine fish, and sea urchin, onto his forearm and gently pricking with a lancet. Fifteen minutes later, the shrimp test site showed obvious red swollen wheals (strongly positive), and the sea urchin test site showed a mild positive reaction. Dr. Li explained that shrimp is a crustacean seafood protein allergy, and although sea urchin is an echinoderm, it has a very high possibility of cross-allergy with shrimp, so both are prohibited. It was formally confirmed that shrimp and other crustacean seafood proteins are allergens, and sea urchin and similar items also carry a risk of cross-allergy and are banned for life.

events.name: Learning Self-Injection with an Epinephrine Pen
events.description: In the afternoon in the ward, the allergy department nurse brought Ye Mingxuan a training epinephrine auto-injector simulator and demonstrated the operation in detail: pull off the safety cap, grip the pen body with a fist, press firmly against the middle of the outer thigh and hold for ten seconds. After watching carefully, Ye Mingxuan practiced three times with the simulator under the nurse's guidance until he was proficient. The nurse also explained the best injection timing—use it immediately as soon as you feel throat tightness or shortness of breath—and that after injection, you still need to call emergency medical services for follow-up support.

events.name: Evening visit from parents and full account of the first-aid incident
events.description: In the evening, his father Ye Jianguo and mother Wang Xiulan arrived at the ward carrying insulated lunch boxes containing millet porridge carefully cooked by his mother and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. While eating, Ye Mingxuan recounted in detail the complete events of the previous night — from the thrilling moment of eagerly cooking sea urchin steamed egg to suddenly feeling throat swelling and difficulty breathing, to the warm strength of his father holding his hand in the ambulance. After hearing this, Wang Xiulan's eyes reddened, and she tightly held her son's hand, repeatedly urging him to be extremely careful in the future and never to put any seafood he could not name into his mouth. Ye Mingxuan solemnly promised to strictly avoid such foods from now on.

start_state.location: Tianjin People's Hospital Emergency Observation Ward.
start_state.mood: Weak but relieved; hope to quickly confirm the allergen and learn how to deal with it

end_state.location: At the emergency observation ward of Tianjin People's Hospital, has learned emergency self-injection skills.
end_state.mood: Heavy but clear: accepted the reality of a lifelong ban on seafood and determined to strictly follow the dietary management.

2025-08.daily_overview: Discharge day was also the starting point for rebuilding Ye Mingxuan's dietary management system. In the morning, he completed the discharge procedures and got the prescription for an epinephrine auto-injector. After returning home, he did a thorough allergen cleanup of the kitchen with his parents, put a bright red list of forbidden foods on the refrigerator door, installed a food ingredient lookup app on his phone, and sent dietary reminders to all the friends and relatives he often met. In the evening, as arranged, he met up with his travel buddy Wu Bin, who was on a business trip to Tianjin, at a barbecue stall near the university town. The two upgraded their self-driving dream from Qinghai Lake to the Qinghai-Tibet route and created a detailed preparation checklist. After the gathering, he went home and practiced his presentation for the next day, staying busy until late at night.

events.name: Completed discharge procedures and obtained the prescription.
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan completed the discharge settlement at the nurse station. Dr. Li Min solemnly wrote on the discharge orders: "Lifelong ban on all seafood and seafood products (including but not limited to fish, shrimp, crab, shellfish, sea urchin, fish roe, kelp, nori, etc.). When dining out, be sure to confirm the ingredients of dishes and carry an epinephrine auto-injector at all times." She also wrote a prescription for the epinephrine auto-injector and urged him to buy it at the pharmacy as soon as possible. Ye Mingxuan carefully folded the discharge orders and put them in his wallet.

events.name: Returning home and thoroughly cleaning kitchen allergens
events.description: After being discharged, Ye Mingxuan took a taxi back to his home at No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue. After a brief rest, he asked his mother to join him in a thorough check of the kitchen: they opened all the cabinets and the refrigerator, and took out the remaining dried shrimp and dried scallops sent by Zheng Kai, along with the oyster sauce and shrimp oil that contained seafood ingredients. He picked up the bag of dried shrimp from which only a few had been used and paused for two seconds—Zheng Kai's kindness had become the main cause of his hospitalization, a complicated feeling. But then, recalling the doctor's stern warning, he resolutely put it into the discard bag. The dried seafood was all placed in sealed bags and thrown away, and the seafood-containing seasonings were also sealed up. He then found the foods-to-avoid list template on his phone, added the easily overlooked seafood such as kelp and laver that the doctor had stressed, and after printing it, stuck it in a prominent spot on the refrigerator door.

events.name: Installed a food composition lookup app and sent a group notification.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan searched on his phone and installed an authoritative food composition query app. He tested scanning the barcodes of several common foods to confirm the database worked. Then he composed a WeChat message briefly explaining that he had been diagnosed with a seafood allergy and would have to avoid all seafood and seafood products for life, including two easily overlooked examples (oyster sauce and fish sauce), and asked that everyone avoid seafood dishes at future group meals. He sent the message to his parents, colleagues Li Xiang and Zhou Tao, classmates Zhao Xiaofeng and Sun Jing, and other key contacts.

events.name: Received replies from relatives and friends and explained one by one
events.description: After the message was sent, replies came in one after another: Li Xiang replied, “Got it. From now on, I'll specifically look for Sichuan restaurants for gatherings.” Zhou Tao sent a surprised emoji and said, “Good thing it's not a beef or lamb allergy.” His mother replied, “I'll be extra careful when buying groceries in the future.” Ye Mingxuan replied to each of them to thank them for their concern, and once again confirmed the next meal arrangements with everyone.

events.name: Contact hiking buddy Wu Bin to confirm the gathering tonight
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan sent a WeChat message to Wu Bin, his travel buddy who was on a business trip in Tianjin, confirming they would meet in the evening at the long-established barbecue stall near the university town they had talked about before. He also told him in advance that he had just been discharged from the hospital and needed to strictly avoid seafood. Wu Bin replied, 'Don't worry, we'll just have the most authentic lamb skewers.'

events.name: In the evening, a small barbecue gathering with Wu Bin to plan the Qinghai-Tibet route.
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, Ye Mingxuan met Wu Bin at an open-air barbecue stall near the university town. Wu Bin was in Tianjin on a business trip and took the opportunity to survey the outdoor equipment market in northern China, while Ye Mingxuan was going out for a gathering for the first time since being discharged from the hospital. As they ate lamb skewers and grilled vegetables, they pointed and swiped on a phone map, fully upgrading their previously planned Qinghai Lake small loop into a self-driving plan for the Qinghai-Tibet route for summer 2026. Wu Bin shared an off-road tent he had just tested, and Ye Mingxuan created a document in his phone notes called 'Geek Travel - Qinghai-Tibet Trip Preparation Checklist', with the first item marked 'vehicle selection reserve fund', and then recorded in turn the required equipment, estimated budget, and precautions for key road sections.

events.name: Refine the preparation checklist after returning home
events.description: After the gathering ended at nine in the evening, Ye Mingxuan returned home, synced the Qinghai-Tibet trip preparation checklist from his phone memos to his laptop, detailed the monthly amount to save for the dedicated car purchase fund (referencing the price of his ideal model, estimated to be achievable in about 3 to 4 years), listed essential items such as off-road tires, recovery boards, and a high-altitude medicine kit, and set a reminder on the 28th of each month to review savings progress.

events.name: Speech practice to prepare for the Python salon sharing
events.description: To make sure his sharing at the technical salon the day after tomorrow was smooth and informative, Ye Mingxuan did a mock presentation of about thirty minutes in the study facing the computer screen, tested the PPT transition rhythm, adjusted two code examples that might confuse the audience, and set a fifteen-minute time reminder for himself.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to returning to a normal life, with a clear understanding of lifelong dietary restrictions

end_state.location: In the home study; the kitchen has no trace of seafood, and the Qinghai-Tibet route preparation checklist has been created.

2025-08.daily_overview: Saturday was a highly productive day. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan took the course outline to Master Qian to ask for teaching tips and borrowed tools, then set up the automatic transfer plan for car-buying savings. In the afternoon, he took the subway to Nankai District to attend a Python enthusiast tech salon, where he successfully shared his practical case of using Python to manage family finances and was invited to join a data analysis project collaboration group. On the way back, he stopped to buy ingredients and decorations for the next day's housewarming party. In the evening, he thoroughly cleaned the new home and arranged the ambiance, and after returning home, he demonstrated how to use the epinephrine auto-injector to his parents.

events.name: Morning recovery brisk-walking training
events.description: Early in the morning, following the discharge instructions, Ye Mingxuan did a 15-minute brisk walk along the South Canal Park greenway, keeping his heart rate around 100-110 bpm. He felt fine and had no discomfort.

events.name: Visiting Master Qian to ask about teaching and borrow tools
events.description: At nine in the morning, Ye Mingxuan went to Master Qian Jianguo's home with the printed course outline and a list of teaching materials. Master Qian put on his reading glasses, carefully went through the outline, and affirmed the course structure. He particularly stressed the safety rules for the hands-on session—demonstrating the correct way to hold a small saw and the precautions for using sandpaper. Before Ye left, Master Qian took out two small hand saws suitable for teenagers and a box of sandpaper in various grits from his tool cabinet, lent them to Ye Mingxuan, and they agreed to prepare the next lesson together.

events.name: Set up automatic transfer for car purchase savings

Based on the Qinghai-Tibet route preparation plan he had refined the previous night, he calculated the monthly amount he could set aside for the car purchase reserve fund. He set up a recurring instruction to automatically transfer money from his salary card to a dedicated savings account on the 1st of each month, with the first transfer to be made in September.

events.name: In the afternoon, went to Nankai District to attend a tech salon.
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan left home and took Metro Line 3 to a maker space on Baidi Road, Nankai District. The August afternoon sun was scorching; he bought a bottle of water at the metro station and drank it as he walked. About half an hour later he arrived, signed in, and entered.

events.name: Python Technical Salon Sharing and Networking
events.description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, at the bimonthly Python enthusiast community tech salon, Ye Mingxuan took the stage as the third speaker. He spent about twenty minutes demonstrating his scripts that use Python to scrape bank and payment platform transaction records, automatically categorize expenses, and generate monthly visual reports, explaining the data processing logic with real cases. Afterward, during the open exchange session, he had in-depth conversations with several other local developers about toolchain choices for data analysis. A developer who worked on e-commerce data analysis invited him on the spot to join a Python collaboration project aimed at developing an open-source data analysis toolkit. Ye Mingxuan readily agreed and they exchanged WeChat contacts.

events.name: Purchase ingredients and decorations for the housewarming party.
events.description: After the salon ended, Ye Mingxuan went to the vegetable market and supermarket near his home, carefully checked the ingredient lists of every seasoning to make sure they contained no seafood, and bought pork belly, ribs, fresh vegetables and fruit, as well as drinks and snacks. He also picked out a few small potted plants and a set of warm-colored string lights in the household goods area, planning to decorate the balcony.

events.name: Cleaning the new home and setting up the atmosphere for the gathering
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Ye Mingxuan thoroughly cleaned the new home from top to bottom—mopping the floor, wiping the windows, and cleaning the bathroom. He then placed the ancient coin collection box and several miniature woodworking pieces given by Master Qian in the living room display cabinet, and wrapped the newly bought string lights around the balcony railing. The warm yellow glow instantly made the balcony leisure area cozy.

events.name: Purchased an epinephrine auto-injector and instructed his parents on how to use it.
events.description: After cleaning, Ye Mingxuan went to a pharmacy near home with the prescription and bought two epinephrine auto-injectors. Back home, he called his parents to the living room, opened the instructions, and used the training pen to demonstrate how to use the device—how to remove the safety cap, how to hold it, and how to inject accurately into the middle of the outer thigh and hold for ten seconds. He guided his parents to recognize the three key signs of an allergic attack (large areas of rash spreading quickly, swelling of the lips and eyelids, and breathing distress), and had his father do a simulated operation with the training pen. His mother was a bit nervous but also remembered the general steps.

events.name: Update the financial script to add an allergy medication category
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan opened the home finance Python script, added a new 'allergy emergency medication' category under expenses, entered the purchase amount for the epinephrine auto-injector, and reserved funds in the monthly budget for future periodic replacements. He also recorded the process of checking dish ingredients during the barbecue meal out that day in his diet log for the first time.

2025-08.daily_overview: Sunday housewarming party day. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan joined the collaboration project group chat he had been invited to the day before and completed initial communication, then spent the rest of the morning meticulously preparing ingredients. At 4 p.m., colleagues Li Xiang and Zhou Tao arrived as promised. The three enjoyed the ancient coin collection in the new home, toured the woodworking corner, and in the evening Ye Mingxuan personally cooked a sumptuous seafood-free dinner. After dinner, they moved to the balcony to drink tea and chat. Zhou Tao and Li Xiang once again urged him to serve as captain of the company badminton team. After the gathering ended, Ye Mingxuan cleaned up the tableware alone until late at night, and before bed he formulated a technical plan for crawling the ancient coin catalog website.

events.name: Early morning brisk walk at South Canal Park
events.description: At seven in the morning, Ye Mingxuan went to South Canal Park for a 20-minute brisk walk, gradually raising his heart rate and feeling that his recovery was going well. On the way, he met his neighbor Uncle Zhang walking his dog and had a brief chat.

events.name: Joined the Python collaboration project group chat
events.description: At eight in the morning, Ye Mingxuan received a WeChat invitation from the e-commerce data analyst he met yesterday and joined a WeChat group called the “DataTools Open Source Project.” In the group, he gave a brief self-introduction, learned that the project's general direction was to develop a series of data processing toolkits for non-professional users, and initially took on a development task for an automated CSV file cleaning module.

events.name: Fine preparation of ingredients in the morning
events.description: After joining the group chat, Ye Mingxuan tied on an apron and went into the kitchen to prepare ingredients. He blanched the pork belly and cut it into even cubes for braising, marinated the ribs in his secret sauce to make garlic spare ribs, washed and cut the vegetables for stir-frying, and scaled and gutted the sea bass, adding ginger slices to marinate away the fishy smell. He also made a large bowl of colorful fruit salad in advance and put it in the refrigerator. In the kitchen, the rhythmic sound of the knife on the cutting board rose and fell one after another, and he checked all the seasonings again to ensure none contained seafood ingredients.

events.name: Afternoon thundershowers interrupted the balcony arrangement.
events.description: A little after 2 p.m., as Ye Mingxuan was about to arrange potted plants on the balcony, a sudden thunderstorm hit. Large raindrops pattered on the balcony awning, so he quickly brought the string lights that could get wet indoors. After the rain stopped, he wiped the balcony table and chairs with a dry cloth.

events.name: Welcoming Li Xiang and Zhou Tao for a visit to the new home
events.description: At around 4 p.m., Li Xiang and Zhou Tao arrived on time at No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue. Ye Mingxuan warmly welcomed them at the door and led them through the rooms one by one: in the living room he demonstrated the smart speaker's voice control and adjustable color-temperature lighting; on the balcony he introduced his handmade woodworking corner and the half-finished camphor wood box on the workbench; finally, in the study he opened the camphor wood collection box and let them examine a few fine modern machine-struck coins. Li Xiang marveled at the edge-teeth details of a silver coin bearing a portrait of Yuan Shikai.

events.name: Cook the housewarming dinner
events.description: Just after five in the evening, Ye Mingxuan put on an apron and started cooking. The braised pork belly simmered in the clay pot with a rich aroma. The steamed sea bass was taken out at exactly seven minutes and drizzled with hot oil. Alongside garlic spare ribs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, he also prepared a small serving of spicy mala hot pot for Zhou Tao, who loves spicy food. Around 6:30, a table full of hearty dishes with no seafood was set.

events.name: The three had dinner together and chatted freely
events.description: The three sat down at the table. Li Xiang took a bite of the braised pork and praised the perfect cooking. Zhou Tao wiped sweat while eating mala xiangguo. Ye Mingxuan deliberately brought up the seafood restriction, and both of them expressed understanding and cooperation. During the meal, they talked about the company recently preparing for the autumn sports league. Li Xiang revealed that a mixed badminton team event had been added. Zhou Tao interjected that Ye Mingxuan was the most organized person and the best candidate for team captain. Ye Mingxuan smiled and served food to the two, without giving a definite answer.

events.name: Tea chat on the balcony and being urged again to form a team.
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan brewed a pot of Tieguanyin tea, and the three of them moved to the balcony to enjoy the cool evening air. The night breeze dispelled the heat of the day, and the warm glow of the string lights made the balcony especially cozy. Li Xiang once again seriously suggested that Ye Mingxuan step up and form a department badminton team for the autumn league, saying that with his project management skills, he was more than capable of leading the team. This time Ye Mingxuan's tone softened a little, saying he would think it over carefully and give an answer next week.

events.name: Seeing off guests and tidying up.
events.description: Around ten in the evening, Li Xiang and Zhou Tao got up to leave. Ye Mingxuan saw them to the door, and the three agreed to meet next time for dinner at the new Sichuan restaurant near the office. After seeing the guests off, Ye Mingxuan spent more than half an hour clearing the table, washing dishes, packing leftovers into containers and putting them in the refrigerator, and mopping the kitchen floor. Once the new home was tidy again, he sat on the sofa and rested for a while.

events.name: Before bed, make a web crawler plan for the ancient coin catalog.
events.description: Before going to bed, Ye Mingxuan opened his laptop and created a new project document. He designed the data requirements for scraping a well-known ancient coin catalog forum — collecting fields such as coin images for each variety, variety number, minting year, and condition grade — and preliminarily designed the SQLite database table structure. He then contacted his programming study buddy Xu Ming via WeChat to ask whether the idle cloud server he had mentioned earlier still had space. Xu Ming quickly replied to confirm that he could provide an SSH key and about 20 GB of storage quota. Ye Mingxuan thanked him and planned to start writing the crawler script tomorrow.

start_state.location: At home, preparing to welcome colleagues for the housewarming party.
start_state.mood: In a joyful mood, looking forward to sharing the warmth of the new home with good friends.

end_state.location: The new house gathering has ended and everything has been tidied up; the ancient coin crawler plan has been made.
end_state.mood: Satisfied and encouraged; the gathering with colleagues deepened friendships, and the invitation to form a team made him seriously consider new potential roles.

2025-08.daily_overview: At the stock market opening on Monday, Ye Mingxuan got a rough wake-up call: A-shares fell sharply, causing an obvious drawdown in the equity-oriented funds he held. At noon he urgently contacted his financial manager, Zhang Wei, to discuss countermeasures. Zhang Wei suggested deciding whether to cut positions based on capital needs, and Ye Mingxuan needed a night to process it. His work schedule remained tight—in the morning he saw the notice for the union sports league, and during lunch break Li Xiang and Zhou Tao again urged him to form a team, so he kept weighing the options during work breaks. In the evening, he turned his anxiety into action and started writing the first version of a crawler script for the ancient coin catalog, and stayed up all night studying market news and fund volatility.

events.name: In the morning, followed the sharp drop in A-shares.
events.description: During the morning commute, Ye Mingxuan habitually opened the finance app on his phone and saw that the Shanghai Composite Index plunged sharply at the open. After arriving at the office, he continued to watch the market trend during work breaks. Seeing that the heavily weighted sectors of the two equity-oriented funds he held were among the biggest decliners, his mood gradually became heavy.

events.name: Urgent discussion with financial manager Zhang Wei at noon.
events.description: During the lunch break, Ye Mingxuan opened mobile banking on his phone to check the real-time net value estimate of his fund holdings. Confirming that his account had seen a drawdown of nearly 8%, his anxiety increased. In the afternoon after the market opened, he contacted Zhang Wei, the wealth manager at China Merchants Bank, via WeChat, sent a screenshot of the fund net values and briefly explained the situation, asking whether he should stop losses or adjust his holdings. Zhang Wei called back about half an hour later and, after calm analysis, suggested: if Ye Mingxuan lacks confidence in the market outlook and has significant capital needs or fluctuations in the near term, he could consider reducing some of the heavily concentrated equity-biased funds and switch to short-bond products with strong liquidity and low drawdown to control risk; if he has no capital needs, he could wait and see. Ye Mingxuan said he needed a night to digest the advice and agreed to reply with his decision the next day.

events.name: Check the labor union sports league notice
events.description: In the morning, a formal notice about the company union's autumn sports league popped up in his work email. Ye Mingxuan opened it and saw the newly added mixed badminton team event, scheduled for late September. He forwarded it to Li Xiang while reading and thinking.

events.name: During the lunch break, I was again asked to serve as badminton team captain.
events.description: During the lunch break, Li Xiang and Zhou Tao carried their trays over and sat down across from Ye Mingxuan. Li Xiang pointed at the league notice on his phone and urged him again to form a badminton team. Zhou Tao chimed in, saying that Ye Mingxuan was the most organized person and best suited to be captain, coordinating training and match arrangements. Ye Mingxuan admitted he was indeed tempted, but said he needed to carefully weigh his workload against the organizational energy required to lead the team, and would give a definite answer within the week.

events.name: Repeatedly weighed the team captain role during work breaks
events.description: During an afternoon break, Ye Mingxuan repeatedly weighed in his mind the time that leading the team might take: at least one training session per week, plus coordinating venues, managing the WeChat group, and studying competition rules. But he also thought that this was a rare chance to practice soft leadership and might earn him extra points in future promotion evaluations. He listed the pros and cons in his memo, and the scales gradually tipped toward accepting.

events.name: In the evening, wrote smoke tests for the ancient coin crawler script.
events.description: After work in the evening, when he got home and had dinner, Ye Mingxuan set up a local development environment in his study. He wrote a crawler script using Python's requests and BeautifulSoup libraries to parse the list and detail pages of the Ancient Coin Atlas Forum, extracting fields such as variety name, image link, era, and condition description. After completing the single-page crawling logic, he ran smoke tests on a few test pages and successfully extracted the expected data. He plans to continue improving pagination fetching and local storage tomorrow evening.

start_state.mood: Energetic, but the stock market opening immediately brought concern

end_state.location: At home study, the initial version of the crawler script passed the smoke test.
end_state.mood: He felt a vague anxiety over fund losses, but the technical progress of the crawler and the approach of the team leader's decision brought some sense of direction; at the same time, he stayed up all night repeatedly checking market news and investment forum posts, and used Python to run a simple fund volatility comparison script to assist the analysis, preparing for the next day's position adjustment decision.

2025-08.daily_overview: Tuesday brought major financial adjustments. After a night of thought and observation, Ye Mingxuan decided to accept Zhang Wei's suggestion and decisively redeemed a total of 45,000 yuan from two equity funds with severe drawdowns, switching to two pure bond funds and one money market ETF, which is expected to reduce the portfolio's volatility by about 40%. In the evening, he fully synced the new holdings to his Python financial dashboard. On the same day, he also formally made up his mind to accept the position of badminton team captain, and in the evening ran a crawler to complete a full data scrape of the ancient coin catalog website.

events.name: Checked the fund trends again in the morning and decided to rebalance the portfolio.
events.description: During a break in the morning work, Ye Mingxuan checked the fund net values and market analysis again. Although the broader market showed signs of stabilizing, the overall trend was still unclear. After a night of thought and data analysis, he decided to adopt Zhang Wei's position-reduction plan and proactively adjusted the family asset allocation to reduce risk exposure.

events.name: Confirmed the position adjustment plan with Zhang Wei by phone at noon.
events.description: During the lunch break, Ye Mingxuan proactively called Zhang Wei and discussed in detail the feasibility of redeeming equity-biased funds and switching to fixed-income products. Based on his risk tolerance, Zhang Wei suggested redeeming two equity-biased funds with concentrated holdings and switching to two pure bond funds with well-controlled historical drawdowns and one highly liquid currency ETF. After agreeing on the plan, Ye Mingxuan thanked him and hung up.

events.name: Executed fund redemption and reinvestment operations.
events.description: After the afternoon market opened, Ye Mingxuan submitted redemption requests for two equity-biased funds one after another via the China Merchants Bank mobile app (total amount 45,000 yuan), and confirmed the expected arrival time of the funds. He then used the available money market fund balance to subscribe to two pure bond funds and one money market ETF, completing this urgent adjustment of the investment portfolio. After the adjustment, the proportion of fixed-income assets in the emergency reserve rose to about 60%.

events.name: Update the Python financial dashboard in the evening
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Ye Mingxuan opened the family financial dashboard Python program he had written, entered the newly purchased fund codes, shares, and costs into the database one by one, and recalculated the account's total assets and portfolio volatility (expected to drop about 40% from before the adjustment). He added an 'emergency fund progress bar' module to the dashboard, visualizing the progress toward the goal of reserving six months of living expenses.

events.name: Formally decided to serve as the badminton team captain.
events.description: After weighing it repeatedly yesterday, Ye Mingxuan told Li Xiang and Zhou Tao at the company in the morning that he had decided to accept the captain position. The two clapped in approval, and Li Xiang immediately said he would be the first to sign up. Ye Mingxuan began drafting a plan for forming the team.

events.name: In the evening, run the crawler to scrape all ancient coin data.
events.description: In the evening, after updating the financial dashboard, Ye Mingxuan launched the prepared crawler script to do a full crawl of the ancient coin catalog website. The script traversed the listing pages one by one and parsed the detail links, obtaining hundreds of entries of coin image-and-text data. During the crawl he monitored the terminal output, handled two request blocks caused by the website's anti-crawling strategy, and after adjusting the request interval, completed it successfully. All raw data was saved to a local temporary directory.
