start_state.mood: Disappointed about the fund losses, but the decision is gradually becoming clearer.

end_state.location: In the home study, investment portfolio adjustment completed, and all the ancient coin catalog data was successfully scraped.
end_state.mood: Grounded and orderly; financial tightening brought a sense of security, and the successful team formation and web crawler success added a sense of accomplishment.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Ye Mingxuan demonstrated the efficiency of multitasking. In the morning, he formally raised the proportion of fixed-income assets in the emergency reserve to 60%. Then, during the weekday lunch break, he and Li Xiang officially started forming a team — drafting invitation emails and sending them to colleagues in the Design Department and the Simulation Team; by the afternoon, they had gathered six team members and set up a training group. After work, he looked up information on badminton courts near the company to prepare for booking. In the evening, he cleaned and stored the scraped ancient coin data into a database, built a SQLite database containing hundreds of records, and, with Xu Ming's help, uploaded the data and image library to a cloud server to enable API access.

events.name: Morning brisk walk and confirm the proportion of fixed-income assets meets the target.
events.description: After getting up early, Ye Mingxuan first went to South Canal Park for a 20-minute brisk walk. When he got home, he checked mobile banking and confirmed that all the fund shares he purchased yesterday had been confirmed. After calculating, he found that the proportion of fixed-income assets in the family emergency reserve had reached the previously set 60% target. He made a brief asset allocation note in his notebook and decided not to make further adjustments in the short term.

events.name: Launched recruitment for forming the badminton team at noon
events.description: During the lunch break, Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang quickly discussed the recruitment scope by their workstations—initially targeting colleagues from the design department and the simulation group, with the goal of forming at least five players. Ye Mingxuan then drafted a concise invitation email on his computer, explaining the intention to form a departmental badminton team for the autumn league and the initial training plan. The tone of the email was friendly and professional—he recalled his experience organizing a flood response team in the homeowners' group last month. He used concise bullet points to list training goals, time expectations, and equipment suggestions, and ended with an encouraging closing line: "Everyone is welcome regardless of skill level." The email was sent to the relevant colleagues.

events.name: Replies to the registration have been arriving, and the list has been confirmed.
events.description: After the email was sent, replies came in one after another from colleagues in the Design Department and the Simulation Group. Zhou Tao was the first to reply, "Ready at any time," and two cross-department colleagues whom Ye Mingxuan had worked with before also expressed interest. By the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang had summarized and confirmed that a total of six people (including himself) were willing to join the team, just meeting the basic lineup requirement for the mixed team event.

events.name: Create a team training WeChat group.
events.description: After the roster was confirmed, Ye Mingxuan created a group chat on WeChat named "Haitai Badminton Team Training Group" and invited all six members into it. He posted a group announcement briefly explaining the league schedule, training goals, and that the first training session was tentatively scheduled for next week, asking everyone to watch for the subsequent court booking notice. Members in the group replied "received" one after another, and the atmosphere was lively.

events.name: Checked badminton court information after work
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan opened map and review apps on his phone, searched for badminton venues near the company and in Xiqing District, and recorded each venue's location, price, opening hours, and reservation method. He planned to compare them and pick two or three candidate venues for team members to vote on.

events.name: Evening web crawler data cleaning and database building
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan deduplicated and standardized the raw data crawled yesterday, extracted fields from the image files and text descriptions of each coin, and marked key features such as variety, era, condition, and size. He then used SQLite to build an ancient coin feature database containing hundreds of records, and wrote a simple Python query interface for easy retrieval by era or variety.

events.name: Upload to the cloud server and configure the API.
events.description: After the database was established, Ye Mingxuan used the SCP command to package and upload the local database files and image library to the cloud server provided by Xu Ming. He configured Nginx and uvicorn on the server side so that the data could be queried via a REST API. After deployment, he tested the API interface in a browser. When he saw the returned JSON data, he took a screenshot and sent it to Xu Ming to report success, and thanked him again for the server support.

start_state.location: At home, starting an orderly day
start_state.mood: A reassured feeling after the asset adjustment, eager to get started on forming the team.

end_state.location: Home study, the ancient coin database is now online and accessible.
end_state.mood: Fulfilling and satisfying—both the sports team and the database project made substantial progress.

2025-08.daily_overview: Thursday was focused on the final sprint of preparations for the community handicraft class. In the morning, Ye Mingxuan confirmed that the adjustment of fixed-income assets was fully in place. In the afternoon, after sorting out the preparation progress document, he confirmed the evening online meeting time with Master Qian and community Director Li via WeChat. At 8 p.m., the three parties communicated through Tencent Meeting and confirmed that the first trial lecture was set for Sunday morning, September 7, for teenagers aged 8 to 12, with content on making simple wooden toys. In the evening, after the preparations were done, he put on his running shoes and went for his first 3-kilometer jog after being discharged from the hospital. Although the pace was slow, it signaled the return of his physical condition.

events.name: Morning confirmation that the fixed-income asset adjustment is in place.
events.description: Before work in the morning, Ye Mingxuan did a quick asset check through the China Merchants Bank app, confirming that the goal set at the beginning of the month to raise the fixed-income allocation to 60% had been fully achieved. He updated this month's household financial data in his phone notepad and marked the task as completed.

events.name: Organize the preparation progress document for the handicraft class.
events.description: During his lunch break, Ye Mingxuan compiled the previously designed course outline, teaching materials list, venue requirements, and community communication records into a PDF preparation progress document. The document clearly listed completed items and items still to be finalized. He then confirmed the evening online meeting time separately with Master Qian Jianguo and Community Director Li via WeChat.

events.name: Test evening meeting equipment
events.description: After getting home from work in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan checked the laptop's camera and microphone, tested the Tencent Meeting link availability in advance, and placed the preparation progress document on the desktop for use when sharing the screen.

events.name: Three-party online meeting to finalize the arrangements for the first trial lecture
events.description: At 8 p.m., Ye Mingxuan entered the Tencent Meeting room from his study on time. Master Qian and Director Li also came online. Ye Mingxuan shared his screen and reported on the course design, material preparation, and venue requirements. Director Li coordinated and confirmed the weekend usage time for the community activity room, while Master Qian gave several specific suggestions on tool-use safety and course pacing. After discussion, the three determined that the first trial lecture would be held on September 7 (Sunday) from 9:30 to 11:00 a.m., for young people aged 8 to 12. The content would be "Making a Simple Wooden Toy — Marble Maze Box", as suggested by Master Qian, a topic that was both interesting and safe.

events.name: Resumed jogging training in the evening.
events.description: After the online meeting, Ye Mingxuan changed into his gear and went to the South Canal Park greenway for his first jog since leaving the hospital. Following the doctor's advice to progress gradually, he jogged 3 kilometers at a pace of 6:30 per kilometer, keeping his heart rate below 150 bpm. After finishing, he felt good and had no breathing discomfort, taking an important step toward rebuilding his fitness.

events.name: Buy Tianjin specialties to thank Xu Ming
events.description: After jogging, Ye Mingxuan remembered that he had not yet thanked Xu Ming for providing the cloud server free of charge. He rode a shared bike to a nearby time-honored fried dough twist shop that had been operating for decades, bought a box of authentic Tianjin 18th Street fried dough twists, and after returning home placed an order through the SF Express mini-program to have them delivered to Xu Ming's address in Shenzhen. He also sent the tracking number to Xu Ming on WeChat with the message: 'A taste of Tianjin, thanks for the server support.'

start_state.location: At home, full of energy to welcome Thursday.
start_state.mood: Focused and efficient; looking forward to a breakthrough in the handicraft class preparations.

end_state.location: Home study: the time for the first trial class of the handicraft workshop has been set, the thank-you fried dough twists have been mailed, and the restart of jogging is going well.
end_state.mood: Feeling at ease and accomplished. The public welfare project has moved from a vague commitment into the countdown stage, and I can see hope for physical recovery.

events.name: Early morning jog for 3 kilometers

events.name: Normal workday attendance; handled design tasks.

During the lunch break, he took time to browse the badminton team's WeChat group and saw that the members had already spontaneously started discussing their preferred positions. He felt that the role of team captain was more interesting than he had imagined.

events.name: After work, wrote and published a recruitment notice for the handicraft class

Soon after, he received inquiry messages from two parents in the group.

events.name: Evening organization of the week's affairs
events.description: Back in the study in the evening, Ye Mingxuan reviewed the week's main accomplishments in his notebook—asset adjustment reached the target, the crawler database went live, the team was formed, the craft class start date was confirmed, and jogging was resumed—and felt satisfied with the highly productive week. 2025-08.daily_overview: Saturday was spent on a rainy, overcast day. Ye Mingxuan cancelled his outdoor plans, using the morning for the first badminton team group training (observation and basic practice only), and the afternoon for rest and household chores. In the morning he did 30 minutes of basic swings and tactical explanations at the sports hall; in the afternoon he tidied his carpentry corner and maintained tools; at dusk he browsed the Qinghai-Tibet route guidebook, and in the evening watched a variety show with his father, enjoying a quiet family time.

events.name: The badminton team's first training session.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Ye Mingxuan and his teammates gathered as scheduled at the badminton hall in the Tiangong University gymnasium. Since he was still recovering from an allergic reaction, he did not do intense play; he only took part in 30 minutes of basic swing practice and tactical instruction, while an experienced teammate led the warm-up. Ye Mingxuan sat on the sideline, carefully observing the players' movements and recording each person's basic skill level, laying the foundation for making a training plan later.

events.name: After returning home, washed and hung clothes and tidied up the house
events.description: After training, he returned home. Ye Mingxuan sorted a week's worth of laundry into the washing machine. Since it was cloudy and he couldn't dry clothes outdoors, he hung the washed clothes on the balcony to air-dry in ventilation mode. Then he tidied up the living room clutter and vacuumed the floor.

events.name: Simple self-cooked lunch at noon.
events.description: At noon, his mother went to visit relatives, his father watched TV in the living room, and Ye Mingxuan cooked himself a bowl of tomato egg noodles with the pickled cucumbers made a few days earlier — simple and refreshing. After the meal, he checked the ingredients in the refrigerator to confirm there was no potential allergy risk.

events.name: In the afternoon, tidy up the woodworking corner and maintain tools.
events.description: In the afternoon, as the rain gradually eased, Ye Mingxuan cleaned the sawdust off the workbench in his balcony woodworking corner, wiped the hand saw, chisels, and plane blades one by one with a cotton cloth, and applied a thin layer of anti-rust oil. He rearranged the layout on the tool rack, placing commonly used tools within easy reach on the right side. During the tidying-up, he found that the handle of a small saw was a little loose, so he tightened it with a screwdriver.

events.name: In the evening, browsed Qinghai-Tibet route guides and off-road vehicle reviews.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan curled up on the sofa, opened his laptop, and browsed several Qinghai-Tibet route self-driving guides that Wu Bin had shared on an outdoor app. He carefully read the driving checkpoints from Golmud to Lhasa and the high-altitude precautions. He then opened several reviews of new mid-size SUV off-road performance that Wu Bin had sent, compared the vehicles' ground clearance, four-wheel-drive system, and trunk capacity, and updated several candidate models in his notes.

2025-08.daily_overview: The last day of August ended with morning exercise and the start of the new season. In the early morning, Ye Mingxuan jogged 2 kilometers in South Canal Park, then walked 3 kilometers with his father, enjoying the cool-weather morning exercise. In the morning, he bought equipment for next week's badminton training and reserved the first training court. In the afternoon, he checked the procurement status of teaching materials for the handicraft class. In the evening, he and Master Qian and Director Li finally confirmed the trial lecture arrangement for September 7. At night, alone in his study, he reviewed the ups and downs of the past August, wrote an August summary in his diary, and looked forward to September with hope.

events.name: Morning jog and a walk with Dad
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan put on his running shoes and went to South Canal Park, jogging 2 km easily at a pace of 6:30 per kilometer as a continuation of recovery training. Then he walked 3 km along the park greenway with his father, who came as promised. His father's blood pressure was stable, and the father and son chatted about the weekend arrangements as they walked.

events.name: Purchase badminton equipment
events.description: After morning exercise and breakfast at home, Ye Mingxuan went to a sporting goods store in Xiqing District and bought an entry-level carbon fiber badminton racket and two tubes of training shuttlecocks for himself. Considering that some team members might be beginners, he bought extra grip tapes and wrist guards as backups.

events.name: Book the first training venue and send a group notice
events.description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan called a well-reviewed badminton hall near the company and reserved two hours on Thursday evening. He posted a notice in the Haitai Badminton Team Training Group specifying that the first training session would be from 7 to 9 p.m. on Thursday, the location, suggested items to bring, and a list of shared equipment he had prepared. Team members replied with acknowledgments, and Zhou Tao sent a clenched-fist cheering emoji.

events.name: Checked the teaching aid list in the afternoon.
events.description: After lunch, Ye Mingxuan took out the teaching materials list for the handicraft class and checked off items one by one against the things already at home and the supplies he had purchased. The two small saws and a box of sandpaper lent by Master Qian were in place, and the basic facilities in the community activity room had been confirmed usable. He still needed to buy some children's safety gloves and wood glue. In his phone memo, he listed the last few items to purchase before the class.

events.name: In the evening, confirmed the final arrangements for the handicraft class.
events.description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan sent confirmation messages via WeChat to Master Qian and Director Li to verify the time of the first trial lecture at 9:30 a.m. on September 7 and the lesson plan for the marble maze box. Both replied confirming it was correct. Director Li also told him that seven teenagers had already registered. Ye Mingxuan forwarded the registration list to Master Qian for final confirmation.

events.name: Evening August review and diary
events.description: At nine o'clock in the evening, Ye Mingxuan opened his personal digital diary in his study. He reviewed the major events of August—the mid-month move into the new home, the warm birthday spent in the new house, the scare of two emergency hospital visits due to seafood allergies, the urgent adjustment of the investment portfolio to a conservative allocation, the transformation of his woodworking skills into community public-service classes, forming the department badminton team, the technical breakthrough in the crawler database, and the invitation to join an open-source data analysis project—though he had only just claimed the CSV cleaning module, it was his first time participating in formal collaborative development. He wrote: 'August was a month of upheaval and restructuring. My body gave me the harshest lesson, but I also gained growth beyond technology. September begins with the first sound of the saw in the community classroom, and also with the first pull request on GitHub.' After writing and saving the document, he got up and turned off the string lights on the balcony, and the last night of August quietly came to a close.

start_state.location: At home, the last day of August, with crisp autumn air
start_state.mood: Calm with a sense of fulfillment, ready to bring August to a complete close.

end_state.location: At home in the study, the August diary has been written, and the time for the first trial lesson of the community handicraft class has been fully confirmed.
end_state.mood: Calm and fulfilled. Looking back on the turbulent August with gratitude, and full of anticipation for the upcoming September.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day of the new year, Ye Mingxuan and his parents went to the Yangliuqing New Year picture market to soak up the traditional festive atmosphere, immersed in the bustling and joyful holiday mood. While resting at the market, his father recalled his factory years, adding a warm cross-generational dimension to the family outing. After returning home in the evening, his mother brought the day to a cozy close with a table of her best dishes. Late at night, after the family had gone to bed, Ye Mingxuan sat alone in the study making final detailed preparations for the next day's annual performance review.

events.name: Early morning family outing preparations
events.description: On the morning of New Year's Day, Ye Mingxuan dressed up neatly with his parents. His mother, Wang Xiulan, straightened his collar for him, while his father, Ye Jianguo, carefully checked the thermos and cloth shopping bag they carried. After confirming the route to Yangliuqing Ancient Town, the three left the house chatting and laughing.

events.name: Heading to the Yangliuqing New Year picture market
events.description: Ye Mingxuan drove his parents from Zhongbei Avenue in Xiqing District toward Yangliuqing Ancient Town. Considering that the New Year's market would be crowded and parking inconvenient, he parked in a lot a bit farther away, and the three walked about 10 minutes to arrive. Along the way, his mother Wang Xiulan looked at the winter street scene outside the window and cheerfully recalled the amusing story of Ye Mingxuan riding on his father's shoulders while visiting the New Year's market as a child. The car was filled with warm family affection.

events.name: Visiting and shopping at the ancient town's New Year goods market
events.description: The family of three immersed themselves among the rows upon rows of stalls at the Yangliuqing New Year painting market. Ye Mingxuan sometimes paused to admire a New Year painting of a child holding a fish, sometimes helped his mother pick paper window cuttings and Spring Festival couplets with auspicious meanings, and occasionally raised his phone to photograph the traditional handicrafts full of Tianjin's local charm, feeling the lively festive atmosphere washing over him.

events.name: Sharing memories of the parents' generation during the break.
events.description: In the market rest area, his father, Ye Jianguo, holding a cup of hot tea, was touched by the lively scene and told Ye Mingxuan and Wang Xiulan at length about what New Year's Day was like at the Tianjin No. 1 Machine Tool Plant when he was young: the factory parties, commendations of advanced workers, and the collective passion that belonged to an era. Ye Mingxuan listened seriously, frequently asking for details, and gained a deeper understanding of the rigorous, honor-filled working years of his father's generation.

events.name: Went home and organized the New Year goods.
events.description: After shopping, Ye Mingxuan drove his parents back to their home on Zhongbei Avenue. The three of them laid out the New Year goods they had bought—New Year paintings, Spring Festival couplets, and window paper-cuts—in the living room. Ye Mingxuan and his father eagerly gestured about where to paste them on Chinese New Year's Eve, making advance plans for the New Year home decoration.

events.name: A warm New Year's Day dinner
events.description: In the evening, his mother Wang Xiulan was busy in the kitchen, carefully preparing several dishes that Ye Mingxuan usually loves, such as braised pork and steamed sea bass. The family sat around the dining table under warm yellow light, the three of them savoring the delicious food while sharing their experiences and feelings from the day, and the air was filled with peace and warmth.

events.name: Late-night organization of performance review meeting materials
events.description: As the night grew deeper and his parents went to their rooms to rest, Ye Mingxuan opened his laptop alone in the study. He pulled up, one by one, the project records, technical achievements, and personal work improvement logs he had handled in 2024, and, against the key points he had listed in his notebook in advance, methodically compiled them into a booklet, quietly making thorough final preparations for the next day's performance appraisal interview with his superior, Gao Zhiyuan.

start_state.mood: Calm and full of anticipation for the new year.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and confident because well-prepared

2025-01.daily_overview: On a Saturday morning with scattered snow flurries, Ye Mingxuan went alone to the community health service center as scheduled for his annual physical exam. When Dr. Liu Wentao, holding the report, clearly told him that his height was 1.73 meters, his weight 75.2 kg, and his BMI had reached the overweight threshold of 25.1, and advised him to increase aerobic exercise, the chord of "I must make a change" was struck in Ye Mingxuan's heart. That night, he not only decisively made a detailed fitness plan but also openly shared the doctor's advice with his family during dinner, winning his mother's support on diet. That was how the change began.

events.name: Go to the community hospital to check in and wait to be seen
events.description: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan put on a thick coat, took an umbrella, and set off from home, walking through a thin layer of light snow to the Community Health Service Center in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District. After arriving, he checked in smoothly at the guidance desk and then sat quietly in the waiting area.

events.name: Complete the annual routine physical exam item by item.
events.description: Under the gentle guidance of Dr. Liu Wentao, Ye Mingxuan visited each department in turn and completed a series of routine checkups including blood routine, urine routine, electrocardiogram, blood pressure, and height/weight. The medical staff performed skillfully throughout, and he only needed to follow along.

events.name: Physical exam result interpretation and health alerts
events.description: After receiving the summary report, Dr. Liu pointed at the data and explained it in detail to Ye Mingxuan: height 1.73 meters, weight 75.2 kg, BMI 25.1, already within the overweight range. Fortunately, his blood pressure and other indicators were still normal. He patted Ye Mingxuan on the shoulder and earnestly advised him to add aerobic exercises such as jogging and swimming to his daily routine, and to consciously limit excessive oil intake in his diet. At this, Ye Mingxuan's expression turned serious and he nodded solemnly.

events.name: Schedule a follow-up checkup for indicators in two months
events.description: On Dr. Liu's advice, Ye Mingxuan immediately used the hospital's appointment system to book a follow-up appointment three months later, i.e., early March. He decided to use this defined period to genuinely test the effects of his upcoming lifestyle adjustments. He carefully put away the follow-up appointment slip and the doctor's tips together.

events.name: Adjust the workout plan in response to the health checkup recommendations.
events.description: In the afternoon, after returning home, Ye Mingxuan sat at his desk, turned on his computer, and created a new Excel spreadsheet. Based on Dr. Liu's advice, he made an initial fitness plan for himself: arrange 2-3 gym sessions per week, alternating strength training with aerobic exercise; strength training focuses on basic movements such as squats, bench presses, and rows, while aerobic exercise includes treadmill jogging and swimming. He highlighted the doctor's recommendation of "at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise per week" in red font and saved the plan in his phone memo.

events.name: Family health communication at dinner
events.description: That evening at the dinner table, Ye Mingxuan proactively told his parents about the day's medical check-up results and the doctor's advice. After hearing this, his mother Wang Xiulan immediately said she would pay more attention to less oil and less salt in cooking, and would make more steamed fish and vegetables. His father Ye Jianguo also nodded approvingly and supported his son in adjusting his living habits. Ye Mingxuan felt his family's support and became more confident about the upcoming health improvement plan.

start_state.mood: Keep a calm mindset and act according to plan

end_state.mood: Alerted by the physical examination results, but has gained the motivation to change and the support of family.

events.name: Accepted the best-man invitation for a childhood friend's wedding.

Ye Mingxuan had just finished the morning cleaning when he received a wedding invitation with a unique design, delivered in person by his childhood friend Zhang Wei. The date on the invitation was clearly printed as May 20. Ye Mingxuan smiled knowingly and immediately called Zhang Wei. On the other end of the line, Zhang Wei excitedly explained the reason for coming. Without any hesitation, Ye Mingxuan smiled and said he would be honored, gladly accepting the solemn invitation to be the best man. The two briefly discussed the initial arrangements over the phone.

events.name: Organizing and caring for the ancient coin collection.

He carefully wiped them with a soft cloth dipped in a small amount of maintenance oil. He especially liked the Yuan Datou coin from the third year of the Republic of China, with clear edge teeth and a warm patina. While maintaining the coins, he updated the collection list and condition records in his notebook.

events.name: Had an online exchange with ancient coin collector friends.

It was a WeChat message from Zhao Jianguo, a fellow collector in Xi'an, sharing a Hubei Guangxu silver dollar he had just acquired, with high-definition detail photos attached. The two then chatted for half an hour about the varieties and current market prices of late-Qing machine-struck coins. Ye Mingxuan also asked a technical question about cleaning the coin surface and gained a lot.

events.name: Mother brought up the topic of blind dating again.

Ye Mingxuan smiled and waved his hand, politely declining with the excuse "Wait until I get my health and housing matters sorted out first." His mother sighed, while his father Ye Jianguo mediated, saying, "The kid has his own plans, no rush." Ye Mingxuan secretly thought to himself that it was time to properly prioritize his annual goals.

In the afternoon, he paid a special visit to financial manager Zhang Wei and formally switched his investment portfolio strategy from [Steady Appreciation] to [Capital Preservation and Liquidity] to accommodate the large capital needs for a future home purchase. In the evening, his colleague Zhou Tao invited him and Li Xiang to a newly opened Mala Xiang Guo restaurant near the company. The three chatted about work and games, and the atmosphere was lively. After the meal, he went home, felt that his diet had gotten out of control, reflected, and used his phone to record a remedial plan before resting.

events.name: Organize family financial records
events.description: After returning home for a simple lunch, Ye Mingxuan organized his fund holdings details, the home purchase down payment plan drafted over the weekend, and the income and expenditure records of the past few months into a folder, ensuring the afternoon consultation would be well-targeted.

events.name: Go to the bank to meet with the wealth manager
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan left home on time by car and arrived at the Private Banking Department of the China Merchants Bank branch on Youyi Road, Hexi District. After waiting a short while at the front desk, he was welcomed by Manager Zhang Wei into a quiet VIP room.

events.name: Discuss adjusting the investment portfolio toward a home purchase
events.description: In the VIP room, Manager Zhang Wei opened his computer and called up a review of Ye Mingxuan's fund holdings performance in recent years. Ye Mingxuan candidly explained that he might use most of the funds as a down payment for a house within half a year. After hearing this, Zhang Wei professionally suggested that he transfer some of his flexible funds out of equity-oriented funds and reallocate them to highly liquid, low-risk money market fund products to fully ensure future capital flexibility. After careful consideration, Ye Mingxuan fully agreed with this plan.

events.name: Execute asset reallocation
events.description: After finalizing the plan with Zhang Wei, Ye Mingxuan immediately took out his phone and logged into mobile banking. Under the manager's guidance, he completed the asset conversion, redeeming the designated portion of flexible funds and transferring it into a low-risk money market fund pool. Looking at the new portfolio distribution chart, he felt a stronger sense of control over his home-buying progress.

events.name: Arranged a mala xiangguo dinner with colleagues.
events.description: In the evening, colleague Zhou Tao suggested in the department group chat going to Chuan Wei Ju near the company for mala xiangguo. Li Xiang immediately responded. Ye Mingxuan, though thinking about his diet, did not want to dampen his friends' spirits and agreed to go. The three ordered a mildly spicy pot base and chatted while eating about recent project progress and bits of their personal lives. In the cheerful atmosphere, Ye Mingxuan temporarily set aside his dietary concerns and ate much more greasy food than usual. The dinner did not end until after 9 p.m.

events.name: Self-reflection and remedial plan after returning home from a dinner gathering
events.description: Returning home at 9:40 p.m., Ye Mingxuan washed up, sat at his desk for a while, opened the diet-tracking app on his phone, and logged today's mala xiangguo. Looking at the 'deficit' in this week's diet log, he felt some regret for not sticking to his control plan, and immediately wrote in his phone memo: the weekend diet must be strictly controlled—make homemade chicken breast salad on Saturday, and add extra cardio at the gym on Sunday. Only after making this remedial plan did he feel somewhat reassured and go to bed.

start_state.mood: Focused on completing the final tasks of the week.

end_state.mood: Felt relaxed, but a little guilty about losing control of my diet. After making a remedial plan, I felt somewhat reassured.

2025-01.daily_overview: Under the warm winter sun on Saturday, Ye Mingxuan set aside the complex drawings and data for a while and walked into a pottery studio in Yangliuqing Ancient Town to take on a completely new hands-on experience. At the spinning wheel, he tried to shape a lump of clay, a process that gave him a creative pleasure completely different from working with cold metal parts. In the evening, his childhood friend Zhang Wei invited him to their usual place for barbecue to celebrate their groomsman bond, and the two talked late into the night—another high-calorie meal. After returning home, feeling a little uneasy about two consecutive days of indulgent eating, he decided he had to return to strict discipline the next day.

events.name: Signed up for a pottery experience class
events.description: While wandering through the community in the morning, Ye Mingxuan was drawn to an ad on the bulletin board for a weekend pottery-throwing trial class at a ceramics studio in Yangliuqing Ancient Town. Recalling his love of woodworking, which was also a handicraft, he became interested at once and signed up through the phone number on the ad for the 3-hour trial class that afternoon.

events.name: Go to and immerse in a pottery wheel-throwing experience
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan tidied up a bit and walked to the pottery studio in the ancient town of Yangliuqing. In the space filled with the smell of clay, under the hands-on guidance of a professional pottery teacher, he learned how to find the center and how to apply force. Although his first attempt was clumsy, he stayed completely focused, watching a lump of clay gradually rise and take shape in his hands, eventually becoming a crooked but heartfelt clay mug blank. The process was fascinating.

events.name: Celebrated with childhood friend Zhang Wei eating grilled skewers.
events.description: In the evening, after carefully leaving the clay blank at the studio, Ye Mingxuan went as arranged to Old-Flavor BBQ Skewers, the place he and Zhang Wei often went to. To thank him for agreeing to be his best man, Zhang Wei specially ordered a table full of skewers, grilled fish, and beer. The two chatted from wedding preparations to embarrassing childhood stories, and amid the warmth of the charcoal fire and the aroma of the grilled food, the meal lasted nearly three hours. Ye Mingxuan knew clearly that this had deviated from his diet plan again, but faced with his close friend's sincere hospitality and the rare get-together, he chose to temporarily set aside his restraint and returned home after enjoying himself to the full.

events.name: Evening resolve to return to discipline.
events.description: When he got home in the evening, Ye Mingxuan stood in front of the mirror and touched his slightly protruding belly. Two consecutive days of eating out had caused his weight number to rebound noticeably. He took a deep breath, opened the memo on his phone, and solemnly wrote down the next day's to-do items: 1. Breakfast: oatmeal with milk; lunch: homemade chicken breast salad. 2. Go to the gym in the afternoon for 40 minutes on the treadmill. He was determined to make up for these two days of indulgence with action.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, full of anticipation for novel experiences.

end_state.mood: Felt satisfied with the handmade creation but a little guilty about losing control of his diet

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Ye Mingxuan strictly kept the promise he had made the night before. In the morning, he enjoyed a healthy breakfast of oatmeal with milk and eggs; lunch was a homemade chicken breast and vegetable salad. In the afternoon, he made a special trip to the gym for a 40-minute treadmill cardio session, the sweat carrying away the greasiness of the previous day. After returning home, he focused on the principle design calculations for the core transmission module and drew preliminary drawings. In the evening, his mother once again tried to put photos of 'other people's daughters' in front of him, sparking a subtle conversation about personal planning. Facing his mother's earnest expectations, Ye Mingxuan gently but firmly gave his life priority ranking of 'buying a house - getting promoted - dating', and received his father's understanding and support. Late at night, he sat at his desk and wrote this order into his notebook, feeling fulfilled and clear about his goals.

events.name: Maintain strict dietary control.
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Ye Mingxuan politely declined the traditional fried dough cake his mother had prepared and made himself a bowl of oatmeal with milk, along with a boiled egg. At noon, he made a large salad by hand with lettuce, red cabbage, cherry tomatoes, and ready-to-eat chicken breast, drizzling it with a little vinaigrette. It was refreshing and satisfying.

events.name: Dedicated cardio day at the gym.
events.description: In the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan changed into his workout clothes and went to Limei Fitness Center. He did not do strength training; instead, he went straight to the treadmill and ran at a steady pace of 7 minutes per kilometer for 40 minutes, covering a total distance of about 5.7 kilometers. During the run, he listened to a podcast, focused on his breathing and stride, and felt his body gradually lighten.

events.name: Principle design and calculation of the core transmission module.
events.description: In the afternoon, after returning from the gym, Ye Mingxuan took a shower and refreshed himself. He sat down at his desk and began complex mechanical calculations and conceptual design for the most critical transmission module in the plan, and drew preliminary drawings in CAD.

events.name: A brief blind date episode after the meal.
events.description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan was clearing the dishes when his mother Wang Xiulan sat down beside him with her phone and pulled out a photo of a girl sent by a distant relative, muttering, "Xiaoming, take a look. This girl is quite good and also in Tianjin, one year younger than you. Would you like to get to know her?" Ye Mingxuan looked at his mother's expectant eyes, smiled and waved his hand, and replied in a gentle but firm tone: "Mom, no rush. Let me buy a house first." His father Ye Jianguo, who was watching the news nearby, also interjected at the right moment: "Let him arrange his own affairs. Don't worry about it." His mother sighed at this, feeling a bit disappointed, but helplessly put her phone away.

events.name: Establish priorities for personal planning
events.description: At night, after his parents had gone to their rooms to rest, Ye Mingxuan sat at his desk, recalling the conversation at the dinner table just now. He opened his notebook with the dark green cover and solemnly wrote down the three words 'buying a home - promotion - love' on a blank page. Looking at these words, he gained an extremely clear understanding of the main line of his life for the next one to two years, and felt more fulfilled and goal-oriented inside.

start_state.mood: Leisure and ease on a Sunday morning

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and goal-oriented, with progress made in both work and life plans.

2025-01.daily_overview: The new week began with light winter snow. Ye Mingxuan threw all his energy into deepening the technical solution design. Like assembling precision building blocks, he completed the designs of the control module and auxiliary support structure one after another, and repeatedly refined and optimized the core transmission module completed the previous day, ensuring the feasibility of the entire solution and seamless integration among modules. After long hours of focused desk work, his shoulders and neck began to feel sore in the afternoon, so he had to get up and move around regularly and apply heat packs for relief. In the evening, he carried out the first formal workout of the week, completing high-intensity strength training and 40 minutes of cardio under his coach's guidance, and his body found a balance between soreness and release.

events.name: Completed the control module and auxiliary structure design
events.description: After a full day of desk work, Ye Mingxuan continued to go deeper on the overall framework he had already built, using CAD software to design the detailed structure of the control module and the key auxiliary support components. Each time he finished arranging a part, he switched to the 3D view and repeatedly checked for interference with the surrounding structures.

events.name: Fine-tune and optimize the core module.
events.description: After completing the auxiliary parts, Ye Mingxuan re-examined his previously completed core transmission module design. Combining the newly completed surrounding structures today, he made fine adjustments and optimizations to several connection and support points of the transmission module, repeatedly checking the dimension chain to maximize the stability and manufacturability of the overall solution.

events.name: Self-care for neck and shoulder discomfort
events.description: Around 3 p.m. while working in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan felt his shoulders and neck gradually become tight and sore, and he realized that his strain symptoms might be recurring. So he set himself an alarm to get up and move for 5 minutes every 45 minutes, took out a heat pack from the drawer and applied it to his shoulders and neck, and did simple neck and shoulder stretches during the breaks. The discomfort was somewhat relieved.

events.name: Evening gym: Monday intensive training.
events.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan rushed to Limei Fitness Center. Under the guidance of coach Wang Jian, he completed a strength training session focused on compound movements such as squats, bench presses, and deadlifts, with sets and weights slightly increased from last time. Then he did 40 minutes of high-intensity interval cardio on the treadmill, with his peak heart rate reaching 160 bpm, and sweat soaked his workout clothes. After the training, he felt his whole-body muscles both tired and pleasantly refreshed.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, ready to enter deep work state.

end_state.mood: Satisfied with the gradual refinement of the plan, and the shoulder and neck discomfort was relieved after treatment

2025-09.daily_overview: In the morning, Ye Mingxuan took leave to accompany his father to a follow-up for hypertension. The results were great, so he recorded it in his health diary and rewarded his father with a pair of running shoes. In the afternoon, he hurried back to the company; the 3D-printed samples had arrived and he did a preliminary inspection. In the evening, father and son tried on the new shoes and jogged in front of their home. The family health management achieved a milestone, and after returning home they did some stretching, growing even closer.

events.name: Accompany my father for his hypertension recheck
events.description: At eight in the morning, Ye Mingxuan accompanied his father Ye Jianguo to the Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center in Xiqing District, where family doctor Liu Wentao conducted a regular follow-up examination. Dr. Liu measured his blood pressure at 132/85 mmHg, a significant improvement from three months ago, and praised Ye Jianguo's execution in diet and exercise management. Ye Mingxuan asked in detail about how to deal with blood pressure fluctuations in autumn, adjusting medication times, and other questions, and confirmed with the doctor the goals for a low-salt diet and daily walking steps. While waiting for his number to be called, he also checked the confirmation information for the Shenzhen flight and hotel booked last night on his phone; everything was correct.

events.name: Record family health diary and buy running shoes
events.description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan entered the complete data from this follow-up examination, the doctor's advice, and the three-month intervention effect comparison into the iPad health diary template. To reward his father for sticking to a low-salt diet and morning exercise, he directly ordered a pair of professional cushioned running shoes on an e-commerce platform with next-day delivery, encouraging his father to upgrade from brisk walking to jogging. He also added a "mood self-rating" entry and gave himself 8 points for today.

events.name: Initial inspection of 3D-printed samples upon arrival.

Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang opened the box together in the inspection room, using calipers and a roughness tester to conduct item-by-item preliminary checks on appearance and dimensions. They found slight step marks on the support surface, but all critical mating dimensions were within tolerance. The two photographed and recorded the abnormal points, then sent the sample to the mechanics laboratory to arrange formal performance testing the next day.

events.name: Evening father-and-son trial run of new shoes and at-home stretching
events.description: After work, the running shoes had arrived, and Ye Mingxuan had his father try them on at home. Half an hour after dinner, the father and son went out and jogged and walked about 2.5 kilometers along the greenway on Zhongbei Avenue. Ye Mingxuan shared the technique of forefoot striking, and his father gradually got used to the cushioned feel. After the run, they returned home, and Ye Mingxuan did a 20-minute home rehabilitation stretching routine, including core activation and lower-limb stretching, and recorded his father's feelings about his first jog.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Saturday, Ye Mingxuan got up early to fulfill his civic duty of voting in the election. Then he talked with the community director about the venue for the public-welfare class and received a new commitment of support. Immediately afterward, he hurried to Master Qian's woodworking workshop and attended the first day of the traditional mortise-and-tenon training class. He spent the whole day immersed in making a small rosewood offering cabinet, from cutting the timber to assembling the frame, and gained a lot. In the evening, he went home and reflected on the day's experience, delighted at the dual improvement in his craftsmanship and his relationship with the community.

events.name: Vote in the early morning and pick up souvenirs.
events.description: After getting up at 7:30 a.m. and having a simple breakfast, Ye Mingxuan took his ID card and voter registration card and walked to the polling station in the Zhongbei Avenue community, arriving around 8:00. Under the staff's guidance, he verified his identity, received a ballot, filled it out carefully, and cast it into the ballot box. After voting, he received a commemorative bookmark printed with the community emblem at the exit, and also confirmed that his voter registration information was accurate.

events.name: Discussed the venue for the public-interest class with the community director.
events.description: After the voting ended, Ye Mingxuan went to the community service center office and talked face-to-face with Director Liu Jianguo about the development of the youth handicraft class, showing the feedback drawings from the children in the last session. Director Liu expressed satisfaction with the activity's results and verbally promised to expand the activity room's usage time from Sunday mornings to Saturday afternoons next year, providing more ample venue support for the public-interest woodworking activities.

events.name: First class of the mortise-and-tenon training course (morning)
events.description: Before 9 o'clock, Ye Mingxuan arrived at Master Qian Jianguo's woodworking workshop. On the first day of the training class, Master Qian first explained the structural principles of the traditional corner mortise-and-tenon joint and the clamp-head mortise-and-tenon joint, then distributed a piece of rosewood lumber to each person. Under the master's guidance, Ye Mingxuan cut the lumber and performed initial planing, determined the basic dimensions of the components for a Ming-style small offering cabinet based on the drawings, and used a marking gauge to mark the positions of the tenons and mortises.

events.name: Brief midday rest and tool maintenance
events.description: The morning class ended at 12:00. Ye Mingxuan swept up the wood shavings and put the tools away. He went home quickly to eat the seafood-free lunch his mother had prepared, rested for a bit, and shared with his father what he had gained from the voting and community communication.

events.name: First class of the mortise-and-tenon training course (afternoon)
events.description: Class continues from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM. First, finely plane the components from the morning to ensure all sides are flat and square, then mark the mortise and tenon joints precisely according to the drawings. Following Master Qian's step-by-step demonstration, Ye Mingxuan begins assembling the frame of a small altar cabinet, learning how to control the tightness of tenon insertion. After repeated adjustments, the frame takes initial shape and is structurally stable, giving him a great sense of accomplishment.

During the buffet lunch, he exchanged business cards with several alumni. In the free-exchange session during the afternoon tea break, an alumnus's experience with a 3D printing outsourcing side business inspired him to seriously consider for the first time the monetization potential of combining woodworking with 3D printing. After the event, he went home and listed his initial ideas in his study, and a new window of career exploration quietly opened.

events.name: Easy morning run

After the run, he did simple stretching, took a shower, and had breakfast.

events.name: Attend the intelligent manufacturing alumni seminar
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan arrived at the conference center of his alma mater, Tiangong University, and checked in. In the morning, he listened to three experts' talks on intelligent production lines, digital twins, and additive manufacturing, and took notes. During the Q&A session, he briefly reported to Professor Chen Jianguo about his recent work using CATIA surface design combined with 3D printing to tackle technical challenges. Professor Chen happily patted him on the shoulder.

During the free-exchange session at the afternoon tea break, a designer alumnus who had just bought an apartment in Tianjin mentioned that he used his spare time to take outsourced orders for 3D-printed figurine models and custom home parts, steadily earning 3,000 yuan a month to help pay his mortgage. This real-life example struck a chord with Ye Mingxuan. He thought of his own woodworking skills and the company's 3D printing resources, and for the first time seriously began to consider a side-business path.

events.name: Go home to reflect and record thoughts.
events.description: After the seminar ended at 4:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan cycled back home in Xiqing District. He closed the study door and quickly jotted down keywords in his phone notes: custom small woodworking pieces, 3D-printed wood molds, ancient coin display boxes, and community woodworking experience class fees. He then opened his computer to search for prices of 3D-printed wood-plastic materials, wrote down his initial ideas and doubts about feasibility, and decided to do a systematic investigation later. In the evening, he chatted with Coach Wang Jian on WeChat, saying he wanted to resume personal training in October to strengthen his strength training.
